tei:div.tei:p: r+ṣa44rmya snye —— ‘ chisnyeci rmo(r+sha dze /4chos l+lī (1 sa 4 pha rdzo tre—༈ — — ni —— gyi —༷4༷chortso skyobaspros pa skyob 95skyob bde skyid 'tsho/ kan sto g.yang ldan phyug mo'i mi tshog yin/ 1984lor nub byang mi rigasaslob grwa chen mo'i mong ngapang pha mo'i bsang sa'or sa pha ba / grangs yi mi rigasaskad mig sde khag nas slob mthar tsa /4 / snye / ( gho / phyin/ bod kyi rig gnasalon skyong spel ba'i bya ba don du gnyer nas lo ngo nyi shu lhag 'das pa'i ring la snga — gtso tu 〈mi rigagartsom rig sto lajug 〉dang ṭ+wāṃlho nub ’ mi rigs slob chen gyi rig gzhung dusadeb〉 sogasakyi gtsos/ dusadeb khag tu bod rgya yig rigs gar+ṣa kyisabade skyid 'tshos rtsom snyig byas/ bod kyi rtsom rig dang rigaganasaskor gyi dpyad rtsom sum d+ngha sa / / cu lhag spel ba dang / 〈lod med don gyiglu mkhan〉 dang 4 ṭ+wāṃ bod kyi kun spyod zhiga'ajug〉 ṭ+wāṃbasamatha'i snying stobs ltosnyamanyami / lko ༷ ‘ ram̐risduspyo 4 —— ci sgyurdzi ru zi~X dang rig gnagaspel ma〉 sobata kyisamatshoni pa'i ljags sgyu ’ rtsom pod gsum dang / klong che'in rab shākhunamasapa dri med r+ghaṃ cinya’ dzi 4 ci ske ṭ+wāṃgle nga/ ༵ chi cicicho d+nghalha ne ri 'od zerogyi ṭ+wāṃgrub mtha' si dzi+otsho mdzod 〉 rgya yig tu tre —ram̐ /ce 4cho cistotsho ci rimo / bsgyur pa pod gog d+kuspobar sgrun byas/ da lta lho nub ye 'i 6 / mi rigasaslob r+sā gyi bod rig pa'i slob gling na dge phyo lha7zhe/thu tsā wa ṭ+wāṃ two//ri d+ku rku chi chisdeX rwa/ lgi/rtsa rgan gyi 'gan lkor bawo yod/si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang / /trī//
krasde sdi da rirngos༈ rto tāri ngh+ru /ku/ rngos /si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun bang /

sems pa'i rtsom gyi lam bu+o/myang dpyad phra ma' bsang gtar/bde skyid 'tsho/si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dkar chagapar du bskrun pa'i zhu mchid/ (1)tshe srog las mched pa'i me stag gi 'phro 'du/ (1)gsar du bzhad pa'i me tog gi gang bu/ (11)bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la gsar du dpyad pa/ (25)rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ / ci (49)sha tsha ba'i rkyen gyis khong gis gzhas btang / (124)rma 'bri'i mgo khungs nas brdol ba'i snyan ngag (140)a le la shākyas lon byed pa/ (157)lam ni 'tshol zhib pa'i rdog sner 'then yod/ (180)'gog thabs bral ba'i nyams 'gyur gyi ri mo/ (200)jo mo glang ma'i 'dabs rol nas khong gi mig mda' har gyis ri tshom brgal/(222)zhu 'phrin mdza' ba'i gleng mol/ (244)tshe stod kyi rang rnam mdor bsdus/ (250)1

'das song gi rang rgyus ban bun du brjod pa rmi lam snang ba'i zin tho/(255)gangs ri'i chu phran/ (277)gsang dgos don med/ (283)rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ (288)pha yul gyi lcang ma'i sdong rgan/ (290)rtsom 'bri'i myong tshor dang lta tshul rags pa/ (298)dka' sdug gi lam nas 'ong ba'i mi (304)rtsom mkhan 31/ (314)rang rnam/ (321)bu mo'i sems kyi rang mdangs/ (331)rang gi byung ba hril gyis brjod pa rgyud mangs rol dbyangs/ (337)nga dang sgyu rtsal gyi lam sne/ (345)dka' spyad pa zhig gi gom 'gros/ (351)2

༄7/ /par du bskrun pa'i zhu mchid/lo ngo bcu lhag gi sngon nas bzung / nga rang gis deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom dang rtsom pa po'i dpung khag de min da dung gsar rtsom gyi gnas bab sogs deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig gi phyogs so sor do snang chen pos brtag dpyad gtong ba'i 'go brtsams pa dang / deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi stegs bur go gnas cung zad thob cing / pha skad kyi rtsom rgyun skyong ba'i na gzhon rtsom pa po rnams rtsom rig gi bshul lam du zhugs tshun gyi myong ba sna tshogs rgyus lon byas te thabs tshul du ma'i lam nas dpyad brjod byed pa'i ched dang / lhag par du pha skad kyi rtsom rgyun skyong ba'i gsar rtsom pa rnams kyi brtsams chos dang 'brel ba'i rtsom gyi bsam blo dang sgyu rtsal khyad chos sogs skad yig gis bar du chod pa'i mi rigs gzhan pa'i klog mkhan dag la ngo sprod gang legs byed pa bcas kyi ched du/ dus rabs gong ma'i lo rabs dgu bcu'i 'go tsam nas rang gi bsam tshul rnams yi ger phab ste rtsom bsdu brda tho'i tshul gyis rtsom pa po rnams la sbran pa yin/ rtsom pa po mang che bas rang gi lo rgyus dang rtsom rig 1

gi lam bur zhugs pa'i myong ba sogs rang mos kyi rtsom gshis bskyangs te snga gzhug tu bskur 'ongs pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis da lta'i bar du lan ci yang ma byin/ lar bskur 'ongs pa'i rtsom de dag phyogs gcig tu bsgrig ste dpyad gtam dang bcas snga mo nas klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du bstar ba'i 'char gzhi yod kyang / gcig nas rtsom pa po 'ga' res do snang de 'dra ma byas pa'i dbang gis yin nam bya bar brel 'tshub che ba gang yin cha ma 'tshal zhing/ rtsom yig de dag gis rang gi rtsom rtsal ji bzhin mtshon mi thub par snyam pa dang / gnyis nas dus mi 'gyang bar rtsom yig legs po 'ga' re e 'byung gi re ba bcangs nas dpe deb yid tshim pa zhig bskrun rgyu'i 'char gzhi da bar du lus song /da lam rtsom sgrig byas pa'i deb chung sems pa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor zhes bya ba 'dir/ rtsom pa po bcu gnyis kyi rtsom pa'i lam bur brgyud pa'i myong ba rang mos kyi rtsom stangs ltar bris yod pa dang / de dag las snyug rtsal gyi tshan kha 'bar ba'i rtsom yang yod la rtsom rig gi lam bur zhugs pa'i sdug yus kyang brjod yod pas/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi dus rim treris can zhig gi rtsom pa po'i dpung khag mtshon pa'i rtags mtshan yin pa su yis bsnyon/ de dag gi khar phran gyis de sngar bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal dang krung go'i bod rig pa/ zla zer sogs dus deb steng du spel ba'i bod yig gi rtsom dpyad du ma dang / rgya yig gis bris pa'i rtsom dpyad 'ga' zhig rang re bod rig 2

pa'i slob gling gi zhib 'jug slob ma klu rgyal don grub dang karma 'bum/ ros hri rgyal khab na yod pa'i slob gnyer ba mchog ldan tshe ring gsum gyis dga' mos kyis dang du blangs te bod yig tu bsgyur ba rnams dkyus gcig tu 'khod pas/rtsom pa po'i myong ba dang rtsom dpyad pa'i dpyad gtam gnyis gzhi gcig tu 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa ltar byas yod la/ nga rang la mtshon na deb chung 'di ni lo bcu lhag gi ring la rtsom pa po de dag dang mnyam du bod kyi rtsom rig dang rig gnas skor gyi lab gleng sna tshogs byas pa'i zin bris lta bur 'dug pas/ rang gi rig gnas la sri zhu cung zad bgyis pa'i spro sems kyi rgyun chad med du skyong bzhin pa'i dam bca' klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/dpyad pa'i zhor la pha rol bor thog brdzir song ba dang / rtsom pa po'i bsam blo'i mthil ma rtogs par 'gal 'khrul nor ba'i cha ci mchis dge sems bod kyi rig gnas spyi dang sgos su bod kyi rtsom rig dar spel kho na'i ched bcangs pa yin pas blo rgya yangs pa'i grogs po rnams dga' ba'i skyes su phul ba yin/zhes bde skyid 'tsho nas grong khyer chen po spos kyi ngad ldan du bris pa dge'o/ /3

tshe srog las mched pa'i me stag gi 'phro 'du/༄༅/ /tshe srog las mched pa'i me stag gi 'phro 'du/da wa don grub rgyal dang khong gi lhug rtsom/deng rabs bod kyi gzhon rabs gras kyi phul tu byung ba'i mkhas pa/ skad grags che ba'i rtsom pa po ste/ sku zhabs don grub rgyal ni krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod yig ched gnyer sde tshan gyi skabs thog ma'i hro hri bya ba'i ming btags thob pa'i zhib 'jub slob ma yin la/ khong gis mdzad pa'i dpyad rtsom dang / sgyur rtsom/ rig rtsom sogs grangs 'bor ha cang chen po yod pa'i khar/brjod bya'i don dang rjod byed tshig bcas gang ci'i thad nas thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos thon yod pa bod yig gi klog pa po kun gyis mkhyen gsal yin pa ma zad/ mi rigs gzhan dang rgyal khab phyi na'ang khong gi ljags rtsom la dga' bsu byed mkhan mang po yod pa red/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi khyab khongs nang /don grub rgyal gyis rang gi dmigs bsal gyi tshe srog gi gshis ka la brten nas/bod kyi rig rtsom 'bri spel gyi kun ra'i nang du tshe srog gi me stag 'od du 'tsher la/brtse dung gi 'o mtsho dgung la 'byur zhing / 'du shes kyi mtshams sprin lang long du 1

sems pa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/g.yo ba'i lhug rtsom gang mang bris yod pa dang / rtsom rig gsar rtsom la dga' zhen ha cang che ba'i klog pa po bdag lta bu zhig la mtshon na/ thog dang por khong gi lhug rtsom grags chen rkang lam phra mo zhes pa de klog skabs/ yig 'bru re rer zin pa'i rtsom pa po'i lhad med kyi brtse dung gis bdag la sems 'gul tshad med thebs par ma zad/ khong gis mi rigs dang pha yul la phul ba'i nyams pa med pa'i dga' zhen dang / bod kyi rig gnas la snying khong rus pa'i gting nas bcol ba'i bsam gzhig dang 'dam ga yis/ rnying zhen gyi ri bor gnas rten bcol shing lo rgyus kyi rkang lam phra mo'i steng du sos dal bag phebs su bskyod pa'i mi rnams la rmongs pa'i gnyid las dkrogs byed kyi skul brda brgyab cing / rang nyid las brgal dgos pa'i bsam gzhig gi sgo mo'ang phyes pa red/ 'di lta'i 'bri stangs legs shing nang don zab pa'i rtsom gshis kyis klog pa po rnams la bod kyi rig gnas kyi rnam pa las 'phros shing lo rgyus kyis gleng bslangs pa'i 'dri tshig mang po bton yod pas/ bdag gis kyang yig sgyur gyi byed thabs spyad de/ skad yig gis bar du chod pa'i rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan sngar rkang lam phra mo zhes pa'i lhug rtsom de ngo sprod byed dgos byung song / yin na yang / rtsom rig yig sgyur byed pa la mdzes dpyod kyi skabs su phyogs gnyis sam gcig nas tshod 'dzin byed pa'i mdzes dpyod kyi tshor ba mi 'dra ba gnyis re 'byung srid pas/ sgyur rtsom gyis mtshon pa'i sgyur pa po'i mtshon don gnyis pa dang ma rtsom gyis mtshon pa'i rtsom pa 2

tshe srog las mched pa'i me stag gi 'phro 'du/po'i mtshon don dang po gnyis la bar khyad yod pa smos ma dgos/ yin kyang dri med brtse dung gi mtsho mo ji ltar brdol yang / rtsom pa po'i bsam blo rjen par mngon pa las ma 'das pas/ don grub rgyal dang khong gi lhug rtsom la mi rabs du ma'i bar du bstod pa'i me tog 'thor zhing mchod pa'i sprin phung yang spro ngesared/don grub rgyal ni lo na gzhon zhing rnam rig ldan pa'i mkhas pa zhig yin pas/ rkang lam phra mo zhes pa'i lhug rtsom yi nang du bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang deng rabs rig gnas gnyis kyi bar chod snang tshul thabs mkhas kyis mtshon yod pa dang der bstun te nang blo rnal du phab pa'i sgo nas rig gnas la do snang byas yod pa ste/ lam phran 'dis bod gangs can gyi lo rgyus thog mar bskrun te rig dar gyi bod rigs 'di sngon thon gyi ri rtser bskyal pa dang / lnga rig gi glegs mdzod kyis lcags ri bskor te 'dzam gling gi yang rtse nas khyim gzhi btsugs/ zhes pa las srol rgyun rig gnas rang re'i lo rgyus steng gi go gnas khag theg byas pas gzu bor gnas pa'i gtam du 'dug lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i ring la bskrun cing bsags pa'i gangs can gyi shes rig de la/ rang re deng rabs kyi mi rnams kyis khong gi rgyang ring gi khyad chos dang gting zab cing rgya che ba'i rang bzhin la blo gros kyi mig zhags 'phen tshe/ nyam chung zhing rang blo 'thom pa'i tshor snang ngang gis skye bar nges/ de'i phyir/ mi rabs ji 'dra mang pos srol rgyun rig gnas kyi brag ri la rgyab rtsa bcol par ma zad/ de la yid tshim pa'i ngang blo bde ba'i ngal gso thob 3

sems pa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/pa'ang ma yin nam/ don grub rgyal khong nyid kyang de 'dra'i rig gnas kyi drod rlangs kun nas 'thul ba'i khor yug nang nyams su myong ba dang / lo rgyus la phyi mig lta bzhin/ khong gis sems gting nas shes tshor byung ba ste/ gna' mis btod pa'i rkang lam phra mo 'di rgya che ru gtong pa la sa 'jor gcig brkos ma myong la khem gang yang bcus ma myong / rkang lam phra mo 'di'i thog tu gom pa'i 'degs 'jog ci tsam bsgyur ba ni bgrang gis mi lang na yang / rkang lam phra mo 'di'i phan yon dang / nang sgos su rkang lam phra mo 'di la gzi brjid dang la rgya snon rgyu ni yid la'ang dran ma myong / zhes pa 'dis lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i thog ma ste srol rgyun shes rig gi tshad gzhi la gdeng 'jog mthon po byas yod pa dang / spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rim dang lo rgyus kyi yar rgyas la sems khur tshad med kyang byas yod/de'i rkyen gyis bod kyi snyan ngag pa grags can yi dam tshe ring gis khong la zhabs kyi stangs stabs sngon la bsgyur ba'i lde mig na mnyam gyi spun zla khri ma 'bum la sprad/ ces bstod bsngags mdzad pa'ang tshad snyelas brgal ba'i bstod pa zhig ga la yin/don grub rgyal ni bod rigs kyi rtsom pa po zhig yin pa'i cha nas brtag na/khong gis rkang lam phra mo/ zhes pa'i nang du zab cing mthug pa'i brtse gdung gi smyu gu spyad de/ rang gi mi rigs la dga' 'dun lhag par che ba'i brtse sems mtshon/khong gi pha mes rnams la dpa' zhing rtul phod pa'i snying stobs dang / yangs shing 4

tshe srog las mched pa'i me stag gi 'phro 'du/dkyel che ba'i blo rgya/ gzi dpal 'bar ba'i ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung / sems can thar bar 'dren pa'i chos lugs/ brag ri'i spo la 'gran pa'i glegs bam sogs yod pas khong la dga' bde'i tshor ba ches cher 'phel du bcug par ma zad/ yid 'gul zhing ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus kyi byung rabs dag gis khong la blo spobs chen po skyes su bcug yin na yang / nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di da dung bong bur zhon nas rkang lam phra mo 'di'i thog tu sos dal bag phebs kyis 'gro zhing mchis pa'i ngang tshul de mthong dus/ khong gi yid la sems las ha cang che ba'i skyo gdung zhig gis kun nas mnar ba dang 'pho 'gyur bla lhag tu byung ba'i deng rabs shes rig gi mdun du kha rtsod byed pa rgyun mi chad pa'i rgan rgon rnams dang sangs rgyas chos lugs spel ba'i dge 'dun pa zhig snga mus bzhin rkang lam phra mo'i steng du 'gro ba yis/ 'khod snyoms shing yangs pa'i gzhung lam gyi bslu brid la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i shes tshor byung / de ni rmongs pa dang rjes lus kyi gnyid las sad pa'i 'bod sgra yin pa dang / 'bod sgra de la ri klung ma lus kyis lags so'i tshig gi me tog ma 'thor yang / ma mthar yang des nga tsho tshang mar rnying ba dang deng rabs kyi khyad par gsal du bcug cing / bar khyad de nyid med par gtong ba la bsam blo gsar ba zhig kyang bstsal byung /nga tsho dga' sa ni rkang lam phra mo 'di yin pa'i rgyun mtshan ni/ rkang lam phra mo 'di ni nga tsho'i mi rabs snga ma rnams kyi zhabs rjes dang 'bral thabs med 5

sems pa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/pa'i lam zhig yin pa dang / nga tsho skyo sa yang rkang lam phra mo 'di yin/ ci yin zhe na/ de ni 'jig rten gyi 'pho 'gyur dang deng rabs shes rig gi rjes su lus shing srid pa'i yang rtse na nyams gog gi rnam pa snga mus bzhin 'gyur med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis red/ dga' skyo 'dres ma'i yul du gyur pa'i rkang lam phra mo de yis dga' skyo gnyis dang ldan pa'i rang re'i lo rgyus kyi byung rabs dang dar rgud sna tshogs thabs mkhas kyis mtshon yod par ma zad/ gangs chab bsil ma srog gi gsos su gyur zhing bcu phrag rig gnas bsam blo'i rgyags phyer spyod pa'i rus rgyud gcig pa'i spun zla khri ma 'bum la bsam gzhig gi gyong brda brgyab/gal srid rkang lam phra mo zhes pa ni don grub rgyal gyis mi rigs dang rig gnas la phul ba'i me stag ltar mched pa'i bsam blo'i 'phro 'du zhig yin par byas na/ khong gi lhug rtsom cig shos te rang gi tshe srog gi mjug mthar rtsom par mdzad pa'i lhug rtsom dri bzhon gyi bu mo ni rtsom mkhan khong rang nyid kyi gnas bab dang bsam blo dri bzhon gyi bu mor bcol te gsal bshad byas pa zhig yin pa dang /tshe srog gi 'tsho rgyun ma chad pa'i sngon du rang gis rang nyid phyogs bsdoms kyis rtog zhib mdzad pa las grub pa'i tha tshig lta bu zhig kyang red/ der brten/ lhug rtsom de las mtshon yod pa'i rtsom nyams dang rtsom gshis kyis khong la rgyus yod cing ngos zin pa'i mi rnams la yid 'gul sngar bas kyang thebs su bcug yod/bod yig gis thad kar rtsom 'bri byas pa'i lhug rtsom gang mang gi khrod du bsdus 6

tshe srog las mched pa'i me stag gi 'phro 'du/brjod dang don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan sogs bkol nas rang gi bsam blo dang brtse dung mtshon pa'i lhug rtsom ni mig thog lag zin gyi tshod du 'dug kyang / don grub rgyal gyi lhug rtsom nang bzhin rjod byed tshig gi lo 'dab kyis brjod bya'i don gyi 'bras bu ma bsgrib par don gnad dang rtsom nyams g.yur za'i tshul du spel yod pa ni nyung tsam las mi 'dug lhug rtsom 'di rtsom legs shos kyi gras su brtsi chog pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni/ rtsom 'di yis sa chu me rlung ste 'byung ba bzhi bo sems ldan du byas te rang bzhin gyi dga' sdang mtshon pa tsam ma yin par/ 'byung ba bzhi bo'i mtshan nyid la legs par brtag cing dpyad pa las brtsams te 'byung ba bzhi bo spyi 'dus kyi gong bu ste mtho rim srog chags su rloms pa'i 'gro ba mi'i nang gi rnam pa du ma'i chos nyid dmar rjen du sngog 'don byas pa dang / rtsom gyi thog mtha' bar gsum du lhad med gshis drang dang kher rkyang grogs med kyi rnam pas kun nas khengs bzhin/ yid ches dang u tshugs/ spobs pa dang re ba'i ral gri 'phyar zhing 'gros dal sdug bsran gyis klog pa po re re'i bsam blo'i gting du bskyod par byas pas/ mi rnams la rang gis rang nyid ngos zin par byed pa dang btsan tshugs kyis rang nyid ngos zin par bya ba'i slob ston gnang / 'di ni rlabs chen gyi mi zhig gis gsungs pa nang bzhin/ tshe srog gi rnam pa ni gnyis las ma 'das te/ gcig ni rul sungs su 'gyur ba dang cig shas ni dmar 'bar ba de'o/tshe srog gi rgyun ji ltar skyong ba'i rnam pa 'dem ka byed skabs/ don grub rgyal gyis 7

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/the tshom ci yang mi byed par phyi ma 'dams pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'jig rten gyi skye dngos ji snyed skyong ba'i dbyang rlung gis tshe srog gsar ba zhig 'grub par byed dus/kho mos (dri bzhon gyi bu mo) nga la skyes stobs kyi shes rab bstsal ba dang / bem shes zung 'jug gi gdams ngag gnang pa dang / dri bzhon gyi bu mo ni lus dang grib ma 'grogs pa ltar kho bo dang skad cig tsam la'ang bral ma myong pas kho mo ni nga'i srog gi gzung thag tu gyur pa yin pas dri bzhon gyi bu mo la dga' sdang bcol ba ni don gyis rang gi tshe srog gi rin thang la gdeng 'jog mthon po mdzad pa ltar snang / de yang yin te/ 'gro ba mi yis 'jig rten du tshe srog gi gom pa dang po spos pa nas 'jig pa'i bar du skyid sdug dga' sdang gi tshor ba sna tshogs res kyis myangs dang myong bzhin yod pa ma yin nam/ rtsom 'di'i mgo mjug bar gsum du rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi skyo shas las thon pa'i brtse dung dang shes rab dang 'grogs pa'i nges tshig gis mi rnams la gtan tshigs ltar gzab nan ldan la snyan ngag bzhin nyams 'gyur 'dzom pa'i sems kyi sdug yus shig zhus pa dang lhan du/dga' sdang gi dar cha ma 'dres so sor smreng bzhin dngos po'i rang gshis la nges tshig 'jog par dga' ba'i mkhas ming 'dzin pa 'ga' zhig la 'phya smod kyi mtshon btab par ma zad/ yin pa min par bsgrub nus shing min pa yin par bsgrub thub pa'i rtog ge pa de dag la mi bzad na zug bskyed pa'i zur za'i mda' mo drag tu bsnun pas/ rang byung gi chos nyid la grogs bcol nas rang gi gshis 8

tshe srog las mched pa'i me stag gi 'phro 'du/ka 'bur du thon par byas/ der brten/ so skyes kyi mig gis mthong mi thub la grub thob kyi phyag gis 'dzin mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan ma nges pa'i sgo nas dri bzhon gyi bu mo la dbugs dbyung ba'i go skabs byin/ tshor shes kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i tshe srog bar du yod pa'i ma gros gsang mthun gyi chos de ni rang rang gi gshis ka skyong ba'i sngon 'gro'i 'og phan tshun mthun sbrel byung pa zhig yin la/ go don de'i steng nas bshad na/ rtsom pa pos lhug rtsom 'di rtsom 'bri gnang skabs/ ma mthar yang khong gi bsam blos grogs med kher rkyang gi tshor snang myong bzhin yod par nges la/ de 'dra'i tshor snang ni nad med 'khun sgra 'byin pa lta bu'i zol tshugs ma yin par/ brtsams chos yongs la khyab pa'i kha dbugs mthug po zhig yin pas/ nga tshos de nyid klog bzhin tshor snang de 'dra khor yug tu khyab yod pa shes thub/ de yang yin thag chod red/ de 'dra'i tshor snang khyad par can dang tshor shes de 'dra myong ba'i spobs pa yod pa'i rkyen gyis/ de sngar tshig bcad snyan ngag gis bod kyi snyan ngag gi gar stegs yongs la dbang bsgyur ba'i skabs su/ don grub rgyal gyis rang gi khyad chos ldan pa'i thabs tshul spyad de blo spobs chen pos rang mos snyan ngag gi shing rta'i srol thog mar phyes te snying 'jags g.yo med kyi mtsho mo'i nang du chab rgyun gsar ba zhig drangs pa dang 'dra bas/ bde bar ngal gso thob pa'i bsam blo ji 'dra mang po zhig g.yo bar byas pa dang rtsod pa ji 'dra mang po zhig bslangs pa red ang / yin na yang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'gros dang bstun 9

sems pa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/nas dang thog gi chab brgyun phra mo de da lta rgya mtsho chen po'i rlabs kyi zla rba sdu:ra te gangasari'i sul dang rtswa thang gi gzhung na chal chil snyan pa'i sgra dang bcas mdun du skyod bzhin yod pas khong nyid zhi ba'i dbyings su bde bar mnal thabs chags 'dug pa the tshom med/ mdor na/ mkhas pa gzhon nu de nyid 'tsho bzhugs byed skabs grogs med kher rkyang gi tshor snang khyad par can rgyun par myong pa la brten nas mtho ba'i mkha' dbyings dang dma' ba'i rgya mtsho'i ngogs su rgyu ba'i dri bzhon gyi bu mo la dga' ba lhag par skyes pa dang / dga' ba de 'dra skyes pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten gyi tshul 'chos la ngo rgol dang / blang dor gyi gnas ma nor bar blo spobs chen pos kha tshon bcad de rang nyid las brgal bar byas shing / khong gis mdzes dpyod kyi byed thabs de 'dra spyad de rang gis rang nyid 'jig pa'i chos can du bsgrubs te/ 'on kyang tshe srog gi sdug yus ni gtan tshigs kyi zhim ngad 'thul ba'i lhug rtsom re re dang / nyams 'gyur gyi 'dab ma rgyas pa'i snyan ngag mang po/blo gros gyi g.yu ral gsig pa'i gsung rtsom du ma la bcol zhing zhus pa yin pas/de 'dra'i zla med kyi bla srog cig la lag pa'i pad+mo snying kar mi sbyor ba'i rang dbang ci la yod/10

gsar du bzhad pa'i me tog gi gang bu/༄༅/ /gsar du bzhad pa'i me tog gi gang bu/da wa bde skyid sgrol ma dang mo'i snyan ngagadus nam zhig gi tshe nas bzung / bde skyid sgrol mas gal te khyod rang dang /nga dang 'ba' 'ba' lu gu/ thog ma'i brtse dung gi 'du bral/ a ma'i snying gi re 'bod zhes pa sogs mo'i snyan ngag gi sgrung gtam re re brtse dung gi gras su nyams 'gyur rdzogs pa'i stangs stabs bsgyur ba dang / skyes sman dag la khyad du mnga' ba'i phra zhib kyi blo gros dang 'jam mnyen gyi gzhis ka tshor 'du drag po'i rkyen gyis bskul te smyu gu'i rtser phab pas/ rdzig nyams kyi lo 'dab kun nas rgyas shing brling brjid kyi yal ga phyogs su brkyangs pa'i snyan ngag gi ljon pa'i rtse la rdzi bag gi ge sar mngon par 'dzum pa'i me tog gi gang bu zhig gsar du bzhad cing brtse ba'i gsang gtam snyan ngag gi lam nas shub bur bzlos shing zlo ba ltar snang /de nas bzung / sngo ljang gi nags ma'i tshal la dmar mdangs rnam par bkra ba'i kha dog gor mo zhig bsnan pa dang / kha dog de ni yun ring bor bdag gi mig mdun du ma yal bas/ dran shes kyi bung ba brjed nges kyi bser bu'i gzhan 11

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/dbang du ma gyur par mos 'dun gyi gshog rlabs de'i phyogs su yang yang bsgyur myong / lo du ma 'gor ba'i rjes su/ kho mos bod kyi na gzhon rtsom pa po'i gsar rtsom dang dpyad gtam phyogs bsgrigs zhes pa'i dpe deb rtsom sgrig byed skabs/bde skyid sgrol mas rang gi gsar rtsom a ma'i snying gi re 'bod ces pa de legs skyes kyi tshul du bskur 'ongs te slar yang dpyad khag 'di'i nang du zhugs/ spro 'os pa zhig la mo ni dpe deb 'di'i nang du bdem pa'i skyes sman gcig pu yin par ma zad/ rtsom rig pa'i dpung khag 'di'i nang gi lo na ches gzhon shos kyang yin pas/snyan ngag la grogs dan bcol ba'i rten 'brel gyi thog ma 'di gdon mi za bar mo yi tshe gang gi 'tsho ba'i dpung gnyen dang mdza' bshes su 'gyur bar nges/gal te khyod rang zhes pa'i snyan rtsom de ni bde skyid sgrol mas 1991lor bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi steng du bkod pa'i mdza' zhen mtshon pa'i snyan ngag cig yin la/ rtsom de'i brjod bya'i don gyi thad nas bshad na spyi khyab gyi rang bzhin ldan pa zhig yin te/ pho mo'i bar gyi mdza' zhen ni mi'i rigs kyi brtse 'dun bya ba'i nang gi grub cha gal chen zhig yin pas/ thog ma nas bzung ste mi rigs so so'i snyan ngag pas spyi rdzas ltar nyar ba'i 'jig rgyu med pa'i brjod bya zhig red/ rgya'i mi rigs la mtshon na chin rgyal rabs sngon gyi rtsom rig mtshon byed kyi snyan ngag gces bsdus zhes pa nas thang rgyal rabs ring gi skyo shas mi zad pa'i snyan ngag ces pa byung ba'i bar dang / tel wang hru'u yi char chu 'bab dus kyi 12

gsar du bzhad pa'i me tog gi gang bu/srang shur zhes pa dar ba nas hru'u thin gyi 'gyig sdong la zhus pa zhes pa khyab pa'i bar du mdza' zhen ba'i bstod tshig brtse dung gi dwangs mar sbyar ba'i rkyen gyis de ni kho tsho snyan ngag gi gar stegs steng du bskal ba'i bar du 'gying thub pa'i rmang rdo lta bur gyur/ bod kyi snyan ngag pas pho mo'i bar gyi mdza' zhen mtshon skabs/chos lugs kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i rig gnas kyi btsan rdzong nas dmangs chos rig gnas kyi thang chen du bstod glu len par dmigs bsal dang ldan pa'i lo rgyus kyi khor yug yod pa dang / yin na yang / deng rabs kyi rig gnas la sbyangs shing goms pa'i na gzhon snyan ngag pa zhig yin tsa na/ mi'i rigs la lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs pa'i mdza' zhen gyi brjod bya de la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i gnas shig yod pa gtan nas mi srid/ der brten/ mdza' zhen mtshon pa'i snyan ngag myong zhing tshod 'bri byed pa ni snyan ngag pa re res 'dem nges kyi brjod bya yin pa dang / dngos gnas snyan ngag mkhan chen po nyis la'u twa zhes pas gsungs pa nang bzhin/ snyan ngag pa zhig yin na thog mar mdza' zhen mtshon pa'i snyan ngag 'bri dgos shing / gal te snyan ngag pa zhig gi pho mo'i bar gyi mdza' brtse de 'bri ma thub pa yin na/ de ni mi mtshan nyid pa zhig ma yin/ ci yin zhe na/ mi'i rigs su dar ba'i pho mo mthun bsdebs ni sa steng gi don dngos gang las kyang yid du 'ong zhing mdzes nyams ldan pa zhig red/ bde skyid sgrol ma'i gal te khyod rang zhes pa'i snyan ngag de ni mo rang gi tshor shes kyi gzugs brnyan yin par ma zad/13

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/dus rabs gsar ba'i bod rigs kyi skyes sman shes ldan mi snas mdza' zhen gyi lta ba rjen par mngon pa'i mtshon rtags shig kyang red/ snyan ngag de'i nang gi mnyen zhing nem la gtsang zhing spus dag pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi rang gshis khyad par can des gzhon nu ma'i sems khong du yun ring bsgoms shing rgyun par smon pa'i lha bu gzhon nu zhig re 'bod byed pa dang 'dra ste/gal te khyod rang nga la dga' na/ri rab dang rgya mtsho dpang rtags su mi dgos te/yab yum gyi zungs khrag mna' tshig la mi dgos/brang khong gi don snying yar btegs te/'gyur med kyi snying de bstan pas chogasems dang sems bar gyi 'phro 'du de ni snyan ngag pas smon par bya ba'i yid sems rang shugs kyis mthun zhing kha 'phrod par ma zad/ dri med rnam dag gi brtse 'dun gyi me tog phreng ba'i steng du gser dngul dang g.yu byur gyi phra'ang bkod mi dgos pa mtshon yod pas na/ snyan rtsom 'dir brtse dung gi dbal dang tshe srog gi drod sngar las lhag par 'bar du bcug pa ste/gal te khyod rang nga la dga' na/g.yu byur gyi rgyan cha'i ngo so mi dgos te/gser dngul gyi rin thang de bas mi dgos/14

gsar du bzhad pa'i me tog gi gang bu/ma yum gyi nu zho'i dri ngad ma yal ba'i/sbrang chang gi 'o zhig gnang bas chogaskyes sman snyan ngag pa'i tshig gi nyams la don gyi ro phun sum tshogs pa bro ba'i skad cha re re'i nang du mo'i brtse dung gi re smon thams cad bcol yod pa dang /'on kyang desad dung brjod don yongs rdzogs grub pa'i mthil ma lon par snyan tshig 'di'i mjug mtha'i tshan pa de'i nang du mdza' zhen gyi sngon 'gro ni pho mo gnyis kyi bar du dgos pa'i rang gshis 'dra mnyam yin pa de mtshon yod par ma zad/ 'dra mnyam zhes pa de yang sku mgron la gus byams byed pa lta bu'i zol tshugs dang lus dang grib ma ltar kha mi 'bral ba'i so srung gi sha tshugs 'dzin pa tsam ma yin par/pha mes nas smon pa'i dmigs 'dun der bsnyeg phyir/nged gnyis lag gdangs dpung gshib kyis chog go /zhes pas brtse dung rnal ma'i 'bras bu gsal bor mtshon 'dug pas/nem nur gyi 'gros kyis phyir bltas bya ba'i don yang med la skyo shas kyi yid sems ra ror 'gyur ba'i nges pa'ang ga la yod/ bkra shis kyi kha g.yang dang kun nas bsdongs pa'i smon tshig gi 'ur sgra'i khrod nas slar yang rgyang ring gi 'bod skul 'tshol bar snyeg dgos pa dang / lag gdangs sbrel ba'i 'gro stabs kyis mnyam du mdza' zhen dang 'brel ba'i gtame rgyud la 'grel ba rtsom rgyu ni da gzod snyan ngag pa mo rang gis 'tsho ba'i pha mthar bgrod par bton pa'i re ba red/ de ni 15

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/rgya'i snyan ngag pa hru'u thin gyis 'gyig sdong la zhus pa zhes pa las mtshon pa nang bzhin/bdag ni nges par du khyod kyi nye drung gi shing bal rkang zhig dang 'dra bar/ljon shing gi gzugs dbyibs bskyangs te khyod dang lhan du langs nges te/nga tshos grang reg mnyam 'gog dang /nga tshos na bun dang zil bar mnyam rol byed cing /dus gtan du kha bral ba 'dra yang /tshe gang bor phan tshun la brten 'dugabade skyid sgrol ma'i snyan rtsom de yi yid 'gul ba'i gnad sa gzhan zhig ni brtse dung gi rlabs ris gcig rjes gnyis mthud du mngon zhing snga ma las phyi ma je rgyas je drag tu song ba de yin pa dang / rnyed sla zhing go bde ba'i 'tsho ba'i thad kyi dpe mang po ste/ ri rab dang / rgya mtsho/ zungs khrag dang 'dres pa'i mna' tshigagayu byur/ gangs seng sogs drangs te mig gis mthong mi thub pa'i bsam blo'i 'jig rten mtshon par byas/ snyan tshig gi 'gros bab kyi steng nas bshad na/ rtsom pa pos gal te khyod rang nga la dga' na zhes tshan pa re'i tshig rkang thog ma bskyar zlos kyi rtsom tshul bkod pa dang bstun te/ bskyar zlos byas pa de yang don gyi steng 16

gsar du bzhad pa'i me tog gi gang bu/nas zlos skyon du ma gyur par ma zad/ tshor 'du'i 'phel phyogs sngar las lhag par rgyas shing mthar rbad kyis bcad de brjod don mang po shugs su bstan pa ltar 'dug pas / bod kyi snyan ngag gi mtshan gzhir rung ba'i tshod du 'dug snyan tshig 'di'i khyad chos gzhan pa zhig ni tshig sbyor bde zhing go sla ba de yin pa dang /rtsom mkhan zhig la mtshon na tshig sbyor thabs mkhas kyis bkod thub pa ni sgrung gtam legs po yong ba'i rgyu rkyen gal chen zhig yin pas/ snyan tshig 'di bklags myong ba'i rig shes rgyun ldan gyi pho gsar zhig la mtshon na/ mtho sgang du 'tsho ba'i gzhon nu ma'i brtse ba'i drod 'bar zhing 'dun pa'i rlabs zab pa'i mdza' zhen gyi me dpung gi mdun du yid sems mi 'gul ba'i nges pa ga la yod de mi srid pas/rtsom 'di'i mdzes chos kyi dwangs ma'ang de yin/gal srid bde skyid sgrol ma'i gal te khyod rang zhes pa'i snyan rtsom de gsar du bzhad pa'i me tog gi gang bu zhig dang 'dra bar rang gi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi thog ma'i dus rim mtshon pas da dung nar ma son pa'i tshod du 'dug zer na/ mos nye dus su bris pa'i snyan tshig a ma'i snying gi re 'bod ces pa des ni rtsom mkhan rang nyid snyan ngag rgyu rtsal steng gi cung zab pa'i 'phel rim mtshon pa ste/ cung zad gu dog pa'i rang gi tshor shes kyi yul mtshams las brgal te don dngos kyi 'tsho ba'i zhing sa la sems khur byed mgo brtsams pa dang / 'di ni bsam blo'i steng gi dkyogs mtshams shig yin la nges par du dgos pa zhig kyang 17

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/red/ slob grwa chen mo las thon pa'i bde skyid sgrol ma ni snyan ngag pa la khyad du mnga' ba'i 'char yan gyi nyams snang dang bcas rtswa thang du phyir log pa'i tshe na/chung dus kyi 'tsho bas rang la bstsal ba'i dgod sgra thams cad lo zla'i zhabs rjes kyi 'gros dang bstun nas rgyab tu bskyur 'dug pa da gzod rtogs pa dang / 'ba' 'ba' lu gu dang mnyam du rtse ba'i rtswa thang steng gi yid spro ba'i gtam rgyud ni rang gi byis sgrung du gyur pa shes tshor byung / rnyog 'dzing che zhing rnam pa mang ba'i don dngos kyi 'tsho ba mig lam du mngon 'ongs pa dang / snyan ngag pa la yod pa'i tshor ba rnon pos bde skyid sgrol mas rang gi las gnas steng du 'brog khul gyi rmang gzhi'i slob gso zhan pa rtogs te/ byis blo'i dri ma ma yal ba'i gzhon nu ma'i brtse sems rtswa thang steng gi byis pa tsho'i don med kyi gna' bo'i rtsed 'jos g.yos shing bskul te/nga la gting zab pa'i ngos zin nas rtogs sad cig byung ba ni/ ma gzhi slob grwa'i phyi rol gyi 'jig rten ni de 'dra'i mdzes sdug lhad med cig gtan nas min te/rtog 'dzing dang rdzun bcos ldanapa'i spyi tshogs kyi don bya mod po zhig gis nga'i dri ma med cing yid spobs kyis khengs pa'i gzhon sems chung chung 'di la bsam yul las 'das pa'i 'jab rgol drag po gang mang du byas myong zhes spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos las byung ba'i myong tshor snying gtam gyi tshul du lhug por brjod pa dang / myong tshor des mo'i brtse dung la 'pho 'gyur dang g.yo 'gul byed du bcug cing / g.yo zhing 'gul ba'i brtse dung gi mtsho mo de'ang snyan ngag gi lam nas 18

gsar du bzhad pa'i me tog gi gang bu/mtshon dgos pa byung / a ma'i snying gi re 'bod ces pa'i snyan rtsom de ni 'tsho ba dngos kyis mo la gnang ba'i rtsom 'bri'i tshor 'du yin pas/ rtsom de'i bsam blo'i khyab tshad dang brtse dung gi zab tshad gang gi thad nas kyang mos de sngar bris pa'i ljags rtsom kun las phun sum tshogs par mngon/ snyan tshig 'dis bod kyi srol rgyun snyan ngag gi 'bri stangs bkol yod pa ste/ tshigs rkang rer tsheg khyim bcu dgu dang sha lo ka rer tshigs rkang bzhi'i yan lag 'dzom pa'i rtsom tshan dgu'i bdag nyid du grub pa de'i nang du/ rtsom pa pos phyogs yongs nas 'char yan gyi gshog pa brkyangs te/ rngam brdzid kyi rtsa ba brtan cing lhun chags kyi 'od mdangs 'tsher ba'i jo mo glang ma'i ri rtse nas mar 'jig rten khams la rgyang lta'i tshul gyis rtsom nyams kyi sgo mo legs par phyes/ snyan tshig nang gi ma yum ni rtswa thang steng gi bod rigs kyi a ma khri ma 'bum gyi snang brnyan yin pa dang / gangs ri'i steng gi dwangs gtsang dri ma med pa'i kha ba'i 'dab ma ni ma yum de'i mtha' ru bskor ba'i lha bu gzhon nur byas yod pas/ snyan tshig 'dis ni gtsang zhing bab chags ldan la rgyang ring zhing dpangs mtho ba'i rgyab ljongs 'og rtsom gyi yol ras dal bur phye ba ste/go la'i phyag gis gyen du btegs shing nyi zla'i bgrod lam 'gog la snyems pa'i ri chen jo mo glang ma ya/ /tshangs pa'i sras mo lha las babs pa'i dar skas yang 19

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/mo khyod kyis rnyed na nga la re zhig g.yar bar mdzod/ /nga yi snying gi bu dang bu mos dga' ba'i bro dang dgod pa'i 'dzum gyis 'byung 'gyur legs tshogs skrun slad du/ /kho mos nges par khyod kyi rtse nas khams gsum skye 'gror bsgrog bya 'di yang a ma'i snying thag re 'bod lags/ /snyan ngag nang gi ma yum de yis snying gi bu dang bu mor bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi dpe zlar bskyod pa'i lha bya khrung khrung dkar mo la/ lha shing shug pas gtsang dud bgyis shing lo 'bru sna lnga'i bsang gtor bcas dang bzho ze'u lag la thogs te 'bri brgya'i 'o ma sor mo'i rtse nas yar mchod de snying gi re 'bod zhu 'go brtsams/de 'dra'i gzab rgyas kyi dngos gzhir bshams pa'i yid kyis sprul ba'i mchod tshogs rgya mtsho mngon par spro ba'i mdun du/ ma yum gyis lham med rkang rjen du rta thog tu rtsed 'jor rol ba'i rtswa thang steng gi byis pa tshor byis rtsom lha bya'i gsung snyan dgos zhes re ba bcol ba dang / re ba de ni bkra shis pa'i dar dkar zhig dang 'dra bar 'byung 'gyur gyi phun tshogs bsu grabs byed cing gda'/ rtsom pa po ni rtswa thang gi bu mo yin pa'i rkyen gyis/ rtswa thang steng gi byis pa kun dang 'dra bar nor lug dang 'grogs pa'i chung dus kyi rtsed 'jo dang a ma'i dro 'jam gyi rum las skya ka khra mo'i gtam rgyud la nyan bzhin nam mkha'i skar tshogs la bltas te gnyid du yur ba'i 'tsho ba brgyud de nar son pa yin pas/ de dag gis bde skyid 20

gsar du bzhad pa'i me tog gi gang bu/sgrol ma'i dran shes kyi gzhir bsub tu mi btub pa'i ri mo sna tshogs phab myong /nam zhig gi tshe mo rang gis slar yang 'brog khul gyi byis pa rnams kyis rol ba'i rtsed 'jo mig gis dngos su mthong ba dang / rang gi chung dus kyi 'tsho ba dang gnyis su med par rtogs te/ skyes sman rnams la rang gshis su yod pa'i snying rje'i sems de yang bskyar 'gul bar gyur pas ma yum lta bu'i sems khur dang byams brtse yis mo rang bskul te rang gi bu dang bu mor nye bar mkho ba'i byis blo'i dga' tshal zhig 'tshol bar bsam gzhig gi gzhu mo nang du bdungs/ snyan ngag pa'i brtse dung dang dran shes kyang de lta bu'i re 'bod kyi khrod du 'tsho ba dngos dang gzhi gcig tu 'dres shing / brtse ba'i tshon ris ni sngar las kyang je rgyas je gsal du song ste snyan tshig yongs kyi rtog yul mdzes par spud pas/ rgod nyams dang rdzi bag lhan du 'dzom zhing nang sems dang phyi yul mnyam du bsres pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi mdzes nyams thon pa red/snyan tshig 'di'i khyad chos gzhan pa zhig ni/ 'tsho ba'i sa khyon gyi che chung ltar dar ma'i 'jig rten dang byis pa'i 'jig rten phan tshun bsdur ba'i sgos mtshon par byas pa de yin la/ dngos po'i longs spyod kyi 'tsho ba'i thad phyug po yin pa des bsam blo'i rgyags phyes dbul ba'i tshul mtshon pa dang / tshig sbyor dang brjod bya'i go rim ha cang 'grig pa'i nang a ma'i re 'bod de gzab nan dang bcas mngon par byas shing / 'di ni snyan ngag mkhan mo rang gi yul phyogs gcig 21

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/pa'i na gzhon snyan ngag pa ljang bus gtsang bzhes gnongs dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kye zhes pa'i snyan tshig nang /skam sa chen mo mkha' ru thol gyis 'phags shing /shes rab kyi sgo mo dal bur phye skabs/khyed kyi zhib mo'i blos bzhengs pa'i byis pa rnams re re bzhin nar son/kho tsho gzi dpal 'bar bzhin ri rab brgal zhing mya ngam gyi thang gsar ba dag kyang brgal te/smu+og po sha modangs can gyis 'dod yon gsar ba langs su spyad par byas/zhes bkod yod pa dang 'dra bar/ rtswa thang gi mi rabs gsar ba ste nga yi snying gi bu dang bu mo rnams kyis kun gyis gnang ba'i rten 'brel gyi kha g.yang dang len byed pa dang mnyam du/ lha bya'i gsung dbyangs snyan mo da dung thos rgyu med pa dang / byis sems mtshar pos bdag gi gam na 'jig rten khams la dri ba brgya phrag 'don pa'i dus kyang yod pa bden yang / 'on kyang ma yum 'di yis 'bri brgya'i 'o ma sor mo'i rtse nas yar yar mchod de 'tsho ba gsar ba'i mdzes 'dzum la chags dga' snang yod tshad mi 'dod dri mas ma sbags sngon la/ lha bya dkar mo la khyod kyi pho nya 'di ru thongs dang zhes sdug yus zhus par ma zad/ srid 'di'i 22

gsar du bzhad pa'i me tog gi gang bu/smon tshig mtha' dag gi snying bo gcig tu bsdus te re 'bod kyi skad sgra lhang lhang bsgrags pas a ma'i smon bya dri med rnam dag yin pa rjen par mtshon/na g.yi+on snyan ngag mkhan mo rangagi snyan tshig nang phyogasabasdomasakyi tshul gyis/rnying zhen rlung dmar drag tu khros pas mdun bskyod sems shugs thal ba'i rdul du brlag pa'am/ /yang na lo rgyus dgu tshigs lam na dkar mdzes gshog zung som nyi'i dra la tshud pa gang / /zhes sems khral byed pa dang / 'di lta bu'i sems khral ni mos dngos gnas la bsam gzhig btang rjes su byung ba'i bsdoms tshig yin pa smos ma dgos/yin na yang / srol rgyun dang dngos gnas ni phan tshun 'thab rtsod kyi go rim brgyud de mnyam du mdun skyod byed pa zhig yin pas/ mi su zhig yin yang 'di lta bu'i 'thab rtsod kyi nang mdzes pa'i chos ni lo zla'i chu klung gis 'khyer du mi btub pa'i rin chen yin pas/ bsam gzhig gi mtsho mo lhod la babs pa'i rjes kyi bde skyid sgrol mar rang gi blor 'bab pa'i dris lan zhig nges par rnyed pa'i yid ches nga tsho la yod pa yin/gang bu gsar du bzhad pa'i skabs ni me tog gi ches thog ma'i mdzes chos mngon pa'i dus yin pa dang / me tog gi dus tshigs nang ches mdzes shos kyi skabs kyang yin pas/ de la nyi zer dang char chu'i gso skyong dgos par ma zad/23

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsangagator/dwangs gtsang gi kha dbugs gsar ba'i mthun rkyen yang 'dzom dgos pa red/gal srid bde skyid sgrol ma'i snyan ngag ni gsar du bzhad pa'i me tog gi gang bu zhig yin par byas na/ gang bu de ni skyes stobs kyi dpal 'bar zhing grang reg la mi 'jigs pa'i gangs rgyan pad ma zhig yin pa dang / nam zhig 'dab stong rnam par grol tshe/ ge sar gyi bsung zhim phyogs su 'thul zhing lo 'dab kyi kho lag yongs su rdzogs pa'i skabs ni yod nges pas/ nga tshos kyang dus de lta bu zhig la re smon gyi mig 'bur gtad yod/24

— bodakyidengarabs rtsom rig la gsar du dpyad pa/༄7//bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la gsar du dbyad pa/dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i krung go'i mi rigs rtsom rig gis lo rabs dgu bcu ba'i rtsom rig dkyogs mtshams kyi rig gnas kyi khyad chos rgyun 'dzin byas te/mu mthud du spyi tshogs ring lugs tshong ra'i dpal 'byor skabs kyi phal ba'i rig gnas kyi khyad chos mngon pa'i khar/mi rigs rig gnas deng rabs can du phyogs pa'i lo rgyus kyi kha phyogs mtha' gcig tu mngon te/mi rigs rtsom rig gi mi rigs rang bzhin/dus rabs rang bzhin dang khyad par rang bzhin gyi sger chos gra ma chag par sor bzhag gnang ba'i thog sne mang rang bzhin gyi mi rigs rtsom rig bskrun pa la mngon du phyogs te/sne mang mnyam gnas kyi 'phel phyogs shig chags par 'bod skul dang dar spel gtong rgyu ni/dus rabs nyer gcig po'i mi rigs rtsom rig spyi'i mngon sum gyi gnas bab dang kha phyogs shig tu gyur yad/grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom rig ni krung go'i rtsom rig spyi dang 'dzam gling can du gyur ba'i skad kyi khor yug tu lte dbus rtsom rig gi bas mtha' can ṭ+wāṃ

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/gnas su lhung 'dug pa nga tsho'i mthong snang du grub mod kyang des sngar bzhin mi rigs rig gnas kyi srol rgyun dam du 'chang ste stobs chen po'i ste dbus rtsom rig gi skad kyi khor yug tu/ 'dzam gling dang go la hril bo can du gyur ba'i lte dbus rig gnas kyi mdzes dpyod dang rol myong goms gshis la rig gnas kyis bar du chod pa'i phar ngogs su rgyang lta dang thad lta byed par ma zad/ 'dra mnyam gyis bgro gleng byed pa'i re ba'ang bcangs yod/mi lo chig stong bzhi brgya lhag gi rtsom rig srol rgyun brgyud nas bod mi rigs kyi pha skad rtsom rig gis mi rigs rig gnas kyi sger chos ngom pa'i rtsom stegs chen mo zhig mngon te/ mi rigs rig gnas kyi gting zab sar snyigs pa'i byams snying rje dang spyi phan snying stobs nas snyan ngag gi dung ba dang 'char yan/gtan tshigs kyis phyug pa dang tshe srog la bsam gzhigs bgyis pa'i brtsams chos bar du mi rigs shig gi rig gnas kyi rgyun chad med pa'i skye stobs kyi sgul shugs thang mar brdal yod/ dus rabs nyi shu ba'i rjes nas kyang bod kyi rtsom rig gis yig rigs kyi cha nas rnam mang rang bzhin dang brtsams chos kyi cha nas phan tshun mnyam 'dres kyi rang bzhin/ brjod bya'i thad kyi sne mang rang bzhin bcas brgyud de/ sngar bzhin stobs cung rgyas pa'i gsar rtsom gyi rnam pas/ krung go'i mi rigs rtsom rig gi mthong lam du sgyu rtsal skye stobs kyi rang mdangs mngon par ma zad/ spun zla mi rigs kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom dang dpung ba mnyam 26

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la gsar du dpyad pa/gshibs kyis mi rigs pha skad rtsom rig gi gdod ma'i skye khams khor yug bskrun/pha skad bshad pa la brten nas rang skad kyi khe dbang dam por srung nas lte dbus rtsom rig gi sim 'dzul bkag pa'i steng / rang gi rtsom rig gi sger chos dang rig gnas kyi srol rgyun la brten nas krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom rig khrod kyi rang gi go sa dang don snying bskrun yod la/ krung go'i sne mang rnam gcig gi deng rabs rtsom rig gi yongs khyab rang bzhin dang drang snyoms rang bzhin la spobs pa dang stobs shugs sbyin bzhin yod/dang po/ sne mang rig gnas ring lugs kyis pha skad rtsom rig la rtogs sad kyi don snying bskrun/dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i rtsom rig de go la hril bo can du gyur ba'i rig gnas kyi mtho rlabs drag po'i rgol ba'i 'og tu/ mi rigs rig gnas kyi ma lag dang rang gi rig gnas kyi khag thag dang 'gyur ldog bar gyi 'gal ba la thug yod/ 'di lta bu'i rgyab ljongs chen mor sne mang rig gnas ring lugs kyis rig gnas la/ rig gnas kyi sne mang rang bzhin khas len pa dang / rig gnas 'dra mnyam dang phan tshun la shugs rkyen thebs pa khas len pa/ zhes pa'i lta tshul zhig bton par ma zad/ grangs nyung mi rigs dang dman sa 'dzin pa'i sder thugs gzhig gnang ba gtsor 'dzin pa dang / lo rgyus nyams myong gi sne mang rang bzhin 27

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/gtsor bzung nas mthar thug rig gnas 'dra mnyam dang / rigs rgyud 'dra mnyam/chos lugs phan tshun bar la khod yangs pa'i rnam pa dmigs yul du bzung nas bsnyegs/ sne mang rig gnas ring lugs kyis don dngos su nga tsho'i rtsom rig la rnam mang sna 'dzoms kyi mi rigs rig gnas kyi thon khungs dang nying bcud sbyin yod pas/ 'di las rtsom rig dang tha na rig gnas sne mang can dang bcud 'dus can/ sger chos kyis phyug cing khod yangs pa'i bsam blo dang ldan dgos par mngon yod/ nga tshos mkhyen gsal ltar/ mi rigs shig gi rig gnas grub pa nas 'phel rgyas kyi bar du rang gi thun mong gi khor yug cig tu gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i 'tsho ba rol stangs shig dam por srung yod la/ bye brag gi mi sger gyi ngos len 'du shes khongs gtogs 'du shes dang mnyam gcig tu rig gnas 'di'i srol lugs ji bzhin srung ste/ deng rabs can gyi rig gnas kyi sim 'dzul ci 'dra rgod kyang sngar bzhin rang gi thun min gyi 'du shes 'di mkhregs por bzung yod/ mi rigs rang ngos 'dzin pa'i rig gnas lta tshul gyis rang gi 'tsho ba'i snying bo dang rin thang mngon gyin yod/ lo rgyus 'phel rgyas kyi chu klung ring mo'i khrod du/ rigs rus mnyam 'dus sam 'tsho gnas kyi brje spor ram dus rabs kyi 'phel rgyas gang gis kyang mi rigs rig gnas kyi 'gyur ldog khrod du gzhi rtsa'i rang bzhin gyi zhabs rjes dgod nges/ rtsom rig ni mi rigs kyi nang sems kyi 'gyur ba rjod byed cig yin pa'i cha nas/ des mi rigs kyi mdzes 28

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la gsar du dpyad pa/dpyod kyi dung ba ston cing mi rigs snying stobs kyi rgyun thag mtshon pas/ mi rigs rtsom rig gi mthar thug gi gnas mal ni der skyes stobs kyi 'tsho bcud sbyin pa'i mi rigs rig gnas yin la/ mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi mngal rtags ni de'i mgrin tshab pa ste/ rtsom pa po'i steng gsal bor bkod yod na/ rtsom pa po 'di dag gi mi rigs dbye ba dang mi rigs rig gnas kyi bag chags zab mo ni rig gnas de'i khyad chos mngon pa'i rtags mtshan du gyur zhing /de las mi rigs shig gi mi rigs snying stobs kyi sbubs su gnas pa'i thun min gyi sger chos bkrol klog zhib mjal byed thub cing / de la brten nas thun min gyi rang chos lham mer bkra ba'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa'i dbus su bag la nyal ba'i mi rigs kyi rang bzhin grub/rig gnas kyi mi rigs rang bzhin ni grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom pa po'i rtsom gsar rtsom gyi rmang rdo yin/ nga tsho phul du byung ba'i grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom pa pos rang mi rigs kyi snying stobs bskyed phyogs 'dra bshus byas te rgya che zhing gting zab pa'i rig gnas gzhan zhig gi khor yug la 'jug pa'i tshul la bag yangs su rgyu ba'i tshe na/ zhi ma'o rong gis rang gi pha skad kyi lam nas dung ba brjod ma thub pa'i sdug yus kyis sems 'gul thebs su 'jug la/ de dang chabs cig tu pha skad mi mkhyen pa'i kho mo dang kho mo'i sems ngal/ 'u thug bcas dang len byed cing / rig gnas kyi lkug pa'i tshul nas rtog pa 'phos te rig gnas kyi sa 29

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/stong / tha na sems gting nas yid phangs pa'i tshor ba rgyud la skye/ nga tshos ‘‘dong du lhung ba'i mig zung dag las khrag gi bzhur rgyun phra mo mthong’’ba'i mi rigs kyi brtse dung la nges shes 'drongs pa'i khrod/ kho'i rtsom rig gi dad mos dang kha phyir phyogs pa'i 'dun pa mthong thub/ yi dam tshe ring gi snyan ngag las rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas la bcangs pa'i rnam dkar gyi lhag bsam mthong thub la/ bkra shis zla ba'i 'char yan gyi 'jig rten las mi dang lha/ mi dang rang byung khams rgyab ljongs su byas pa'i mi rigs rig gnas kyi gzugs brnyan mthong thub/gal te nga tshos rtsom pa po rang nyid 'tsho sdod kyi rig gnas rgyab ljongs dang sa khongs khor yug las mi rigs rtsom pa po zhig gi khyad chos la bltas na/ kho rang tsho'i rgyab rten du gyur ba'i rig gnas kyis yid sems 'dren/ kho tsho'i rtsom rig brtsams chos yod tshad rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas kyi ma lag dang skad cha'i khor yug khrod da gdod brtsams chos de'i che srog gi skye shugs hril gyis ston nus phyin/gdod ma'i rig gnas kyi skye khams 'di la rgyus lon dang rin thang la gdengs 'jog byed rgyu ni da lta nga tshos mi rigs rtsom rig gzhung lugs kyi rin thang thad du byas rjes 'jog pa'i don gnad gal chen zhig tu 'gyur dgos/rtsom rig gi mi rigs rang bzhin ni grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom rig 'grub byed kyi rtsa ba'i khyad chos shig yin la grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom rig gi thun min gyi 'gugs shugs shig kyang yin/ rtsom pa pos rtsom rig brtsams chos las zhib 30

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la gsar du dpyad pa/brjod byed bzhin pa'ang mi rigs spyi'i dran pa'i ngos kyi rig gnas snang tshul yin pas/ des brtsams chos la mi rigs rig gnas kyi chu klung ngogs kyi khyad mtshar gyi snying stobs kyi gzegs ma bsnyal yod la/ des gtsang bo'i phar ngogs kyi cha med pa'i ltad mo ba dag gi re ba'i mig zung bar med du sgul/ ltad mo mkhan dag la bkrol klog gi re ba ji bzhin skong ba dang mnyam du thun min rig gnas 'di'i gnyug ma'i skye khams kyi tshe srog gi bskyed stobs rnam par mngon par ma zad/spun zla mi rigs bar gyi rig gnas bzang bo tshor rtogs 'du shes dang rig gnas 'gran rtsod bslangs/ mi rigs rig gnas kyi rtsa ba rgyun 'dzin thub min ni rtsom pa po zhig gi rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas la rang 'gul gyis brten pa dang rtog 'jug byed min la rag las yod/ yang gcig bshad na/ 'di lta bu'i rang 'gul gyi rgyun 'dzin ni rtsom po po mi rigs gang yin thag gcod byed spyad dang de la brten nas rgyal kha blangs pa'i rjes su stobs chen po'i lte dbus skad kyi bstod smad ci rigs kyi mdun du rang gi mi rigs rig gnas la bzung ba'i lta tshul mi 'dra ba'i steng nas bshad pa yin/ h+pha ran si'i rig rtsal gzhung lugs smra ba dan ṇas rgyu rtsal mtshan nyid rig pa zhes par/ rigs rgyud dang dus rabs/khor yug bcas rgyu rkyen gsum gyi ngos nas bshad na rtsom rig gam rig gnas shig chags par shugs rkyen chen po thebs par gsungs shing / 'jar man gyi rtsom pa po tha'o ma su man gyis nam yang rang gi brtsams chos ni 'gyur rtsom zhig 31

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/tu brtsis zhing grib ma ji bzhin gnas pa la shugs ring 'byin/ rgyu mtshan ni khong gi rigs kyis gtan nas bklags ma myong ba'i rkyen gyis yin la der gting zab pa'i le gda' byas/ na'o pe 'ar bya dga' reg pa'i na'e pa'o 'ar gyis rang nyid ni dbyin ji rig gnas kyi gnyor bu yin par brjod/ gal te rtsom pa po 'di dag gis mes po'i rig gnas te/ gsar rtsom 'byung khungs kyi tshe srog la nges shes med par der bcangs pa'i dung zhen kho na las med pa'i dbang du btang na/ kho tsho'i gsar rtsom gyi kha phyogs de mi rigs rtsom pa po'i sde las rgyang bkyed pa dang bstun nas lte dbus skad kyi stobs chen po'i khor yug dang mthun 'jug byed cing /rang mi rigs kyi khrag rgyun chad pa nas bzung ste brjod bya ji 'dra'i phul du byung ba zhig bdam nas skad cha'i 'char yan ji ltar bkod na'ang madz+res dpyod bskyar zlos kyi sun snang khrod na zungs zad nas mthar 'chi gnas su dong ngo /bod kyi pha skad rtsom rig gi gsar rtsom yang spun zla mi rigs gzhan gyi rang skad rtsom rig dang mtshungs par krung go'i deng rabs mi rigs rtsom rig khrod kyi med du mi rung ba'i grub cha zhig yin/ mi rigs kyi skad cha ni mi rigs rang rang gi sems khams dang rig gnas bar gyi 'brel thag yin zhing / skad cha'i zam pa brgyud pas mi rigs rig gnas sems khams kyi ngos zin cing / de la brten nas spyi tshogs khyad par ba'i mtshon rtags shig bskrun te mi rigs kyi khyad chos mtshon par byed/ mi rigs kyi skad dang snying stobs ni ya gyur mi rung ste/ nga 32

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la gsar du dpyad pa/tsho'i pha skad kyi bkod spyod rigs dbye la 'di lta bu'i thun mong gi cha yod pa 'dis nga tsho'i sems khams su bde 'jags kyi nyams snang ster/ bod kyi pha skad rtsom rig la lo ngo stong phrag gi rig gnas srol rgyun yod la/ rtsom rig gi rabs dang 'phel rgyas/ rtsom rig gi mdzes dpyod dang rig gnas kyi 'gyu bag bcas mtha' dag stong lo'i 'phel 'gyur brgyud yod/ bod mi rigs kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig gi rtsom mang shas ni bstod pa'i rnam pa can gyi lha sgrung dang gtam rgyud/ngag rgyun gyi khrod du bstar yod/ dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi phun sum tshogs la bod rang gi snyan ngag gi bro ba'i bab sdod nus pa de phyis kyi rtsom pa po'i brtsams chos khrod du rgya bskyed thub pa byung la/ rtsom rig grub mtha' mang bo gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byung ba dang / rtsom gshis phun sum tshogs la rtsom pa'i sde chen por chags pa 'dis/ bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig dang rtsom pa po'i rtsom rig gnyis grangs dang spus ka gnyis thad nas tshad mthon por sleb tu bcug yod/ pha skad rtsom rig de bod kyi rig gnas 'thus je tshang dang 'phel rgyas byung ba la brten nas dung ba brjod pa dang rig pa brdar ba/ spyi tshogs la thugs khur dang tshe srog gi mtha' rtog pa mnyam 'jug byed pa'i rtsom rig gi sa lam thob yod/ srol rgyun rtsom rig tu mi sger gyi tshe srog dngos yod kyi 'tsho gnas khor yug khrod du gnas stangs la thugs khur dang de gtso bor mngon yod cing / des mi tshe'i sdug bsngal khod du phyung nas nang bstan gyis 'bod skul byed bzhin pa'i snying rje chen 33

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/po la brten nas dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod du mi rnams kyis myong bzhin pa'i lus sems gnyi ga'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag sba gsang dang sgro skur spangs pa'i sgo nas mtshon te 'tsho sdod kyi gnyug ma'i ngo bo rjen par phyung ba'i khar/ nang bstan mtshan nyid khrod kyi tshe srog gi 'du shes dang mi gtso'i bsam blo/ rig gnas mtshan nyid bcas la brten nas tshe srog kun la thugs khur dang lhod yangs/ rogs skyor byed par bskul/ 'tsho gnas kyi sdug bsngal de dag rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi khor yug tu dang len dang / thugs khur/ btang snyoms su bskyur ba bcas kyi dus rabs rim bzhin brgyud myong / byams pa dang snying rje rgya chen po nam yang rtsom rig gi brjod byar bzung ste sdug bsngal las grol te rang dbang dang 'od snang gi thar ba'i phyogs su bsnyeg pa'i 'dun ma bstan/dus rabs nyi shu'i lo rabs lnga bcu ba'i rjes nas/ bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi dpung sde rim gyis rgya je cher phyin te gsar rtsom gyi nang don dang rnam pa'i thad la rtsa ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'gyur ldog byung la/ gzhan gyis tshab byed mi thub pa'i rtsom rig brtsams chos kyang ji snyed cig byung yod par ma zad/ dus skabs 'dir/ rgya yig gi lam nas 'bri ba'i rtsom pa po'i sde chen por chags/ kho tshos lo rgyus khor yug dang chab srid kyi rgyab ljongs khyad par ba zhig las rtsom phun sum je tshogs su gtong bar 'bad cing lhag par du mgo rting slog pa'i rang bzhin gyi rtsom pa'i lam phyogs bsnyegs pa des bod kyi rtsom rig la snga na med 34

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la gsar du dpyad pa/pa'i rnam pa gsar ba zhig bskrun yod/ 'on kyang / rtsom rig gi bag la zha ba'i mi rigs kyi rig gnas la bas mthar 'jug pa dang go 'dzol 'dra min thebs kyin yod de/ dper na/ rang rigs kyi rtsom pa pos rang gi rig gnas la cha med pa'am cung tsam yod kyang go 'dzol byung ba dang / yang na gsar rtsom thob thang rang rigs las gyes pa dang / lte dbus rig gnas kyis grangs nyung mi rigs kyi rig gnas la cha med pa'am go 'dzol thebs pa dang / yang na cha cung tsam yod pa'i rjes kyi gdengs 'jog dang ngos 'dzin gyi mig rgyang ring du ma slebs pa 'dis/ mi rigs rtsom rig gi sne mang rang bzhin gyi 'dzugs skrun dang go gnas/ dge mtshan bcas la shugs rkyen tshabs chen thebs yod/gnyis pa/ mes po'i rig gnas ngos 'dzin byas pa brgyud nas phyir rang gi rig gnas la zhal phyogs/bod kyi deng rabs rtsom pa po dag gis rang gi mes po'i rig gnas ngos 'dzin byas pa'i tshad mi 'dra ste/ rgan rabs rtsom pa po yi dam tshe ring dang rta mgrin mgon po/ skal bzang rdo rje/ ngag dbang rta mgrin/ dmu dge bsam gtan/sher grags/ rab rgyas pa sangs/ ye shes tshe ring sogs ni mi rigs rig gnas kyi gshin sa nas 'grengs te gsar rtsom gyi las bgyi ba'i rtsa don mtha' gcig tu rgyun 'khyongs byas yod de/ kho tshos mi rigs rig gnas kyi phung bo'i dkyil du 35

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/rang gi gsar rtsom snying stobs kyi sa bon btab yod par ma zad/ srol rgyun rig gnas kyi snyan ngag gi dung ba dang gtan tshigs la brten nas rang gi tshe srog gi dad mos dang phugs 'dun snying stobs brjod kyin yod/ kho tshos mes po'i rig gnas kyi khrag rgyun khrod du nam yang skam par mi srid pa'i gsar rtsom gyi tshe srog gi gson shugs rnyed cing / phugs bsam ring lugs kyi bkrag mdangs dang mi tshul ring lugs kyis kho tsho'i thun min gyi sgyu rtsal gyi zhing khams bskrun/ mes po'i rig gnas la shugs cher brten pa dang brtsams chos las brdol ba'i tshe srog gi dung ba dngos ma des skad cha'i mtha' mtshams brgal nas klog pa po'i yid sems dang smon tshig drangs/ rtsom pa po 'di dag gi thun mong gi khyad chos ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i mi rigs rig gnas kyi sger chos la brten nas rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas ma lag dang skad cha'i khor yug (yang na rgya'i rig gnas kyi skad cha'i khor yug) tu mi sger ram mi rigs shig gi 'tsho gnas kyi rten du gyur ba'i ljid tig gi lo rgyus rig gnas dang chos lugs dung ba mngon par mtshon yod/lo rgyus kyi snang tshul dang mi rigs sems khams kyi snang tshul gsal bor mngon pa des brtsams chos khrod du mi rigs rig gnas la gdeng thob pa'i ngos 'dzin dang 'grel bshad yang dag par mdzad/ yi dam tshe ring gi snyan ngag gi brjod bya gtso bo ste/ gangs ri dang gangs seng / gangs ljongs/ mi rigs rig gnas kyi shul bzhag dang gyang chag re re snyan ngag pa'i smyug kha na bstar la brgyus te mdzes 36

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la gsar du dpyad pa/pa'i byu dmar gyi ske rgyan re re grub yod/ mi sger gyi tshe srog dang mi rigs kyi las dbang ni so sor 'byed mi nus pas/ gdung rabs dang skad cha'i mtha' mtshams brgal ba'i gangs ri'i snyan ngag pa 'dis mes po'i rig gnas la bcangs pa'i bus phrug gi dung ba sus kyang gnon mi nus/ de dang mtshungs par/ rta mgrin mgon po'i zab brling gi mes po'i rig gnas kyi rmang dang / ye shes tshe ring gi brtsams sgrung khrod kyi lhad med rang byung gi brtse ba gcal tu bkram pa bcas thams cad kyis/ mes po'i rig gnas las 'phos pa'i tshe srog la khod yangs por lta ba dang dngos yod 'tsho gnas kyi shes rab 'thu ba'i mi rigs kyi snying stobs rnam par mtshon yod/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas 'di nyid kyis/nyin re bzhin dngos po dang tshong zog can du bgrod pa'i deng gi dus rabs 'dir/skya mdog gi ar 'dam khrod du 'gying ba'i grong khyer gyi ba gam mthon po las ring du 'das te/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyis rang gi lte khrag 'pho sa'i gnas la bcangs pa'i brtse dung la dran skul gyi cong sgra sgrog bzhin yod/ rtsom pa pos rang 'gul gyis rang gi mes po'i rig gnas rgyab rir bzung ba la brten nas/ gcig nas brtsams chos khrod du mi rigs rig gnas kyi khyad chos rgyud 'dzin byas yod la/gnyis nas mig mdun gyi khe phan bsnyeg nas lte dbus rig gnas kyi rin thang dang bstun ci thub byed pa dang / 'on pa'i rna bo bzhin du don gyis stong ba'i mi rigs rig gnas kyi rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i spyod lam bkag yod/37

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/dus rabs gsar ba'i rtsom rig brtsams chos ni rig gnas mi 'dra ba mang bo mnyam du 'dus pa'i rgyab ljongs chen mor byung ba yin/ gsar rtsom spyi'i cha nas phun sum tshogs pa'i snang tshul byung yang / deng rabs rig gnas 'bor chen dang mtshams sbyar ba dang bstun nas rnam pa dang brjod bya gang thad nas kyang tshur len ring lugs kyi tsha rlabs drag tu 'phyur ba dang / mi rigs kyi brtse dung bag la zha ba'i rnam pa byung bas/ gsar skyes rtsom pa pos da ni rang gi mes po'i rig gnar+sā kyi rtsa ba bsnyeg nas rang gi 'dod pa skong ba'i las la mi 'jug par/gsar 'byed dang 'pho 'gyur gsar ba la krog krog byed par ma zad/ 'od stong ldan pa'i lo rgyus dngos don dang bral te nang sems kyi 'gyur ba dang nyams myong gi zhing khams las 'phos pa'i tshor snang can gyi rtsom thabs la brten nas rang gi‘‘gsar byung’’ rtsom rig gi yang rtser 'ur gyis 'gas/ rtsom pa po re 'ga'i brtsams chos phud/ gsar du byung ba'i rtsom rig rang gi mes po'i rig gnas dang bar thag byung ste cha rgyus med par gyur zhing rig gnas rabs kyis chod par gyur/ 'di lta bu'i rabs kyis chod pa'i snang tshul 'byung bar lo rgyus rig gnas kyi rgyab ljongs nges can zhig yod na'ang / rang mi rigs kyi rtsom pa po la las tha na lte dbus rig gnas dang mi mang rang bzhin gyi rig gnas tshong ra dang bstun ched ci mi snyam par rang gi rig gnas lhu gtor dang / de'i khrod kyi kho rang nyid kyang cha med pa'i ‘‘thun min gyi rig gnas’’ phyir 'tshong byas te/ gting zab cing 38

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la gsar du dpyad pa/gson shugs kyis brtas pa'i mi rigs rig gnas kyi phyi'i rnam pa tsam la brten nas gzhan rigs kyi klog pa po'i 'dod blo dang mtshar bsnyeg gi dgos mkho bskang / nam zhig gzhan rigs kyi mos pa 'phel ba na/ rtsom pa po mang bo zhig lte dbus rig gnas kyi khag theg dang bstod ngag khrod bzi ba'am rim gyis mi rigs kyi sde las phyung ba'am/ yang na mi rigs rig gnas kyi mgrin tshab pa'i tshul bzung yod/ mes po'i rig gnas la lkugs par gyur ba'i gnas babs 'og tu gzhan gyi zhing la rang gi lo tog btab/mi rigs rig gnas dang srol rgyun la go log 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gzhan zhig ni rtsom pa po kho rang nyid rang gi mes po'i rig gnas la cha med pa dang ring du gyes par thug yod/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi dpung sde khrod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom mkhan mang shas shig rig gsar dus skabs kyi rjes nas byung ba yin la/ rtsom rig gis chab srid la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i rgyab ljongs chen mor/grangs nyung mi rigs kyi rig gnas bas mtha' can du gyur ba des rtsom rig gi mi rigs rang bzhin la go log thebs shing / rtsom pa po mang bo zhig gzhon dar gang gi dus su'ang rang gi pha skad sbyong ba'i go skabs ma byung / gsar skyes rtsom pa po'i steng du mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi nying bcud brtan por ma chags la/mi rigs rig gnas kyi shes rtogs lte dbus rig gnas kyi smyan gzugs la brten nas byung zhing / srol rgyun rig gnas kyi shes rtogs dmangs khrod rig 39

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/gnas kyi chu thigs tsam la brten nas byung ba red/ de ring gi dus su'ang kho tsho'i khrod kyi mi mang po zhig sngar bzhin rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas la cha med cing /gsar rtsom gyi brgyud rim khrod du'ang rang mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas las gyes te phyi ru 'khyams pas smra ba nyams pa'i lkugs pa'i tshul 'dzin dgos pa'i gnas bab 'og tu/ phyogs gzhan zhig ste/ lte dbus rig gnas kyi re 'dod kyi mdun du rtsom pa po rang gi mi rigs thob thang phyir bdams te mes po'i rig gnas la mi 'ju ka med byung la/ de las mi rigs kyi khyad chos mtshon pa'i ‘‘rig gnas dngos gzhi’’ btsal nas srin 'bu mi ru brdzus/ ltar snang gi rig gnas mang bo zhig ‘‘'char yan’’dang ‘‘gdong len’’ ‘‘dngos 'bri gsar’’ba'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa'i phyi gos gyon te phyi nang go ldog gi rig gnas zlos gar bsgyur/ 'di lta bu'i deng gi rig gnas pa mang po zhig gis rang gi rig gnas rang gis rdzob pa'i nyen brdar nga tsho mi rigs rtsom pa po dag gis rang 'gul gyis thugs gzab gnangs dgos pa zhig lags/mi rigs rtsom pa po ni mi rigs shig gi rig gnas kyi mgrin tshab pa yin la/ phul byung gi rtsom pa po zhig gis nges par du rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas srol rgyun la rgyus lon byed dgos shing / khong gi brtsams chos las mi rigs de'i rig gnas snying stobs kyi ngo bo thang mar brdal dgos/ nyin re bzhin 'jig rten pa'i ring lugs gsar ba'i rig gnas kyi tshong ra'i dpal 'byor dang 'dzam 40

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la gsar du dpyad pa/gling rang bzhin du phyogs pa'i deng gi rig gnas kyi rlabs phreng khrod na/ slar yang mi rigs kyi rig gnas la ngos 'dzin dang bskyar zhib byed pa nyin re las nyin rer gal chen por 'gyur bzhin pa mthong / mi rigs re re'i rtsom rig srol rgyun ni bzhur rgyun skyong ba'i tshe srog gi gtsang bo re yin zhing / de ni dus kyi 'pho 'gyur gyi chu ngogs su thol gyis rgyu nas mtsho mo gsar ba'i 'gram du slebs pa'i mod la/chu sna mang bo bsdus te phyir rgya mtshor babs/ mi rigs rig gnas kyi byung 'phel lo rgyus dang khor yug bkrol klog byas te/ rang gi mes po'i rig gnas las rang gi rgyu btsal nas rgyus lon byas na/ da gzod rig gnas kyi gting rum so sor gyes pas bskyed pa'i bas mtha' can gyi go nor thebs pa gcod/ 'di lta bu'i rang 'gul gyis rang gi mes po'i rig gnas la kha phyir phyogs pa ni/ nyin re bzhin bas mtha'i rtsom 'bri'i go rim khrod nas tshong ra'i dpal 'byor dang go la hril bo can la g.yol ba ni ma yin par/ mes po'i rig gnas rgyab tu bor rjes kyi bor shar dang yid mug brgyud rang 'gul gyis skyabs su song ba yin zhing /des rtsom pa pos rang gi rtsom rig gi rgyal kha'i phyogs mang bo zhig ni mi rigs gang la gtogs pa dang de'i ltag rgyab na bag la nyal ba'i mi rigs kyi rig gnas phun sum tshogs por thugs snang mdzad de 'thob pa de bas kyang gsal bor mthong bar byas/ nga tshos khong gi smyug rtsal bzang shos dang rtsom rig gi tshor rtog 'khyug po rtsis med du gtong mi rung ba lta ci smos kyang / rgyal kha'i ltag rgyab 41

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/na mi rigs thob thang yod pa dang brtsams chos las mngon pa'i mi rigs kyi dran shes ni rgyal kha 'thob byed kyi dngos rgyu yin par mthong dka'/mi rigs rig gnas la kha phyir phyogs pa dang mi rigs rang bzhin la yang bskyar ngos 'dzin byed pa ni sne mang rig gnas mnyam mthun gyi 'dzin stangs chags pa'i sngon 'gro yin/ mes po'i rig gnas la kha phyir phyogs pa'i go rim khrod du/ nga tshos rig gnas shig grub pa'i rnyog 'dzing rang bzhin rim gyis rtogs nus/ mi'i rigs kyi rig gnas lo rgyus rig pa'i mkhas pa khri la khi khung gis/ rig gnas dang mi sger zhes par/ rig gnas la lo rgyus steng bskrun pa'i 'tsho gnas rnam pa'i ma lag ces pa'i mtshan nyid bzhag yod pa der/ mngon skog gi cha gnyis yod cing / mngon sum gyi cha ni nang na gnas mkhan gyis phyir mtshams sbyor byed pa yin zhing / lkog gyur gyi cha ni tshor bas 'dzin pa las smra brjod kyi yul las 'das te bag la nyal ba'i thun mong gi 'du shes lta bu yin/ nga tsho'i rtsom pa po dag gis tag tag phyi mar 'grel rgyag mkhan gyi tshul bzung yod/ bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas ni gting zab cing zhib cha'i bogs thon pa zhig yin zhing rig gnas 'di'i yang snying dang bla srog ni bod brgyud nang bstan rig gnas yin te/ tshe srog 'khor bar 'khor ba dang bla med kyi brtse ba/ lus srog mnyam gnas kyi mtshan nyid kyis rig gnas kyi rim pa gang la'ang khyab yod cing / de ni rtsom pa po'i brtsams chos khrod kyi rtag brtan gyi brjod bya dang ches phra zhib kyis mtshon 42

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la gsar du dpyad pa/pa'i gsar rtsom gyi nang don thun mong ma yin pa'ang yin/ nang bstan rig gnas la dpyod shes kyis ngos 'dzin dang yang dag pa'i gdeng thob dgos na yi ge'i gzugs kyi ltag rgyab na gnas pa'i nges don la 'jug dgos/ gal te rang gi rig gnas srol rgyun dang rtog gzhig byed stangs/ rang la gsal cha gang yod bcas la brten nas de la bkrol klog dang lhu dgar/ yang na rang ngos kyi tshod bgam gang byas kyang go nor dang go log 'byung ba sogs ldog phyogs kyi 'bras bu 'byung zhing / de lta na rtsom pa po de'i rig gnas kyi thob thang yang nyams pa red/'di'i thad nas bshad na/ gal te nga tsho'i rtsom pa por mi rigs rig gnas kyi 'du shes gsal thag chod pa zhig yod na/ mig sngar gyi 'jig rten pa'i ring lugs kyi rtsom rig gi rdzob dreg rtsa nas 'byin thub/ mes po'i rig gnas kyi zur 'phros las srol rgyun dang deng rabs gcig 'dus/ rang dang gzhan mthun 'jug gi thabs shig rnyed la/ de'i gsar rtsom gyi rtsa ba ni tshe srog la thugs khur byed pa dang mthar thug gi re 'ben la bsnyeg pa'i 'dun pa las/ thugs brtse ba dang ldan zhing / mig zung rgyang du gtad pa'i mi rigs rig gnas kyi nying bcud steng lo 'dab rgyas pa zhig yin/gsum pa/ mi rigs rig gnas la kha phyir phyogs te sne mang gi rtsom rig bskrun/43

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/krung go'i deng rabs rtsom rig gis go la hril bo can du gyur ba'i rig gnas kyi rgyab ljongs su/ sne mang mnyam gnas kyi mi rigs rtsom rig gi rnam pa gsar ba bskrun/ rang gi mi rigs rig gnas kyi sger chos la khag theg byed pa des mi rigs so so'i rtsom rig gi da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i 'phel phyogs su nang don gal chen zin/ bod kyi rtsom rig gi ngos nas bshad na/ dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i 'phel rgyas kyi mdun du/ rang gi rig gnas kyi yang snying dang gtso bor gyur ba'i bod brgyud nang bstan las mi rigs thun mong gi snying stobs kyi kha phyogs de bas kyang 'tshol bsnyeg bya rigs la/ thad ka thad ka'i dngos yod dang mi tshe'i 'tsho ba dngos las mi rigs kyi bar ma chad pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas snying stobs 'tshol bsnyeg dang / rig gnas kyi ris med cher sdud kyi spobs pa sngog 'don byed dgos/ mes po'i rig gnas la kha phyir phyogs na snyan ngag gi dung ba dang rigs lam gyi srol rgyun rnyed cing / mes po'i rig gnas kyi khod yangs sne mang khyad chos rnyed/ rgya che la mig rgyang ring ba'i rtsom rig rnam pas‘‘ro brgya'i nying khu btsags pa'i dus rabs’’ bskrun dgos la/ spun zla mi rigs kyi rtsom rig dang mnyam du rang gi dman sa 'dzin pa'i bas mtha'i go gnas bsgyur dgos/bas mtha' can gyi gsar rtsom lag len khrod du sna gcig rkyang gi skad dang sna gcig rkyang gi brda sprod thabs las ring du 'da' dgos/ mi rigs rtsom pa po gang mang zhig gi lhan skyes kyi sgyu rtsal dang rig gnas byang tshad/ yon tan gyi sgrig 44

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la gsar du dpyad pa/gzhi bcas kyi steng nas yang bskyar 'dzam gling can gyi rig gnas khor yug la ngos 'dzin byas te/ rang 'gul gyis bsam blo gtsang phyags byed dgos/ rngams mthug pa'i mi rigs rig gnas kyi rgyab rten la brten nas rtsom rig gi bas mtha' can gyi bkag rgya las grol te sgo 'byed pa'i rig gnas 'dzin stangs chags pa dgos/ mi rigs rig gnas de 'dzam gling rig gnas kyi rgyab ljongs chen mor bzhag nas skad brda'i 'khrul ba las thar te rig gnas phyi spel bya dgos/ gtam rgyud zhib 'bri ring du dor te gnyug ma'i khor yug las 'tsho ba'i rnam pa mngon pa dang chabs cig rig gnas kyi bsam gzhig gi phyogs su phyogs te mi rigs rig gnas kyi gting zab pa'i lo rgyus gcal tu bkram nas srol rgyun gyi rgyun deng rabs dang mthud de/ rig gnas dang rtsom rig thob thang gi byed nus la khag theg byas na/ nyin re las nyin rer bas mtha' can du gyur nas nam zhig mi rigs rig gnas kyi tshe dus byed pa gcod/mi rigs rtsom rig gi ma 'ongs pa'i 'phel phyogs su/ mi rigs rig gnas kyi khyad chos las rig gnas kyi rang blo rang 'khel la khag theg bgyi dgos zhing / mi rigs rig gnas la zhal phyir phyogs pa'i mod la rig gnas kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos sngog 'don dang khag theg byed dgos/ rtsom rig gsar rtsom du sger chos 'di dang 'di'i rgyun phyi ma rnam par mngon te/ rtsom rig gi khyad par rang bzhin nam mi rigs rang bzhin ni nga tsho 'dzam gling mi 45

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/rigs rig gnas kyi tshal du bgrod pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin pas/ mi rigs rang bzhin stor na 'dzam gling can du 'gyur ba'i rgyu bor ba yin/go la hril bo can dang sne mang can gyi bod kyi rtsom rig bskrun pa la/ mes po'i rig gnas kyi mi rigs snying stobs rig gnas sne mang dang mnyam 'dres kyi lo rgyus 'phel rim la yang bskyar bsam blo gtong ba dang chabs cig bas mtha'i gsar rtsom gyi dkyu sar khod rgya yangs po'i rig gnas mig rgyang dang rtsom rig 'du shes bskrun dgos/ rtsom rig brje res dang rang gi khyad chos phyir mngon pa'i khrod du rig gnas srol rgyun rgyud 'dzin dang gzhan gyi rig gnas tshur 'dren dgos par ma zad/ don dngos kyi rig gnas steng gi ro brgya'i nying khu btsags dgos/mjug gtam/sne mang rig gnas ring lugs kyis grangs nyung mi rigs deng rabs rtsom rig la rtogs sad gnang ba'i snying bo ni/ mi rigs rtsom pa po yin na'ang 'dra/lte dbus skad kyi rtsom yin na yang chog kun gyis nges par du mi rigs rig gnas kyi thun min rang bzhin dang khyad par la gzu bo'i mig gis blta dgos pa dang / mi rigs rtsom rig 'dzam gling can dang deng rabs can du 'gyur ba'i go rim khrod du/ de'i srol rgyun dang mi rigs/ dus rabs gsum ga'i rang bzhin bar gyi 'brel bar ji ltar blta dgos pa/ mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas la 46

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la gsar du dpyad pa/ngos 'dzin dang deng rabs rang bzhin gyi rig gnas gsar ba bskrun pa'i go rim du/ lta log dang go log gsar brje'i deng rabs rang bzhin gyi don brjod kyis grub pa'i rig gnas 'tshub rgol ring lugs sngon 'gog bya dgos la/ brjod bya 'di'i mdun du rtsom rig gsar rtsom mkhan dang rtsom rig dpyad brjod pa gnyis kas rang skya pher ba'i bsam blo gtong ba'i nus pa sor 'jog byed ci nus bya dgos par ma zad/ dpal 'byor rnam gcig can gyi 'dzam gling rang bzhin gyis 'bod skul byed bzhin pa'i‘‘nub phyogs dpal yon 'dzam gling can’’gyi mdun du/rig gnas kyi gdam ga sna mang dang rigs so so'i rig gnas bar du 'dra mnyam bgro gleng gi khe dbang srung dgos shing / de dang chabs cig tu deng gi 'jig rten pa'i rig gnas gsar bar blangs dor ma rmongs par bar thag 'dzin rgyu dang / sne mang ring lugs kyis rig gnas mi 'dra ba'i bar du‘‘rig gnas 'dra mnyam dang phan tshun la shan zhugs’’ pa'i bsam blo bskyed cing / nga tsho mi rigs kyi rtsom pa pos rang gi thob thang ngos len dang / mi rigs rtsom rig deng rabs can du 'gyur ba'i go rim khrod rig gnas kyi khyad par rang bzhin gyi ngos 'dzin dang thag gcod bcas la nyen brda rang bzhin gyi don snying bskrun yod/47

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/zur lta'i dpyad gzhi/1 dbyin ji'i dzuspo or thug sin gyis brtsams pa'i/ sne mang rig gnas ring lugs zhes pa'i/ shog ngos33gyi steng / ce lin mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis/2 khi la khi hung gis mdzad pa'i rig gnas dang mi sger zhes pa'i/ shag ngos6gi steng / krug cing mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gi1986lo'idapar/3 ca'e zhan lin gyis mdzad pa'i/ khran dang rig gnas/ de dang rtsom rig hrang ba'u bskyar dpar khang gi 1998lo'i dpar/4 la'e hran yug gis mdzad pa'i/ dus rabs nyi shu'i rtsom rig gi shar nub ljongs rgyu/ mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gi2004lo'i dpar/48

rnam shesakyi dbyangasarta laskyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangasastabasabasgyur bar byas/ /༄༅/ /rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /da wadon grub rgyal gyi sgyu rtsom zhing khams/snod bcud kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i 'jig rten du tshe srog re re'i 'gro 'ong de bde skyid dang sdug bsngal/ rtag brtan dang skad cig gang zhig yin rung / de nyid kyi skye rga na 'chi'am mdza' brtse dang brtse gdung sogs gang gi ngos nas bshad na yod tshad tshe srog gi myong ba las 'phros shing phyir yong med pa'i yul ljongs re re yin par ma zad/ 'jig rten 'khor ba'i nang sha khrag gdos bcas kyis grub pa'i kher rkyang gi snang brnyan re re red/ brtse gdung gi bkrag mdangs rnam par bkra ba'i 'du shes khrod nas rang cag gi lkog gyur rang bzhin ldan pa'i khyim gzhi de 'tshol snyeg byas te/ nga rang tsho'i khom long med pa'i lus sems la lhing 'jags kyi ngal gso zhig gnang nas/ rnying zhen du song ba'i lta ngan 'dor par ma zad/ 'tsho bas nga tsho'i sems par bkod pa'i tshe srog gi rma kha re re btsal rgyu ni deng rabs kyi mi dang lhag par du na gzhon rtsom pa po rnams kyi mdzes rtogs 49

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/kyi mig zhags 'phro sa'i gdengs 'jog bya yul zhig red/lo rabs brgyad cu'i dus mgo zhig la/ brtsams sgrung gi 'bras bu khur gyis dud cing snyan ngag gi me tog lham mer bzhad pa'i bod rigs na gzhon mkhas pa zhig gis rang gi tshod bgam dang bsam gzhigs re re mtshar sdug 'od stong 'phro ba'i lam chen re rer bskrun nas/ rang gi sha rus gcig pa'i na zla tsho bde blag ngang pha ral tu bskyad par byas/khos snyan ngag bris tshe/ lhad med kyi pha skad la rang gi thun min rig gnas kyi dri ngad ldang bas skog gyur gyi sgo mo re re khad kyis phye/ 〈rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud gsar ba〉 〈gzhon nu'i yid kyi mdzes rgyan〉 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉 〈'di na'ang drag tu mchong lding byed bzhin pa'i snying gson po zhig 'dug〉 〈rgyal srid sna bdun la sbyar ba'i 'bel gtam〉 〈sprin dkar gyi 'dab ma〉 〈rig pa'i dpa' bo rnams la phul ba'i bstod tshig〉 sogs la brjod bya srog gi rnam shes gtsang la/ lus kyi rgyan cha'ang mdzes pas/ deng rabs klog pa po rnams la srol rgyun snyan ngag gi khyad 'phags kyi yon tan te tshig gi sbyor ba mdzes shing dbyangs kyi 'degs 'jog gsal ba'i khyad mtshar gyi mdzes nyams dang dri ngad ldang ba'i bro ba rnams cig car du myong thub par byas/khong gi brtsams sgrung ste/ 〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog〉 〈brtse dungs kyi rba rlabs〉 〈sha dang rus pa'i brtse dung /〉 〈btsan po'i bang so myul ba'i gtam 50

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /rgyud〉 〈sprul sku〉 〈tshul khrims rgya mtsho〉 sogs kyi nang du tshe srog gi rgyu ba rnam par g.yo ba'i gzugs brnyan re re ni ji 'dra'i gson nyams dang ldan pa la ang /nga tshos khong gis gsar skrun byas pa'i brtse gdung gi grub rim dang skad brda'i grub rim la bltas tshe/ de'i nang gi mi sna dag las 'phros pa'i las dbang gi glu sgras dbang med du yid sems 'gugs par byed/khong gi lhug lhug du dgod pa'i lhug rtsom ni/ khog pa'i glo snying gi mgo rting slog pa lta bu'i tshor ba sbyin pa'i 〈rkang lam phra mo〉 dang / rang gis rang la brtag pa'i 〈dri bzhon bu mo〉 sogs mgo mjug bar gsum du drag tu lding ba'i bsam blo'i chu chen zhig red/ da dung tshe srog gi nyi zer khrod nas 'tshar longs byung ba'i bod rigs kyi brtse gdung de'ang nga tsho'i mthong lam gyi mkha' dbyings su sprin dkar bzhin nga tsho'i sems pa dang mtha' gcig tu 'brel/de las kyang lhag pa zhig la/ khong ni rig gzhung zhib cing sbyang gzhi la nan mo dang shes rab kyi 'od snang 'phro ba'i mkhas dbang zhig ste/ yig 'bru khri nyis brgya lhag gi gsung rtsom deb drug po yis/ khong gi gzhal mtha' bral ba'i bsam blo dang rtag brtan gyi gzi nyams de mtshon thub/ spyir khong gi mi tshe la bgrang bya so gnyis tsam las med na'ang/ khong gi tshe srog gis grub pa'i brtsams chos re re'i sra brtan gyi rmang gzhi dang lhug par rgod pa'i 'bras bus khong gi dgongs gzhi da dung rig pa'i klong du yal ba med par dus kyi sgo mo re re nas 51

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/brgal te thag ring thag ring zhig la 'gro thub par nges/nga tsho snyan grags che ba'i rtsom pa po dang bsam blo'i sngon thon pa don grub rgyal dang khong gi gting zab la go bde ba/ nyams 'gyur stong ldan gyi brtsams chos kyi mdun du khong gi kun las rgyal ba'i yon tan la dad mos 'phel par ma zad/ de las kyang khong gi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi gshin sa las 'khrungs ba'i bod mi rigs kyis rang byung khams dang / 'jig rten/ tshe srog dang rnam shes sogs las shes rtogs byung ba'i dgongs pa rnams mngon par gsal ba la yid sems dbang med du 'gul/'di nas nga tshos don grub rgyal mchog rtsom rig sgyu rtsal pa zhig la ngos 'dzin byas pa'i thad nas/ khong gi sgrung gtam thor bu'i sgo mo phye nas/ sgyu rtsal gyis phyug pa'i tshe srog gi glu dbyangs re rer nyan tshe/ khos ji ltar mtho sgang du 'tsho gzhes gnang ba'i bod mi'i khor yug dang mi tshe'i rnam pa de rtogs pa dang / ji ltar sa 'dzin ma ma'i thu 'og nas 'tshar longs byung ba'i dga' skyo chags sdang gi brtse gdung mtshon yod pa gzhi nas tshor thubo/dang pa/don grub rgyal gyi brtsams sgrung phyogs bsgrigs de bsdoms pas sgrung thung 'bring bco lnga lhag gis grub cing / de'i nang nas mang che shos ni lo rabs brgyad 52

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /bcu'i dus mgor bris la/ dus skabs de ni lo bcu'i zing 'khrug thebs rjes bod kyi rig gzhung bskyar dar byung ba'i sgang red/ ltogs par zas dang skom par chu ltar gyur ba'i na gzhon rnams sngar gyi gtsug lag tu nyar ba'i lkog gyur dang khyad mtshar ldan pa'i rang re'i bod kyi srol rgyun bstan bcos rnams la slar yang rang dbang thob pa'i gzi dpal la dbang med du phyogs nas/ khong tsho rgyal dbang lnga ba'i 〈deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs〉 kyi bcud la rol zhing /chos lugs dang lo rgyus kyi mkhan po de'i rtsom rtsal dang gshis rgyud kyis yongs su bkug mdo mkhar tshe ring dbang rgyal gyi 〈gzhon nu zla med〉 du rigs rus mtho dman gyi 'gal ba dang / 'jig rten pa'i brtse gdung / da dung khong gi tshig gsal zhing nyams ldan pa/ rang bzhin khyad par can/ ngo mtshar ba'i rtsom rtsal sogs kyis rang nyid kyang brjed par byas pas/ skabs der bod skad kyis brtsams pa'i brtsams sgrung 'bring thung la dpal 'byor lags kyi 〈gtsug g.yu〉 dang / lhag pa phun tshogs kyis brtsams pa'i〈bu mo spun gsum gyi rnam thar〉sogs re gnyis tsam las ha cang nyung zhing thabs chag gi rnam pa ru mngon 'dugaskabs de dus brtsams sgrung spyi'i grub tshul dang / zhib 'bri'i rnam pa/rtsom pa po'i mdzes rtogs kyi dung zhen rnams gna' rabs bod kyi srol rgyun rtsom rig gi gting zab cing spus legs pa'i tshad la thon med la/ rang rigs kyi rtsom gshis dang khor yug gi khyad chos ldan pa'i lam bu zhig btod thub med/ de bas/53

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/mi rnams kyis khor yug khyad par ba 'di'i nang don grub rgyal gyi brtsams sgrung dang snyan rtsom rnams deng rabs rtsom rig gi gar stegs su zhal ras gsar ba dang bcas mngon par rgyang lta dang re smon byed bzhin yod/ khong gis rang mi rigs kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi rgyu cha dang po ste bod skad yig de rang mi rigs kyi 'tsho ba dang gshis rgyud mtshon byed kyi lag cha ru byas te/ klog pa po'i spyan lam du〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog〉 〈'brong stag thang /〉〉 〈sha dang rus pa'i brtse dung 〉sogs mtho sgang gi 'tsho ba dngos las mched pa'i brtsams chos re rer rang gi zhib phra'i rang bzhin mnga' zhing tshe srog ge brtse gdung gis kun nas khengs pa'i sgyu rtsal snang brnyan dang ldan la/ brtsams chos kyi nang 'bur du thon pa'i 'tsho gzhes kyi dgos pa dang mdza' brtse dang brtse gdung rnams la sngon gyi dpyod shes kyis bsdams pa'i nang bsam pa'i gzugs 'das kyi bsam gzhigs gting zab par mdzad pa'i rtsom 'bri'i thabs de rim gyis nga tsho'i 'jig rten dngos yod 'tsho gnas kyi steng du sbyar bar ma zad/ dngos yod de khas len pa dang mnyam du mi sna re re'i nang sems kyi skyo gdung la bsam pa'i 'gul phyogs kyis sne khrid dgos pa nan bshad byas yod pas khong gi brtsams sgrung de rnying zhen rul song du gyur ba'i gna' srol da spel gyi phyogs su lhung med la/ skog gyur dang gting zab pa'i sgro btags kyis 'jig rten las 'das pa lta bu'i rgyang ring gi gzigs mo khrod du'ang song med par/ skye stobs 'bar zhing gson shugs brtas pa/ tshe srog gi 54
