rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /gdung 'bod kyis khengs pa'i mi gshis de mi chos kyi rang bzhin ngo ma'i steng du phab par byas te/ skog gyur rang bzhin thal drags pa'i dpyod shes ring lugs kyi skyo gdung gi rang bzhin la gnas skabs kyi ngal gso byed du bcug la/ da dung sha khrag gdos bcas kyis grub pa'i spyir btang gi bod mi de slar yang sngar yod kyi tshe srog gi dro tshad du slebs par byas par ma zad/ da dung gting zab sgos mi gshis kyi don thog nas kho tshor thugs khur mdzad pa red/don grub rgyal gyis rang gi gsar rtsom gyi thabs lam tag tag 'di 'dra zhig la brten nas/ rang gi thun min gyi skad cha'i ma lag dang 'tsho ba spyad de klog pa por lta ba dang bya ba zhib 'bri byas pa'i thad nas bsam blo brje res byas la/da dung rtsom pa po zhig ji ltar 'tsho ba dang 'brel ba'i lam g.yo gzur med par zhugs pas/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i gsar rtsom gyi rtsom gshis shig grub gshis / klog pa pos khong gi gsung rtsom la mu mthud du bstod bsngags thob cing /bstod bsngags las bsam blo brje res kyi khor yug cig bskrun cing / des khong la sngar las lhag par 'tsho ba dngos la zhugs pa dang / skad cha brje res/ rang nyid kyi bsam blo mtshon pa sogs kyi go skabs zhig bskrun pa red/ khong gi gsung rtsom de ser skya gnyis kas khas len pa zhig yin zhing / la la zhig slob grwa chen mo'i rtsom rig bslab gzhir bdams pa dang / de las snyan rtsom dag ni na gzhon tsho spro 'dzoms byung skabs gyer 'don bya yul du gyur yod/ khong gi rig gzhung 55

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/bsam blo de bod shes rig las rigs khag gi mi rnams kyi yid smon 'chor ba'i gnas su gyur cing / tha na kho rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba'ang mi rnams kyi sems khur dang thugs snang mdzad yul du gyur/ 'di dag las khong gi gsung rtsom du mi rigs rang bzhin de rdo la ri mo nang bzhin rang nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs kyis mi spyir btang ba'i mi gshis gtam rgyud gyi rgyab ljongs rgya cher mngon te/ rgya che'i klog pa por mdzes rtog gi dga' snang yid tshim pa zhig spyin pa rtogs thub/mi gshis gleng tshe/ nga tshos shes gsal ltar/ ji ltar deng rabs su slebs na/ mi yi rang gshis kyi gnad don de de ltar du mtshan nyid rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi gnad don gtso bo ru gyur yod/ 'jar man gyi mtshan nyid rig pa pa in si thi kha zhis ar gyis khong gi 〈mi la dbyad pa〉 zhes pa'i gsung rtsom nang 'di 'dra'i skad cha zhig bshad yod de/ rang gis rang rtogs rgyu ni mtshan nyid rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi yang rtse yin zhing / 'di ni mi rnams kyis khyab mnyam du khas len par 'dod/ grub mtha' mi 'dra ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i rtsod pa yod tshad kyi khrod du/lta ba 'di la thog mtha' bar gsum du g.yo 'gul dang 'gyur ldog gang yang ma thebs shing/ yang dag gi tshad mar 'dzin pa bden dpang byas yod pas/ bsam blo'i rlabs phreng yod tshad kyi khrod nas g.yo 'gul byas mi chog pa'i bsam blo 'gangs chen zhig tu gyur yod/ 'jar mar gyi bsam blo'i blo sgo 'byed mkhan lu'u 56

rnam shes kyi dbyangasarta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /sa'o yis bstan par/ mi'i rigs kyi shes bya sna tshogs las khrod ches bkol spyod kyi nus pa ldan pa dang ches legs grub min pa ni mi la shes rtogs 'byung rgyu de red/nga tshos mgo bo phyir 'khor te mtsho ngos las mus sum stong gis mtho ba'i mdo dbus mtho sgang du gnas pa'i bod rigs kyis ji ltar mi gshis gnad don la ngos 'dzin par bltas na/ nga tshos shes gsal ltar lo ngo stong lhag gi ring du/bod mi rigs kyis mi rabs nas mi rabs bar bod brgyud nang bstan la dad pa byas shing / kher rkyang gi tshe srog re re ni lo ngo khri stong du bzhur pa'i 'gyur med dad ldan mtsho mo khrod kyi zegs ma re re red/ mi 'dra ba'i tshe srog gi phung bo re re mi'i lus kyi tshe srog gi rnam pa'i 'du 'god rtsen dus/ gzhi nas tshe rabs nas tshe rabs bar gyi rnam shes de 'khor bar 'khor ba rtogs thub/ mig mdun gyi 'tsho ba dang tshe 'di/ sha khrag gi rgyud pa/ ming dang khe spogs sogs la de 'dra mi bsnyeg par rang gi 'dun pa dang / brtse gdung / tha na mi rang nyid kyi rin thang sogs yod tshad bsam blo'i yang rtse ste/ rgyang ring gi tshe phyi mar bcol ba'i don dngos 'di lta bu ni bod mi rigs kyi spyi tshogs dang sems khams kyi gnas stangs zhig tu grub yod/ des na/ 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas dar myor zhing / zhum pa med pa'i rig pa'i dpa' bo 'brungs myong pa'i mtho sgang 'dis/ nga tsho'i lhag bsam zol med kyi re sgug la lag skyes su phul ba ni/ dpyod shes kyi gtan srol dang / lung bstan tsam gyi tshad gzhi 'khyag sib sib kyi ngo gdong kho na yin nam/ nga tsho'i 57

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/gson nyams ldan pa'i tshe srog gi brtse gdung dang / mi gshis kyi drod 'khol mod pa'i sems pa dmar rjen de 'du 'dzis dben zhing khe grags mi gnyer ba'i 'jig rten las 'phags pa'i lta spyod kyis zhum par byas sam/ bstan pa'i shing rta chen mo shākya mu ne yis khong gi rjes 'brangs pa rnams la mi gshis kyi rnam par rdzogs pa ni sangs rgyas yin zhing / sangs rgyas ni mi gshis kyi rim pa ches mtho shos yin zhes gsungs/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyis tshe srog thams cad dang bsam pa thams cad 'dra mnyam yin pa'i dgongs bzhed bton la/ rang steng nas shes rab skye ba dang / rang gi nang sems kyi rmongs ba sel tshe/ sangs rgyas pa yin zhes bstan yod/ shākya mu nes mi rnams la khong gi gsung la bsreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du brtag dgos pa'i re ba bton yod cing de las bden gnyis kyi nges don rnyed dgos pa las/ bsam blo de gsung rab dang ming tshig kho na'i steng du mching sdom byed rgyu de min/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyis shes rab 'tshol snyeg byas te/ gang zag de ches khyad 'phags kyi khams su bskyod byed kyi bsam blo'i lag cha yin/ de ni ye shes chos lugs dang 'dra bar brtse ba dang byams pa gang yang med par mi rnams la ‘‘khyed la ma gzhi nas nyes pa dang ldan pas/ mi tshe'i bgrod lam khrod du ji ltar sgrib pa sbyangs te brtson pa bskyed na'ang / sngar yod kyi nyes pa de dag thabs med’’ zhes gsungs mi srid/ nang bstan kyis gting zab pa'i snying rje dang byams pa/ brtse ba la brten nas nga tsho'i mi gshis la mnga' ba'i 58

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /tshe srog gi brtse gdung la 'gebs srung dang / nga tsho'i tshe srog dang 'grogs pa'i brtse gdung gi 'gyur ldog la skul ma gnang ste/ mu mthud du mi gshis khrod kyi sger sems dang / ham pa/ ma rig pa dang / mi sdug pa/ snyigs rdzob sogs 'joms par byed cing / mi gshis khrod kyi dri ma dang bral ba'i gshis rgyud gser las brin pa 'don len byas pa red/ 'di ni bcos ma min pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yin la mis rang nyid kyi tshe srog gi 'du 'dzi mang po brgyud nas rnyed pa'i mi gshis kyi rtogs pa'ang yin/ rgya che ba'i chos lugs khyab yul 'di ldan tshe/ bod mi rigs kyis cung dbul phongs yin pa'i dngos po'i 'jig rten khrod rlangs pa 'phyur ba ltar byung ba'i bsam blo'i sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa dang / mtshar sdug bkra ba'i dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba sogs la/ da gzod rgyus lon gyi cha zhig mnga' zhing / da gzod rengs po mkhregs 'dzin gyi lta stangs dang / lung 'dzin gyi lta ba las ring du gyes nas/ 'di 'dra'i lkog gyur dang 'char yan/ skyo ba dang dga' ba/ drag pa dang zhi ba sogs phan tshun mthun sbyor lhun grub gyi mi rigs kyi spyi'i gshis ka zhig tu+o byas te rnam par bkod cing 'grel ba rgyag thub pa'i gzhung lugs lta bur gyur yad/bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus dang lo rgyus rig par zhib 'jug byed pa'i na gzhon mkhas pa zhig la mtshon nas bshad na/ don grub rgyal gyi rtsom rig zhing khams su/ nga tshos ches myong 'dod yod pa ni mi'i bsam par sngog 'don bya rgyu de 59

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/yin zhing / chos lugs kyi snying rje dang dngos yod 'tsho ba'i bar dang / kun spyod kyi rin thang dang mi rang nyid kyi nus pa sogs kyi bar du som nyi'i rgya ru tshud pa'i dus rabs gsar ba'i bod mi dag gi bsam pa'i brtse dungs kyi zhing khams la mthong chen byed pa de red/ kho rang sngon gyi rnying zhen du song ba'i dmar rjen gyi 'bri stangs las bral zhing / mi rigs de'i tshe srog gi dpal 'bar ba'i pha skad bkol nas klog pa po'i spyan lam du mtsho bod mtho sgang gi shar lho'i khul dang /rma chu'i stod rgyud kyi a mdo'i bod khul gyi dngos yod 'tsho ba'i yol ras phye pa red/ 'di nas khos rang gi pha sa la bcangs pa'i gting zab pa'i gus bkur dang brtse ba mngon par ma zad/ rang gis brtsams sgrung gi sgyu rtsal la bsngog 'don dang re snyeg byed pa'ang gsal bor bstan nas/ spyir btang gi bod mi re re'i thun min gyi 'tsho ba'i khor yug dang spyi tshogs dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod du mngon pa'i lhag bsam dang / gshis legs/ drang bden bcas kyi mi rigs 'di'i rang gshis dang / da dung kho tsho'i sba gsang rang bzhin ldan zhing dpog dka' ba'i kyag kyog gi brtse dung gi zhing khams sogs bris yod/khong gi sgrung 'bring〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog〉ni sa khul gyi khyad chos mod cing brtse dung zhib 'bri byas pa'i brtsams sgrung zhig yin zhing / chung dus nas mnyam du nar son pa'i mi sna na gzhon pho mo zung gi brtse dung bris yod/ lha skyid dang tshe ring gnyis kyi thog ma'i brtse dung gi mdzes sdug gis sngon bsus nas ma 60

rnam shes kyi dbyangasarta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /'ongs par re ba khengs ba nas 'go brtsams shing / mjug mthar mi gshis kyi zhan cha dang rnying zhen du song ba'i srol ngan gyis bzos pa'i skyo gar gyis mjug sgril par byas yod (rtsom pa'i re ba zhig shugs su bstan yod) / nga tsho lha skyid dang /tshe ring / lha mo/ rig yag jo mo sgrol ma sogs kyi nang sems kyi zhing khams su zhugs nas bltas na rgyus mnga' che zhing brtse gdung yod pa lta bu'i phyi yul gyi zhib 'bri las/ re gsal re yib kyi ngang nas rtsom pa po'i lta ba de mngon thub cing /khong gis 'tsho gnas dang brtse gdung / srol rgyun gyi goms srol sogs kyi 'grel bshad de bstan yod/ stobs shugs gang zhig gis da dung ma bzhad pa'i me tog gi gang bu de bcom pa yin nam/ de ni gdug rtsub che ba'i srol rgyun gyis bzos pa yin nam/ yang na rnyog 'dzing ldan zhing nga tsho'i lus steng du rtsa ba rgyas pa'i 'tsho ba'i khor yug khrod kyi goms srol gyi ngan shugs yin/ yin yang yin mod yod tshad de ltar ma yin no/〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog〉de brtse dungs kyi skyo gar kho na ma yin par/ lhag par du mi gshis khrod nas byung ba'i sdar ma dang / sger sems/ rmongs mun sogs kyis bskrun pa'i 'bras bu kha bo de bstan yod/ tshe ring ste lha skyid kyi gzugasadang grib ma lta bur gyur ba'i mdza' grogs kyi lus steng du/ rtswa thang gi 'brog pa lta bu'i drang bden kho na gnyer ba'i dga' na dga' phod cing sdang na sdang thub pa'i skyes pa'i snying stobs med cing / zhing las dpal 'byor gyi 'du shes khrod byung ba'i zas gos gnyis las ci yang mi sems pa'i spyir btang gi zhing 61

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/las pa'i khyad chos kyang med/ skog g.yo dang ham sems kyis khengs zhi/nga /skabs bstun gyi dbang shed can la phyogs pa'i sger sems dang khe phan gnyer ba'i mi'i spyod pa de las kyang med par/ tshe ring gi lus steng du bab chags dang /las la brtson pa/ byang sems ldan pa sogs kyi gshis rgyud dang ldan la/ sa khul dang zhing las rig gnas kyis bskyed pa'i rang nyid kyi shes rab la brten nas zhing las pa'i thob thang las brgal ba'i blo skyed dang / blo sems gcig mthun min pa'i rang gi las dbang de phal bar mi sems pa sogs kyi gshis rgyud sna tshogs shig ldan/ kho rang mdun lam gyi ched du lha skyid dang kha bral te zog gi sman pa zhig tu gyur pa nas/ kho'i brtse dung gi me tog kyang de dang bstun nas rnyid par gyur/ skabs 'dir mi mang po zhig go log thebs kyin yod mod/ 'on kyang kho ni bshad phod cing sgrub phod pa zhig min pa dang / kha zhe mi mthun pa'i gshis rgyud de lha skyid kyi gzhung drang zol med dang / zhum med snying stobs/ dga' phod sdang phod kyi rang gshis dang bsdur tshe/ kho rang cung nyams chung gi tshul du snang / lha skyid ni rtsom pa pos gsar gzhengs byas pa'i a mdo'i zhing las sa khul gyi bod rigs bu mo zhig gi gzugs brnyan yin zhing / 'di la me tog lta bu'i bzhin ras ldan la/ las la brtson zhing zhi 'jam gzhung bzang gi bu mo zhig yin/ kho mor rang gi a phas gnyen rtags brgyab nas tshe ring gi phu bo rig yag la gnyen sgrig byed dgos pa'i skabs su/ a pha'i bka' dang las dbang la mgo bo bsgur mi 62

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /'dod cing / zhing ba'i bu mo zhig la ldan dka' ba'i snying stobs kyis ngo rgol byas te 'khyags sib sib kyi 'jig rten lugs srol gyi khrod du/ kho mo 'chi lam du ded kyang / phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas yong ba'i dka' ngal dang rna bar gzan pa'i mi kha sogarmo kyi mdun du phyi nur ci yang med par/ da dung drod 'khol 'khyil ba'i brtse dungs kyi klong na/ a phas bka' bkyon dang srol rnying gi gnya' gnon 'og smre ngag gang yang ma bton/ las dbang gis kho mo slar yang mi tshe'i g.yang gzar du ded rung / kho mor dwangs gtsang dri bral gyi gshis ka las med pas 'jig rten gyi rnyog 'dzing dang spyod ngan la g.yol mi shes pa dang / de'i rkyen gyis/mi gzhan gyi rdog brdzis thebs nas mthar gar 'gro gnas med du gyur ba'i lha skyid rab tu byung ba'i jo mo rgan gras zhig gi rjes su 'ded dgos pa byung rung / da dung ma 'ongs pa dang bde skyid/ sdug bsngal dang som nyi bcas kyi pha mtha' ru re thag chad pa'i yid sems kyis khengs na'ang / nam yang yal thabs bral ba'i bcos min gyi brtse dung dang zhen chags kyis/ da dung rtse gcig tu tshe ring phyir slebs par re sgug byed par ma zad/ sngar bzhin sdug bsngal gyis khengs pa'i khor yug tu 'tsho ba gsar bar re 'bod byed kyin yod/lha skyid kyi lus steng du/ nga tshos skyo gar gyi dri mas khengs pa'i tshe srog de mngon thub la/ thengs re re'i skyo gdung gi rgyang 'bod dang / yang nas bskyar du nang sems kyi brtse dungs la rdung rdeg dang g.yo 'gul thebs pa brgyud nas/ tshe 63

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/srog dang brtse dungs la bcangs ba'i re snyeg de sngar bzhin kho mo'i lhog lhog tu 'phyur ba'i sems steng du mchong lding byed kyin yod/ kho mo'i 'di 'dra'i 'chi ba dang nyams pa med pa'i tshe srog gi me lce de/ srol rgyun gyi ngan shugs dang 'tsho ba'i khor yug gis bskrun pa'i bsam blo'i gnon shugs 'og yal ba med pa'i mi gshis kyi 'od snang gis kun nas 'tsher/ snang brnyan 'di lta bu shig gnas thub pa'i rin thang ni/ rtsom pa pos mi gshis kyi rtsa ba'i khyad chos dang rang byung gi mi dang rang nyid bar gyi 'gal zla'i rtsa ba de gzhir bzung nas slar yang bud med la ngos 'dzin byas shing / phra zhing zhib pa'i zhib 'bri'i thabs kyis/ sems khams kyi yul ljongs de thengs re re bzhin dran ngos su shar ba'i brgyud rim khrod/ lha skyid kyi brtse dung gi 'tshol snyeg dang thob shor gyi brgyud rim de hril gyis mtshon yod/ kho mo'i gshis rgyud 'jam yang u tshugs kyis khengs pa'i rang gshis des las dbang gi lung bstan la mi nyan par/ rgyun par u tshugs kyis mi'i rang dbang gi thob thang dgos pa'i re ba bton/ tag tag 'di 'dra'i 'jam rtsub gnyis ldan gyi phra zhib gshisaka 'dis bod rigs bu mo rnams kyi blo brtan 'gyur med kyi tshe srog gi 'dun pa de mtshon yod/ lha skyid dang / sgrol ma/ lha mo bcas kyi bltas tshod kyis 'jam por snang ba'i phyi'i rnam pas kho mo tsho'i lus steng du rang sor gnas pa'i skyo mdog ldan zhing 'gyur ba med pa'i bod rigs bu mo tsho'i gshis 'jam/ lhad med/ blo khog che ba/ mi tshe'i 'jigs snang la kha gtod phod 64

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /pa'i sems khams zhig ngang gis rtogs thub/ don grub rgyal gyis bu mo 'di dag gi gshis ka'i 'bri bzhengs kyi steng / thugs khur dang gdung sems zab mo bcangs yod par ma zad/ da dung gting zab pa'i spyi tshogs kyi don snying dang rgya che ba'i 'tsho ba'i khor yug rnams gzhi gcig tu 'dres par byas yod/brtsams sgrung 'di'i nang da dung sgrol ma zhes pa'i bud med cig yod de/kho mo ni rab tu byung ba'i jo mo zhig yin/ rtsom pa pos kho mo'i skor mang po bris med kyang / kho mo'i byung ba de gtam rgyud kyi mjug bsdu ba'i char ches 'os mtshams kyi bar sbrel byed mkhan zhig tu gyur yod par ma zad/ kho mo dang 'brel te gtam rgyud de ha cang gting zab dang nan skul gyi phyogs su lhung yod/ sngon chad 'jig rten 'khor bar zhen chags che zhing / gtan 'jags min pa'i myong ba sna tshogs la rol rjes stong sang gi dben gnas su jo mo'i rnam thar bskyangs mod/ yin yang mjug mthar kho mo lha skyid kyi lhad med kyi brtse dung la yid 'gul thebs cing / 'jig rten gyi bab chags dang spyir btang gi brtse dungs la phyir dran byas/ kho mos lha skyid kyis skra bzhar bar bkag nas da dung tshe ring la yi ge bskur/nus shugs yod tshad kyis gnyen 'brel gyi las dbang de legs grub yong bar brtson/ lar spyod pa 'di dag rab tu byung ba'i btsun ma zhig gi thob thang dang mi 'tsham na'ang / snang brnyan 'di brgyud nas nga tshos dngos yod kyi mi tshe dang 'tsho ba sogs las ldog 'phros byung ba'i mi yi tshe srog dang 'tsho bar bcangs pa'i re ba 2 65

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/de mtshon yod/ tshe srog gi 'od snang dang sems steng gi rmi lam de bud med 'di dag gi lus steng nas yal med par ma zad/ da dung 'tshar longs byung bzhin ba'i snying stobs dang bsdongs nas tshe srog gi glu dbyangs mthon por len gyin yod/gzhan yang / don grub rgyal gyi 〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog〉 nang mi gshis kyi ngos 'dzin dang sgyu rtsal gyi bsam gzhigs gnyis 'o chu 'dres pa nang bzhin legs grub byung yod/ phun sum tshogs pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas dang dung zhen gyis khengs pa'i mdzes rtogs kyi lta stangs/ da dung snyan ngag gi nyams kyis phyug pa'i bstan bcos sogs kyis mod pa'i bod mi rigs la mtshon/ spus legs pa'i rtsom rig brtsams chos shig la/ gting zab pa'i bsam blo'i rang bzhin ldan dgos par ma zad/ gzhan da dung phun sum tshogs shing mdzes nyams ldan pa'i brda sprod kyi rmang gzhi yang brtan po zhig dgos/ skad cha'i zhib 'bri brgyud nas brtsams chos kyi gting zab tshad dang spyi don de gang legs su byas te klog pa po rnams la dran snang gi rang dbang dang tshig mdzes sdeb legs kyi nyams la rol thub pa'i zhing khams rgya chen zhig bskrun pa de ni don grub rgyal gyi brtsams sgrung gi khyad chos shig tu mngon/khong gis tshe ring gi mig lam gyi lha skyid kyi snang brtan zhib 'bri byas pa ni 'di lta ste/ bzhin ras dkar gsal zla ba'i ngos na/ rgod kyi gshog pa brkyangs 'dra'i smin ma zung gis mdzes shing / de'i 'og tu rnam rig gis khengs ba'i spyan 66

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /gnyis ni chu yi 'od gor 'khyil ba ltar khra chil ler 'dug ring zhing stug pa'i smin ma'i 'og tu lkog gyur gyi mdzes sdug zhig sbas yod pa ltar snang la/ dkar la dmar mdangs rgyas pa'i mkhur tshos zung ni smin drags pa'i ku shu gnyis dang mtshungs ba sogs kyis mi la dga' snang zhig dbang med du sbyin 'ongs/ mos mtha' phrug khras brgyan pa'i ras lwa rnying bo zhig gyon na'ang bab chags dang tshul ldan gyi nyams 'gyur sngar bzhin ma yal bar da dung tshe ring gi brtse ldan gyi bung ba dbang med du lha skyid kyi me tog gi 'dab ma'i steng du phyogs la/ tshe ring gis lha skyid kyis gnang ba'i dngul gyi mdzub dkris de lag tu bzung ste bde skyid kyi snang ba dang / brtse dung la re smon byed pa de ni gcan gzan gyis sha la sgug pa'am rngon pas ri dwags la skug pa nang bzhin dal ba dal bu'i goms 'gros khrod nas yod tshad rang gi sems su 'thims/'di 'dra'i 'jam zhing spro ba 'phel ba'i zhib phra'i tshig sbyor dang / gab pa mngon byung gi rgyan bkol nas na gzhon tsho'i rab rib kyi brtse dung dang de'i brjod pa gsal zhing bro bas khengs ba'i ro ji bzhin mtshon no/ /don grub rgyal gyi brtsams sgrung gi skad cha de rtag tu brtsams sgrung khrod kyi mi sna'i snang brnyan la brten yod pa las brjod bya dang kha bral nas logs su gtan nas song med/ khong gi brtsams sgrung du 'os 'tsham gyi gtam dpe dang thun mong ma yin pa'i skad cha'i rtsal bkol nas brtsams sgrung gi nyams 'gyur 67

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/gzengs su thon par ma zad/ nang don yang phun sum tshogs par byas yod/ khong gis go sla zhing sbyor ba mdzes pa/ gson nyams ldan zhing tshor snang gsar ba ster ba'i phal skad la brtson len byas te/ skad cha'i rtsal gyis mi sna'i gshis rgyud kyi khyad chos dang / 'tsho ba'i goms srol/ rig gnas kyi mngar bcud sogs mtshon yod la/ lhag par du 〈sprul sku〉dang〈tshul khrims rgya mtsho〉 〈sha dang rus pa'i brtse dungs〉 〈'brong stag thang /〉 sogs kyi nang du 'bur du thon yod/nga tshos shes gsal ltar/ bod rigs ni nang sems sgyu rtsal gyis khengs pa'i mi rigs shig yin zhing / phun sum tshogs pa'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig dang rgya che zing gting zab pa'i nang bstan rig gnas kyis dus rtag tu kho tsho'i bsam pa'i zhing khams la byams skyong gnangs te/ kher rkyang dang dka' sdug gi 'tsho bar mdzes chas spro bzhin mchis/ glu gar gyi rgya mtsho zhes pa ni bod mi rigs la mi rigs gzhan gyis ngos 'dzin byas pa'i thabs snyelam tsam du zad cing / ku re rtsed mtshar dang gad mo slong rgyur dga' ba/ kha lce bde bo dang rtsod par mkhas pa ni mi rigs 'di'i ches spyir btang gi 'dod blo'i khyad chos shig red/ ka kha'i mgo rnga mi shes pa'i 'brog pa zhig gam/ yang na skra lo dung ltar dkar ba'i bgres po su zhig yin rung / kho tsho'i zab cing dag pa'i lhan skyes kyi skad cha'i rtsal dang snyan ngag gi bag chags kyis rgyun par bshad la mkhas pa'i mkhas pa dag ngo tsha'i gnas su bskyal ba red/ 'di 'dra'i rol myong gi nus pa ldan pa'i klog pa po'i 68

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /tshogs la kha gtad te/ ji ltar khor yug khrod kyi skad char sreg bcad brdar gsum byed rgyu'i thad la don grub rgyal gyis dngos gnas sems shugs gang mang phul yod/ 〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog〉gi nang du/ khong gis 'os shing 'tsham pa'i ngang nas bod kyi srol rgyun gtam dpe dang / legs bshad sogs kyi nang gi tha snyad bkol te mi sna'i gshis ka brko bzhengs byas yod pa ni dper na ‘‘sde mgo skyong na khog pa yangs dgos/ rgod po khrid na mthur mda' ring dgos’’ ‘stag dmar yag nags la mchongs rung nyal sa tshang dang / bya rgod pos nam 'phang bstad kyang 'bab sa brag red/’’ ‘‘mis mi bza' mna'/ khyis mi bza' lcags/’’ ‘‘pho rab tshig thog 'phar ba rjes thog’’ sogs gtam dpe 'di dag gis mi sna'i rnyog 'dzing ldan pa'i sems khams kyi yid 'gyu sna tshogs ston thub par ma zad/ zhing grong gi brjod byar ran pa'i skad cha spyi'i gdangs kyang thon par byas yod pas/ klog pa po rnams la dpe chas sbyin pa'i sun snang yang cig car du 'joms par byed/ 〈sprul sku〉 zhes pa'i nang du don grub rgyal gyis mi tshe'i phugs 'dun yod tshad chos lugs kyi lta bar bcol zhing / blo bde bag phebs kyi ngang bza' mi mnyam 'dzoms kyi 'tsho ba rol ba'i a khu nyi ma zhes pa'i snang brnyan zhig gsar bzhengs byas yod/ brtsams sgrung du rtsom pa pos a khu nyi ma de 'jig rten khyim pa zhig tu gyur yod na'ang bsam pa'i zhing khams de da dung sngon gyi btsun pa las yal med par/ dad pa brtan po zhig med rung dad pa'i mdud rgya 69

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/las da dung thar med pa'i mi sna zhig tu brko bzhengs byas yod te/ khong gi ches mtho ba'i 'dun pa ni ‘‘dkon mchog gsum po sems la bcangs nas/ slob dpon dam pa zhwa ltar bkur ba dang / rgyun par rgyal ba'i gsung rab klog 'don/mchod me sgron rgyu sogs yin’’ 'di ni bod rigs lo lon zhig gi dpe ru 'os pa'i snang brnyan zhig kyang yin te/ khong la 'jig rten 'khor ba'i nang gi 'tsho ba'i nyam 'dod gang mang zhig med par/ khang ba'i khyams 'og nas nyi ma lde nas/ ma ṇi 'khor lo dang phreng ba/ da dung las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag dang rnam shes 'dren par byed pa la dad pa bcas dang ldan tshe/ khong la yod tshad ldan pa lta bu'i snang ba skyes shing / blo bde bag phebs kyi spro ba de nang sems kyi zhi 'jags las byung zhing / dus skabs phal ba'i nang dad pa'i spu lang rgyas pas dus dang rla/ma pa kun tu bsam pa'i rba klong zhig bar med du 'phyur kyin yod/don grub rgyal gyi 〈sprul sku'i〉 legs grub byung ba'i cha ni/ khos sprul sku rdzun ma zhig gi bya ngan spyod ngan dang / lkog g.yo ngan jus sogs kyi snang brnyan de ji bzhin du bzhengs bskrun byas pa kho na min par/ khong gi 'jig rten 'khor bar lhung nas phyir thar 'dod pa'i mi rnams kyi las dbang gi mdun du dpa' zhum pa dang / 'dzem bag che ba/ 'chab pa/ mi tshe 'di la rang skyon rang bshags byas te skyes pa phyi mar legs po zhig 'khyongs par re bar yid skyo dgos pa'i rmongs mun dang ci yang mi rtogs pa'i sems khams kyi gshis rgyud sogs gtsigs su bzung 70

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /yod/ gong gi sems khams gshis rgyud 'di ni a khu nyi ma nyid kyi gshis rgyud yin la/ yang khong kho na ma yin te/ rgya che'i mang tshogs khrod mi mang po zhig gis 'di ltar rmongs mun dang mun 'thoms kyi dad pa byed kyin yod pas/ da gzod sprul sku rdzun mar lkog g.yo ngan jus dang mgo skor gtong ba'i go skabs byung ba red/ bltas tshod kyis tshang ma bzhad gad du 'gro ba'i gtam rgyud khrod/ don grub rgyal gyis thugs khur bya yul ni bzhad gad kyi cha las kun nas brgal te/ mi gshis dang mi'i chos lugs brtse dungs kyi gnad don de ston gyin yod/〈sprul sku〉yi rjes su/ don grub rgyal gyis〈tshul khrims rgya mtsho〉zhes pa'i kho'i ches mtha' mjug gi sgrung gtam de bris la (sgrung 'di'i mjug bsdu ma thub par lus) / 'di'i nang du'ang gong gsal ltar chos lugs dad mos kyi gnad don drangs yod/ 〈tshul khrims rgya mtsho〉 las nga tshos rtogs thub pa ni khong gi kyag kyog gi 'tsho ba dang / chab srid kyi drag rlung / 'khor ba las phyung zhing slar 'khor bar log pa'i bod rigs shes ldan pa zhig gi snang brnyan steng / mi gshis la zhib 'jug byed pa'i gom 'gros de spos dri 'thul zhing chos sgras khengs pa'i lha khang du phyogs nas/ nga tshor rang byung gi nyams kyis tshe srog la bcos bsgyur dang bkag rgya thebs rjes kyi rnam par myong tshor byed du bcug rjes/ rim pa bzhin rnam shes dang / phung bo/ brtse sems dang blo rig bcas so sor bkar te/ mi chos dang lha chos gnyis phan tshun 'gal zla dang gcig gyur gyi khrod du gnas par byas 71

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/nas/ phyi tshul zhi bar gnas kyang / nang sems su brtse gdung gi rba rlabs 'phyur ba'i dge 'dun gyi sde rgya mtsho lta bu'i sems nas/ mi tshe la gting zab sgos shes rtogs byung ba de brgyud bsgrags byas yod/ tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i lus steng du/phran gyi dran tshul la don grub rgyal gyis mdzes rtogs kyi brtse gdung brjod snying byas te phyogs yongs nas zhib 'bri byas pa'i thabs spyad yod cing / mi sna gtso bo tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i gtam rgyud rim pa bzhin bkram pa dang / khong gi 'tsho ba'i gsang ba phyir 'don pa brgyud nas/ byams sems ldan zhing / nyams nga ba u tshugs che zhing blo rig gsal ba'i tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i rang gshis las dkar phyogs kyi cha de nga tsho'i mig mdun du re re bzhin bkrams pa dang mnyam du nga tshos khong gi rang mthong che la gtan tshigs mi ldan pa/ tha na sdar ma'i zur zhig kyang mthong thub la/ da dung chos lugs brtse gdung gi khrod kyi bden lugs dang mi gshis kyi rtsa ba'i ngo bo/ bdag 'dzin sogs kyi rgyun mi chad pa'i 'gal rkyen yang mthong thub/ rtsom pa pos 'di 'dra'i mdzes rtogs kyi brtse gdung khrod rang ngos kyi dga' snang de phyi yul gyi chos nyid las brgal chog la/ mngon sum gyi sgul shugs de rjes dpag gi gtan tshigs las brgal chog pa zhig yin stabs/ khong gi mi'i chos nyid kyi lta stangs dang / tshe srog so so'i brtse gdung la khas len byas par bzod bsgom dang rgyus lon gyi rnam 'gyur zhig bzung yod/ mi skyon gyis ma gos pa dang / gser lhad kyis ma 'dres pa zhig med pa'i dpe ltar/ sngon rgyal 72

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /ba'i bka' ru'ang / 'khor ba khab kyi rtse mo na/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs bas/ bsam pa'i sdug bsngal las thar bar 'tshol snyeg dang / sems khams kyi lhing 'jags kyi ched du grwa sar zhugs pa'i tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ sems kyi nyon mongs ma dag pa'i rkyen gyis skyo gdung skyes shing mi gshis kyi nyam sems kyi rtsa ba gcod ma thub pa'i skabs su/ kho la 'di 'dra'i skad cha tshan pa zhig bshad rgyu yod de/ ‘‘sdom pa zer ba ni 'tsho ba'i bde skyid sdom byed kyi lcags thag cig yin la/ lang tsho'i re smon 'gog byed kyi btson ra lta bu'ang red/ ngas ci'i phyir lcags thag 'di lta bu zhig ske la bskon nas sdug bsngal gyi btson rar 'gro zer na/ sangs rgyas lags/ khyed kyis dri ma med pa'i bka' yis nga la 'di ltar phyag ston mdzad yod de/ dam bca' thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin zhes gsungs yod la/ 'di ni bla na med pa'i gdams ngag yin/ phran khyed kyi rjes 'brangs te dam bcas nas sdom khrims la khog pa'i snying dang gdong gi mig ltar gces rgyu yin/ 'on kyang da lta ngas lha mo sgrol ma dang kho mo'i gdong gi 'dzum dang lus kyi sgeg nyams mthong tshe/ da gzod rang gi dam bca' de rang gi sdug bsngal gyi rgyu ru 'gro ba gzhi nas tshor/ sangs rgyas lags/ nga rang khyed kyi bka' la 'gal ba tshor mod kyang / khyed kyis ci'i phyir nga tshor chos khrims srog bzhin du srung dgos pa dang / yang khrims thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin zhes gsungs/ a tsi lha mo sgrol ma 'dzum mdangs dang bcas te nga yi sems khung la 'dzul byung /’’sdom khrims 73

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/kyi zhags pas tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i ra bzi ba'i sems kyi glang chen 'dogs ga la srid/ 'di lta bu'i sems kyi 'gyur ba mtshon pa'i kher bshad kyi dum mtshams 'di'i nang nga tshos mthong thub pa ni tshul khrims rgya mtshos lha mo sgrol mar bcangs pa'i rab rib kyi brtse ba 'phyur ba'i skabs su/ brtse gdung dang rang tshod 'dzin pa bar gyi dza drag gi 'gal bas lo na gzhon pa'i grwa rkyang zhig gi sems kyi mtsho mo ru ji ltar 'dod zhen gyi rba rlabs 'phyur tshul dang / ji ltar bsam pa'i sdug bsngal las grol te 'jig rten gyi pha mthar bgrod 'dod kyi re ba chen po de yin/ 'gal ba dang / sdug bsngal/ le gda'/ the tshom sogs kyi sems 'gyu chu chen zhig dang mtshungs bar nga tsho'i phyogs su rlabs dang bcas te bzhur 'ongs/ tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i snang brnyan ni don grub rgyal gyi mi sna'i brtse gdung de rtogs sad dang / zhi 'jags su phyogs pa'i skabs su bzhengs bskrun byas pa zhig yin zhing / de'i nang du gting zab cing ljid tig tig gi mi gshis kyi ngar shugs shig mtshon yod/khong gis stong ba nyid kyi lta bar rnam shes kyi 'od snang spros te/ dpyod shes dang chos nyid kyi gsang ba de gsal la mi gsal ba'i sgron 'od ltar spro sems 'khol zhing gson shugs ldan pa'i mi sna'i steng la 'phros par ma zad/ snang brnyan 'di dag gi mi tshe gcig gi brtse mdangs la shes rtogs dang khas len byas te mi gshis kyi ches zab sar rtog zhib mdzad yod/ brtsams sgrung 'di bris ma tshar rung / nga tsho ches rgyang thag ring zhing thug dka' ba'i tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i g.yo 74

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /'gul che ba'i las dbang la 'ol tshod kyis 'jug par byas/ 'on kyang sgrung gtam 'di'i nang du khyab pa'i thun min gyi sgyu rtsal 'gug shugs de khong gi sgyu rtsal gyi 'tsho+ol snyeg dang tshe srog gi 'khyer so la bsam blo nan mo gtong rgyur khag theg byas yad/〈sprul sku〉 〈tshul khrims rgya mtsho〉 sogs kyi brtsams sgrung nang / don grub rgyal gyis yod tshad brjod bya gdam gses dang thag gcod bya rgyu nas mgo brtsams te/ brjod byas rtsom rig gi srog la kha lo bsgyur nas nga tshor ches rgyus mnga'atshoche ba'i rtsom rig brtsams chos kyi slob gso'i don snying ldan pa dang /gzhan skul gyi nus pa ldan pa'i sgam brling gi dpyad brjod las brgal te phun tshogs sna mang gi 'tsho ba'i nang snying gsal ston dang / mi sna'i bsam pa'i zhing khams kyi rnyog 'dzing rang bzhin dang 'gal zla'i rang bzhin sngog 'don byed par phyogs par ma zad/ yid ches kyis khengs pa'i rtsom rtsal dang rnam dag gi smyu gu bkol te bod mi phal ba'i dngos 'brel gyi nang sems kyi brtse gdung gi zhing khams dang 'dres nas yod/ mi dang mi'i bar/ mi dang rang byung khams kyi bar/mi dang spyi tshogs kyi bar bcas kyi 'gal ba dang / 'gran rtsod/ 'dum 'grig sogs kyi rnyog 'dzing gi rgyab ljongs khrod/ 'du shes ldan pa'i sgo nas mi gzhi'i ma dpe ste byams snying rje dang de las mched pa'i gnyen nye'i brtse gdung dang / brtse dung / brtse mdang bcas sngog 'don dang bzhengs skrun byas te mi rigs shig gi 75

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/sems khams su rus pa'i rkang ltar chags pa'i zhi dul/ bag yangs/ ya rabs kyi spyod bzang de 'bur thon gyis mtshon zhing / brtsams sgrung gi khrod 'di 'dra'i tshe srog gi ngar shugs bskyar skrun dang rnam dag gi brtse bar yang bskyar bsam gzhigs gnongs te sems gting nas mi sems sgul ba'i 'jig rten gyi brtse dung basbran yad/nga tshos 〈sha dang rus pa'i brtse dungs〉 khrod 'di 'dra'i sba gsang med pa'i dmar rjen gyi brtse dung ngo ma de mthong thub ste/ lha bzo a khu dbang ldan ni thang ga'i 'byung yul gyi ming grags che ba'i lha bzo zhig yin/ kho ni chung dus nas a ma'i brtse ba dang bral zhing / a pha lha bzos rang gi mig 'bras ltar gces pa'i byams skyong las 'tshar longs byung / gzhon dus skyo gdung gi bro ba gang yang ma tshor ba'i dbang ldan de/ rang gi ri mo 'bri ba'i rtsal nyin re bzhin je legs su song ba dang bstun nas/ rtse gcig tu bya rgod pos gnam 'phang gcod pa dang /gzhon dar mas rgyal khams 'grim dgos zhes pa'i legs bshad de lag bstar byas nas yul khams gzhan zhig la 'gro rgyu'i re smon byas par ma zad skog tu grogs po dang dus btab cing / rang gi a phar gsang ste the tshom dang kher rkyang gis khengs ba'i rgyang ring gi lam du zhugs/ kho tsho'i spro sems kyis khengs ba'i sems par dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba dang jag rkun gyi mda' yis mes skyon phog dus/lus hril bor sdug gis khengs shing dran snang gis bzi ba'i dbang ldan gyis 'tsho 76

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabasabasgyur bar byas/ /gnas kyi lam bu gzhan zhig 'dems mgo brtsams/ gzhan yul du dbang ldan gyis sngar med kyi snying stobs zhig sems la bcangs nas ri mo dang tshon rtsi'i khrod rnam g.yeng dang thang chad gang yang med par 'tsho ba'i yang rtse bsnyegs/ kho bo thengs re re bzhin lha sku'i rnam shes dang gcig tu 'dres dus/ dbang med kyis rang gi lus steng gi dug gsum dag par byas nas/ skyo zhing rnam par dag pa'i a pha'i brtse ba de btsal/ khong gis snying stobs cher skyed kyis a pha'i tshad med kyi brtse dung dang 'gyod gdung zhig khyer te rang khyim gyi sgo khar thon dus/ a pha ste/tshe gang bor smyu gu dang shes rab spyad te lha'i zhing khams kyi blo dkar dang brjid nyams 'god pa'i lha bzos dbang ldan gyi a mar skyes sgo zhig bzhengs te/sems zhi ba'i ngang kha rog ger 'jig rten 'di dang gtan du bral/ de nas bzung /dbang ldan gyi mi tshe'i khrod kyi re snyeg chen po ni lha yi 'gyur ba med pa'i dad sems gsar gzhengs byas te sngar btang zin pa'i a pha'i brtse bar drin lan 'jal rgyu de red/ khos rang gi ches mtha' mjug gi sgrol ma'i sku 'dra chen po de legs grub byung rjes/ rang gi mna' bcad grogs po klu phyug la kha chems kyi yi ge bskur te/ yi ger sngon 'u gnyis kyi gros gzhi ltar nga dang 'brel ba'i sgrung gtam zhig phris zhes nan gyis bshad yod/ klu phyug khong gi kha chems la 'gal ma phod par/ na bza'i sne mo lhab lhub tu g.yo zhing / rna rgyan gyi sgra sing sing du grags pa'i sgrol ma'i 'dra sku'i mdun du/ a khu dbang ldan gyi re smon 'grub par 77

semar+sāpa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/byas te/ sha dang rus pa'i brtse dung gi gna' bo'i gtam rgyud zhig las 'di ltar mi yul gyi ches phal ba dang ches gzi brjid can gyi brtse gdung 'di mched pa'o/'di ni brtse gdung srog shing du byas shing / rnam dag brtse dung gis zhib 'bri byas pa'i brtse dung mtshon pa'i brtsams sgrung zhig red/ de las nga tsho'i brtse dung la shugs rkyen thebs rgyu ni thag ring zhing thug mi thub pa zhig min par/gtsug tu bkur ba'i lha gshis dang skog gyur ldan pa'i gsang ba sogs yin/phal ba dang bab chags kyis nam yang nga tsho'i sems kyi sgo mo phyes te/ lhan skyes kyi mi yul gyi rnam par dag pa'i brtse dung smu gru char bstsol ba ni nga tsho'i sems khungs nas mched pa'i gces nor yin la/ 'dis drin lan mjal rgyur mi re ba min/ 'gyod pa bral ba'i pha bu'i brtse gdung gis dbang ldan gyi bsam pa'i sgo mo phyes nas dran ngos kyi 'das song gi rdzog dreg bkrus la/ tshe srog gi yul khams gzhan zhig nas sgyu rtsal gyi tshor 'du yod tshad sos bar byas/ smyug 'og gi 'jam zhing thogs pa med pa'i thig rtsa'i bag la nyal ba ni mi yul gyi brtse gdung gi 'dra bshus red/ skad cha dang ma 'brel bar lhod cing rngam brjid ldan la/ tshos gzhi sna tshogs kyis byug pa'i mdzes sdug gi thang ga las/ ngas don grub rgyal gyis dmigs yul ldan pa'i sgo nas klog pa po rnams la gtam rgyud phyi rol gyi ches gting zab kyi che srog gi brjod gzhi de mtshon par byas pa la brten nas brtse gdung de 'tsho byed kyi mi rigs rig gnas kyi gzhi rtsa de khyab sgrog byed pa tshor byung /78

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /nga tshos bod mi rigs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam pa'i zhing khams dang 'tsho ba'i khor yug la thugs snang mdzad tshe gna' bo'i bab chags nyams ldan gyi chos lugs dad mos de ri rgyud dang chu bo re re/ tha na sdong bo rkang gcig dang rtswa nyag re/mi/ rang byung khams/ srol rgyun/ gdung rgyud sogs 'tsho gnas su lwa ba snum gyis sim pa ltar yongs su zin yod/ bod mi rigs te phyogs yongs nas bod brgyud nang bstan la dad pa'i mi rigs 'di la mtshon nas bshad na/ rgyang ring du gnas pa'i lha sgrung dang chos lugs kyi dung ba ni nga tsho'i sems kyi khrag rtsa ru rgyu ba'i tshe srog gi brtsi 'jog zhig yin par ma zad/ rang byung khams kyi gus bkur dang / gzhan phan sgrub pa'i bla med kyi snying stobs shig red/ kho tshos dka' ngal che ba'i khor yug tu lhan skyes kyi nus pa bzhin chos lugs dad mos la rtse gcig tu srung nas/ rang byung khams dang / mi/ sems sogs kyi pha mtha' nas rnyog 'dzing de sla mo dang / skog g.yo de drang bden/ zhabrug pa de zhi bde ru bsgyur te/byams dang snying rje de mi gshis kyi ches yang rtser drangs nas/ rang nyid kyi sems gting du skye 'gro'am tshe srog thams cad ma bzhin brtse ba'i dam tshig bzhag tshe srog gi rin thang dang 'tsho ba'i bde sdug de phal cher sgor mo dang dbang thang gis dbang bsgyur byas pa'i deng gi char/ nga tshos sems lhod la babs te/ dbang thang dang go sar bsnyegs pa'i skyo gdung de brjed par byas te/ rang sems slar yang rang byung dang dwangs gtsang gi ches spyir btang gi brtse gdung du phyin tshe/ nga tshos 79

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/nyin re bzhin je zhan du 'gro ba'i mi'i brtse gdung de rgyus lon byed thub cing /des thebs pa'i ngan shugs kyang nges len byed thub/don grub rgyal gyi brtsams sgrung du/ bod mi'i chos lugs brtse gdung gi skor ha cang khyab che zhing / mi gshis kyi don snying la sems khur byed rgyu rtsa ba byas te rang ngos kyi khyad chos shugs drag pa'i brtse gdung gi myong ba brjod pa de yin/yang gcig bshad na/ khong gi sems khur byed rgyu ni chos lugs spyod pa'i byed po mi yis thog mar rang sems legs grub byung bar byas te/ da gzod rim gyis lha gshis mngon pa'i brgyud rim de yin/ de'i rkyen gyis khong gi smyug rtse nas thon pa'i tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang / dbang ldan bcas ni rang nyid kyi nang sems kyi brtse gdung gi bang rim rgyas par byas te/ mu mthud du srid pa'i khams kyi 'tsho ba'i du rdul gyis khebs pa'i gu dog dang / ham 'dod kyi lta stangs de mi dang mi'i bar gyi res mos su 'khor ba'i ha cang dngos yod yin pa'i mi yul gyi lta spyod du mngon pa red/ mi gshis dang lha gshis gnyis kyi bar mtshams su/ don grub rgyal gyis rang dbang ldan pa'i sgo nas sgyu rtsal gyi snang brnyan re re bzhengs bskrun byas shing / klog pa por rgya che ba'i bsam gzhig dang 'char snang gtong sa'i khor yug zhig skrun/nga tshos yang bskyar lha bzo dbang ldan gyis bskyur ba'i thang gar bltas na/mi rabs gnyis kyi brtse gdung gzhi gcig tu 'dres pa'i thang ga'i steng du/ lha mo 80

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /zhig ngang gis phebs byung / ‘‘thang ka'i mtha' bzhi'i thig skud snyoms shing / de'i nang gi mdzub mo'i ring tshad tsam gyi nang skud dang phyi skud kyi bar du/ g.yon du bkra shis rtags brgyad de pad ma dang / gdugs/ dung dkar/ dpal belā rgyal mtshan/ bum pa/ gser nya/ 'khor lo bcas bris yod cing / g.yas su me long /gi wang / zho/ dur ba/ bil ba/ dung dkar/ li khri/ yungs dkar bcas bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyis spras shing / gong du pa ṭa dang / 'og na g.yung drung mang po bris 'dug dkyil 'khor du be+eḍār+ya yi tshon gyis byug pa'i gnam sngon po'i ngos su sprin dkar lang long 'phyur ba'i khrod du dar gos bklubs pa'i lha mo zhig gis phyir mig lta bzhin mkha' la 'phur ba dang / de'i sku stod 'ja' gur gyis brgyan zhing / sku smad dbang gzhu'i khri la bkod pa ltar snang la/ rna bar brgyan pa'i rna chas sing sing du grags pa nang bzhin ske la 'ching ba'i kha btags kyang lhab lhub tu rlung gis bskyod de gar du rol ba'i rnam pa dang gnyis su med/ lha mo de 'jig rten pa'i rnyog rdzob kyi las la gtan du bral nas rgyang ring zhing skog gyur ldan pa'i lha yul du 'phur na'ang / su zhig la zhen chags byas pa'i skyo gdung gi mig zung du 'bral mi phod pa'i snang ba zhig dbang med du ster thub/’’'di ni a phas dngos su mdzub ston gnang zhing / dbang ldan gyis yang 'bri bskyar 'bri byas pa'i lha mo'i thang ka de yin/ dbang ldan gyis lha mo'i spyan kong nas a ma'i brtse sems de rtogs dus/ a ma'i brtse sems las mched pa'i tshe srog gi gdeng tshod de khong gi 81

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/thang ka 'bri ba'i tshor 'du dang khyad chos su gyur bar ma zad/ khong gi drag tu 'phyur ba'i gsar rtsom gyi ngar shugs su gyur nas/ kho'i snying stobs de rang gi thang ka dang bsdongs nas slar yang mi gzhir btso sbyong thebs so/don grub rgyal gyis brtsams sgrung 'de'i nang du dmigs yul yod pa'i sgo nas dbang ldan dang klu phyug rgan gzhon gnyis ngo shes pa nas spun grogs bsgrigs pa'i bar gyi brtse dung gi rgyud rim zhig bkod bsgrigs byas yod/ mi tshe'i mgo rtsom pa dang mjug bsdu ba'i gnas bab spyad te rtsom pa pos gting zab cing bro ba ldan pa'i sgo nas mi rabs gnyis kyi ma gros rang mthun gyi bsam pa'i go rtogs de mtshon yod/ klu phyug gis lag tu 'khar ba thogs shing / ha lam 'theng bor gyur 'dug pa'i rkang bas ha cang dka' ba'i ngang nas lus po 'degs pa dang / lam 'gram gyi pha bong chen po zhig gi steng btsog nas rlangs 'khor la sgug pa'i rgad po 'di thengs dang por mthong skabs/ khos rgyang ring nas bltas tshe bya rgod cig brag steng du babs pa lta bu'i snang ba zhig nges med du shar/ rgad po de'i gdong la lo mang du dka' sdug myangs pa'i rjes shul bkod yod la/ gnyer ris cung tsam gon pa'i mig kong du gsal zhing dwangs la/ shes rab kyis khengs pa'i mig 'bras gnyis mthong tshe/ mig zung 'di'i bdag po ni dbang bo skyon can dang / rkang lag mi bde ba zhig yin par su yang rlom mi srid/ don grub rgyal gyis dbang ldan gyi 'bag btsog gi bzhin ras dang mtshar sdug gi thang ka gnyis 82

rnam shes kyi dbyangasarta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabasabasgyur bar byas/ /phan tshun sbyar nas/ kha sang gi rgad po'i phyir dran de na gzhon klu phyug gi smyug rtse nas rgyun bsrings te/ khong gnyis rang rang so so'i dus skabs nas chas te/mtha' mar spyi la dbang ba'i brtse gdung zhig tu 'dres su bcug nas/ brjod don zab pa'i zhib 'bri re re'i thad nas dbang ldan dang klu phyug gnyis brtse gdung gi phung bo gcig tu bkod de/ klog pa po tshor rgan gzhon gnyis kyi 'jig rten sna gnyis mngon yod/ gcig ni mi yul gyi dga' skyo bral 'dzoms sogs kyis khengs shing / sems pa rgya mtsho ltar 'jags pa'i sgyu rtsal pa zhig yin la/ cig shos ni som nyi'i dra bar tshud cing / phyi rol gyi 'jig rten la lta ba'i re bsnyegs 'chang ba'i na gzhon zhig gcig ni khog rgya yangs shing byams sems ldan pa/cig shas ni gnas nges med du 'gro phod pa ste/ mi rabs 'di gnyis kyi bar du nam yang mi'i rigs kyi yid sems 'gugs thub pa'i brjod gzhi zhig brgyud sprod byas yod la/ de ni mi yul gyi brtse dung ngam khyim gzhi gcig gi brtse zhags kyi 'phro mdud red/ 'di lta bu'i brtse zhags kyi mdud pas mi rabs gnyis kyi rang sems kyi 'dun pa phyir sprod gnang yod la/ rtsom pa po'i gsar rtsom gyi 'du shes khrod ches gzhung drang zhing bab chags ldan pa'i mi gshis kyi 'du shes dang mi chos ring lugs kyi snying stobs de mtshon pas/ khong nyid la mi rigs 'di'i bsam pa'i lta stangs thad la 'bad brtson lhod med kyi sgul shugs drag tu 'phyur yod/ ha lam don grub rgyal lo na phra dus kyi 'tsho ba'i dka' khag gi dbang gis/83

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/khong gis pha ma'i byams brtse'i gdung ba de lhag par shugs drag cing / khong gis 'jig rten pha rol gyi ches gting zab kyi sha dang rus pa'i brtse dung bzhin phan tshun gcig la gcig brten gyi gdung ba de yod tshad brtsams chos khrod sel bar byas yod/ lha bzo ba dbang ldan dang khong gi a pha gnyis bar gyi phan tshun gcig srog gcig la brten pa'i lus thog tu/ khong gi ha cang yid thang chad pa'i sems pa de pha bu'i bar gyi zhim mngar gyi brtse gdung brjod pa'i khrod du sems gso thebs yong / khos yang nas yang du zhib phra'i 'tsho ba'i grub cha re re zhib 'bri byas pa'i rgyu rkyen ni byams brtse ldan pa'i a pha zhig gi snang brnyan la bstod bsngags bya ba'i ched du yin/ nga tshos don grub rgyal gyi brtsams chos khrod zhi drag gnyis 'gul gyi sems gting gi gsang ba de rtogs rjes/ khong gis ci'i phyir mtha' gcig tu deng rabs mi yi je zhan nas je zhan du 'gro ba'i brtse ba 'bri ba las/yid 'gyus khengs shing rtogs dka' ba'i skog gyur gyi brjod don mi bsnyegs pa'i rgyu mtshan rtogs la/ dbang med du 〈sha dang rus pa'i brtse dungs〉 zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung gi kha byang de dran 'ongs/ tag tag 'di 'dra'i rgyun ldan zhig ste ri ltar brtan zhing mtsho las zab pa'i dam bca' mi dgos la/ mi dran dgu dran yang bya mi dgos pa'i zhi dul dang bag yangs kyi mi'i rigs kyi brtse sems ngo ma de lo zla'i khrod du myu gu ltar 'bus shing / dga' skyo chags sdang gis bzhengs pa'i mi'i rigs kyi brtse gdung gi khang bzang la/ deng rabs tshan rtsal las byung ba'i ar 84

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /'dam gyis thebs pa'i bkag sdom khrod sngar las lhag pa'i gu dog dang sger sems che bar 'gyur ba ni deng rabs mi yi nyams myong gi zhan cha ma yin nam/don grub rgyal gyis 'di 'dra'i brtse gdung la rgyab brten pa ni/ khong gi brtsams sgrung khrod kyi gting zab cing bcos min gyi yid dbang 'phrog pa'i 'gug shugs shig red/ khong gis gsar bzhengs byas pa'i 'di 'dra'i phul byung / gzhung drang /bab chags/ brtse sems zab pa'i mi rigs rig gnas kyi rang gshis de/ mgo mi yang ba dang / khe phan mi gnyer ba'i kho rang nyid kyi mi tshe'i legs bshad cig red/ khos mi re re'i tshe srog gi myong bar thugs khur gnang rgyu de mdor bsdus nas bshad na/ mi rigs kyi brtse gdung gi tshe srog gi snying stobs kyi brgyud rim mngon pa zhig yin zhing / yod tshad la spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang nas thugs khur dang re smon bcol ba yin/khong gi brtsams sgrung khrod drod zhing 'jam pa'i khyim gzhi'i 'char snang mngon thub la/ 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi ches rgyun ldan dang ches med du mi rung ba'i rnam dag brtse dungs kyi khyad chos dang mi gshis de g.yo bzhin yod/ khong gis bod mi rigs kyi rig gzhung gi ngos 'dzin de rgya che zhing gting zab pa'i chos lugs brtse gdung gis mi gshis la ngos 'dzin byas pa'i steng du gzhi bcol zhing / khong gi rtsom rig gi myong ba de/ brtse gdung dang / mi chos/ mi gtso ring lugs sogs kyi brjod snying dang 'brel te mgo brtsams shing / dus rabs gsar ba'i bod rigs 85

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/kyi phyi tshul gyi khe grags mi gnyer ba'i rnam pa de mtshon yod/mtsho bod mtho sgang ste bod mi rigs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos kyis khengs pa'i rang byung gi rnam pa dang rngam brjid che ba'i bsam pa'i khyab khongs nang / mi'i rigs kyi sems pa'i bshul lam la lad zlos byas pa'i rtsom pa po zhig la mtshon nas bshad na/ don grub rgyal gyi khyad chos ni/ khos sngon lha sgrung bzhengs skrun dang bro ba myong ba'i tshod lta'i rgyud rim khrod/ khong gis blo rtse gcig sgrim gyis 'phrul snang rang bzhin dor la/ yin na'ang 'tshol zhib kyi khyad mtshar la dgag pa mi 'phen/ mi gshis khrod kyi bden mdzes legs gsum gyis 'jig rten blos btang bar ngo rgol byas yod/ dag pa'i zhing la bgrod phod pa'i spobs par rjes bsnyegs te 'jig rten lugs kyi spro sems la rgyab 'gal du song yod/de dang mnyam du khos kyang rang gi bsam pa'i zhing khams nas rang la sne khrid byed mkhan gyis mu mthud du bsam pa'i grog rong las thar ba'i phugs bsam gyi lha mo de 'tshol snyeg byed kyin yod/ da dung 'tshol snyeg 'di lta bu la rang byung las brgal ba'i rang byung gi yul zhig bkod sgrig bya dgos/ 〈btsan po'i bang so myul ba'i gtam rgyud〉 (bris tshar med)'di ni khos ngal ba 'dzem med kyis rtag brtan gyi mdzes pa 'tshol snyeg byas pa'i bsam pa'i ljongs rgyu thengs shig yin/ 'di ni rmi lam khrod kyi ha cang ring ba'i yul skor zhig ste/ de ni dmag zhabrug rang bzhin gyi kher rkyang dang rnam dag gam 'char yan gyis khengs pa'i 'grul bzhud cig red/86

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /rmi lam khrod kyi dong ring des/ yangs shing rtsub pa'i nang sems kyi zhing khams de mtshon la/ dben stong du grags pa'i khu byug gi gsung snyan gyis ha lam re ba zhig shugs bstan byed kyin yod/ kho rang dmyal ba dang mtshungs ba'i mun nag gi dong ring las 'od zer gyi lam du khrid mkhan gyi lha mo de ni/ tan tis brtsams pa'i〈lha'i rol dbyangs〉 khrod kyi pe ya ti li chus kyis tan ti de lha yul gyi phyogs su khrid pa dang 'dra bar/ don grub rgyal khrid de mu mthud du 'jig rten 'khor ba'i nang gi mi sems kyi nag nog dang / ma rig pa/ khungs med bcas 'dor bar byas te/ 'od zer dang 'dres pa'i lhad med kyi sems pa de dag pa'i zhing du bskyod song / 'di ni bsam pa'i steng gi thod brgal zhig yin la/ rang nyid gcig pur gnas pa'i rnam pa'i khrod/ khos lha mo'i mi mngon pa'i tshul gyis sne khrid pa tshor te/ thengs re re bzhin bslu brid dang rmongs pa/ 'jigs snang sogs las rnam par rgyal zhing / rang gi 'phrul snang du byung ba'i nyen kha dang gdug rtsub sna tshogs las rgyal thub/ khos rang gi sngon chad bzhag pa'i darme/ bca' brtsi srung byas te/ skrag snang dang 'gyod pa med pa'i sgo nas khas len gyi phugs bsam gyi phyogs su bskyod pa red/ khong gi brtsams sgrung khrod bris pa'i 'phrul snang dang 'phrad tshe mgo mi 'khor ba dang / dka' khag gi mdun du phyi bshol dang 'dor bar mi byed pa'i dad pa brtan po dang spro sems chen po des/ khong gi rnam shes 'dren pa'i khungs de res su 'khor ba'i sems kyi rgyud sprod steng du yod pa rtogs/87

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/khos rang gi sems steng du dka' sdug thams cad snang med dang / rang gi phugs bsam la phyogs phod pa/ mi tshe'i 'gyod gdung khrod gom mtshams mi 'jog pa'i gangs ljongs pho gsar gyi snying stobs shig bzhengs bskrun byas yod/ de ni brtsams sgrungs khrod kyi lha yis gsungs ba nang bzhin/ lha yul du 'gro bar tshegs med kyang / 'jig rten mi yul gyi gang zag rnams ni sems la nyon mongs/lus su sdig sgrib che bas/ 'di lta bu'i khur gyis ljid pa'i lus sems de thar ba thob par ha cang dka' nyon mongs dug gsum de lus nas dag par byas rjes/ da gzod sdug bsngal las thar ba'i lam thob/ spyir brtsams sgrung 'di kho rang 'das pa'i rkyen gyis mjug skyong ma thub mod/ 'on kyang khong gi 'di lta bu'i rmi lam dang myong rtogs/ rang rlom che zhing 'dul dka' ba/ phugs bsam dang lhag bsam la brten nas mi gshis kyi sger sems rang bzhin dang tha shal gyi tshul 'dor spobs pa'i dpa' bo ring lugs kyi brjid nyams dang / da dung phal ba yin pas tha shal du mi 'gyur ba dang / ya rabs dang spyod pa gtsang bas mgo bo gyen la mi 'degs pa'i snying stobs bcas kyis/ khong gi brtsams chos khrod ha cang shugs drag pa'i 'char yan ring lugs kyi nyams kyis khyab par byas yod/ 'di 'dra'i nyams 'gyur dang snying stobs des/ kho rang 'das rjes kyi lo ngo bcu lhag gi yun du/lkog nas ngan bshad byed par dga' zhing rang don phran bu tsam yang sems su 'dzin pa'i deng rabs mi yis brtsams chos 'di 'dra zhig la kha ya mi byed par 88

rnam shesakyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangasastabasabasgyur bar byas/ /brjed de 'jig rten gyi spro dga'i khrod gnas pa'i kha yag dang ngo dga' khrod du yal mod/ 'on kyang nga rang la yid ches brtan po zhig yod de/ snying stobs kyi ches dma' ba'i dus rim ni rnam shes thar thor du 'gro ba'i dus ma yin/ lhag par du bsam pa'i dad mos de 'tsho gnas kyi rtsa bar 'dzin pa'i mi rigs shig la mtshon nas brjod na/ sems pa btul te lha gnas su 'pho ba'i lhag bsam rnam dag gi mdzad sgo da dung rngam brjid ldan pa'i mchod khri'i steng spel nges/don grub rgyal gyi brtsams sgrung mang che ba zhig ni lo rabs brgyad bcu'i dus mgor brtsams shing / bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus dang lo rgyus rig pa gnyis la zhib 'jug byed pa'i zhib 'jug slob ma zhig la mtshon nas bshad na/ khong gi rig gzhung zhib 'jug dang rtsom rig gsar rtsom gnyis phal cher dus mnyam du gong 'phel byung zhing / 1980lo nas 1985lo'i bar gyi dus yun thung thung nang /khong gi tshe srog gi bgrang bya so gnyis ring gi dbyar dgun ston dpyid kyi 'khor 'gros las/ khong gis rig gzhung gi brtsams chos re rer thabs lam gsar ba re brgyud de/ zab cing mthug pa'i yon tan dang rang rkya pher ba'i shes rab la brten nas/ kho rang nyid kyi deng rabs bod kyi rig gzhung gi lta ba chags/ khong gi rtsom rig gi dga' phyogs dang sems shugs des thad kar du bod kyi rtsom rig gi 'phel rgyas la tshe srog cig sbyin yod/ khong gi brtsams chos re re'i rgyab ljongs su/ nga tshos khong gi 'jig rten 'tsho ba'i khrod gnas pa'i mi tshang mar yod nges 89

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/pa'i sems shugs drag po dang / kher rkyang / sdug bsngal/ dga' ba sogs kyis brtsams chos yongs su zin pa'i skabs su khos bsdu len dang nang 'dren byas te/yi ge'i rnam pas rang gzhan gnyis ka'i yid sems drangs/ khos gsar rtsom gyi sgyu rtsal gyi khor yug tu/ rang nyid nar son pa'i go rim khrod kyi las dbang brjod pa dang / kho dang khong gi brtsams sgrung khrod kyi mi sna gnyis phan tshun kha brda byas te bsam blo brje res dang 'brel 'dris byed pa bcas kyi ngang tshul las 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi sdug bsngal gyi myong ba the ba'i 'tsho ba hril gyis dang len dang ngos len byas te/ de las gting du snyigs pa'i snying stobs kyi bcud nga tshor sbyin yod/ de'i rkyen gyis/ 'brug mtsho dang pad mtsho'i gangs ltar dwangs pa'i mig mdangs khrod nga tshos don grub rgyal gyis ches thog ma'i mi gshis kyi rnam par dag pa'i cha de bsdu len la byis blo ltar phyogs gcig kho na bzung ba thal drags pas/ lha skyid dang / tshe ring / dbang ldan sogs kyi phun sum tshogs pa'i tshe srog rgyud rim las/las 'brel gyis grub pa/ rnying dor gsar len/ bzod sgom ldan pa'i mi gshis kyi nang don thog don grub rgyal gyis tshe srog gi nang bcud de 'dra'i dwangs gtsang kho na zhig min par/ 'gyur ldog dang g.yo 'gul/ mi gshis dang lha gshis gnyis kyi thal rdul dang dwangs gtsang gnyis kyis grub pa'i phung bo zhig yin pa rim gyis rtogs kyang / khong gis mtho sgang gis nyi 'od dang len byed thub cing / gangs ri yang dang len byed thub pa nang bzhin hril gyis dang du blangs/ gsar rtsom gyi dga' 90

rnam shesakyi dbyangasarta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangasastabasabasgyur bar byas/ /snang khrod/ khong gis mdzes sdug yid du 'ong ba'i rnam shes dag la shes rab dang /spro sems 'khol ba/ tshe srog gi rnam pa rgyan spros byas rjes da gzod nga tsho'i mdun du bkrams/myong tshor dang 'char snang gi pha sa sa don grub rgyal gyis nga tshor bstsal ba ni rtsom rig gi myong tshor kho na ma yin par/ tshe srog de nga tshos gus shing 'jigs pa'i yi ger bkod de/ mdzes sdug ldan pa'i bod yig gi gsal byed re re bsgyur nas lhab lhub tu 'bab pa'i kha ba'i 'dab ma bzhin nga tsho'i phrag zung g.yogs/gnyis pa/1986lo'i zla10par/ bod kyi snyan ngag pa grags can yi dam tshe ring lags kyis/ don grub rgyal 'das nas lo 'khor gcig lon pa'i rjes dran gyi nyin mo der/ 〈yid ches kyi lam ste/ rang nyid kyi shugs ring las brgal ba'i rtogs sad〉 ces pa'i snyan ngag cig bris te/ phul tu byung ba'i mkhas pa 'di la rjes dran byas/ sems shugs drag pos brtas pa'i snyan ngag pas khong la 'di ltar bstod pa byas yod de/ khyod ni ji 'dra'i las can zhig red ang / a ma'i mngal las skyes ma thag me bzhin du 'bar ba'i mig zung rnon po zhig ldan zhing / nu ma nu ba'i dus skabs nas/ ri'i mtho tshad dang chu'i gting tshad 'jal/ gog 'gro byed pa'i dus nas 'tshol zhib kyi lam du zhugs/ sgor bud ma thag glog ji ltar 91

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/'khyug pa dang / 'brug ji ltar grags pa rtogs la/ gom gang spos ma thag rgya mtsho ji ltar dal gyis bskyod pa dang / ri bo ji ltar gyen du 'bur ba'i gsang tshig brtol/ zhes pa ltar/ ri dang rgya mtsho'i thod gtugs pa'i ngar skad las 'khrungs pa'i mdo dbus mtho sgang du/ don grub rgyal gyis bde ba can gyi zhing khams su rgyang lta byed bzhin/ snyan ngag gi dung bas gsos shing snyan ngag gi bro bas bsnyal pa'i zhing khams 'di sa khos rang sems la brten nas mi rabs nas mi rabs bar du nyams pa med pa'i mes po dang rang nyid kyi khrag rgyun na nyal ba'i lhan skyes kyi snyan ngag gi sa bon rnyed/ 'dzam gling gi dpa' bo'i lo rgyus snyan rtsom ring shos〈ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung〉 du/ rta mchog gi rmug rjes na bskyur ba'i gser dngul g.yu byur sgrung ba'i ngag na ske rgyan du bsgrigs nas yid sems 'gugs pa'i lo rgyus phar zhog seng lcam 'brug mo rtswa thang du dal gyis bgrod pa'i zhabs rjes las bzhad pa'i me tog gi 'dab ma re res kyang / nga tshos yul 'di ni snyan ngag gi sa bon 'debs sar ches 'os pa'i gnas shig yin pa bden dpang byed thub/gnas 'di yi sgyu 'phrul dang / 'char yan/re sgug gis khyab pa'i snying 'jags kyi 'tsho bas/ rgyun par tshor ba 'phel skyen pa'i sems dang rang byung / sems dang lha bar 'bral med du sbrel yod/ gzhan yang / sangs rgyas kyi byams snying rje dang 'dra mnyam gyi dgongs pas zin pa'i mi yi rnam shes kyi 'od zer gnas 'di yi mkha' dbyings nas lo ngo stong phrag lhag gi ring la 'phros myong la/ nyi zla 'di'i 'og tu 92

rnam shes kyi dbyangasarta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangasastabs bsgyur bar byas/ /sngon byon gyi skyes mchog dam pa re res mi tshe hril gyis sgom brgyab ste 'phags pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i khrod du/ la la zhig sprin dkar du sprul shing / la la zhig dar lcog tu sprul ba/ la la zhig rang byung du sprul nas bskal ba'i bar du gnas nas rang gi skyes pa snga phyi la mno bsam gtong ba de ni snyan ngag gi rang gshis 'byungs pa'i dus rim ma yin nam/ nga'i bsam pa'i rmongs 'char la nga tsho'i snyan ngag pa rnams kyis sems kyi 'od kor brtol ba'i dus yun 'gyangs pa'i bar thag kyi dbang gis/ 'od gsal zhing rgyang thag ring ba'i sa nas mes po tshos tshe srog dang / rang byung la gdung 'bod byas pa'i gdangs dbyangs la nyan tshe/ khong gi snyan ngag gis gting zab pa'i ngang nas yod tshad 'jibs par ma zad/ da dung rang nyid las thod brgal byung ba rtogs thub/gal te don grub rgyal gyi brtsams sgrung du/ mi gshis la thugs khur dang /tshe srog gi sra zhing phun sum tshogs pa'i rim par rgyus lon/ mi'i tshe srog gi gnas stangs kyi 'pheb 'grib la thugs khur gnang yod ce na/ khong gi spro snang 'khol ba'i snyan ngag gi khyab khongs su/ tshe srog gi ches mtho ba'i lha gshis la ngos len dang bstod bsngags byas yod/ rgyun ldan gyi tshe srog gi ngang thung dang bag yangs las khong gis rig par brten nas brtse dung gi 'gro phyogs la tshod 'dzin ma byas la/ lugs brtsi srol srung gi sgyu rtsal gyi tshad ldan mtshon stangs la'ang ma brten par/ khos mdzes nyams ldan pa'i tshig sbyor la brten nas/ khyad mtshar gyi 93

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/bsam pa'i brtse gdung dang gsal zhing dag pa'i 'degs 'jog gis gsal byed sum cu'i sdeb sbyor ri rtse nas chu mo rgyug pa nang bzhin le bar stong phrag tu drag tu 'bab par byas/ nga tsho 'di lta bu'i snyan ngag gi khor yug tu sdod dus/ bsam pa'i sgo mo ches cher phyes te khong gi rmi lam gyi zhing khams su gyar ba'i snyan ngag tshor thub/〈'khrul min rmi lam ngo mtshar dga' skyed〉 ni don grub rgyal gyi skabs dang po'i rgyal yongs grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi 'gran bsdur khrod snyan ngag khag gi bya dga' 'thob pa'i snyan rtsom zhig yin zhing / snyan rtsom gyi lus hril bor chu mo rgyug pa'am sprin pa 'byur ba lta bu'i tshig gi sbyor bas mdzes shing / rgyan sna tshogs kyis phyug pa/ tshig brjid cing lhun chags ldan pa bcas kyis/ don grub rgyal gyi bod kyi gna' gzhud gi tshigs bcad snyan ngag gi sra zhing brtan pa'i rmang gzhi mngon thub/ rmi lam gyi zhing khams su/ rab rib kyi bsam gzhigs ring mo khrod nas sems lhod yangs chen pos gting zab kyi brtse gdung la bstod pa'i gnas su phyin/ de ni bod kyi srol rgyun snyan ngag khrod du rgyun par bkod pa'i brtse dung 'bri tshul zhig red/ 'di lta bu'i 'du shes med pa dang phyed ka'i sems khams grub rim nang / snyan ngag par nam yang gsar rtsom gyi nus pa dang 'char sgo'i nus pas khengs par ma zad/ da dung tshe srog gi ldem shugs kyis khengs yod/ de los yin te/ 'di yang snyan ngag pa'i 'du shes yod pa'i sgo nas bzo bskrun byas pa'i 'du shes med pa'i yul khams shig red/ 'di lta bu'i rang 94

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangasastabs bsgyur bar byas/ /byung las brgal ba'i snying stobs gnas yul du/ khong gis da gzod mdzes dpyod kyi mthong yul nas drag tu 'phyur ba'i brtse gdung skrun pa red/ khos rmi lam du skar tshogs khra chil ler 'dug pa dang / gser 'od phyogs bzhir 'phro ba/ gangs ri g.yo ba/ sbrang mas gshog rlabs rdeb pa sogs rmis/ mkha' dbyings kyi yol ras chen mo'i 'og tu/ snyan ngag pa'i rmi lam gyi dar tshon mkha' ru 'phur bas/ rmi lam gyi gshog zung dal gyis rdeb byung / rmi lam nang nas mkhal ru 'phur ba'i sems pa des dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi mdzes sdug gi re ba gang mang zhig khyer te/dus rabs kyi rol dbyangs dang bsdongs nas/ 'tsho ba gsar ba'i rgyab ljongs zhig basbun zhing / rmi lam sad dus/ nga tsho'i mthong lam gyi zur zhig tu bzhur byung /gal te nga tshos dus rabs dang mthun pa'i mdzes rtogs kyi brtse gdung gi dgos pa dang de'i kha snon gyi cha rkyen 'dor dgos na/ snyan ngag khrod kyi bsam bzhin du btsan sgrig byas pa'i cha la dwangs snyigs bton tshe/ don grub rgyal gyis khong gi brtse dung khyer pa'i snyan ngag gi sgrig rim dang / brjod pa/ gdangs dbyangs sogs sngar bzhin khyad 'phags kyi srol rgyun snyan ngag gi mdzes nyams mngon nas/ dus rabs 'di'i snyan rtsom gyi tshogs su rang rkya pher ba'i ngang gnas yod/srol rgyun snyan ngag gi gab pa mngon phyung dang rgyan sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa gnyis kyis brgyan pa'i 'og don grub rgyal gyi snyan ngag gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi bro ba dang mdzes rtogs kyi 'dod snang gis nga tshor khong gi skad cha'i sgyu 95

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/rtsal dang rig gnas kyi zungs khrag las mched pa'i srol rgyun snyan ngag 〈rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod〉 'di 'khyer 'ongs pa red/〈ra ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod〉dang〈ma hā bha ra ta'i gtam rgyud〉gnyis kyis rgya gar gyi snyan rtsom lo rgyus steng go sa gtso bo zhig zin yod/ dpa' bo rā ma ṇa dang khong gi chung ma si tā gnyis kyi gtam rgyud de/ rgya gar du sa khyab rdo khyab tu song yod la/ spyi lo1439lor/ bod kyi ming du grags pa'i mkhas dbang / rje tsong kha ba chen mo'i slob ma brgya lhag gi khrod na ming du grags pa'i zhang zhung chos dbang grags pas〈rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud〉'di bod kyi srol rgyun tshigs bcad snyan ngag tu bsdebs la/ de nas bzung rtsom yig 'di ni rgya gar rig byed rtsom rig khrod kyi snyan rtsom 'khrul med zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed cing / bod kyi mkhas dbang rnams kyis de nyid phra zhing zhib par spus ldan gyi bod kyi lo rgyus snyan rtsom zhig tu bsgyur/ra ma ṇa dang si tā gnyis kyi yongs grags kyi brtse dung gis rang byung khams chen mo'i rgya che zhing mdzes sdug ldan pa'i rnam pa de legs par spras te/ gangs ljongs nas snyan ngag gi khu sim dang rgyang ring dang mi sems dbang med du sgul ba'i cha de rgya bskyed/zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa'i snyan ngag gi khyad chos de mang che ba rgya gar shar ba'i lugs kyi shan shugs thebs yod cing / de lho ba'i brjod don gsal zhing tshig sbyor bde ba'i sgyu rtsal khyad chos dang bsdur tshe/ snga mas de las kyang skad 96

rnam shes kyi dbyangasarta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangasastabs bsgyur bar byas/ /cha'i mdzes nyams dang rig byed gtam rgyud bkol rgyu gtsigs su bzung zhing /rtsom rtsal dang rgyan bkod tshul byang bar byas te snyan ngag gi gdangs dbyangs legs po yong bar brtson pa byas yod/ de ni cis zhan lin gyis gsungs ba nang bzhin/ gdangs gcig la brtson dgos na/ /tshig gcig la zhib sdur dgos/ /zhes pa ltar yin/ don grub rgyal mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyi phrag par langs te/snyan ngag pas sgyu rtsal gyi 'khyer so 'dzin pa dang brje ba'i byed thabs kyis/ ma rtsom gyi chig rkyang dang / brtan 'jags/ bab brling gi zhib brjod byed thabs las brgal nas/ khong gi thogs pa med pa'i skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyis mdzes nyams ldan zhing phun sum tshogs pa'i brjod don kha lo bsgyur pas/ 〈rā ma ṇa'i〉sgyu rtsal gyi skad cha stabs bde dang / yi ge dang nang don gnyis ma sgrig rang mthun byas pa'i phyogs su phyogs te/ rdzing bur pad+ma bzhad pa'am rang byon sgyu ri mo ltar snang bas/ da gzod mtshar sdug thal drags pas rang ga bar snang ba'i dpe ltar sgyu rtsal gyi yul khams chen por thon pa red/tshigs bcad snyan ngag gi rgyal sa na don grub rgyal gyi rang dbang ldan pa'i sems pa de gang dgar mchong rgyug byas te/ zhib phra spros pa'i bod yig gi tshigs bcad snyan rtsom 'bri srol khrod/ khos ches mtho ba'i snyan ngag gi rang gshis de mngon yod/ 〈rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod〉 la yang bskyar rgyas bkrol gnang ba de/mkhas dbang tshos 'di ltar gdeng 'jog byas yod de/ ‘‘gdangs rang shugs kyis 97

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/mthun zhing / tshig gi ring thung ha cang 'tsham/ rgyan phun sum tshogs par spros pa/dbyangs rna bar snyan pa'o’’de las kyang gtso che ba ni khong gis bod kyi mkhas dbang rnams kyis snyan ngag gi nang don la bton pa'i tshe srog gi rnam pa de rgyud 'dzin byas pa de red/ snyan rtsom khrod mi sna'i snang brnyan dang nang sems kyi bsam pa'i brtse dungs kyi 'gul skyod 'bur du thon par byas yod/ brtse ba dang khor yug mnyam 'dres kyi rgya che ba'i rang byung gi rgyab ljongs khrod/ rang byung las 'phros pa'i gting zab pa'i mi tshe'i don snying ste skyo ba med pa'i sdong bo'i me tog dang / dir dir sgrog pa'i ra yig gnyis pa/ chu skyes pad+ma'i 'dab ma sogs kyis rā ma ṇas si tur bcangs pa'i brtse dung de mngon yod/ gal te zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa'i〈ra ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod〉la dpe rgyan gyis mdzes shing tshig sbyor bde ba/ rngams brjid kyis khengs pa'i srol rgyun snyan rtsom gyi mdzes pa ldan zer na/ don grub rgyal gyi〈rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod〉ni tshig sbyor bde zhing go don rtogs sla ba'i snyan rtsom de sems pa dang rang byung du slebs pa'i lhing 'jags dang spyir btang gi ri mo'i brtsams chos shig dang mtshungs/ 'di lta bu'i sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur de bāng go wa'e yi skad cha 'di dang 'dra ste/ ‘‘rtsom pa po grags can gyi rtsom yig de/ de'i brtse gdung gi skad cha'ang nges par du mi yi khams dang mthun zhing / de'i yul ljongs kyi zhib 'bri'ang nges par du mi'i rna la snyan zhing mig la mdzes pa zhig yin dgos/ de'i tshig sbyor chu mo rgyug pa nang bzhin dang / bcos ma'i rgyan gyis ma 98

rnam shesakyi dbyangasarta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /khebs shing / mthong ba don ldan dang rtogs pa'i gting zab pa cig yin no/ /’’don grub rgyal gyi snyan rtsom khrod bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi zhing sa ru rtsa ba rgyas pa'i mdzes sdug gi nyams de ni khong gis bod mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas la deng rabs kyis 'grel bshad byas pa las byung / mi mang po zhig snyan ngag gi tshig rgyan gyi rtsed mtshar dang / tshig gi mdzes rtsal la mgo 'thoms yong skabs/ kho rang yi ge'i rtsed mo khrod nas brgal te/ khong gi sems gting gi ngag gi lha mo dbyangs can ma de la mi'i tshe srog dang ldan par ma zad/ tshe srog dang tshe srog mnyam pa'i ches nye ba'i brtse ba'i lha mo zhig red/ dbyangs can ma'i pi wang gi sgra dbyangs 'og chos lugs kyi dag pa'i zhing khams kyi ches snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrog thub la/ de las kyang lhag pa zhig la mi gzhis khrod brtas pa'i tshe srog gi thog ma'i 'khrun sgra'ang 'byin thub/ don grub rgyal gyis snyan ngag la rgyus lon byas pa der/ mi rigs rig gnas dang srol rgyun sgyu rtsal la nye bar bcar zhing shes rtogs byung ba 'dus par ma zad/ rang 'gul gyis snyigs dor bcud len byas yod/ khong gi don brjod snyan ngag gzhan zhig ste/ 〈rgyal srid sna bdun la sbyar ba'i 'bel gtam〉la sngar med gsar spros dang / thun min sgyu rtsal gyi 'gug shugs shig ldan pas thos pa tsam gyis skya ser yongs la yid 'gul thebs thub pa zhig yin phyir/ krung go'i bod rgyud mtho rim nang bstan slob gling gi bslab gzhi'i khrod du bdams yod/ don brjod snyan rtsom 'di'i nang / khong 99

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/gis rtog btags dang 'ud bstod kyi smyug rtsal bkol te/ 'khor lo rin po che dang / nor bu rin po che/ glang bo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ bcas rin po che sna bdun re re bzhin/ snyan rtsom nang gi dngos yod kyi snang brtan re la bsgyur te/rin po che sna bdun so so'i rang rang gi khyad rmos de/ kha dog rnam par bkra zhing /gser 'od lam lam 'phro ba'i bltas na mthong rgyu yod pa'i snang brnyan mnga' ba'i ri mo re re bris nas/ dri ba dris lan dang / rang don rang brjod byed pa/ yang na kha ta bslab bya gnang ba sogs snyan ngag gi rnam pa sna tshogs kyi gtam gleng gi sgo nas klog pa po tshor brdzid chags yid du 'ong zhing / khyon rgya yangs pa'i blo khams shig bskrun te/ nga tshor rdo rje pha lam dang / dngul dkar/ gser nag byu mā g.yu/mu tig sogs kyi lha'i bzo ba'i rtsal las grub pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo rin po che la blta bar byas/ dus kyi rgyal bo 'dis mngags pa'i pho nya des/ ji ltar khong gi gsung dbyangs de 'khyer nas nga tsho'i tshig don gyi thang chen du zhugs 'ongs she na/khong gis brtson 'grus can gyi shes rab kyi snying stobs la bstod bsngags mdzad de/ bag med longs spyod kyis bzi zhing / dus tshod kyi bzhur rgyun ring mo'i khrod/mu mthud du le lo dang / rnam g.yeng / gti mug sogs kyi dbang du gyur ba'i nga tsho'i rmongs mun gyi sems khams btul nas 'ongs/ gser gyi 'khor lo de mu mtha' med pa'i a sngon nas 'phyur nas 'ongs mod/ 'gran rtsod dang / phrag dogang rgyal sogs kyi lag zung chen po de sngar bzhin mun nag gi mtshan mo'i khrod na 100

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /phar g.yug tshur g.yug gis khengs bas lha nor de slar yang shes bya'i nor chen du sprul nas/ kho mo'i gzi byin 'bar ba'i 'od snang 'khyer nas shes rab kyi mtsho mo ru 'khrungs/ kho mo'i yon tan gyi bdud rtsi de zang zing gi 'du 'dzi'i khrod na rnam shes kyi kha brdar nyan pa'i shes rab can kho nar dbang la/ kho mo'i 'od snang de snying stobs dang dad mos kyi skyabs 'jug zhu mkhan tsho'i mjes sdug gi gtsug rgyan byed pa las/ tshong zong brje res khrod na 'khyam pa'i lcags rigs kyi 'od zer byed mi srid/ dmar rjen rjen du mngon pa'i rtsom gshis thabs chag sngar bzhin khyab pa'i dus 'dir/ blon po rin po ches lhag bsam dang bzod bsran/glang po rin po ches blo brtan dang bab brling/ btsun mo rin po ches zhi 'jam dang gzhung bzang / rta mchog ren po ches rang dbang dang rnam shes la gces 'dzin gyi snying stobs bcas re re bzhin rang rang gi nus par sbyar te/ blo brtan 'gyur med kyis bsam blo'i dwangs gtsang gi khams srung yod/ shes rab dang / shes bya/brtson 'grus/ gshis bzang / gzhung drang sogs kyi mdun du/ khyad du 'phags la 'thus sgo tshang ba'i mi gshis brjid po de/ mthar nga tsho'i lus la 'ching ba'i blun rmongs dang / ma rig pa/ ham sems/ sun snang sogs spran nad las rgyal ba red/〈rgyal srid sna bdun la sbyar ba'i 'bel gtam〉gyis nga tshor 'khyer 'ongs pa snyan ngag pa rang gi sgyu rtsal khyad chos kho na min par khong gi zhib phra skog gyur gyi sgyu rtsal gzugs brtan dang sems khams kyi khyad mtshar ba'i 'gyur ldog khrod/ snyan 101

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/rtsom gyi lus su khong gis shes rab dang / snying stobs/ phugs bsam/ da dung srol rgyun gyi rin thang gi lta tshul sogs la brtsi bkur dang rgyus lon byas pa'i gting zab kyi go don de mngon yod/ lo rabs brgyad bcu ba'i nang / nga tsho'i rtsom rig ni gang sar 'gas gtor byas pa'i dngos po'i ham 'dod dang tshong las kyi mtho rlabs kyis mnar te don med stong gtam du ma gyur bar/ da dung snying stobs dang dad mos kyi gshog zung brkyangs te/ thabs chag dang / don med/ bcos ma'i mdangs sogs la rgyang gyes nas 'phur bzhin yod/ slar yang snyan ngag 'di bklags tshe/ nga tsho'i mtha' skor du khyab pa'i kha dbugs de sngar bzhin gsar ba zhig ste/ jo mo glang ma'i steng nas 'thul yong ba'i zhim mngar ldan pa'i lhan skyes kyi dri mas khengs shing / thal mo'i rdeb sgra dben pa'i lhing 'jags kyi khrod na khams dwangs pa'i tshor bas khengs 'dug go /h+pha ran si'i brnyan bzo ba lo tan gyis/ 〈sgyu rtsal la dpyad pa〉 ces pa'i nang skad cha 'di 'dra zhig bshad myong ste/ slob dpon chen po zhes pa ni gzhan gyi bltas myong ba'i dngos po la rang gis bltas nas/ gzhan gyis rgyun mthong mtshar med kyi dngos po'i steng nas mdzes pa rnyed thub pa zhig la zer/ le h+phu'u tho ar si than gyis/ ji ltar snyan ngag dang ldan na/ de ltar gsar rtsom dang ldan no/ /zhes gsungs myong la/ rlabs che ba'i mi rnams kyis kyang ‘‘rgyun ldan dang goms srol dkyus ma gnyis ni snyan ngag pa'i gsar rtsom gyi 'dzem bya chen po zhig red’’ ces 102

rnam shes kyi dbyangasarta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /gsungs pa bzhin don grub rgyal gyis khong gi snyan rtsom gsar rtsom khrod/ thog mtha' bar gsum du rang gi snyan ngag gi lhan skyes de sngar yod kyi rnam pa'i steng nas mu mthud du brgal bar 'bad kyin yod/ khong gi rang mos snyan ngag 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉 ni/ rbab chu lta bu'i spro sems dang / mkha' dbyings su 'phur skyod byed pa'i snyan ngag gi nyams kyis bris yod la/ pha skad kyi ngo bo ma yal ba'i skad cha'i khor yug khrod tu/ klog pa po rnams la dus rabs gsar ba'i mtho sgang gi na gzhon tshos rang gi lang tsho'i me lce bkol nas tshe srog gi mdun lam ston phod pa dang / lang tsho'i stobs shugs kyis tshe srog don ldan du 'gyur bar gdung 'bod byed phod pa/ g.yo 'gul med pa'i dad sems dang mchog gyur gyi bsam pa'i mdzub khrid 'og gzi brjid dang re snyeg spro ba sogs ldan pa'i ma 'ongs par phyogs pa'i zhum med kyi snying stobs mtshon yod/ 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉 ni don grub rgyal gyi tshul ldan bab chags kyi skyes pa'i skad gdangs kyis bod kyi snyan rtsom gsar bar sgrog pa'i gdung 'bod cig red/ 'ud bstod ma yin pa'i sgo nas brjod na/ khong ni bod kyi snyan ngag gsar ba'i gsar btod pa yin/ khong gi snyan rtsom gyis dus nam yang tshe srog gi khrod ches mdzes sdug ldan pa'i sgo mo phyes te/rgyang thag ring ba'i lha gshis kyi 'char snang dang mes po tshos sems par sems gso byas pa dang len dang / srol rgyun snyan ngag gi rtsom gshis kyi dbugs rgyun rgyud 'dzin byas pa'i khrod tshe srog gi sra brtan dang phun tshogs kyi legs skyes kyang 103

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/dang len byas pa red/ de'i stabs kyis/ khong gi snyan ngag gis mi rnams deng rabs kyi shugs drag po'i dga' skyo las gyar bar byed thub la/ zang zing dang bral ba'i gna' bo'i dus skabs su'ang slebs par 'jug thub/ snyan rtsom gyi dum mtshams re re dang tshig phreng re re'i lhug brjod dam/ yang na snyan ngag gi tshig don 'ga' zhig gi 'og tu nga tshos tshor thub pa ni/ khong gi tshe srog gi ngo bo de khos bstod bsngags byed pa'i rbab chu bzhin/ ri mthon po nas mar 'bab pa'i spro sems dang skyo gdung gis khengs 'dug tshe srog gi rbab chu des/ gangs dar gyis 'khyag pas bsdams 'dod kyi re ba gtor la/ mtho ba nas dma' bar 'bab pa'i mchong lding gi rnam pa ni khong gi gug pa las chad par dga' zhing mkha' nas dpyangs ba las sa ru 'bab par 'dod pa'i bag yangs kyi tshe srog gi lta tshul de brjod yod/ ngar gdung dang shes rab la lag brdzis byas shing / tha na khong gi mi tshe'i mtha' mjug de'ang snyan ngag gi lam nas shugs bstan byas yod/ tshe srog gi me lce ni ji 'dra'i ngar shugs ldan pa la ang / khong gis mtho sgang nas 'ongs ba'i dwangs gtsang gi rbab chu de/ gangs ljongs kyi lcags ltar sra ba'i pho rgod kyi rnam sprul yin par bstod bsngags 'di ltar mdzad yod de/ ‘‘brjid cing rngams pa'i nyams/ 'jigs pa med pa'i snying / zhum pa med pa'i dpa'/ dar zhing rgyas pa'i lus/ snyan zhig 'jebs pa'i glu’’ zhes bris yod/ rbab chu'i stod rgyud ni gangs ljongs kyi pho rgod tsho'i lang tsho'i chu bo yin la/ de na sdar ma dang bcos ma'i 104

rnam shes kyi dbyangasarta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangasastabs bsgyur bar byas/ /rang mdangs dben la/ snyan grags g.yo sgyu dang mi bsam dgu bsam gyi snyigs ro yang med/ de ni khu sim mer gnas te/ ‘‘dpyid gsum dal gyis 'bab pa'i char chu dang / dbyar gsum sa nas brdol ba'i chu mig ston gsum sad dang ser badzo nying bcud/ dgun gsum khangs dang kha ba'i yang bcud ’’ sogs bsdu rub byas rjes/ rang byung khams kyi dus bzhi'i 'gro 'ong gis khong la gnad smin 'thus tshang gi gdangs dbyangs shig bstsal/ char rlung mang po brgyud pa'i mi tshe de tshe srog gi 'od snang dang bsdongs nas sngar las lhag pa'i bkrag mdangs 'tsher skabs/tshe srog gi chu bo 'di gangs ljongs kyi bkra shis pa'i chu bo dang / ngo mtshar ba'i chu bo/ don grub pa'i chu bo bcas dang gzhi gcig tu 'dres nas de yis yan lag brgyad ldan gyi nus pas rtswa thang dang zhing sa yongs su lhag med du bzhur zhing / de nas phyi bshol med par rgya mtsho chen por bskyod pa red/ lang tsho'i rbab chu de tshe srog gi na tshod gzhon rkyen spro sems dang ngar gdung gis khengs yod/ snyan ngag pa'i mig lam du/ 'di ni mi tshe'i khrod kyi lang tsho'i dus rim zhig min ga la srid/rnyog pa dang bral ba'i dwangs gtsang dang / sa rdul gyis ma gos pa'i rang mdangs des/ nyam sems kyis dwangs gtsang gi rgyug chu yod tshad bsdu len byas te/ rang lus la 'tsho bcud bskrun pa dang / mu mthud du tshe srog gi lhad skyon la dwangs snyigs phyes nas rang nyid phun sum tshogs par btang / snyan ngag pas tshe srog gi chu bo 'di la 'di ltar brjod yod de/‘‘rbab chu ya/ khyed ni lo rgyus kyi dpang bo dang /105

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/ma 'ongs pa'i lam ston red/ khyed kyi dri ma dang bral ba'i chu thigs re re'i nang du/gangs can bod kyi 'phel 'grib 'khod yod la/ khyed kyi gzegs ma 'bar ba'i rdul phran re re'i nang du/ bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs kyi dar rgud 'dus yod/’’'di ni rbab chu'i ches rngam brjid ldan pa'i mar 'bab kyi ngang tshul yin/ sha thor rus thor 'gro ba'i dus skabs med na/ skyo gar gyi glu dbyangs lta bu'i gdung 'bod kyang yod mi srid/ 'ur sgra med tshe rbab chu de dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad pa'i bem ro zhig dang mtshungs/ mar la 'bab pa ni kho'i mtho tshad kyi bden dpang zhig yin la/ tshe srog gi yangs shing che ba'i 'pho 'gyur dang tshab byed gzhan zhig red/ da dung tshe srog bzhur rgyun gyi mgo gzhan zhig brtsams pa'ang yin/ snyan ngag pas 'di 'dra'i mdzes sdug gi ri mo dang kha gtad de/ khong gi tshad mtho ba'i spro sems de mtshon yod la/ tshe srog gi srog ldan chu bo de drangs tshe/ da gzod snying stobs kyi khyim gzhi de dus bzhi la ljang bar nges/ gson shugs kyis brtas pa'i chu bo 'di ni na gzhon gyi sems pa dang / lang tsho'i mtshar sdug gi 'dzum mdangs yin la/lo rgyus kyi nyams pa med pa'i rgyud 'dzin dang / bcu phrug rig gnas kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i rgyun bsrings kyang yin/ rbab chu la 'di lta bu'i tshe srog gi ngar shugs shig ldan yod rkyen/ snyan ngag gi yid dbang 'gug pa'i nus pa bslang ba red/snyan ngag pas spro sems 'khol ba'i skad cha bkol nas/ lang tsho'i mdzes sdug de myangs la/ sems gting gi brtse dung yang lhug por brjod yod/ na gzhon pa'i 106

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /rkyen gyis/ snyan ngag pa ngar sems kyis khengs la/ ngar sems kyis khengs pa'i rkyen gyis/ snyan ngag pas lhag par na gzhon pa'i snang ba shar/rbab chu ni don grub rgyal gyis rang mos snyan ngag gi rnam pa spyad de khong gi sgyu rtsal gyi rtsal drug mngon pa'i dus skabs thung thung zhig red/ snyan ngag gi zhing khams su/ khos rang nyid kyis 'tsho bar bcangs pa'i dga' snang dang tshe srog gi 'od snang la phul ba'i skad cig gi bstod pa de/ snyan ngag gi brtse gdung gi gdangs dbyangs su gyer te snyan rtsom gyi tshig phreng re re'i bar du mngon yod la/de dag gis yangs shing rgyang thag ring ba'i yul khams shig skrun te/ gang legs kyis rang nyid kyi 'char yan dang ngar sems kyis khengs pa'i snyan ngag pa'i rang gshis de mngon yod/ 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉 yis khong la yang nas bskyar du snying stobs kyi stobs shugs rgyas pa'i she mong bstsal/ khong gis snyan ngag gi khrod nas tshe srog dang rang gshis bar gyi gzhi mthun sa de rnyed byung / de ni rbab chu'i chal chil gyi 'bab rgyun khrod/ tshe srog ni 'jags thabs bral ba'i mtho sa nas dma' sar 'bab pa'i myong ba zhig yin pa de 'akral yod/ lang tsho dang spro sems ni tshe srog la myong tshor byed pa'i go rim khrod kyi rnam pa zhig red/ gal te khong gis snyan ngag 'di'i khrod du lang tsho dar zhing rgyas pa'i rnam par bstod glu 'bul zer ba las/khos snyan tshig bkol nas tshe srog de snyan ngag can du bsgyur ba'i myong tshor zhig red ces zer na dga'/ nga tshos mthong snang gi ri rtse nas 'bab pa'i rbab chu dang 107
