semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/kha gtad de des ji 'dra che ba'i gdong thug las thor ba'i chu yi wu bar nyi 'od 'phros pa las byung ba'i mdzes sdug gi 'od kor la myong tshor byas na/ nga tsho snyan ngag pa'i 'gog thabs bral ba'i brtse gdung gis yongs su bskor nas/ khong gi 'char yan gyi dran snang ring mo dang / sprin ltar g.yo zhing chu bzhin rgyug pa'i rtsom rtsal gyi nyams dang nang sems kyi yul ljongs bcas ni snyan ngag 'di'i brjid chags nyams ldan dang / yangs shing che ba'i brjod yul du gyur/ nga tsho'i sems khams kyi pha rol nas ldir sgra dang bcas te rgyugs 'ongs/〈'di na'ang drag tu mchong lding byed bzhin pa'i snying gson po zhig 'dug〉 zhes pa 'di ni 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu'i〉 rjes nas snyan ngag pas rang gi brtse dungs kyis phyug pa'i bsam pa'i zhing khams kyi sgo mo de yang bskyar thengs gcig phyes pa zhig yin/ mtho sgang gi mi rigs dang / khu sim mer gnas pa'i sems par/ brjod thabs bral ba'i sems shugs kyi rnam pa de yang bskyar lhug por brjod pa'i semasasgra zhig red/ 'di ni snyan ngag gi kha byang dang 'dra bar/ snying gson po zhig lding ba'i sgra red/ mtha' skor ni lhing 'jags yin zhing / dbang bor zug gzer gyis khengs pa'i 'ud sgra thams cad dal 'jags su babs pa'i khu sim gyi khrod/ phyir mngon dka' ba'i kher rkyang de sems kyi rgya mtshor 'thims nas khe'i mtha' skor du yongs su khengs/ rang nyid la tshe srog dang rnam shes/ khrag rtsa sbyin myong ba'i mi rigs dang / rang nyid kyi gsar rtsom gyi 'byung khungs la kha 108

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabasabasgyur bar byas/ /gtad de/ don grub rgyal gyis rang gi mi rigs kyi lo rgyus dang rig gnas la bcangs pa'i bsam pa'i brtse dungs de mi mngon thabs med red/ 'di ni sngon chad nas gna' bo'i dpal yon ldan pa'i rig gnas dang 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas yod myong ba'i mi rigs shig yin/ 'jig rten chags tshul gyi ngag rgyun rig gnas nas gting zab pa'i nang bstan rig gnas dar ba'i bar sha khrag gdong bcas kyi tshe srog re res/ dad mos kyi dar cha ring mo mtho ru bsgrengs nas/ mtho sgang 'dir mi rabs nas mi rabs bar 'khrungs ba dang rgyun bsrings byed kyin yod/ khong gi rtsom yig tu/ rnam shes gnyis kyi 'phrad sbyor gyi sgyu ma'i garal brten nas/ gzung 'dzin yul dang thabs shes zung la brten nas bsil ldan yul gyi 'dir khyim gzhi chags pa ma yin nam/ ces brjod pa ltar / mi rigs 'di'i mes po rnams kyis/ khyad mtshar 'char yan ldan pa'i sgo nas spre'u dang brag srin mo gnyis kyi mtho ris tshal gyi gtam rgyud de rgyas par grol yod/'di ni nga tsho dang ha cang rgyang thag ring ba'i ngag rgyun zhig red/ snyan ngag pa'i mig lam du/ lo rgyusakyi ches mtha'i yol rasadal ba dal bu'i ngang dus kyi gar stegs su lhung dus/ bstod bsngags kyis dben zhing thal mo'i rdeb sgra'ang med mod/ 'on kyang de yis brjed tshar ba mtshon mi thub/ lo rgyus de lhing 'jags kyi khrod nas bskyar gso byed dgos la/ dus kyang re sgug gi khrod du sbrel mthud byed dgos/yod tshad mjug rdzogs pa'i rjes kyi 'das zin par 'gyur nges yin/yod tshad 109

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/mgo brtsams pa'i ma 'ongs par yang 'gyur nges yin/ snyan ngag pas 'di ltar bris yod de/ ‘‘sha za ba tsam gyis gcan gzan du 'gyur mi rung ba dang / gdong dmar pa thams can spre'u rigs ni ga la yin/’’spyir mi rigs 'dir rgyun par rgyu nor sogs dngos por zhen pa'i mig mdangs de zhan na'ang / snying stobs kyi 'od snang de sngar nas snyan 'gyu ldan pa'i sgo nas gnas der kun nasa'aphros/ 'das song ba'i kha sang la bltas nas/ nga tsho skyo gdung du tshud dgos pa'i rgyu rkyen ga la yod de/mes po tshos nga tshor de ring gi dus su'ang nga rgyal ngang ngom chog pa'i rig gnas shig bskrun yod pas red/ ma 'ongasapar kha gtad de/ nga tshor mkho ba ni ‘‘bsam blo gsar ba dang / skya rengs gsar ba de red/’’snyan ngag 'di'i khrod du/ khong la rang dbang gi sems pa dang / rang dbang gi phugs bsam gyis khengs pa'i ngang nas rang gi na zla tshor kha brda lhug po dang bsam blo brje res byas yod/ ‘‘mi'i rigs kyi sems kyi mkha' dbyings su nges par 'od ltar bkra ba'i shes rab kyi mig zung zhig ldan dgos shing / 'di ni mi'i rigs kyi nyams pa med pa'i bsam blo'i phyogs ston yin par kho rang yid ches yod de/ gal te nga tsho mi re re'i sems gting du/ 'di lta bu'i sems nas brdol ba'i snyan ngag gi mig zhig ldan tshe/ sus kyang 'di ltar lding ba'i snying gson po de'i sgra thos thub/ de lta na nga tsho 'tsho gnas kyi sems khral dang sun snang gi gdung ba'i khrod nas slar yang phugs bsam ldan pa'i bsam pa'i zhing khams su log 110

rnam shes kyi dbyangasarta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /nges red/ he te ki er gyis 'di ltar brjod yod de/ snyan ngag pa'i skad chas brjod pa de/ 'thus sgo tshang ba'i 'jig rten rang bzhin gyi 'tsho gnas yin/ de ni 'jig rten du 'dus la/ sems pa'i zhing khams su phyir mi mngon pa'i tshul gyi mkha' dbyings shig bskrun yod/don grub rgyal gyi snyan ngag gi mkha' dbyings su/ gal te nga tsho khong gi brjed che ba'i tshigs bcad snyan ngag dang / ngar shugs ldan pa'i yi ge las brgal te/ pha skad kyi brtse gdung mngon par thon pa'i skad cha sogs la mjal na/khong gi snyan ngag pa'i snying stobs kyis nga tshor yid 'gul thebs/ de ni tshe srog zhig gi brtse dungs kyi myong bar brten nas bsam pa'i zhing khams kyi pho brang du bgrod phod pa de red/ snyan ngag gi sgyu rtsal zhing khams su/ nga tsho'i gzhi rgya che ba'i bsam pa'i 'tsho ba de bgro gleng byas yod la/ snga ma'i phrag steng du spos te rang nyid las brgal phod cing / gzhon skyes kyi stobs las tshe srog gi mdzes sdug dang bab brling de zhib 'bri byas yod/ 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉 yis khong gi tshe srog gis nam yang snyan ngag gi bro ba 'khur ba'i las dbang de mngon yod/ 〈gzhon nu'i yid kyi mdzes rgyan〉 gyis khong gi snyan ngag gis nam yang rang gi pha skad kyi 'jig rten gting zab sgos dang len byas yod/ khong gi snyan rtsom las brdol ba'i tshe srog gi dri bsung de dri bzhon bu mos rgyang ring gi ma 'ongs par khur nges/111

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/garna/ma pa/1984lor zla1par/ don grub rgyal gyis khong gi lhug rtsom 〈rkang lam phra mo〉legs grub byung / de nas cang ma 'gor bar lhug rtsom〈dri gzhon bu mo〉zhes pa de bris/ lhug rtsom 'di gnyis dang 'brel yod kyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos dang nang don skor/ gus pas 95lo'i 〈bod ljongs skurtsom rig〉 deb dang po'i steng yig bsgyur dang bcas te mtshams sbyor zhus myong / de ring slar yang 〈dri gzhon bu mo〉klog dus/ de'i nang gi gting zab kyi rtog dpyod dang dpyod shes kyi cha/ da dung skad cha'i shugs bstan gyis rang nyid shes rtog byas pa bcas kyis/ nga tshor khong gi tshe srog mjug bsdu ba dang 'brel ba'i bsam pa'i ngo bo gzhan zhig gi rgyu cha de 'don sprod byas yod/ 'di lta bu'i lo rabs brgyad bcu'i bod rigs kyi phul tu byung zhing thun min khyad chos ldan pa'i na gzhon mkhas pa dang / bsam blo dang shes bya'i sngon 'gro ba des/ khong gi bgrang bya so gnyis kyi lo 'khor mo'i nang /mtho sgang gi ches 'khyag pa'i dus tshigs shig bdams nas/ rang gi 'bri shog dang dpe chas khengs pa'i thabs chag gi gzim shag tu/ tshe srog dang dus gtan du kha bral ba red/ tshe srog gis khong la ‘‘skyes stobs kyi shes rab bstsal ba dang /bem shes zung 'jug gi gdams ngag gnang bar ma zad/ ngas ma'i mngal gyi khang bzang du yod pa nas bzung phun sum tshogs pa'i las rgyu 'bras dang bstun par 112

rnam shesakyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangasastabasabasgyur bar byas/ /byed shes pa’’ bcas sbyin myong ba red/ 〈dri bzhon gyi bu mo〉 khrod byung ba'i tshe srog 'di ltar yin te/ rnam shes de phung bo'i phyi shun dang bral te/ khang chung gi phyi ru 'phur ba dang / mtho sgang gi mu mtha' med pa'i mkha' mtha' ru dal gyis yal/tshe srog de a ma'i mngal las byung la/ tshe srog gzhan zhig gi rnam par zhugs pa'i bar do ru gnas/ tshe srog gi dus tshod mjug sgril yang / rnam shes yang bskyar skyes pa'i brda 'phrin de rtogs rjes/ 'jig rten khams kyi sdug bsngal sna tshogs brgyud de/ slar yang dri bral gyi gnas shig la slebs yong / khong gi tshe srog gi yul 'khyam la mchod me khri stong gis lam 'dren byas med la/ skyo zhing dungs pa'i chos sgras kyang bskor ma myong / 'on kyang / khong gi rnam shes de kher rkyang yin mi srid/ bsam pa'i mu mtha' med pa'i zhing khams nas rang dbang ldan pa'i sgo nas bud song / 'di ni rnam shes kyi khyad 'phags kyi rnam pa zhig yin la khyad 'phags ni gdod ma nas kher rkyang gi rgyab gzugs yin phyin srol rnying gi ra ba rgyang du spyugs/'di ni smug nag pa'i dgun 'khyags kyi mtshan mo zhig tu nges te/ khong gi bya byed yod tshad tshe srog dang gyes pa'i mdzad sgo yin/ gam na gnyen nye zhig kyang med/ lo phra ba'i dus kyi 'tsho ba'i kyag kyog des khong la nam yang pha ma gnyis 'dzom gyi byams brtse'i khengs pa'i khyim gzhi de shor du bcug gnyen nye'i brtse ba la bcangs pa'i thugs khur dang re ba de/ khong gis nam yang rang la sems gso 113

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/byed pa'i brtsams sgrung re re'i nang bkod yod cing / de na rtag brtan dang phun tshogs kyi pha ma'i brtse gdung yod la/ de yis khong gi tshe srog la 'od snang bstsal zhing / khos nyam chung dang kher rkyang gi sems gzhas 'jags su bcug khong gi lus steng du gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad mtshar gyi cha mang po yod pa de rtsom yig 'bri ba'i lang tsho'i rnam pa zhig tu phyogs yod/ rnam pa 'di 'dra'i 'og gi rtsom yig dang 'tsho ba'i rnam 'gyur gnyis gcig tu bsnol bas/ 'jig rten phal ba'i lugs de snang chung du mngon zhing / rang gshis khrod kyi rang rlom chen po des/phal ba'i phyogs la mig zur tsam yang mi blta bas/ 'jig rten pa'i mig nang du khyad mtshar gyi cha 'di dag kho tsho'i rgyun ldan gyi rnam pa'i tshad gzhi dang gtan nas mthun mi srid/ 1985lo ni/ don grub rgyal la phyogs gang thad nas dka' ngal byung ba'i dus skabs yin te/ bya ba dang 'tsho ba'i steng gi bar chad gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byung ba dang / khong gi tshad brgal gyi tshor snang dang na ba las shi bar snyam pa'i khengs dregs kyi rang gshis des/ kho rang yang yang du rang lta mkhregs 'dzin gyi phyogs su khrid pa red/ kho rang dga' drags pa'i rtsom rig de 'dor mi rung la/ khong gi tshe srog gi ma gzhi de rtsom rig gis bzung bas/ mi tshe'i dus rim re re gsar rtsom gyi sems shugs khrod nas re re bzhin bskyar dpar btab nas khong gi sems kyi ches bzang ba'i khams su zhugs/ 'di lta bu'i sems shugs kho na 'bul ba'i rgyud rim khrod/ da gzod khong gi brtse gdung gi chu mo de yod tshad la 114

rnam shes kyi dbyangasarta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangasastabs bsgyur bar byas/ /mi 'dzem par dmigs dben gyi phyogs su drag tu bzhur thub pa red/ na tshod gzhon pa'i rkyen gyis/ rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi mchog tu gyur ba'i zhing sa nas mgo 'khor rgyu kho na las ma shes kyang / na tshod gzhon pa'i rkyen gyis/ 'jig rten pa'i lugs kyi char zhor de dus rgyun par drag tu 'bab par ma tshor/ mthon po la nyam chung gis mgo sgur mi shes shing / gzhan gyi 'dod par bstun mi shes pa'i skabs su/ nyam chung dang bag 'khums nas 'tsho ba las/ rnam shes de snying stobs kyi mkha' dbyings su spur na dga' zhes/ 'chi ba'i myong ba rol ba'i go rim khrod/mi tshe 'di'i ches mjug mtha'i dus skabs 'di rtag brtan du gyur pa red/ khong gis bltas tshe/ ches mthar bgrod sa'i tshe srog gi pha mtha' de ni khrus byas rjes kyi rnam shes kyi dwangs gtsang dang lhing 'jags ldan pa'i pha khyim ste/ phung bo'i bkag rgya dang phal ba'i gtan khel byas pa'i gnas las thar te/ rang gi lhan skyes kyi rang gshis de rang nyid bor ba las slar yang 'khrungs pas so/ /lo ngo bcu bzhi 'das pa'i da lta/ nga tshos yang bskyar snyan ngag par phyir lta byas te/ 'tsho bzhugs dang 'das pa'i rin thang gleng dus/ bdag gi mtha' 'khor du sems sdug med pa'i‘‘sdug bsngal pa’’mang pos 'tshang kha shig shig tu rgyag la/kho tsho dgod bro ba dang spyang grung ldan pa'i sgo nas rtsom rig dang khe phan bsnol ba'i stegs bur 'grengs te/ cha mnyam pa'i nang rdzong dang skad cha'i thob thang gis khengs pa'i ming byang brje res byed pa las/ su zhig gis lo ngo bcu bzhi'i sngon la 115

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/kho tsho yang na gzhon zhig gi tshe srog 'das par skyo gdung gis khengs pa de dran myong / 'tsho gnas kyi ngo bo de nyin re bzhin dngos po'i 'dod sred kyis tshab byed pa'i dus 'di la/ nga tshos yang bskyar sems sdug pos phyir dran byed mi dgos la/rnam shes la 'gyod bshags kyi cho ga'ang spel dgos don med/ nyin bzhin phun tshogs su 'gyur bzhin pa'i dngos po dang nyin bzhin nyams dmas su 'gro ba'i rtsom 'bri'i mdun du/ da ni nga tshor sdug bsngal dang sems khral de 'dra med/ rtsom rig gi longs spyod ring lugs dang / rtsom rig gi stabs bde zas rigs/ rtsom rig gi sa bon phan tshun spel ba sogs kyis nyin re bzhin nyam je chung du 'gro ba'i bsam pa'i stong cha de skong bzhin mchis/ lha sgrung dang / snyan ngag gi bro ba/spyang rig 'khor 'das/ rnam shes/ 'di dag ni mi'i rigs kyi bsam pa'i 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi ches phun sum tshogs pa dang rin thang ldan pa'i bsam pa'i rang gshis shig ste/ bdag 'dzin dang rul sungs kyis khengs pa'i mal khri'i steng rim gyis gnyid du yur/ las ka kho dang mthun par rtsom 'bri ba'i mi mi nyung ba zhig gis 'chi ba de slar skye bar brje ba'i tshe srog gi ches mtha'i bdams ka byed dus/'phya dmod dang zur za'i mig zhags kyis bltas te/ ‘‘ci'i phyir sgyid por mi 'tsho bar shi na 'dod dam/ de ltar byas na phan khe ci yod/’’ ces par khag mi 'dug ste/ de ltar ma yin nam/ kho tshos bltas tshe gsung rtsom phun sum tshogs par mchis shing / yon tan la mnga' brnyes pa'i lo na gzhon zhing mdun lam ldan 116

rnam shesakyi dbyangasarta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /pa'i tshe srog la rang gis ci 'dra'i sha tsha dang gces skyong gnang mi shes pa la ang /mi 'di rnams kyis mi gshis dang rang bkur/ skyo gdung dang rjes dran/ bsam blo dang rtsom 'bri sogs dngos yod 'tsho gnas dgos mkho'i ches mtha' mtshams su sprugs pa red/ gal te dbang thang dang sgor mo la 'tshang kha shig shig gis 'tshang ba'i tshe na/ mtha' 'khor na gnas pa'i yod tshad de ma thag bskyur nges red/ kho tsho'i mig nang du yod tshad rgyun ldan gyi nyams myong 'tsho ba'i dngos yod kyi rgya kha'i lci yang la ltos te/ ‘‘gal te tshe phyi ma med na tshe 'di'i byed las yod tshad 'bras med du ma song ngam/’’'di 'dra'i bzo bkod legs shing skad cha'i tshig sbyor mdzes pa/ deng rabs mi yis dngos yod kyi khe phan kho na bsnyegs te deng rabs kyi rtsom rig gsung rtsom re re brgyud nas/ bdag gis dbang med du 'di 'dra'i skad cha zhig dran 'ongs/ ‘‘dbul phongs kyi dus rabs 'dir snyan ngag mkhan gyis ci bya/ yin yang / khyed kyis snyan ngag mkhan ni chang lha'i mchod dpon yin zhing / lha yul gyi mun nag nas kho rang yul khams kun tu 'grims zhes zer/’’ (he e te li)'bar bzhin pa'i shing leb kyis/ me lce lham mer 'phro bzhin/ 'di ni nga yi me tog dang / 'di ni nga yi 'chi ba yin zhes gsungs/ (the ki ar)srin 'bu me 'khyer gyisanam mkha'i skar ma la 'di ltar brjod myong / mkhas pas bshad na khyod kyi 'od zer de/ nam zhig la je chung du 'gro bar nges/ nam mkha'i skar mas a lan ci yang ma byin/ (the ki ar)117

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/de ring kho mos bris pa'i yig 'bru 'di dag dag pa'i zhing du gshegs zin pa'i tshe srog zhig la mtshon na/ de ni chos lugs kyi cho ga thengs gcig spel rjes kyi slar yang lhing 'jags kyi rnam par slebs pa ji bzhin/ phyogs bzhir lding ba'i spos dri de 'das zin pa'i dga' skyo gang mang thebs pa'i dngos yod 'tsho bar gtogs mi srid/ tshe srog gi bzhur rgyun la gyen ldog dben na'ang rnam shes kyi rgyu kho nar 'gyur ldog med cing yal rgyu de las kyang med do/ bod mi rigs la mtshon na/ tshe srog gi rin thang gzhal tu med cing / rnam shes kyis sha khrag gdos bcas kyi phung bo dang mtha' yas pa'i sems gnyis bar gyi bar thag de sbrel mthud byed kyin yod/ bgrang bya so gnyis ring gi lo zla'i nang / yig 'bru khri nyis brgya lhag gis bskrun pa'i shes rab can zhig gi rang nyid kyi bsam pa'i gzhal yas khang du/rang gi tshe srog gi snying bo mi rigs rang gi pha skad dang yi ges rang shugs kyis myong bar byas par ma zad/ lta klog brgyud de/ lhad kyis ma gos pa'i sems pa rgya bskyed cing dran ngos su gtan du dpar/ 'di ni phal cher tshe srog gi khams gzhan zhig red/skabs 'dir/ kho mos don grub rgyal gyi 〈dri bzhon gyi bu mo〉 nang gi tshig 'ga' dran 'ongs pa 'di lta ste/ sa chu me rlung 'byung ba bzhi yi khrod du/ rlung de ches mtha' mjug tu bgrang yod/ /sa ni sra zhing 'thas pa zhig yin pas u tshugs dang nga rgyal gyi rang bzhin mngon la/ chu ni brlan zhing gsher bas 'gyur 118

rnam shes kyi dbyangs rta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /ldog che zhing mi brtan pa'i rang bzhin zhig mnga'/ me ni tsha zhing sreg pas khro ba dang zhi ba de me ltar mngon pa'i rang bzhin zhig ldan/ dri bzhon gyi bu mo lags/dngos po'i rang gshis la nges tshig 'jog par dpa' ba'i mkhas pa dag gis/khyed ni bltos bcas kyi shes rab can zhig yin zhes gsungs/ 'o na/ log bshad de 'khyog brjod kyi tshul gyis drang bden du bshad pa dang / drang bden yang nam yang log bshad du 'khyog brjod byed pa rnams kyi tshad gzhi'i steng / dri bzhon lags/ khyed ci'i phyir grib med gzugs med kyi rang nyid de grib ldan gzugs ldan gyi phung bor sprul te kho tsho'i brjod 'dod pa'i bsam blo'i brjod par ya mtshar dgos sam/ ngo ma 'di ltar ma yin nam/ tshe srog gi du sprin yang mo de bser rlung gis mkha' mtha' ru 'ded skabs/ so skyes phal ba'i mig zung de khyed kyi grib ma'i rjes bsnyegs ga la srid/ grub pa thob cing rmad du byung ba'i lag zung gis yal la nye ba'i gzugs brtan de 'dzin rtsis ga la bya/ sa gzhi de zhig nas ral bar gyur pa dang / chu rgyun de chad nas dri ngan gyis khengs pa/ me phung de yal nas thal rdul du 'gyur skabs/ skye dngos kun gyi 'phel skyed la srung skyob byed bzhin pa'i rlung kho na 'ur sgra dang bcas te g.yug cing / rnam shes yal zhing dri zhim shor ba'i skad cig gi nang tshe srog gi gdod ma'i dri bsung dag khyer 'ongs/don grub rgyal dri bzhon la 'di ltar dga' ba dngos nas khag mi 'dug ste/ khos dri bzhon bu mo de snying nye ba'i sgo nas rang nyid la lus dang grib ma ltar du/ 'bral 119

semasapa'i rtsom gyi 'am bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/dka' ba'i tshe srog gi mdza' mo yi dper bkod yod/ nga tshos tshod dpag byas chog ste khong gi tshe srog gi snga gzhug tu/ khong rang steng gi dbye zhib la/ lhag bsam gyi nges shes shig dang brtse dung gi kher rkyang de 'tshol snyeg bya rgyus khengs 'dugakher rkyang 'dis kho rang 'khyud mid btang mod/ 'on kyang khong gi bsam pa de dngos nas 'di 'dra'i kher rkyang gis g.yogs pa'i yol ras 'og nas da gzod dwangs gtsang du gyur/ khong gi nang sems kyi zhing khams su/ kho rang 'tsho ba'am gnas pa ni rtsom rig gi lcags kyus rang nyid kyi gson pa'i skad cha de 'dzin cing /kho rang gi bde skyid dam/ yang na sdug bsngal gang rung gi rjes dran gnyid las bslangs/ khos rtsom rig gsar rtsom khrod rang nus la btso sbyang byed rgyu de 'tshol snyeg byed thub pa byung zhing / bzi ba'i rnam pas dngos yod dang rang nyid mthun sbyor byed thub pa'i tshad la thon/ 'di lta bu'i bsam tshul khrod/ khong gis ha lam mi tshe'i skyo gar gyi don snying de gting zab sgos rgyus lon zhing / bsam tshul 'di 'dra las brgal te dngos yod 'tsho bar kha gtad dus khos rang nyid la mdzes chas spras mi 'dod la/ gzhan gyi mdzes chas spro bar yang dang len byed mi 'dod/khong gis rang gi gshis kar mgo gnon mi byed cing / bcos ma la yang dga' bsu byed mi srid do/ / ‘‘nga rgyal gyi ngang nas 'tsho mi thub pa'i skabs su/ nga rgyal dang bcas te 'jig rten la kha bral/’’ khong gi tshe srog gi gar stegs su lus gzugs gang mang zhig gis bskor yod na'ang / 'on kyang / khos nges shes dang 120

rnam shesakyidabyangasarta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangasastabs bsgyur bar byas/ /brtse gdung gi khur bo de 'jog sa zhig rnyed ma thub la/ rgyus lon bya rin yod pa'i bsam pa zhig gi bstod bsngags kyang 'tshol ma thub la kho rang song sa kun tu thal mo rdeb sgras khyab na'ang / 'on kyang thal mo rdeb sgra mang po zhig ni goms gshis shig gi 'gul stangs kho na las/ go shes thebs pa'i mtshon rtags shig ma red/ khong gi sems khams kyi rang rlom dang tshor ba rnon po mi nyung ba zhig gis kho rang 'jig rten pa'i lugs kyi 'khor ba'i 'du 'dzi la zhen pa'i ngar shugs su tshud mi thub par byas/ de'i phyir khos nges par du 'dem ka bya dgos te/ yang na srung skyob dang / yang na rtsa med du gtong dgos shing / rtsom rig la gdod nas phyogs res dang nyen kha 'di yod pa red/ mkhas dbang gang mang zhig lo tshod 'di lta bu'i nang 'das la/ de las shes thub pa ni/ tshe srog gi ches mtho ba'i gnas de na ches mar lhung nyen che ba rtogs thub/ tshe srog gi shes tshor khyad par ba des khong la 'tsho gnas kyi mthar son rgyu de 'dem tu bcug 'di lta bu'i thal drags pa'i dngos po ste/ kha thor gyi 'gal rkyen de khong gis rtogs ma thub pa zhig min par/khong gis 'di ltar bshad myong ste/ ‘‘dri bzhon gyi bu mo 'di la nye ring gi phyogs ris yod pa ma yin mod/ yin yang chags sdang gi rang gshis yod srid/ dgun kha'i nyi 'od de la drod 'jam ldan la/ 'od zer mnga' mod/ 'on kyang dgun kha'i nyi khar kha gtad pa'i srib 'og ni nges par du 'khyag grang ldan pa'i mun nag zhig yin/ de'i rkyen gyis daphyid mgo'i res 'khyag res tsha dang / dbyar kha'i drod zhing 121

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/'jam pa ston gyi brdzid cing bsil ba/ dgun gyisagangasadar gosasu g.yogs/’’bcas ni don grub rgyal gyi smyug rtse las thon pa'i dus bzhi'i rang mdangs yin la khong gi tshe srog gi 'khor 'das rang bzhin gyi shes rtogs ma yin nam/tshe srog la dka' ba dang len gyi sbyong brdar thob dgos shing / spro sems 'khol ba'i 'tshams 'dri yang dgos/ rnam shes la sha khrag gi phung bo lci mo de mkho la/ sha khrag gi phung bo de dor rjes kyi yang mo'i rang bzhin yang mkho/ 'di dag tshang ma rim pa bzhin sems kyi rtogs pa dang brgyud tshe/ da gzod tshe srog la mtho sanasabalta thub pa'i gnas su thon thub pa red/ don grub rgyal la 'di 'dra'i sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs thub pa'i lam bu brgyud pa'i yid ches yod mod/ 'on kyang khong nyid sems su bzhengs pa'i lkog gyur gyi pho brang las thar ma thub pa red/tshe srog gi sdug bsngal de tshe srog gi smon lam las byung zhing / skyes pa ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin/ skye rga na 'chis grub pa'i tshe srog ni mi tshe cha tshang ba zhig yin pas/ nga rgyal gyis tshe srog gi re 'dod med par byas te/ bdag zhes pa de med par bzos nas kher rkyang dang sun snang gi rang nyid tshe srog gzhan zhig tu brgyud pa de/ le lo dang bros byol yin nam zhe na/ kho mo'i myong ba dang / shes bya/ lo tshod bcas ni rlabs che ba'i brjod gzhi 'di'i mdun du/ ha cang nyam chung ba zhig yin stabs/ gus pas 'di ltar yin zhing de ltar ma yin zhes kha tshon gcod mi phod cing / rang gi mtha' skor gyi spun zla tshor re ba zhig yod pa ni/ 'di ltar ltogs 122

rnam shesakyi dbyangasarta la skyom nas/ /yid 'ong gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur bar byas/ /skom dang chags zhen gyi khrod du brjid nyams kyis gzim pa'i tshe srog de dus nam yang mi brjed par 'tshal/bstod bsngags dang phyir dran la phyir log sa'i gnas dben na'ang 'di ni nga tsho'i sems kyis bzos pa'i me tog gi phreng ba zhig las ma 'das/ du sprin med pa'i mtshan mo dang / smug yol dben pa'i skya rengs su nga tshos me tog gi 'dab ma re re pha yul la log pa'i lam du gtor dus/ lam kha na dngos nas phyir log pa'i gom sgra zhig grags 'ongs/(rdo smis klu rgyal don grub kyis bsgyur/)123

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/༄7/ /sha tsha ba'i rkyen gyis khong gis gzhas btang /da wamakhasagrubadang khongagi 〈dusabazhi'i sonam byed lugasamatshon pa'i tshig phrengangag gi rol dbyangs/〉'od dang nyi mar bsngags pa'i snyan ngag pa ed chin gyis sems gting nas brdol ba'i glu ste/ nga'i mig na rgyun du mchi ma 'khyil don ni nga gnas 'di la dga' drags pas yin/ zhes len dus nga tsho'i yid sems 'gul bar byed pa dang mnyam du bye brag gi dngos po re re shog dkar du bab byung / gnam mtho zhing sprin srab cing bya brgya dgung na 'phur ba'am/ sdong lo sa la bab cing phyogs bzhir ston mdog bkra ba'am/ yang na sems pa gnam du lding zhing brjod byas kun nas gtams/ gnam 'og gi bya dngos yod do cog khyod la brtse sems yod pa'i rkyen gyis ga sa ga ru yid 'gugs kyi nus pa bskyed/ rang byung khams kyis tshe srog bskyed pa'i zhor du gson shugs kyis brtas pa'i snyan ngag gi brjod bya'ang bskrun/gal te yid mi ches na/ khyed kyis mtho sgang gi snyan ngag pa mkhas grub kyi snyan ngag gyor dang / g.ya' dag pa'i nam mkhar g.ya' dag pa'i sems pa klog thub/tsha lam lam gyi nyi 'og tu rngul chu phyi ru phyung ba'i ngal rtsol gyi rjes su 'bras bu 124

sha tsha ba'i rkyen gyis khong gis gzhas btang /reg yod/ 'di ni mkhas grub kyis bsam bzhin du bskrun pa yin nam zhe na/ ma red/ 'di ni mtho sgang rgyab ljongs su byas nas 'greng ba'i kho rang gis pha sar bcangs pa'i brtse zhen te/ dga' ba lasabartse ba 'phel/ brtse ba lasadung ba 'byur/khong ni sa gzhi chen po'i thu 'og na glu len pa'i mtho sgang gi snyan ngag pa yin/mkhas grub ni lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i mjug tu da gzod rim gyis bod kyi snyan ngag gi gar stegs su bud pa'i snyan ngag pa zhig yin/ byis dus kyi dka' sdug gi 'tsho bas snga mo nas kho rang la 'jig rten 'tsho ba'i drod 'khyags myong du bcug khong gis bslas pa'i rmi lam yod tshad tshags dam pa'i srol rgyun gyi dgon pa'i ra ba nas yang yang shor ba'i rang gshis kyi 'char sgo ste/ dgun ljongs kyi bkag rgya brgal nas rang dbang gi dus tshigs shig la smon/ srol rgyun snyan ngag gi ldum rar kho rang gser gyi sbrang chung ji bzhin hur thag gis 'tsho bcud bsdu ba'i rang 'gul gyi rtsol ba 'di/ phyis kyi kho rang gi snyan ngag gi bang mdzod du bsnyal nas rdzogs med kyi rgyags bro bstsal/ mkhas grub kyi snyan ngag gi rtsa ba 'di ltar mtho sgang la zug cing / brtan cing gshin po'i srol rgyun snyan ngag gi zhing du btsugs/ dpyid rlung gis ga sar khyer ba'i rtswa sngon yin na'ang 'dra/ dbyar gyi nyi 'od dron mo gangs rtser phog kyang rung / ldid tig tig gi ston gyis skyel 'ongs pa'i 'bras bu yin na'ang chog dgun gyi bu yug gis yod tshad g.yogs kyang rung /gang gis kyang mkhas grub kyi dpal gyis phyug pa'i snyan ngag gi brtse ba gnon par 125

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam gamyong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/mi nus/ khos sems shugs brtan pos khong gi mthong ba dang myong ba bris/ 〈dus bzhi'i so nam byed lugs mtshon pa'i tshig phreng ngag gi rol dbyangs/〉 ni khong gis rang sa rang yul la phul ba'i bstod glu yin zhing / rang sa rang yul gyi mi rnams la phul ba'i sems gting gi 'gyur khugs kyang yin/zhing rmo mgo tshugs pas dpyid ka bos shing / dpyid slebs pa nas mkhas grub kyi sems 'gyu dkrogs/ kho gnyid kyang rmi lam med pa/ sems gtam brjod pa med pa'i skad cig la glo bur du sge'u khung phyi rol gyi zhing sa'i steng glu skad phyogs su lding zhing / gom gang spos pa tsam gyis mtsho bzhin gyi dpyid mdog gis khong gi sems 'gyu bslangs/ 'di ni dus bzhi'i thog ma ste/ dpyid kyi thu 'og gi mtho sgang lags/ rlung bu dal gyis ldang yang 'jam zhing mnyen/ skye dngos myu gu 'bus par bskul cing re smon 'debs pa'i dus tshigs yin/ snyan ngag pas rang gi brjod bya'i snyan ngag gi rgyab ljongs 'dzin pa'i tshe na/ rang byung gi yul ljongs kyi bkod pa kho na las krong nger 'greng ba ma yin par/ nges par du bkod pa dang dung ba sbrel byed kyi snang brnyan zhig btsal te/ de la dung ba bcug pas da gzod dung ba gzugs su mngon pa yin/ 'di na gcal tu bkram pa ni dpyid kyi 'bru zhing thog mar rmo ba'i snang brnyan zhig ste/ lag pas bshol mda' skyor mkhan ni rgan mgo dkar dang chung byis pa gang yang ma yin par/ rtsom du/ phra ldem smyug ma'i gzugs 'dzin sgeg 'chang mas/ /rol nang sa bon gtor ba'i phyag rgya 126

sha tsha ba'i rkyen gyis khong gis gzhas btang /ni/ /lha yi gar ma'i stangs stabs nyid dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa ni ji 'dra'i yid du 'ong ba'i bris thang zhig red ang / gal h+phan gob kyi 〈zhing 'debs pa po'i〉'gugs shugs ni bris thang du tshe srog gi bla na med pa'i sems shugs mngon/ tsha lam lam gyis 'bar ba'i nyi ma bzhin 'od zer phyogs bzhir mched de/ bris thang ngos kyi ngal rtsol bar gser mdog gi tshon mdangs spyin/ drod lam lam gyi bris thang las kho rang gis ngal rtsol par gting zab pa'i dga' ba mngon pa yin tshe/ mkhas grub kyi smyug kha'i mtho sgang gi dpyid ka'i bris thang ni/ 'bur dod pa'i thang ga zhig red/ gcig 'jags gcig langs su grags pa'i dgod sgra dang na chung bu bu mos phan tshun la blangs pa'i glu skad/ brda res brda ma'i dgod sgra/'phrul 'khor gyi 'ur sgra dang drod 'jam gyi dpyid rlung / gsar du 'bus pa'i lcang sdong gi lo ma dang 'khyags rom gyi sbubs las thar ba'i chu mo/ yod tshad dpyid kyis bskyed pa'i thang bris las dpyid kyi mdzes sdug khyad mtshar dang dpyid kyi tshon mdangs rnam par bkra dpyid kyis rlabs phreng dgod pa'i gzhon nu dang de'i stobs shugs bskyed pa'ang kho thag yin/ khyim bdag dang ngal rtsol pa'i gsar gtod kyis da gzod snyan ngag pa'i drag tu lding ba'i snyan ngag gi dung ba bslangs/kho tshos 'bru zhing 'debs pa'i dus mtshungs su re smon yang btabs te/ lo gcig gi ngal rtsol dang rngul chu btabs yod/ sa la gtor ba'i sa bon ji bzhin grags rgyu ci yang med par/ 'ur gtan nas mi sgrog cing zhi 'jags kyis dus bzhi 127

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/brgal zhing zhi 'jags kyis dbyar gyi drod khol dang nying bcud la sgugasngon mtho sgang la dbyar kha med ces pa'i rtsom zhig mthong myong / mtsho bod mtho sgang gi dus bzhir dar dang kha bas g.yogs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de yang ma nges te/ snyan ngag pa'i mig lam gyi lho kha'i dbyar kha ni 'di ltar yin te/rgyu skar lam du lha yi rdzing ring ba gam mchod rten bzhin du gnas/ /chad pa med pa'i sbrang char bsil masanor 'dzin thal rdul ma lusabakrus/ /ri klung kun nas chu phran shang shang rgya mtsho chen po'i lto bar 'dzul/ /yangasapa'i zhing thang lotog ngosasu bung ba babasasa'i rgya khyon dog / dpyid ka'i gom pa 'di ru 'jam mnyen gyis spo ba'i dus su dbyar gyi gom sgra'ang nye ru phyin/ mtho sgang gi dbyar khar bsil 'jam gyi zla ba dang me tog gi grib ma med kyang / brlan bsher dang tsha gdug zang zing las 'phel ba'i skyo snang dang snyoms po ma yin pa'i sems khams kyang med/ mtho sgang gi dbyar ni ches mdzes sdug ldan zhing yid sems 'gugs pa'i dus tshigs shig ste/ mthing mdog gi mkha' dbyings su bal dkar bzhin gyi sprin pa rnam pa sna tshogs/ dwangs gtsang gi mkha' dbugs khrod du rtswa dang me tog gi dri bsung 'thul 'ongs/ gnas 'di'i lhing 'jags dang stong sing gis mi sems 'gul bar byed cing rang byung khams kyi bab chags kyis lag g.yab byed cing / gnam 'og na da dung 'di lta bu'i mdzes 128

sha tsha ba'i rkyen gyis khong gis gzhas btang /sdug gi snying 'jags shig yod par sems pa 'gul/ dus tshigs 'di la nyams su myong ba'i snyan ngag par mtshon na bsam bzhin du 'das zin pa'i so nam gyi lo rgyus la bcar te/ gnas 'di'i lo rgyus kyi phang 'gros las brgyud pa'i dar rgyas dang she mong / brjid nyams dang zab tshad/ da dung sems pa sgul ba'i gyang chag re rer cer nas/ khong gis zhib brjod dang blang bar bya ba ni/ phyi ru mngon pa dang phyung bar bya ba ni/ mgo mjug bar gsum du dung sems shig yin/ yul gyi bkod pa las 'phos pa'i dung sems shig yin/ khos nam yang brjed thabs med pa ni dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba'i klong na mngon pa'i rang byung gi mdzes sdug ma yin par rang byung khams kyi bdag po ste ngal rtsol pa yin/ khong gis mi 'di dag gi bab chags dang / rgyud drang / sems bzang ste mi'i rigs kyi ches rtsa ba'i 'tsho ba rol stangs kyis rang dang gzhan gyi ched du khu sim mer 'bul ba'i snying stobs la bstod bsngags mdzad yod/ kho tsho ni ha cang gi mi spyir btang ba yin la/ khong tsho'i spyir btang gi ltag rgyab na 'tsho bar bcangs pa'i gting zab pa'i ngos 'dzin dang khod yangs/ rgya chen po'i sems khams shig nyar yod/'ja' tshon lus su bklubs pa 'dra ba'i zhing pa pho gsar mo gsar tshos/ /dga' dga' spro sprosalasal brtson zhing glu gar rtsed 'jor rol ba des/ /grong khyeraparnamasanyin re'igling kha skyid por rlomapa'i khengasapa bsnyil/ / zhing pa rnams kyis lo re'i dus bzhir zhing 'debs pa dang / bsdus te 129

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/rngul chu sa zhing du thim zhing / sag bdar bzhin gyi lag zung rtsub mo re re dang /nag cing nag pa'i ngo gdong re re/ re bas khengs pa'i mig zung re re/ nyi ma shar ba nas mgo brtsams te nyi nub bar tu las la brtson/ nyin nas nyin 'di ltar dang lo nas lo 'di ltar yin/ lo dang zla ba nas tshe gang bor 'di ltar zhing btab/lud bzhag yur ma yur/ zhing breg nas zad/ bltas tshod kyis ches spyir btang ba'i 'tsho ba dang ches spyir btang gi mi tshe bskyed par snang mod/ su zhig gis mi bzos dang dus tshod kyi bar gseng brgal nas ches spyir btang ba'i ngal rtsol pa 'di dag gi tsha zhing lhing 'jags su gnas pa/ tshor ba rno zhing nyag nyog gi sems par reg myong ngam/ dbyar drod kyis khyab pa'i dus tshugs su/ mkhas grub kyi snyan ngag gi dung bas snyan ngag gi dung ba lam seng sbar bar ma rngams par/ khos sngar bzhin dal lhod kyis mngon pa'i skad cig tu/ shugs bstan kyis khyab pa'i rnam pa bsal/ dbyar zla ring mor zhing nang du 'bru'i grib 'og na 'bru dang mnyam pa'i stobs kyis 'tsho ba'i rtswa sdum mi nyung zhing /rdog med snye gra gnam la gzengs de mkhas rlom can gyi ngang tshul ston/ /lag gdang sbrel ba'i sran ma'i me tog na chung bu mo'i dgra zlar gyur/ /gro snye stong pas mig skyag dkar po rgyan char bsam te gzhan la ngom/ /zhes pa lta bu'ang mi 〈chor ngo / /don dngos dang / bab chags/ khengs skyung nam yang brdzu bag dang mgo 130

sha tsha ba'i rkyen gyis khong gis gzhas btang /stong / nga rgyal bcas dang mnyam du gnas/ zhing nang na skye ba'i myu gu yin na'ang de'i 'gram du brdzu bag gi dug rtswas mgo bo 'degs na/ lang long gi 'jig rten na phal ba dang / brdzu bag cho med par chen por brdzus pa ji ltar mi mang ngam/brling zhing phun sum tshogs pa'i snyan ngag gi sgrig gzhi las snyan ngag pas shugs bstan ston pa'i thabs la 'bad pa mthong thub/ nang gi tshab mtshon gyi don snying steng nas snyan ngag pa mang shas shig gis tshig gi rdzong mkhar brtsigs te thun mong ma yin pa'i dpe 'jog stangs kyi rnam pa zhig bsnyegs mod/ don gyis snyan ngag gi nang rdzong je zab tu gtong ba dang snyan ngag gi bsam blo 'khor phyogs kyi thad nas da dung nar son med/ mkhas grub kyi snyan rtsom la khyab rgya dang zab tshad kyi cha nas rang 'gul gyis zab pa dang chen po bsnyegs pa'i shul yod cing / 'di ni ches rin thang bral ba'i gsar rtsom tshe srog gi shul red/snyan ngag pa'i dung ba'i zhing khams mi tshe'i dbyid ka'i g.yo skyom brgyud myong yang srid/ dbyar gyi nyi drod smyug thogs pa'i dung bar phog ldid tig tig gi 'bras bu dud pa'i ston khar/ khong gi bsam blo lo tog ji bzhin smin pa'i phyogs su bskyod kyang / nam yang rgas mi srid pa'i tshor 'du drag po sngar bzhin byis pa ji bzhin mtshar 'dzin gyi mig zung che ru bgrad de 'tshol zhing 'tshol/smin 'bras stug po ston gyi mtshon byed de/ rtsom du/ 'bras ldan snye ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /mgo lcog yang yang ldem pa ni/ /da ko na tshod smin no 131

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/zhes/ /khyim bdag 'bod dang yang dag mtshungs/ zhes pa ltar/ mkha' la dpyangs pa'i ston dkyil gyi zla bas ni gzhan la bsil ba spyin par shar zhing /mtha' yas pa'i zhing thang ni rtsom du/ ngur smig gos 'dzin btsun par gyur zhes pa dang / sran ma ni/ sran ma lgang bu'i shun skogs nas/ /thon pa'i khung bu ma rnyed par/ /yid sems rab tu ngal bas na/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs kyang nag por gyur/ /zhes pa ltar de 'dra'i zhib phra'i brtag zhib bgyis yod/ ston gyi 'bras bu dang lo legs ni dri bsung sdug po bzhin snyan ngag pa'i sems kyi sgo khar khyab/ kho rang rang gi lo tog gegs med du skye bar re ste nam yang zhing sar cer ba'i zhing ba ji bzhin zhib tshags dang dga' ba chen pos gnon mi thub par ltas bzang gis rang rtsom brgyan/ lo tog gi snye ma gang zhing bang mdzod du 'bru rigs ri bo bzhin du spungs/ bung bus khur bo lci mo khur nas dal gyis bskyod/ 'di ni ston bsdu'i dus tshigs yin pa thag gis chod cing / gna' nas yod cing gsar du'ang skye ba'i dus tshigs yin zhing / mdzes sdug dang phyug po'i dus tshigs yin/ dung ba lci mo skyug dgos shing zhing 'debs mkhan gyi dka' sdug la kha gsab rgyag dgos la/ltas bzang gi go skabs de bas kyang 'brel dgos/ mkhas grub kyi smyug kha nas gtan du nyar dgos pa'i rang byung gi snyan ngag gi phreng ba brdol/dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi mkhas grub ni byis dus su dus 'gyur gyis bcom pa'i 'jig rten dka' sdug gi 'tsho bas/ kho rang thon skyed 'tsho bar mkho 132

sha tsha ba'i rkyen gyis khong gis gzhas btang /ba'i nus pa yod tshad la byang bar byas/ kho rang dus bzhi'i so nam gyi las ka thams cad la nges cha yod cing khong gis dgun gyi 'khyags pa las grol te drag char dang drag rlung la g.yol ba'i sa bon la slar yang skye stobs kyi tshe srog 'phel bar re/ khos lha sa'i gtsang 'gram du lug bal bkru ba'i bu mo bris shing / sa gdan gyi pha yul du sa gdan 'thag pa'i tshul bris te/ bal 'breg pa dang / de khal tu 'thag pa/ sa gdan gyi rtsa ba'i rgyu cha nas las snon byas te tshong rdzas su grub pa'i zhib tshags kyi go rim re re bzhin bris pa de ni rang nyid dngos su brgyud myong ba las dpe cha po ti 'ga' mdun du spungs nas bsdad pas ni mi 'ongs/tag tag 'tsho bas kho la 'di lta bu'i legs skyes sbyin pa'i rkyen gyis kyang mkhas grub kyis 'tsho bar drin lan 'jal ba'i go skabs byung /mkhas grub kyis zhib brjod mdzad pa ni don dngos kyi 'tsho ba ste/ bstod pa'i yul ni rang gi lag pas dngos su bskrun te bde skyid bsu ba'i ngal rtsol pa dag yin/ mi 'di dag gis gtong ba chen pos 'tsho ba dang du blangs kyang lag 'bab de 'dra mi bzang ba'i ngal rtsol pa dag gis sa zhing gi tshe srog bskyed cing /tshe srog la rten sa yod pa'i tshor ba sbyin/mkhas grub ni bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi shugs rkyen zab mo thebs mkhan zhig yin/ khong gi snyan ngag mang che shos ni srol rgyun snyan ngag gi brjod bya gtsor 'dzin dang / tshab mtshon gyi 'dra bshu gtsor bzung nas brjod pa bde ba'i 133

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/myopadapyad phra mo'i bsangagator/phyogs su phyogs yod par ma zad/ snyan ngag gi dung ba'i 'phel kha dang bstun nas khong gi glu len sa'i zhing sa dang zhing ba'i gcig la gcig brten gyi 'brel ba bstan/ 'di ni snyan ngag pas mi dmangs dang 'bral thabs med pa'i spyi tshogs dang 'tsho ba'i khrod du rtsa ba btsugs pa'i mdzes dpyod kyi 'du shes shig kyang yin/gangs 'dabs kyi snyan ngag pa zhig gi ngos nas/ mkhas grub kyi mig zung dkar dung dung gi kha ba dang kha ba'i steng krong nger 'gying ba'i gangs ri/ mu mtha' med pa'i gnam 'og gi rdzi bo kher rkyang / kha ba bu yug gi rjes kyi lhing 'jags/sdong bo'i yal ga skam pos bskor ba'i zhing grong / mtha' yas pa'i rgyang ring gi kha ba'i zhing khams bcas dang kha gyes thabs med/ 'khyags sib sib kyi rang byung khams kyi rnam pa las skye stobs kyi myu gu 'bus pa'i re smon dang tsha lam lam gyi tshe srog grangs med nyar yod/so nam bgres song nam mkhar gzigs pa de/ /lha mor mjal na snyam pa'i re ba min/ /skar dpyad sprin dpyad kha rlung brtag dpyad kyis/ /phyi lo'i gnam gshis shes pa'i lo tho yin/ /bkra shis pa'i kha ba ni lo legs 'byung ba'i snga ltas yin la/ dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog las da gzod lo 'khor yongs su rdzogs nus shing / grang ngar dang kha bar khong 'grum lan cig shar chog rgyu mtshan ni dgun kha thon byung / dbyid ka 134

sha tsha ba'i rkyen gyis khong gis gzhas btang /sleb par da dung yun ring 'gor ram/ zhes dus bzhis nga tsho'i rna rtsar bshad byung /mkhas grub kyi 〈dus bzhi'i so nam byed lugs mtshon pa'i tshig phreng ngag gi rol dbyangs〉 kyis mtho sgang gi yol ras su kha dog sna lnga'i rol dbyangs kyi ang rtags bris te pha skad kyi klog pa po re re'i mig lam du bkram/ srol rgyun snyan ngag gi rgyud 'dzin pa zhig gi cha nas srol rgyun snyan ngag gi dung ba mkhas grub kyi rtsom re re'i nang zug yod/ tshab mtshon don snying can gyi dpe brjod bsnyegs nas dngos yod zhing khams kyi zhib bsdur byed thabs la brten nas snyan ngag khrod kyi dpe bsdur dang 'phel 'grib 'os mthun gyis gting je zab tu btang / rim pa rim par brtsegs pa'i snyan ngag gi zhing ni khong gis go rim dang mgo mjug gra dag por bsgrigs te/ dbyangs kyi 'gros mnyam po las rol dbyangs kyi bro ba spyin zhing kha la bde/ lhag par du dran 'char gyi cha nas mkhas grub la de bas 'char yan gyis phyug rtsom gshis 'dis khong gis brjod pa'i dung ba dang brjod bya rang bzhin lhun grub dang zung sbyar gyi rjes su phyogs pa tshab mtshon rang bzhin gyis mngon thub/ nyin re bzhin rnyog 'dzing du 'gyur bzhin pa'i deng gi spyi tshogs kyis snyan ngag la rim pa mang po'i nang rdzong bstsal ba kho thag yin/ snyan ngag la brjod don skad cha las brgal ba gal zhing nang rdzong dang phyir rtog gal/ lhag par du rgya che gting zab kyi nang rdzong gi don snying steng nas nga tsho'i snyan ngag pa tshos mu mthud du lta rgya dang sems kyi mthong rgya yangs por phye dgos pa'i khar/ dbang 135

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsangagator/lnga'i tshor ba je rnor btang nas mi rigs kyi snying stobs las ches gting du snyigs pa dang ches zil shugs kyis brtas pa'i snyan ngag cig 'khyongs par re zhing smon/gal te gong gi yi ge dag ni mkhas grub kyi dzñodus bzhi'i so nam byed lugs mtshon pa'i tshig phreng ngag gi rol dbyangs〉kyi myong ba las 'phros pa yin na/nye lam mā le hwa'i 〈mkhas grub kyi zhing khams〉klog rjes dpyod shes kyis mkhas grub la bskyar zhib cig byas pa yin/ nang bstan 'du shes kyis zin pa'i mkhas grub kyi bsam pa'i zhing khams su/ rnying ma ba'i sprul sku zhig dang 'khor ba skyong mkhan zhig yin pa'i cha la mā le hwa snying rje ste/ khyed kyi rnam shes sgrog tu tshud de tshe rabs nas tshe rabs sprul sku yin/ khyed kyi rnam shes kyi rang gshis kyis khyed rang gtan nas gtan du chos lugs dang 'jig rten pa'i bdam gses su btsud pa 'di ni khyed kyis bsran par dka' zhes brjod yod/red de/ 'jig rten 'tsho ba las bsam pa pha mthar slebs pa'i mkhas grub ni khong gis bris pa'i 〈'ja' tshon〉 nang bzhin/ dngos yod 'tsho ba'i mdun du mthon por btegs pa'i bsam pa mar mi phab thu med yin/ rang gi gsang gtam gyi bar gseng du 'jig rten snang bas spur ba'i bya sgro gang mang btus yod/ kho rang rmi lam du snying sdug mdza' na mor 'phrad par smon yang ya chung smug pas sgrib par dogs/ khos byang skar 'dzin par 'dod mod skas rgyag thabs bral/ khos grogs gsar ngo shes par 'dod mod yang me tog ltar du skad cig la 136

sha tsha ba'i rkyen gyis khong gis gzhas btang /rnyid par skrag snang ba'i 'jig rten dang mi rtag pa'i chos nyid kyi bar na/ dngos yod dang brdzu bag gi bar na/ thar ba dang rnam shes zhugs pa'i bar na/ kho rang zhugs par 'dod cing thar bar yang 'dod/ 'jig rten gyi brtse ba rnal ma zhig reg par 'dod cing 'khor ba'i phreng thag 'di las thar na'ang 'dod/ bzung na lag pa sreg cing btang na rdza ma chag pa'i ci byed cha ma 'tshal ba'i 'jig rten 'khor ba'i klong du/ khong gi rnam shes skad cig la ngal gso ba'i gnas ma rnyed de/khong gis yang dang bskyar du bzlos pa'i 'tsho ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho ji bzhin mtha' yas kyang / mi yul dkar nag gang yang ma yin par khra khra rig rig yin zhes pa bzhin/ 'di ni dbugs ring gtong bar 'dra la / de bas kyang rang la 'phya bar snang /don dngos su mkhas grub kyi sprul sku dang mi skya gnyis kyi thob thang 'dis dngos nas kho rang la khod yangs pa'i mi tshe zhig sbyin zhing / rnyog 'dzing dang khyad par ba'i bsam blo khor yug cig bskrun/ dpyod shes dang brtse ba mnyam du btab pa'i tshe 'dir kho rang gis 'di lta bu'i las dbang gi bkod sgrig la kha gtad de/g.yol thabs med pa'i dngos yod 'tsho bar 'di lta bu'i sems kyi tshor 'du rtsom du bsgyur zhing / dge tshogs su bsgyur/ 'jig rten gyi brtse bas khengs shing 'jig rten las thar ba'i lam bsnyeg pa'ang mi gtong ba 'di ni kho rang gi rgyal kha yin/gzhan yang / nga tshos shes gsal ltar rtsom rig gi pha sa ni sems pa yin 137

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/zhing / sems pa'i pha sa ni rtsom rig gi gnas mal yin/ nga tsho'i spro sems dngos yod zhing khams nas dngos yod 'tsho ba'i mi'i sems par myong bar 'gyur ba'i tshe na/ nga tsho'i sems par re chad dang spro snang / ha las pa'i skad dang sems chud pa'i ngag gis khengs/ tshe srog gi 'tsho gnas dang bden dpang gis nga tshor dus tshod btsal nas rang byung bkral ba'i zhor du rang nyid kyi sems pa'ang bkral bar basbran/ rang gi rig gnas la gong bkur dang dad pa byed pa'i cha nas/ rang nyid kyi las dbang la thugs snang mdzad pa'i cha nas/ mkhas grub kyis rang la dbang 'byor ba 'thob byed kyi lde mig gzhan lag tu med pa nges dgos te/ bod kyi snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring gis 'di ltar bris yod de/mes po'i phyir mig las 'phos kha chems reg /rang gi mi tshe'i 'os 'gan lci mo kho bos kyang / /gzhan gyi 'dzum la 'tshang ba'i skyid kyi me tog gis/ /gum pa'i las ni bskal ba'i bar du phod nus sam/ /tshe srog re re'i 'tsho gnas ni tshe sngon las kyi 'bras bu smin pa yin na/dngos po dang bsam pa'i zung 'jug gi 'jig rten du/ phun sum tshogs pa'i mi tshe'i brgyud rim dang phun sum tshogs pa'i 'tsho gnas kyi nyams myong gnyis ka mkhas grub kyi mi tshe'i go rim khrod kyi legs skyes re yin/ lam bu 'di ded nas gting zab pa'i nang sems kyi nyams myong ste/ dad mos dang 'jig rten gyi snang ba 138

sha tsha ba'i rkyen gyis khong gis gzhas btang /mnyam du 'dres sa na/ dga' skyo chags sdang gi bsnol mtshams su/ phyogs gcig rnyog cing cig shas gtsang ba'i tsha lam lam gyi nang sems kyi zhing du bskyod tshe/mkhas grub kyi thob thang zung ldan ma ste dngos yod dang bsam blo gzhi gcig tu 'dus pa'i cha de mthong thub pa ma yin nam/ bod brgyud nang bstan du yag pa dang btsog po/ dge ba dang sdig pa/ zhi ba dang drag po'i bzo bkod kyis dpyod shes dang 'char yan/ 'gal ba dang zhi bde ste mdzes pa'i ltos zla gcig 'dus su mngon pa ma yin nam/ngas bsam na gnad 'di rtogs tshe mkhas grub la da ni 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal yod mi srid/ khyod kyi rnam shes sngon nas thag gis bcad mod khyod kyi rnam shes 'pho sa chos 'jig rten gnyis 'dus kyi gnas 'di las ma 'das te/ khyod kyi khrag rgyun dang brtse dung / khyod kyi skad cha dang dad mos/ thams cad khyod kyi sems pa dang mnyam du mtho sgang du gnas par gtan khel byas yod phyin/ khyod kyis 'di ltar du brjod 'dod pa brjod dgos pa las bdam gses byed mi dgos/(mchog ldan tshe ring gis bsgyur/)139

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/༄༅/ /rma 'bri'i mgo khungs nas brdol ba'i snyan ngagad wa 'ju skal bzang dang khong gi snyan ngagadagung du zug pa'i ri tshom gyis bskor ba'i mdo dbus mtho sgang ni mi lo dung phyur gyi snga rol du rgya mtsho chen po yin zhing / sa'i phyi shun gyi 'gyur ba dang gdong gtugs chen mos mtsho dma' shas su chags shing chu bo rim gyis bri nas/sa yi dkyil 'khor du skye khams ji snyed pa'i rgyud chags te/ kun gyis gtan du mgo bo dgye dgos pa'i sa bab gsar ba 'di chags pa red/ 'di na shel gyi gangs ri dang gangs rtse rnon po yod/ 'di na gson shugs mkha' ru snyeg cing me tog gi dri bsung 'thul yod/ 'di na kha ba dang bu yug phyogs su lding zhing phyogs bzhi thang stong yin/ 'di na sa gzhir ljang mdog gis khyab cing nor lug gis ri lung khengs/ rang byung khams chen mos blo ngor mi shong ba dag bskrun pa'i mod la mtshar 'dzin gyi blo'i drod ma yal ba'i mi rnams la mtshar snang rabs dang rim pa bskyed 'ongs/ lo rgyus ring zhing na gzhon pa'i mtho sgang gi rang mdangs kyis/ nga tshor rang byung khams chen mos tshe srog bskyed pa'i dus kyi gzi brjid dang drod 140

rma 'bri'i mgo khungs nas brdol ba'i snyan ngagakhol tshor du bcug la/ nga tshor tshe srog la ji ltar gces tshul gdams/ ma ṇi yig drug gi dbyangs rta'i khrod du/ skye 'chi phan tshun brten tshul dang bde sdug phan tshun 'brel tshul ji 'dra yin par bkral la/ tshe srog gi gsang tshig bkral/gzhon skyes rtsom pa po 'ju skal bzang ni 'di lta bu'i rig gnas kyi khor yug tu 'tshar longs byung / kho rang snyan rtsom gyi las la 'jug pa'i dus ni de 'dra'i snga mo nas ma yin te/ 1977lor snyan rtsom dang po spel ba nas bzung ste/khong gis bod kyi srol rgyun snyan rtsom gyi me long las khyad mtshar gyi zhing khams 'di rnyed de me long ltag rgyab kyi ka kha sum cu'i sdeb sbyor ngo mtshar ba la cer zhing /slob sbyong gi khor yug bzang pos kyang khong gi rmi lam gyi gshog zung legs par brkyangs/ de nas bzung ste khos rang mi rigs kyi srol rgyun snyan ngag gi rgya mtsho las yon tan gsar ba 'jibs te snyan ngag gi sde las rang la dbang ba'i dus kyi 'phrod pa sbyor bar brtson pa drag tu byas/ 1991lor khong la cong sgra rtsom rig bya dga' thob/ snyag ngag pa'i dpa' nyams kyis mthong lam yangs por phyes te/ rma chen gangs 'dabs kyi me 'bri gtsang bo'i 'byung khungs kyi rang byung gi bkod pa las mi rigs shig gi nyams med kyi rang stobs mngon par nyams zhib dang rtogs sad byed du bcug snyan ngag pa'i shugs drag pa'i sems pa nam yang khong gi smyug kha nas skyug ste/ gnas 'di'i lhab lhub bskyod pa'i dar lcog dang / du smug yal rjes su mthong ba'i 'brong gi rus pa/ chad la nye ba'i ge sar sgrung sogs 141

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsangagator/rim gyis brjod yod/ nga tshos 'ju skal bzang gi snyan ngag bklags na/ des nga tsho gangs 'dabs su khrid nas lo zla'i 'bag sku chen mo me chen gangs rir cer du 'jug ljid tig gi dran pa'i yol ras phye ba ji bzhin stor zin pa'i rmi lam gyi zhabs rjes ji snyed 'di nas rnyed cing / yun ring bor re sgug byas pa'i dris lan 'di nas rnyed/ snyan tshom ṭ+wāṃgangasa'adabs kyi sems pa/〉zhes pa ni tag tag rtsom pa po'i blo rtses brgyus pa'i mtho sgang gi rmi lam lags/'ju skal bzang gi snyan rtsom ni srol rgyun snyan ngag gi rmang rdo las 'khrungs pa yin/ bod yul ni glu dang gar gyi rgya mtsho yin par ma zad/ de bas kyang snyan ngag gi rgya mtsho chen po yin/ zil shugs gnam 'og la khyab pa'i dpa' bo'i lo rgyus snyan rtsom yin na'ang 'dra/ dgod kha 'chor ba'i gtam dpe yin kyang chogaglegs bam brtsegs pa'i gtsug lag yin na'ang 'dra/ gtan tshigs can gyi theg lam yin na yang chog mang shos shig gi lus ni snyan ngag las ma 'das/ rgya gar gyi snyan gzhung me long ma dus rabs bcu drug par bod du dar ba nas bzung /bo+od yul du snyan ngag dar khyab rgya chen po byung zhing / me long ma'i 'od zer gangs ljangs su tag tag dus rabs bcu phrag lhag la 'phras/'ju skal bzang srol rgyun snyan rtsom dang mjal nas snyan ngag gi dung ba'i me lce tshig gi sdeb sbyor mnyam zhing go rim can/ tshig rgyan gtso bor 'dzin pa'i snyan ngag gi rnam pa'i gseb tu btab/ bod du me long ma las 'phros pa'ang khyod 142

rma 'bri'i mgo khungs nas brdol ba'i snyan ngagakyi gdong ni chu skyes bzhin zhes pa dang / smin ma 'khri shing zhes pa ltar gyi gna' bo'i rgya gar gyi mdzes ma'i snang brnyan ma yin par/ gzhon sha dar la lo rgyus kyi gyang chag las bskyar du mngon pa'i de ring gi gangs can pa'i zil shugs yin la/mtho sgang gi gzhon rabs gsar ba'i dus rabs gsar ba'i nang gi bsam blo yin/snyan tshom 〈ljon pa'i phugs bsam/〉zhes par/ snyan ngag pas khod du phyung ba'i rgya che zhing khod yangs pa/ blos gtong phod pa'i mi rigs snying stobs kyi rtsa ba gcig tu bsgril yod/ dpyid zla tha ma'i dus su/ lo zlas rdog brdzis thebs pa'i sa gzhir/ dus kyi 'khor lo med pa'i sdong bo zhig yod/ me tog gis bu mo'i 'dzum rmadangs brgyan myong la/ bsil grib kyis rngul chus khengs pa'i lus la grib bsil sbyin myong / shing 'bras kyis 'dzugs mkhan la drin lan mjal myong zhing /sdong lo skam pos kyang mi rnams la drod khol sbyin myong / dgun kha bsleb la nye dus/sdong bo dag skam tshar na'ang sdong rgan 'di kho na 'gyod pa skyes kyi med par ma zad/da dung rang nyid rmang rdo zhig tu gyur nas rjes rabs pa rnams rang gi rtse la 'khyud de 'od 'tsher ba'i nam mkha'i skar ma 'dzin par smon/ sdong rgan 'di'i rtsa ba gangs ljongs su zug nas lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i lo zla brgyud myong ste/ gri mdung gi grib 'og na/ spyang ki phyogs bzhir pu skya dmag gis mthong lam thad kyis bcad cing / lo rgyus kyi sa rdul stug pos steng gi mkha' dbyings sgrib/ sdong rgan 'dis dad ldan pas ston pa'i mdun na phyag gyang 'gyel ba ltar 'tshal ba'i grib ma dang /143

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/ myongadapyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/'od lam lam gyi mar me/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'ang mthong myong la/ phal ba'i mi khri 'bum gyis nyin mtshan med par smon lam rgyag pa'i sgra re re khyab 'ongs te/ glo bur du sdong rgan gyi sems pa sgul/ lo rgyus kyi dpang por gyur ba'i sdong rgan 'dis char rlung gi rgol ba reg myong na'ang / brgyud rim mang po dang yun ring gi ngang sgug gi rjes nas mthar gzhon rabs pas mig zung kho la gtod pa mthong /shog dang / byis pa tsho/ nga'i rgas gnyer gyi yal ga dang lo 'dab kyi bsil grib 'og tu khyed tshor rang dbang gis glu len du 'jug khyed tsho nga'i lus la dal gyis 'gos te ches mtho ba'i yal ga'i steng du mdzes sdug yod tshad la cer du 'jugaces pa ltar/ snyan rtsom du 'ju skal bzang gis ljon pa'i gzugs kyis bla na ma mchis pa'i phul byung gi bsam pa'i 'jig rten zhig gcal tu bkram/ rang nyid skyong ba'i mi rigs dang sa gzhir kho sems gting nas dga' zhing / dga' ba 'di'i rtsa ba kho rang las 'phros te/ khos rang gi gangs ri dang / gangs thang /gnyen nye spun zla dag zhib 'bri byed kyin yod/ dga' ba 'di ni ‘‘rang gi sdug bsngal la brten nas skyes pa min zhing / rang gi bde skyid la brten nas skyes pa yang min/ khong gi sdug bsngal dang bde skyid thams cad spyi tshogs dang lo rgyus kyi sa gzhi'i zab sar zug ’’ (pe lin si ce'i skad/) pa'i mi rigs snying stobs kyi rmang rdo yin/ rmang rdo 'di ni tag tag a pha'i lag gi rta lcag dang a ma'i lag gi ma ṇi brgyud cing ka mad sum cu'i dbyangs rta brgyud nas snyan 144

me 'bri'i mgo khungs nas brdol ba'i snyan ngagangag pa dang gzhon rabs par sbyin pa'i dad 'dun dang nor bu lags/ rmang rdo 'di yod na mi gshis mjes pa'i rtsa ba'i cha rkyen yod pa yin no/ /bod kyi rtsom rig gsar ba'i dus skabs kyi snyan ngag pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas 'ju skal bzang gi mig zung lo rgyus kyi bshul lam la gtad de bsam gzhigs kyi klong nas bsam blo gsar ba'i rtogs pa rnyed/ 〈zol gyi 'dzum mdangs dang /〉 〈bla ri/〉 〈rin thang shor ba'i rin thang /〉 〈me mda'i las dbang /〉〈jing gur gyi bang so/〉 sogs snyan rtsom las/ spyi tshogs dang rang byung khams kyi 'phral yun gyi 'gyu bag las tshor thub pa'i sems khral drag po mngon par mtshon/gna' bo'i rmu thag dum bur chad pa las/byang thang du lhung ba'i bla srog gson po zhigangal dub dang gangs rdul yang yang bab pas/lha sgrung gi phung bo gtos che ba zhig tu chags/lo rgyus ni gtan du chad mi srid la dus tshod kyang ldog nas bzhud thabs med/ lha sgrung mdzes pa'i rmu thag gis gzi byin 'bar ba'i tshe srog cig skyel zin na'ang / 'phel bzhin pa sngar bzhin gnam 'og na bag yangs kyis 'tsho/go khrab dang glegs bam yun gyis rul ba/zangs rag dang gter rdor gyur/rlung rta dang dar lcog byang rlung gis gtses drags pas/145

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/phyi nang nges med du sgyur kyang kha phyogs yang yang 'chol/gtsang bo'i ya tshig gi sne nas/ lha ri'i lo rgyus kyang 'di ltar mi rigs shig gi brgyud rim yin cing / lha ri'i sngon gyi lhun chags kyang dus kyi gom kha nas skad cig la zad/ 'das pa'i lo zlas gzhon nu'i sems su sdug gi btsan rdzong brtsigs med cing / tshe srog gi brgyud rim 'di ltar skad cig gis zad cing brtse ba dang bral/ gtam snyan dang rmi lam gyis dngos yod kyi tshab gtan nas byed mi nus/ mi rnams kyis 'das song gi lo rgyus brjed mi rung la/ 'das song gi lo rgyus brjed na rgyab 'gal byas pa mtshon/ zhes pa 'di ni snyan ngag pas rtogs sad byung ba'i brtse dung dang dpyod shes yin la snyan rtsom du nyar ba'i blo sgo 'byed byed kyi dpar shing lags/ snyan ngag ni mi rigs kyi snying gi lhig sgra yin/ snyan ngag pa yin phyin dang por rang nyid ni mi rigs de'i yid ches khel ba'i bus phrug yin dgos zhing / khos a ma'i nu ma nu ba dang mnyam du 'os 'gan yang phrag tu blangs yod/ ṭ+wāṃmes po a ma ma ṇi/〉 zhes pa'i rtsom du/ khong gis a mar bla med kyi gus bkur byas yod/ brtse ba dang zhi bde kho nas da gzod tshe srog dang phugs bsam bskyed nus/ ma ṇi yig drug bzlo ba'i dbyangs kyis rtsom pa po'i tshor reg brgyud nas khong gi bsam blo rang mi rigs kyi gting zab pa'i bsam pa'i zhing khams su drangs/ kho rang mgo 'khor mi srid de/ yig drug gi bzlo dbyangs 'di gsal lhang nger kho dang mnyam 146

rma 'bri'i mgo khungs nas brdol ba'i snyan ngagadu ji srid du gnas/ de ni a ma'i zhal ras ji bzhin 'dris che bas mtshar snang mi skyes/ de ni gsol smon re re'i khrod na ches mang ba'i legs skyes yin/ gsang tshig 'di rtogs tshe mthon po ri dang chen po pha bong gi steng du rgyun du khong gi zhabs rjes yod la/ lhab lhub bskyod pa'i dar lcog gi steng na khong gi gzugs brnyan bskyon pa'i rgyu mtshan shes nus/ 'di ni goms srol gzhan zhig las 'phos pa'i dga' ba yin la/ de las yan lag lnga bo sa la btud pa'i dad pa'i bden rdzun shes la/ zhib tu bltas na da ni skyo sdug gi dngos yod la 'jig rten phal ba'i mig gis blta mi srid/ rgyu mtshan ni/ snyan ngag pa'i rtogs pa ni brtse ba dang dung ba'i khrol tshags kyis ma btsags par rnyed pa zhig mi srid pas so/ /snyan ngag pas rang sems la brten nas 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi mi bzhengs skrun byas/ rnam dag 'gyur med kyi sems shugs brtan pos nam yang 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi mdzes sdug 'tshol bar skul ba la brten nas snyan rtsom las lhad med kyi brtse ba 'phyur/ byis rgyud kyi gsar rtog gi cha med mkhan ni snyan ngag pa min zhing / gtan tshigs kyi zil shugs dang mig shes kyis snyan ngag pa'i bsam blo'i gting je zab tu gtong thub/ nga tsho'i rgan rabs kyi snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyis snyan ngag gi dung ba dang mtshan nyid kyi gshog zung mnyam gcig tu 'tsho ba'i mkha' dbyings su brkyangs shing brkyangs/ drag tu lding ba'i snyan ngag gi dung ba las rang gi mes rgyal dang mi rigs la bcangs pa'i dga' ba chen po 'phyur zhing / zab rgyas kyi 147

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/gtan tshigs kyis kyang rig pa'i dri bsung bdug cing bduga'aju skal bzang gi snyan rtsom la dkyus gcig tu 'jug na/ khong gi snyan rtsom srol rgyun snyan ngag gi rgyan 'dogs stangs dang snyan rtsom spyi'i mdzes nyams gtsor 'dzin pa'i lugs kyi rjes su 'jug par mthong thub/ 〈lam phran du lhag pa'i gtam/〉 sogs kyis mtshon pa'i nang don cung gting zab pa'i brtsams chos mi nyung ba zhig yod na'ang / snyan rtsom gyi nang rdzong ste gtan tshigs kyi cha rgyas par bkod pa'i tshig nyams kyi spros pa'i gseb tu thim pas/ snyan ngag gi mdzes pa snyan ngag gi bro ba las brgal te bro ba gnyom la mig la shin tu mdzes pa'i zas ji bzhin za mkhan thams cad lta mkhan du gyur/ kun gyis dga' bsu thob pa'i 〈ka rtsom gnod spyin pho brang dkrug pa'i 'phrul 'khor/〉 zhes pa'i snyan rtsom yin na'ang / skabs de'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod du rgyu nor gyi 'dod pa rab tu rgod pa'i spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul 'ga' la zur za byas te/ drang bden dang spobs pas phyug mod/ thad kar mtshon pa dang rang gi chags sdang tsab tsob thad kar du brjod pa mang drags te snang brtan dang dung bas klog pa por blo sgo 'byed pa dang gting zab pa'i bsam gzhig byed du 'jug pa'i nus pa ster mi nus/ nga tshos mgo brtsams ma thag gi nar ma son pa'i snyan rtsom de de ring gi rgya thog tu 'jal mi rung ba ni lta ci smos la/ nga tshos kyang snyan ngag pa yod rgu nges par du rang nyid las brgal dgos pa'i re ba'ang gdon mi chog mod/ nges pa don gyi snyan ngag pa zhig 148

me 'bri'i mgo khungs nas brdol ba'i snyan ngagayin phyin yang dag pa'i spyan gyis rang nyid la blta ba'i spobs pa cis kyang yod dgos/ dga' 'os pa zhig la 'ju skal bzang snyan ngag gi lha mo dbyangs can ma'i thu 'og na bzi med par/ khos rig pa gsal bos bskyar du rang la gdengs 'jog bgyis par ma zad/ nam yang thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshon thabs bsnyegasrol rgyun snyan rtsom gyi thabs la brten nas snyan ngag gsar ba'i bsam blo gtso bor bsnyeg sa te sems gting gi snyan ngag gi bla srog gis rang gi brtse dung rang shugs kyis mngon/ bod mi rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dngos la zug nas gting zab pa'i mi rigs kyi sems khams dang rig gnas 'du shes mngon par mtshon zhing / snyan ngag gi thig phreng re re'i bar na 'jig rten phal ba'i 'tsho ba'i bag la nyal ba'i bsam blo'i 'phel 'grib dang / lo rgyus kyi zhabs rjes/ sems kyi myong tshor mngon par brtson/ der brten 〈da lta/〉zhes pa'i rtsom 'di ni khong gi brnyes pa'i rtogs pa chen por mngon te/ 'di ni skye dngos 'phel 'gyur gyi go rim khrod du byin chags par ma nyams pa'i ches gnyug ma dang ches bab chags pa'i tshe srog gi lhan skyes kyi dung ba yin/ khyim rgyud kyi sa bon 'dis dus rtag tu khong gi bsam blo phyogs bzhi'i sa mtshams kyi rdo ring brgal nas mtha' med pa'i rtsom rig gi skyed tshal re rer 'pho ru bcug cing / khong gi sems 'gyu re re slar rang gi pha sar drangs te yang bskyar rang nyid la gdengs 'jog byed du bcug 'das zin pa'i don dag ni sbra nag tu a mye'i kha spu las brdol ba'i lha sgrung dang 'dra srid cing /149

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/yang dus kyi gom kha dang mnyam du rgas pas nar ma son pa'i byis pa'i sems kyis kha gtod par dka' yang / des sngar bzhin kha spu las brdol ba'i lha sgrung las thad kar ram brgyud de snyan ngag par kha gtad/ bskyar 'bri'am bsgyur bcos gang yin kyang don snying gtan du mi yal/ ṭ+wāṃgangs 'dabs kyi sems pa 〉zhes par snyan ngag pas srol rgyun snyan rtsom gyi rgyud 'dzin dang rjes 'jug khrod kyi 'dor len dang / snyan ngag gsar ba'i khrod kyi rab rib kyi rang bzhin dang shugs bstan gyi rang bzhin 'tshol zhib byas/ khong gi snyan rtsom gsar bas bsam bzhin rab rib dang ci 'chad cha mi 'tshal ba'i zab tshad bsnyeg gin med phyin/ klog mkhan rnams go dka' ba'i zab lam las ma gzhi'i sgom gnas mi rnyed pa'i tshad du mi lhung bar mtshon thabs gsar ba'i lam nas bsam rtogs go tshor gyi myong ba zhig byin te/ klog pa po'i sna thag snyan ngag gis khrid pa ma yin par mi re rer myong tshor phun sum tshogs pa sbyin/ 'di'i thad nas 'ju skal bzang ches legs shos min kyang cung 'bur du thon yod/〈ge sar sgrung /〉zhes pa'i snyan rtsom 'dir/ glu rnying gsar len gyis lam bu gsar du btod de/ dpa' bo'i dus rabs ni a ce jo mo'i mgul gyi ske rgyan nas bzung ste rtswa thang la gtor/ gzu mig dgu rnyed pa'i sgyu rtsal pa dag gisatshe srog dpang du bzhag nas sgrung bshad pa'i dam bca' phul/ rtswa thang 'di dang mi rigs 'dis dpa' bo'i lo rgyus ring mo bskrun zhing / dam pa dang 'phags pa grangs med 150

me 'bri'i mgo khungs nas brdol ba'i snyan ngagabyung ba dang mnyam du phal ba'i mi'ang grangs med skyes myong / tshe tshad skya dmag gi 'tsher skad kyi klong na rgyud bdung ba'i mda' bzhin shugs drag po'i sems kyi rtse la 'phen dus/ yun ring bor gnas gcig tu cer mkhan gyi mig gi rno la phoga'adi lta bu'i byin chags kyi yul ljongs dang 'di lta bu'i grung sha dod pa'i bkod pas nam yang snyan ngag pa'i rtog 'char bskyed cing / mgo mjug bar gsum du khong gi smyug kha brgyan/ kho mtshams mtshams su gsal bor gnas la/ skabs skabs su gos skud kyi dkyus bzhin rmi lam gyi rdo skas steng gser mdog gi 'od grang mo zhig 'phro zhing 'phro/ 〈rin thang shor ba'i rin thang /〉 zhes pa'i snyan rtsom 'di las mtsho skya rengs kyi 'gram du 'brong gi keng rus shig rnyed pa'i myong ba bris yod/las dbang dang smon lam gyi stobs las/rnam shes 'khyam po zhigabu yug dang na bun 'phrad mtshams nas mched pa/g.yung drung dang rdo rje rgya gram bsnol ba'i dra ba las nar son/rus rkang mkhregs po de dang rang gshis gyong bo kho nas/khyod rang gangs 'dabs dang rdza khrod du gcig pur 'khyams/mtha'i rgya mtsho zer ba ma thos pas/151

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/mgo thog gi sprin pa la'ang ci mi snyam/sna gshog tu bskyil ba'i grang rlung las/khrag ngad cung zad tshor ba'i tshe na/hur por bgrad pa'i mig kong g.yas g.yon las/re ltos dang gtan tshigs cig car lhung ba'i shul na/grang shur shur rgyu ba'i skyo shas phran bu zhig gis/sus kyang tshor dka' ba'i skog lab cig shub bur bzlo/'di ni yid skyo ba'i gtam rgyud cig ste/ 'tsho sa med pa'i 'brong zhig 'di ltar kher rkyang gis 'brong khyu dang gyes te/ kho'i gzhan gyis kha lo btul bar mi 'dod pa'i lhan skyes kyi gshis ka sna thag shor nas phyogs phyogs su ngom par mi 'dod/ kho u tshugs dang nga rgyal che bas gzhan gyis gdul dka' ba'i mod la u tshugs 'dis rang lam rang bkag kyang byas yod de/ g.yo 'phrul med pa'i rkyen gyis g.yo sgyu'i rnyi ru tshud pa mi shes la bsam pa rnam par dag pas drag char lus la 'ong ba mi tshor/ ldog tu med pa'i tshe srog gi chos nyid kyis sra mkhregs kyi lus phung keng rus su bsgyur dus su kho'i tsha lam lam gyi sems pas rang nyid mtha' mar mis brdzus bzo mdzad pa rtsa ba nas dran med/ gnyug ma'i rnam pa byug cing bkras btags kyi zangs byang steng gong bcag pa'i rin gong bris/ sgyu rtsal gyi 152

me 'bri'i mgo khungs nas brdol ba'i snyan ngagakhyad chos kyis phyug pa'i khang ba'i nang gi mig la gsal sar bzhag ste/ bdag po'i rol myong dang / yon tshad/ 'dod zhen gyis zur brgyan/ gal te 'chi bas 'tsho gnas kyi rin thang brje ba yin na des sems pa zhig gi thar ba dang 'pho 'gyur mtshon mod/ 'das log gi rus par bcos sgyur byed par bsnyeg sa te gson shugs nyams pa'i khe phan gyi rin thang tsam bsnyeg na ni gting zab sa zhig nas rtsa ba nas brlag pa yin/ rgyu mtshan shes rab dang gson shugs rmongs mun gyis kun nas g.yogs te srog med kyi phung bo'i mtshon gzhir bzung nas btsong tsa na/mdzes pa'i ches rtsa ba'i rin thang nyams pa red/ srog med pa'i dngos por gdod nas mdzes nyams med ces pa ltar/ mdzes pa ni spobs nyams kyis brtas pa'i tshe srog gi khrod du gnas/ nga tshos bskyar dpar btab pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi dngos por rol myong dang rin thang mi 'jal thu med kyi dus su/ re smon ni 'brong gi rno ngar gyi rwa rtse las bud de mtha' med kyi 'brog thang chen por gang dgar gyis mchong lding byed par bsam pa las/ btsan gyis btul nas gyang ngos la 'dzer na mi 'dod/'ju skal bzang gis snyan rtsom 'dir skye ba'i 'jig pa dang 'chi ba'i 'das log gi rnam pa gnyis kyi mtshon thabs las khong gi mdzes dpyod rin thang gi kha phyogs mngon yod/ khong gis smyug 'og gi 'brong snyan ngag gi dung ba 'byur ba'i rkyen byas te/ da nas mtho rim srog chags kyi gras su mi tshud pa'i mis mthong ba'i mtho sgang gi mdzes ljongs kyi rgyan cha ste/ 'brong gi steng na dod du phyung ba'i dpa' nyams dang 153

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/brjed nyams/ sdug bsngal ci yang thad du gcod nus pa'i zil shugs ni mi'i rnam pa dang bsam blo'i rnam par bsdus pa'i 'brong red/ de'i gnas yul ni gna' dus su mi bcar mi thub pa'i 'brog thang yin la/ khong gi rno dbal gyi rwa rtse ni rang nyid srung skyob byed pa'i mtshon cha yin/ snyan ngag pas 'dir brdol ba dang phyir mig lta sa ni 'brong rgod shi rjes su mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i rgyan du byed pa'i g.yu ral ma yin par/ de'i srog gi rgyu ba thog ma'i dus kyi tshe srog gi gson shugs yin la tag tag ma shi gong gi zil gyis khyab pa'i mchong lding gi ngar shugs lags/ kho shi rjes su bstod pa'i dar cha dgung du bskyod kyang chog khu sim gyi dbugs rnga khog tu bsdus kyang rung / 'brong rgod la mtshon na snying bo ci yang med/gal te las dang po ba'i dus kyi 'ju skal bzang lags snyan ngag gi rdo skas su 'dzegs te rim gyis mthong lam yangs por phye ste phyir thog ma'i dus kyi tshugs mi thub par gzhan la brten pa dang mgo 'thom pa'i dka' ngal la blta ba yin na/ de ring khong gis rang nyid la cung yid ches dang bcas te 'das pa'i gshin sar gzigs/ rgyu mtshan ni khong gis rang nyid la mtha' med pa'i rtog 'char gyi 'jig rten gzhan zhig bskrun zin/ ji bzhin bris pas ni sdong bo sa gzhir brten pa dang / nor lug rtswa thang la brten pa ji bzhin dngos yod kyi don dngos dang 'bral thabs med par gyur/ snyan ngag tu bye brag gi chos ni kha ba dkar po dang / ljang mdog gi spang thang / gser mdog gi lha khang dag yin la/154

me 'bri'i mgo khungs nas brdol ba'i snyan ngagardzi mo'i snyan 'jebs kyi glu skad dang a ma'i rdzogs med kyi gsol 'debs las mngon zhing / snyan ngag gi brjod bya ni bye brag gi snang brnyan gyi grib 'og nas de bas phun sum tshogs shing gting zab pa'i sems shugs slar yang khong gi mig lam du mngon/ 'di'i skabs su/ klog pa po tshig phreng gi lci yang sdeb sbyor la brten nas 'gros snyoms por spungs pa'i mdun na/ yi ge'i rol rtsed la 'jug pa'i ltad mo ba'i tshul mi 'dzin par/ sems pa dang sems pa 'dres mtshams nas skad cig gi 'gal 'du dang /ngo mtshar/ glo bur ba'i klong brdol tshor rtogs 'byung la/mun pa med pa'i rtswa thang ji ltar sgyu rtsal pa rgan po'i dbugs dbyung 'og tu khu sim mer mdzes ma gnyid du yur ba ji bzhin yin pa dang / khur bo rgyab tu khur ba'i brtse sems kyis phyug pa'i a mas lha mdun du ji ltar gsol ba 'debs pa dang / lha sku'i byams brtse'i spyan zung mthong mi thub na'ang sems 'gul lam rgyu gzhan gyis gdong yongs mig chus khengs byung ba/ po ta lar bgrod pa'i rdo skas dang yum bu bla sgang gi gyang chag tu g.yag dang 'brog mi mnyam du bskyod pa'i lam bar bcas bye brag gi chos kyi bar na snyan ngag gi tshab mtshon gyi bro ba ldan pa'i don dngos kyi zhal ras lhang la bud pa 'di ni snyan ngag gi bro ba yin/'ju skal bzang lags ni rma chen gangs 'dabs nas 'tshar longs byung ba'i snyan ngag pa yin/ sa'i go la'i sgal tshigs su grags pa'i thang posakhong gi thun mong ma yin pa'i mdzesadapyod kyi mig zung bskrun/ mkha' dbyings na brtsegs 155

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/pa'i du sprin kyis khong gi gshin sa'i lo zla sgrib par ma nus na'ang / khong gis mes po'i shes rab kyis bsnyal ba'i nas chang btung ba'i tshe na chang rag gi dri zhim gyis lus po yongs su zin/ khos snyan ngag gi skad cha dang 'das song gi lo rgyus gleng mol byed par tshod lta byas te/ rnam par dag pa'i sems kyis gangs 'og na yun ring khu sim mer bsdad pa'i lo zla dang sbrel par 'bad/ mthar 'tsho bas kho rang la thob 'os pa'i grub 'bras sbyin song / 'ju skal bzang lags kyi snyan ngag lo zla ring mo'i rgya kha nas 'jal par bzod mi bzod dang / klog pa po'i sems su bsub med kyi zhabs rjes shig dgod thub min da ni snyan ngag pa rang nyid kyi las ma yin no/ / rnam par dag pa'i snyan ngag gi bla srog rma 'bri'i 'byung khungs kyi sa steng na sngar bzhin 'phyo zhing brtse ba rnal ma brdol zhing brdol/ dus rabs dang mi rigs kyi ched du a mar glu len mkhan gyi rta ba zhig yin na/ khong gi snyan ngag srol rgyun gyi 'phel 'grib lasa'agyur mi srid cing / gzhan gyi gdengs 'jog gi ched du rang gshis bor mi srid/ rib ma phyi rol gyi dpyid mdog gis brlag mi nus la/ zil shugasasu sgril ba'i dpyid kyi rlabs 'og nas 'jig pa de bas kyang mi srid/ 'di ni snyan ngag pas bkur ba'i dad 'dun yin par yid ches gyis la/'ju skal bzang lags kyi 〈gangs 'dabs kyi sems pa〉 la sngar bzhin brtan pa'i yid ches kyang gnangs rogs/ (karma 'bum gyis bsgyur/)156

a le la shākyas lon byed pa/༄tsho/ /a le la rgyus lon byed pa/da wa a le dang khong gi 〈sa rdul sar 'bab 〉bkra shis zla ba sogs bod kyi gzhon skyes rtsom pa po'i 'char yan rtsom rig gi rba rlabs drag tu 'phyur ba nas rim gyis/ bod kyi rtsom rig de lo du mar 'jags pa'i rjes nas nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring la slar yang lang long gi rlabs shig 'phyur 'ongs/ bod kyi gzhon skyes rtsom pa po a les khong gi sgrung gtam 〈sa rdul sar 'bab/〉 khams kyi nub byang nas mdo dbus mtho sgang gi she mong gzhan zhig khyer te/ rab rib skog gyur gyi 'char yan gyi gdangs kyis pa cin rtsom rig bya dga'i yang rtse'i rtags ma blangs pa dang mnyam du/ stong ba brjod pa dang lo rgyus kyi tshor ba gting du snyigs pa'i rtsom gshis kyis klog pa po'i khyu bkugs shing /hrig hrig cer ba'i mig zung sa rdul sar 'bab sa'i gnas kyi phyogs su drangs/dang po/ pha sar rgyang lta byed pa'i a le/a le ni nga tshor de 'dra'i rgyus med cig ga la yin/ khong gi shugs drag pa'i tshor 'du ches thog mar snyan ngag gi rnam pas skyug snyan tshom 〈spang thang na 157

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/'khyil ba'i 'gyur khugs〉 ces par khong gis pha sar brtse dung gi dgu mdud brgyab yod de/ snyan ngag gi skad char mi lo mang po'i brtse dung 'thamasayod la zab myur gyi snyan ngag gi brjod bya sems pa dang lus po'i gnas mal du byas yod de/'di ltarathun min sger chos can gyi pha sa'o ma dang nas chang gi dri zhim gyis khyab pa'i pha sadwangs gtsang gi kha ba dang nor bu'i pha sakha lce bar nas gtam chadamig las gus ba dang skrag snang mnyam du skyesagrags rgyu ci yang med par gyur (〈pha sa 〉)thog ma'i dus kyi a le ni chos lugs kyi cha mang du yod cing tha na ci byed 'di byed med par pha sa'i stobs chen po'i khab leb rdo'i 'gugs shugs kyis rtogs pa sad du bcug ste/ khad kyis 'phyur ba'i skad cha mtha' dag gzhib kyin gda'/ snyan ngag gi brjod bya'i tshor snang 'di rjes nas gtan du khong rang nyid kyi tshe srog dang rig gnas kyi tshe srog dang sbrel te dus nam yang phun sum tshogs pa'i nying bcud sbyin/ khong gi bsam blo kho rang la tshe srog dang phugs bsam/ pha skad bcas spyin pa'i gling mol mtshe'u 'gram du lding skor byed/ bsam blo'i bstod yul du gyur ba ni smin pa'i rtswa'i sa bon ji bzhin mi rigs kyi lo rgyus dang tsho ba'i 158

a le la rgyus lon byed pa/lo rgyus/ khyim rgyud kyi lo rgyus bcas khyab spel byed pa yin/ mjal skor ba'i spobs pa dang dad ldan rnams kyi ldog med kyi dad pas khong gi yid sems 'gul bar byas/ ches dga' ba'i snyan ngag blor skyor bzhin bshad rgyun du rtse mor lha gnas pa'i ri zhol du mgo bo yar la dgye ste rgyang lta byed pa ni lhing 'jags dang blo sgo 'byed phyir tsam ma yin par/ bsam blo phyir phyogs pa'i she mong stobs chen po zhig gting du zug yod/ ngas bsam na 'di nas bzung ste a le'i gsar rtsom gyis rang gi bla srog rnyed byung / khos rang gis rjod bzhin pa'i bsam blo'i rtsa ba bod mi dang rang nyid kyis byed pa las/ rigs gzhan gyi zungs khrag gi rgyun gyis ma yin pa thog mar tshor/ mdud pa dang khrag rgyun lta bu'i 'brel bas mes po nas brgyud pa'i spyang rig dang lha mthu'i nus pa la brten nas dus nam yang tshor ba 'gugs shing / de bas kyang bla srog mang por gtsang bkru gnangs pa bshad ma dgos pas/ yod tshad kyi mdun du a les snyan ngag tu/ ngas gtan nas khyed tsho bskyur mi nus/ zhes dam bca' bzhag yod/phul tu byung ba'i rtsom rig mang shas ni de'i mtshon thabs las gzhan da dung grub byed kyi rgyu gtso bo gnyis yod de/ gcig ni rang gi rig gnas kyi rgyud 'dzin dang / cig shos ni thun min gyi khor yug gi shugs rkyen yin/ a le'i brtsams sgrung du/ rgyu gtso bo 'di gnyis kyis nam yang bsam pa'i gzhal yas khang bskrun yod/ 'di'ang grangs nyung mi rigs kyi rtsom pa po gang mang zhig la 159

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/mes po nas brgyud pa'i gces nor thob pa yin zhing / mi rnams kyis rgyun du smon pa 'chor sa'i bod rigs rtsom pa por rang la gtogs pa'i khor yug cig dang gsar rtsom gyi rtsab gting du zug pa yod de red/ rang gi mesaposabaskrun pa'i brjid chags pa'i rig gnas kyi gzhal yas khang gi mdun du/ khyab chen po'i shul bzhag spungs pa'i po ti re rer reg cing / dam pa gang mang zhig gi 'tshol zhib kyi gom sgra la nyan te/ a le'ang de'i gras kyi gcig yin pa'i cha nas khos gus bkur dang bstod pa cis kyang byed nges yin/ khong gis 'di nas dbang bo'i yul du gyur ba'i rgyu cha rnyed cing / bas mtha' 'di nas/ 'gro ba grangs med pa'i lha'i zhing khams 'di nas/ a le'i snyan ngag gi dung ba 'phyur/ yang gcig bshad na/bod mi rigs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rang byung khor yug dang mi rigs kyi gshis rgyud kyis a le'i brtsams chos khrod kyi rang la yid rton gyi gdeng bstsal ba yin/de bas khong gis 'di ltar brjod phod de/da dung sngon byon gyi dam pa mang pos bskor ba'i ngas skya bas nga'i skor gyi legs bshad cig brisage sar rgyal bo'i mthu rtsal nga las mchedatshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos nga la phul ba'i mgur glu len phug ron khyu gnyig gis nga la 'od snang gi gser skud drangasalha mo'i tshogs kyis nga la bstod pa'i snam bu 'thag 160

a le la rgyus lon byed pa/mi rigs 'di'i brdzid chen po'i lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs brjod de/ a les khong gi brtsams sgrung dang snyan ngag la brten nas tshe srog re re'i shes rab dang rtogs sad mngon du phyung / rnam shes dang phung bo ni mnyam du 'dus pa las da gzod tshe srog gi go don rdzogs pa yin/ me tog sna brgya bzhad pa'i gsar rtsom gyi ra ba na/ a le'i rnam shes nam yang 'phur lding byed/ sbrang ma ji bzhin me tog re re'i ze'u 'bru 'jibs te sbrang rtsi rang gi tshang na bsags pa bzhin/ phung bo'i rnam pa gcig tu zad kyang nges par rnam shes zhugs rung yin dgos/ a le'i〈rnam shes kyi bro gar〉zhes pa ni snyan ngag gi brjod bya'i bro gar zhig yin/ mes po dag phung bo las grol te/ rnam shes kyis phyir dran gyi klong na tshe srog 'khor bar 'khor bar sdug bsngal de 'dra'i chen po med/ tsho ba'i gras kyi rgan po bsod nams dpal ldan gyis bde skyid dang re sgug khyer nas rnam shes kyi brgyud rim du yang bskyar mi lus thob tu bcug a les bod kyi mig lam du tshe srog gi gdod ma'i rnam pa ni bar med du 'khor bar 'khor bas/ mi tshe la sdug bsngal med pa ma yin la/ sdug bsngal 'dod pa'ang ma yin zhing / zhugs sa'i phung bo ni rnam shesakyi gnasagazhir byasate/ rang gi smyug 'og gi rgan po dur du skyel ba'i dus kyi 'char yan dang g.yo skyom ni/ tag tag mi rigs 'dis tshe srog 'grel ba'i gsang tshig ma yin nam/snyan ngag du/ a les las dbang gis bstsal ba'i ming gis mes po'i 161

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/rig gnas la dung ba'i brtse ba brjod yod de/e ma/ gragasargyu med pa'i lcam mo'i tshogasakyisang bskor nas yodamig chu dron mos nga rang brlanangs kho tshori zhal ras gsal bor ma mthongargyu mtshan kho mo tsho'i gdong ni ma yum grangs med kyi zhal ras gcig tu brtsegs yod pasakho mo tsho'i 'dar ba'i ngag dang phyag mdzub ni ra yig gnyis pa'i gshog pa ji bzhin rmi lam bzhin gyi brtse semasakyis/ gna' bo'i mi rigs kyi grung rig gi 'od snang gisa.a le rtogasapa sad du bcug nyin re bzhin deng rabs spyi tshogs kyi tshong zong gis brdzis pa'i bsam blo'i 'tsho ba'i mdun du/ snyan ngag gi brjod bya dang rtogs pas deng rabs mi'i skyo gdung gi stong cha skong ba ma yin nam/ mi rigs 'dir tag tag lha dang snyan ngag gi brjod bya'i 'tsho bas khengs pa'i rkyen gyis/a mas rang gi bus phrug la blta ba nang bzhin brtse ba gting zab cing phyir drin lan 'jal bar mi re bas a le dang rtsom pa po'i sde'i sems pa sgul te/ nam yang 'di la smon lam btabs/a les pha sar bcangs pa'i brtse ba brtsams sgrung du mi sna'i snang brnyan dang gshis ka bzhengs skrun brgyud nas de bas gting zab par mtshon yod/ khong gis 162

a le la rgyus lon byed pa/bzhengs skrun byasapa'i sku drag yin na'ang 'dra/ chab 'bangs yin na'ang chog 'tsho ba'i gnas yul yin na'ang 'dra/ ches mtha'i log mal yin kyang rung / thams cad brtse ba'i pha yul yin/ khos rnam pa 'di brgyud nas rtsom gyi nang rdzong je zab tu btang / khong la da dung ‘‘gzhan gyi sems shugs drag pos rjes su yi rang byed pa'i dus kyi bkod sgrig las rgya yig gis 'bri ba'i bod kyi rtsom pa po zhig tu gyur ba dang / dus rabs kyis bstsal ba'i bsam pa dang lus phung gnyis ka'i khrag rgyun rigs gnyis 'dus kyi’’ thob thang yan gar ba zhig yod pa smos ci dgos/thun mong ma yin pa'i lo rgyus kyi khor yug gi rkyen gyis/ bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus kyis rgya yig gis 'bri ba'i rtsom pa po 'bor chen zhig dang len byas yod/rgan rabs kyi snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring dang / rta mgrin mgon po/ shes rab pa sangs nas deng gi bkra shis zla ba/ ye shes tshe ring / g.yang sgron/ a le bcas yod/ kho tshos skad rigs gzhan zhig la brten nas mes rgyal dang mi rigs la nyams med kyi brtse glu blangs/ mi rigs gnyis kyi rig gnas kyi nying bcud la brten nas deng rabs mi'i 'das ma 'ongs da lta gsum gyi rmi lam sbrel yod/lcam mo dan cug gis gsungs pa nang bzhin/ ‘‘khong tsho bus phrug bzhin du pha mes kyi lhan skyes kyi khrag rgyun dang skye gzugs rgyud 'dzin byas yod na'ang / sbyar byung gi spyi tshogs kyi rang bzhin dang dus rabs kyi tshon rtsis/ rang gshis kyi byang tshad bcas grub yod/’’a le ni khrag rgyun gnyis 'dus kyi cha nas skye ma thag nas rig 163

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/gnas gnyis kyi khrus la sbangs yod/ khor yug gis kho rang la rgya mi rigs kyi bsam blo gtong stangs gtsor byas pa'i khar bod kyi bsam blo gtong stangs kyis kha gsab brgyab ste/ ‘‘skye ldan 'dres sbyor 'gyur rdzas’’ kyi bsam blo gtong stangs gnyis kyi rnam pa chags yod/ 'di ltar bsub mi nus pa'i brtse bas a les bod kyi bsam pa'i zhing khams la 'tshol zhib byed pa'i kha phyogs bstan/ khong gis da gzod ‘‘gnam rgan ma/ nam zhig gi tshe na bdag la ches mdzes pa'i skad cha bstsol lam/’’zhes bshad chog don dngos su khong gis 'di lta bu'i skad chas rang nyid mtshon bzhin yod mod/ bdag gis de bas kyang a le'i dar zhing rgyas bzhin pa'i gsar rtsom gyi me lce las mched pa'i du smug las sngar bas kyang mang pa ni rang mi rigs kyi 'phel rgyas dang 'tsho gnas gsar ba yin na snyam/ mi rigs kyi lo rgyus rig gnas las gnas pa deng rabs 'du shes gsar ba kho na ma yin par de bas kyang mi rigs kyi srol du chags pa'i dpyod shes dang bsam gzhig gi she mong lags/a le'i pha sar bcangs pa'i brtse dung gi mdud pa 'di rtogs tshe da gzod nga tshosagasar rtsom gyi go rim du rang nyid thag gcod pa dang dran pa nyar ba'i rgyud rim la thugs snang mdzad nges/ nga tsho'i khrag rgyun dang brtse ba/ pha skad kyi pha sa na/ gal te khyod rang lkug par ma gyur na mnyam gcig tu grags pa'i skal ba nam yang yod/164
