a le la rgyus lon byed pa/gnyis pa/ sa rdul cis kyang sar 'bab nges/a ler rgyus lon byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan zhig ni nye sngon rig gnas pa'i sdes gdengs 'jog legs shing / rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyis thugs snang mdzad bzhin pa'i 〈sa rdul sar 'bab〉 byung bas yin/ a les rang byung dang bya dngos las 'das pa'i lhing 'jags kyi mdzes myong sems khams kyis/ nga tsho dang rgyang thag ring bor gyur zin pa'i sku drag khyim rgyud cig gi dar rgud kyi lo rgyus bris yod/ sku drag khyim rgyud kyi mjug mtha'i skyo gar chab srid dang / g.yo jus/ brtse dung / mo ba dang lung bstan bcas las har gyis 'phyur ba'i sa rdul bzhin/ lo rgyus dang dus kyi rlung 'tshub kyis lhag med du bcom/ sgrung gtam gyi 'gugs shugs ni mi gshis kyis brtse dung sna tshogs kyi nyams myong las/ tshor ba dngos kyis phyug pa'i skad cha'i zhib 'bris 'char yan dang lkog gyur gyi gangs ljongs kyi rnam par rab rib lhab lhub kyi dar gos shig g.yogs/ gangs ljongs kyi sems khral yang bskyar ring du bsring /rlung ni nam mkha' chu ni rlung la brten/ /sa ni chu la brten nas 'jig rten grol/ /bod mi rigs kyi gna' bo'i 'jig rten chags tshul gyi lha sgrung las/ dang po gnam sa gcig tu 'brel ba'i dus na/ 'jig rten ni mtha' med kyi mun pa'i 165

semasala'i rtsomagyi lam gamyongadapyad phra mo'i bsangagator/klong du 'tshar longs 'byung bar sgug sa chu me rlung nam mkha' bcas kyi 'byung ba lnga phan tshun 'dus pa las/ rlung g.yug nas chu la rlabs byung / gdong gtug dang zhib mor chag pa'i klong na re smon khyer ba'i rdul phran phyogs su khyab ste re re bzhin 'jig rten du thim cing / bskyar du gsar ba re bskyed/ 'di ni mdzes sdug gi lha sgrung zhig ste/ shesarab rnam mang gi tshe srog gis yang dang yang du rgyang ring la mdzes sdug kyang bkra ba'i ma 'ongs pa'i gom sgrar nyan/ a le ni lha sgrung rgyud 'dzin byed mkhan gras kyi gcig yin/ 'jig rten thog mar chags dus kyi rlabs chen dang rtag brtan gyis kho'i bsam pa'i zab sa skad cig la sgul myong ba kho thag yin/ ma red dam/ a le'i smyug kha'i sa rdul gyis sku drag gi rdzong mkhar bde ru ma bcug par/ sger gyi re ba btsan po khyer ba'i sger gyi tshe srog dang / dus rabs zhig gi bsam blo'i yul gyar ba khyer ba ma yin nam/ kho tsho me+ongs pa'i sgo nas dus kyi 'gros dang bstun nas mdun du phyogs zhing / la las mtshan mo'i mun pa brtol bar tshod lta byas/ kho tshos kha dbugs gzhan zhig rngub kyin tsha lam lam gyi re smon phyi rwa phyung / rgyang ring gi nam zhig gi tshe na thon srid pa'i tshor ba myong bzhin ches nye ba'i kha dbugs rngub/ lang long gi sa rdul mthar sar bab ste/ rgya mtshor bab nas wu ru gyur zhing / sa ru bab nas ri bor chags/ a les sa rdul sngon 'gror bgyis nas lha sgrung gi rgyab ljongs kyi mdun du langs te sgrung ring gi yol ba phyes/nga tshos mdo khams byang phyogs kyi grags 'byor rab tu rgyas pa'i sku drag gi khyim 166

a le la rgyus lon byed pa/rgyud cig mthong zhing / mgo bo lcog lcog ldem pa'i mdzes shing ngan nag gi rgya men me tog la gyer ba'i smyo ham gyi ngo gdong re re mthong byung / sku drag tshang gi glen phrug gis spyang grung 'dzoms pa'i mi'i ma 'ongs par ji ltar lung ston pa mthong zhing /da dung skog gyur gyi mun nag khrod kyi rdo 'khyag gi ra ba'i nang gi smra ba bcad pa'i lwa smug can dang / dbang 'bum ye shes/ ar ye/ mthar sna/ sgrol ma/ rta mgrin mgon po/ dme cu sku drag bcas snang brnyan re re rlung gi 'khor lo ji bzhin g.yo skyom dang gsig rdeb las dgung du 'phyur nas slar yang sa ru lhung / chab srid dang drag las/ sha 'khon/ 'chi ba/ nyo 'tshong bcas las grub pa'i sku drag gi dgung du zug pa'i mkhar rdzong / a le'i shugs drag pa'i tshor 'du'i mdzub ston 'og nas brtsegs rim re re dod du phyung ste me+ongs la gsal ba'i lo rgyus kyi kha phyogs mngon/zang zing gi dus 'gyur gyi gar stegs su a lesamo‘nga ’’ste/ sku drag gi bu glen pas rgyun ldan ma yin pa'i khyim gyi ‘‘glen phrug’’ gis stobs chen po'i rgyal kha 'thob mkhan la brtag dpyad btang / go min srid gzhung gi mi sna dang sku drag gzhan rnams kyi bar nas/ sku drag tshang gi glen phrug gis sngon gyi blo gros mtshams med du btsal cing / gzhan gyis ma tshor ba'i yul grol nas rim gyis gting zab pa'i bar gseng re re btsal/ dngangs skrag gi khrod du rang gi gnas bab thag bcad cing / thag bcad pa las ma 'ongs pa tshor rtogs byung / glen phrug gi steng nas nga tshos sku drag lam lugs kyi dar rgud kyi lo rgyus mthong thub par ma zad/ de bas 167

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i mi sger gyi tshe srog cig mthong / lam lugs 'di rgud pa'i ched du ji 'dra'i mang bo zhig gtong dgos sam/ rdul dang 'dra ba'ang yin te/ steng du dpyangs pa min tshe sar 'bab pa yin/ mjug mthar da dung dus kyi thod brgal gyis dum bur gtong nges/ gyang chag steng lding skor byas nas mthar yang bskyar rdo ba'i 'jim bzo'i nang du lhung ste/ khu sim gyi nyi 'od gyang chag steng lam lam 'tsher/bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs kyis 'grel lugs la/ rdul phran phan tshun bar gyi 'dren shugs las mthar dngos po grub par bzhed cing / bsam blo gtong stangs yan gar ba gtsor bzung nas tshe srog gi 'tsho gnas mngon pa'i brtsams sgrung gi sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa'i ngos nas bshad na/ 'jig rten du skyom pa'i rdul phran ji bzhin dus kyi 'phel 'gros las mi dang rang byung khams/ mi dang sems pa/ mi dang tshe srog mnyam 'dus sam sor gyes kyi gtam rgyud bskrun/ a le ni tshor ba rno ba'i deng rabs kyi rtsom pa po zhig yin pa'i cha nas nam yang 'dris cha ldan pa'i yan gar ba'i rig gnas dang yan gar ba'i khor yug gsar ba gcal tu bkram rgyu gtsor mdzad/ sku drag lam lugs ni ma gzhi nas‘‘nang 'dren gyi rigs dbye’’ zhig yin/ de ni dbang sgyur gral rim gyis rang gi go gnas sra brtan gtong ched du dpon rgyud dpon 'jog gis mnga' khongs bdag tu bzung ste gnas gcig dum bur bgos te dbang sgyur ba'i lam lugs shig yin/ dus kyi 168

a le la rgyus lon byed pa/'phel 'gros las mdo khams nub byang gi phyogs su sha rus dang gdung rgyud 'dus pa'i phyogs mang por bod rgya mi rigs gnyis kas shugs rkyen gting zab po thebs/ tag tag a les〈sa rdul sar 'bab〉tu/ sa babs kyis nga tsho'i chab srid kyi 'brel ba thag bcad/ ces dang / sku drag rnams shar phyogs kyi gong ma dang rgyun chad med pa'i 'brel ba 'dzin par gna' nas thag bcad yod/ ces bshad pa nang bzhin/ gnas de na 'brel 'dris khor yug rgya bskyed pa des rgya yul gyi rig gnas mang po zhig gegs med du dang len byed kyin yod pas/ ched mngags hang khru'u min gyis sbyogs mdel mtshon cha khyer 'ongs pa'i zhor du ngan nag gi nyal tha'ang khyer yong / sku drag rnams kyis skor dang skor byas te rgya men btab ste me tog khra chil ler bzhad pa nas/ mkhar rdzong du khrag bzhur ba'i skyo gar re re bzhin byung mgo tshugs/ 'di ni lo rgyus kyi skyo gar te/ sku drag rnams la lha'i mgon skyabs dang lhan skyes kyi tshor ba rnon po yod na'ang / 'dod ham bdud kyi zhags pa skog tu rang sker bskon pa'i kha gsab ma nus/ kho tshor ris rgyud kyi dbye ba yod na'ang / thob thang la mtho dma' yod na'ang / thams cad sku drag gi dbang chas gang 'dod du bsgyur chog 'dis kyang lam lugs 'di cis kyang 'jig nges pa bstan yod/ de ni a le'i sgrung 'bring 〈nags tshal dang 'brel ba yod pa'i sha 'khon slog pa'i gtam rgyud ches gsar ba〉 zhes pa'i nang gi khang rnying ji bzhin/ nyal tha dang sha 'khon bsdum pa'i rgyab tu/ khang rnying rdul gyi rdo skas 169

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/su phyin te mthar sku drag dang g.yog po rnams dang mnyam du me chen po'i klong na 'gyel/ rgyu 'byor dbang thang ci yod sa rdul du gyur/ lam lugs shig zhig pa na dus rabs gsar ba zhig mgo brtsams byung / mi la la sku drag dang mnyam du dur 'jug gi dngos rdzas su gyur te lo rgyus kyi sa dong du rul/ mi mang po zhig gis slar yang lo rgyus la phyi mig gis rtog pa dgos/ nga rang gis sgrung mjug gi yang du bskyar du zhib 'bri mdzad pa'i rlung 'tshub kyi rjes nas mthar sa ru babs pa'i sa rdul brjed mi nus/ gal te sa rdul sar 'bab kyis tshe srog gi dus byas dang dbang sgyur lam lugs shig gi mjug gril ba mtshon na/ sku drag tshang gi glen phrug gis‘‘kho skye sa dang 'tshar longs byung sa'i gnas de/ nyi 'od kyi 'og tu rang steng gi grib ma dma' sar gnas/ nyin gung mtshams su/ ga sa gang su thug srid pa'i thol gyis langs pa'i rlung 'tshub kyis sa rdul dang sdong lo skam po bar snang du khyer nas bro gar rtsen’’pa mthong ba'i skad cig tu/ 'das zin par phyir ltos kyi klong na rnam shes gsar ba bskyed/‘‘mi mthong ba'i dngos po gnam du zug mthong ba ni sa rdul te/ slar yang sa ru babs/’’ nga tshos 'bru rigs btab chog cing rgya men yang 'debs rung ba'i sa zhing gshin po'i steng du/ sa zhing la brten nas 'tsho ba'i mi rnams ni ji 'dra'i rmongs sla ba la ang zhes shugs ring 'byin pa las gzhan ci/a les 〈sa rdul sar 'bab〉 tu pha yul 'di ltar zhib 'bri byas yod de/gnas de'i ri bo ljang zhing chu mo dwangs/ sngon pos bzi bar byed pa'i a sngon 170

a le la rgyus lon byed pa/dbyings/ kha ba'i rjes su ga sar 'phur lding byed pa'i 'jol mo/ mu mtha' bral ba'i 'bru zhing / yod tshad khong gi ya chung la gtan du nyar ba'i dung ba dang rmi lam gyi kha phyogs yin/ gnas 'di'i nas chang dang lha ba/ lha sgrung ni phyi mi dag gis mig zung gtod yul du byed na'ang / don gyis de dag gis sems su mngar ba dang cha 'dra ba zhig las ci yang bskyed mi nus/ 〈sa rdul sar 'bab〉 ni ‘‘lo rgyus kyi meng gzhi'i skya thig tu spobs pa chen pos spyi tshogs shig deng rabs can tu bgrod pa'i 'os mthun gyi lha sgrung zhig’’ces pa las rtsom pa pos pha yul dang rang yul gyi rig gnas la rtog gzhig btang ba'i rgyud rim red ce na 'os/ a les lhod la babs pa'i mdzes dpyod sems khams kyis tsha tsha 'ur 'ur gyi zang zing rim gyis snying 'jags su gyur bar bltas te/ sger gyi tshe srog gi zhib tshags kyi nyams myong dang mi rigs spyi'i 'tsho gnas snying stobs mngon par mtshon nas nga tshor sgyu rtsal gyi 'phel stobs dang bsam pa'i 'char sgo yangs po'i bar snang zhig byin/nga tshos da dung a les〈sa rdul sar 'bab〉kyi mgo mjug bar gsum du lo rgyus la rtog zhib dang dngos yod khor yug la zhib 'bri tshags dam por mdzad de khong gi sngon du bris pa'i sgrung gtam dag las brgal/ khong gi smyug kha'i mi rigs gnyis kyi khrag rgyun 'dus pa'i mi sna gtso bor a ri'i nub phyogs kyi rtsom pa po we ar lan h+phu khri na'i 〈'a 'ur dang g.yo skyom〉 gyi grib ma phog yod mod kyang / des yongs su zin med/ a les phyogs gnyis nas brjod yul bzhengs 171

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/skrun byas te/ rang gi rig gnas dang rus rgyud lo rgyus la 'brel ba'i we ar lan h+phu khi nar phyogs pa dang mnyam du ltos bcas kyis rnying zhen can gyi rang byung ngam lo rgyus kyis gsos pa'i thun min gyi mi rigs kyi 'tsho ba rol stangs la ngos 'dzin dang tshor rtogs byung / gal te rang yul la bcangs pa'i dung ba med tshe/dung bas bskyed pa'i skyo gdung gi dran pa yod mi srid/ de lta na a le'i gsar rtsom gyi rmang rdo zhig lo zla ring mor sne mang 'dzings pa'i don rkyen re re rang gi rig gnas dang phyi nas 'ongs pa'i rig gnas kyi gdong gtugs las zad/ brtsams sgrung nang gi sne 'dzings pa'i byung rim phyir phyung na/ shul du lhag pa ni gting tu snyigs pa'i bsub tu med pa'i mi rigs kyi 'tsho ba rol stangs dang 'tsho gnas kyi 'du shes yin/ de ni sngon thon dang rjes lus gang yin kyang hril gyis bcad nas gleng mi rung ste/ gting zab pa'i spyi tshogaso lo rgyus kyi rin thang gi rgya khar thug yod/sku drag rnams yang dang yang du 'phrag rtsad dang yang dang bskyar du mna' bcad bsgrigs/ gtan 'jags ma yin pa'i chab srid kyi 'brel ba las mi rabs nas mi rabs brgyud pa'i mna' tshig gis btags yod/ bzo bcos med par pha mes yang mes nas brgyud pa'i goms srol dang chos lugs kyi 'du shes la dad/ de bas/ khrag dang du sprug yal rjes sngar bzhin mdzes sdug gi brtse dung nyar yod la/sngar bzhin chang gzhas kyi 'gyur khugs skyom/ glen phrug gi bsam blo gtong stangs kyis dpyod shes kyi btsan mkhar brtsigs la blang dor cha mi 'tshal ba'i 172

a le la shrī/sa lon byed pa/shugs bstan dang gsang tshig gis khengs yod/ 'di yang a les mi sna bzhengs skrun gyi steng du phyir rtog gi cha mang du bskyur yod/ 'di ni kho mos 〈sa rdul sar 'bab〉 bklags rjes su mig mdun du lhags pa'i skya ris gnyis te/ lo rgyus kyi bkod pa dang mi rigs sems khams kyi bkod pa gnyis so/ /sa rdul gyis bslas pa'i lo rgyus kyi bkod pa ni/ sku drag gdung rgyud cig gi dar ba dang rgud pas dus rabs shig la rdzogs tshig bkod cing / lo rgyus kyi shul nor te nyal tha/ khrims gcod pa dang 'thab 'khrug bcas yod tshad bdag po dang mnyam gcig tu mi rnams kyi mthong lam las yal/ srol rgyun dang gsar brje/rnying ba dang gsar byung / rgyud 'dzin dang mthar spyugs kyi steng na lo rgyus kyis mang nyung ma nges pa'i sgo nas rnal ma'i rang bzhin dang gzhan 'gog gi rang bzhin srung yod/ dngul gyi 'dod pa 'gog thabs ma byung ba'i rkyen gyis sku drag gis rgya men btabs kyang / sngar bzhin bsam pa'i skyabs la 'gyur ba ji yang byung med/ chos spel mkhan dpon po ye shes kyi ‘‘klad par smyo ham gyi dran pas khengs nas’’‘‘kha lce la brten nas nga tshos yun ring bsten pa'i chos lugs la dgag ste/’’ju dga' sprul sku dang brtsad nas rgyal myong na'ang zhal lce bcad/ da dung rgyang ring gi dbyin ji nas 'ongs pa'i dbyin ji mi'i lcam mor gyur ba'i gcen mo dang /glen phrug gis kyang mang po bsres pa'i dri mang po zhig snom/ mjug tu'ang glen phrug gis 'bru rigs la brten nas mang tshogs kyi dga' bsu thob pa las rgya men 173

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam gamyong dpyad phra mo'i bsangagator/btabs pa'i phu bos ni ma yong / 'di lta bu'i shugs drag po'i rang sa gnas kyi 'du shes dang sems kyi myong bas glen phrug gis ches mtha'i skad cig la 'di ltar shugs ring phyung yod de/ ‘‘gnam rgan ma/ gal te tshe srog 'khor bar 'khor ba bden na/ skye ba phyi mar nga slar yang gnas 'dir skyes par gyis/ nga mdzes sdug ldan pa'i gnas 'di la dga'/’’ zhes pa ltar/ 'di ni a le'i sems pa'ang yin/rnam shes sha khrag gi phung bo las brgal nas 'gro ba'i tshe na dung ba'i lhug brjod 'di ni ji 'dra'i brjid pa la ang / a les 'di lta bu'i snang brnyan la brten nas phyi yong rig gnas kyi zhabs rjes bsub pa ma yin la/ rang yul kho na lte dbus su bzung ba'ang ma yin par/ rang yul gyi rig gnas la dga' ba'i dung ba brjod pa'i rjes nas dpyod shes kyis rig gnas de'i mdun lam la phyogs/ khong gi sgrung gtam gzhan dag gi nang na'ang dus rabs la mdzad pa'i thugs snang dang dga' zhen mngon yod mod/ ngas de bas kyang rtsom pa po'i sems su bzhur ba ni tshe srog gi rten byed pa'i dga' ba zhig dang mjal skor bas dka' sdug gi lam thag brgyud nas thob pa'i 'bras bu yin na 'dod/dan ṇa'i 〈dbyin ji'i rtsom rig lo rgyus〉 kyi mgo brjod du/ gal te rtsom rig brtsams chos shig gi nang don phun sum tshogs shing / mi rnams kyis de ji ltar bkral bar ha go na/ nga tshor gzhi nas brtsams chos de las 'thob pa ni mi'i sems khams shig yin la/ nam rgyun dus rabs shig gi sems khams kyang yin/174

a le la rgyus lon byed pa/mtshams mtshams su de bas kyang rigs rgyud cig gi sems khams yin/ zhes pa ltar/ rigs rgyud dang khor yug dus rabs bcas rgyu rkyen gsum po las dan ṇas sems khams gtsor bzung yod pa 'di las/ mi rigs shig la gzhi nas yod pa'i gzhi rtsa'i khyad chos sngar bzhin kho tsho'i chab srid sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom dang mi chos kun spyod du hril gyis mngon pa mthong thub/ gal te bod mi rigs rang gi 'du shes kyis zin pa dang dbang du gyur med tshe/ gzhan mi rigs kyi rig gnas kyi zhib bsdur las rang nyid ngos 'dzin yang dag cig byed mi nus/ de lta na/ mi rigs kyi nga rgyal dang snying nye ba'i bsam blo rgyud la skye mi thub/ mi rigs rang dang mi rigs rang gi rig gnas kyi 'tsho gnas rin thang rtogs na nga tsho'i rtsom pa po'i bsam blor zungs khrag rgyas te gson shugs kyi dpal 'bar zhing / gzhan dang thun min gyi rtsom gshis kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng nges/bod mi rigs kyi rlabs chen po'i srol rgyun rig gnas las gzhung lugs kyi brdar sha'i dag thon pa dang / yongs su zin pa'i mi rigs rang gshis kyi thun min gyi 'gyur khugs kyis gzhan mi rigs bkugs shing / sus de yi 'od snang mthong na sus de la mchod pa 'bul la/ de'i 'od kyis kyang de nyid skyong / 'di ni a le dang bod rigs rtsom pa po mang po zhig la rgyal kha 'thob pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo yin/ 〈sa rdul sar 'bab〉 kyis rtsom rig gsung rtsom gyi sngon bsus pa'am tshong zong gi bsham dngos gang yin kyang rung / des klog pa por sems 'gul thebs 175

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsangagator/pa dang bsam blo gtong du bcug gang ltar a les bkod pa gzhan zhig gi yul ljongs kyi 'char snang dang rmi lam klog pa po'i spyar sngar drangs/ gsar shas che zhing gnad du thing ba'i skad chas klog pa po zab cing 'jig rten las 'das pa'i nyams myong gi zhing du khrid/ sku drag tshang gi mkhar rdzong dang khrims gcod pa'i sman/smon pa bla ma'i dmod bor lugs/ sha 'khon slog mkhan gyi ral gri dar dkar gyi 'od dang ldan pa'i mthar sna/ nyin rgyun na nas nyal sar lus shing tshor ba rno ba'i sku drag gi chen ma/ lus yongs su dri zhim khyab pa'i chun ma/ 'bag gyon nas gar 'khrab par dga' ba'i sku sras che ba/ re re bzhin gson shugs kyis brtas pa'i mi sna'i snang brnyan dag tshe srog gi shugs drag po'i tshor ba'i zur mchan bkod pa la brten nas klog pa por bsam blo gtong stangs gzhan zhig gi shes rab cig mngon zhing / 'tsho ba rol stangs gzhan zhig yul dus kyi bskal ba las klog pa pos reg mi chog cing thag ring nas rgyang lta byas pas mtshar snang bskyed/ 'di yang a les yid zhib mos 'thag pa'i lag skyes gzhan zhig yin zhing / mes po nas kho rang brgyud de klog po'i spyan lam du drangs pa yin/a le'i thog ma'i dus kyi rtsom nas de ring gi 〈sa rdul sar 'bab〉 kyi bar du khong la 'gyur ba mi nyung ba zhig byung ba mthong thub/ thog ma'i dus kyi nyal 'bu deng gi bye leb tu gyur/ 'o na/ ma 'ongs par ci zhig tu 'gyur ram/ gling mol gtsang 'gram du/ nor bu gling gi gzhi bdag gis mgon skyabs gnangs na/176

a le la zla/sa lon byed pa/ma 'ongs par thang dkar rgod du 'gyur nges/ mtsho ngos las tshad mtho ba'i sa nas rang gnas su rgyang lta byas na/ rgyang zhar yod mi srid/ 'di ni rtsom pa pos re smon gzhan zhig gi mgo brtsams pa'ang yin/bris nas mtshams 'dir slebs dus spyir mjug bsdu dgos kyang / rab rib kyi sems ngogs su da dung ci zhig brjod rgyu yod pa 'dra/ de ni‘‘zungs gnyom pa'i nyi ma'i me tog’’ dran zhing / gzham gyi brjod pa dag ni de la brten nas byung ba yin/a le dang sha rus gdung rgyud mthun pa'i cha nas/ kho mo dga' ba ni khong gis mi rigs gzhan zhig gi skad dang yi ge la brten nas rang gi brjod don rjen par bstan pa kho na ma yin par/ a le'i gsar rtsom gyi mig mda' khod yangs pos gzhan yul gyi rtsom rig la gtad par ma zad/ rig gnas de'i nang rdzong gzhib nas‘‘skye ldan 'dres sbyor 'gyur rdzas’’kyi bsam blo gtong stangs yan gar ba zhig gis/ rang mi rigs nang sems kyi dung ba dang mnyam 'dres dang ltos zlar langs pa de yin/ 'di ni a les sgrung gtam gyi mdzes dpyod la bsnyegs pa yin zhing rang 'gul gyis rig gnas nang 'dren byas pa'ang yin/ 'on kyang / ngas sngon na bshad pa nang bzhin thun mong ma yin pa'i lo rgyus rig gnas kyi rgyab ljongs su 'tshar longs byung ba'i a le dang / rgya yig gis rtsom 'bri ba'i rtsom pa po skor zhig srol rgyun dang deng rabs/ bod kyi rig gnas dang rgya'i rig gnas/177

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/da dung 'tsho gnas kyi rang byung sa bab khor yug gis kho tsho rgya bod rig gnas gnyis kyi 'dres mtshams nas/ yang gcig bshad na rig gnas bas mthar gnas pa'i bas mtha'i mir 'bod pa der gyur zhing / kho tshos mang nyung la ma ltos par rig gnas gzhan la thugs snang mdzad nas rang nyid bor ba'i rang skad mi shes pa'i dogs mi bde ba'i gnas su lhung / ngas shes bzhin ma yin par a les rang gi pha skad dang pha yig gis rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas la zhal la zhal gtad kyis thad lta dang gleng mol rjen par byed thub min la bsam blo btang / mi rigs kyi dran pa rang gi gsar rtsom gyi rtsa bar 'dzin pa'i rtsom pa po zhig gis 'di mi nus tshe/ chad lhag red ces brjod dka' yang ma mtha' yang ha cang yid phangs pa zhig red/ rgyu mtshan 'dis thad ka thad kar du gzhan gyis ma brgyan pa'i rig gnas shig gzhib mi nus/ bzhos ma thag pa'i 'o mar rul 'gog gi rdzas bsres te 'khyags par byas rjes btsong ba'i 'o ma de thog ma'i 'o ma dang khyad par yod pa nga tshos shes gsal ltar/ rtsom pa po zhig gi mi rigs kyi dran par gtogs pa'i yi ge'ang nam yang gzhan gyi nus pa brgyud mi dgos par/ pha rol bor 'grel brjod kyi tshig mdzod dang lag brda ston mi dgos par brda 'phrod pa ste/ nga tsho'i tshe srog gis ma gzhir btang snyoms su mi rung ba'i 'gan 'di nges par theg dgos/tha'o ma si man gyis rgyun du rang gi brtsams chos ni 'gyur rtsom zhig ste/178

a le la rgyus lon byed pa/grib ma bzhin du gnas te/ rang gi rigs kyi mis thig phreng gcig kyang bklags ma myong bar shugs ring phyung zhing / 'di ni kho rang ches skrag pa'i rmi lam ngan pa yin/ rang gis thugs snang mdzad pa'i mis brjed par skrag nas khos da gzod 'di ltar rang la le 'khon byas pa yin zhing / 'di ni brda zhig yin pa 'dra/ me tog nyi ma dga' ni mdzes sdug ldan pa zhig yin/ 'on kyang zungs gnyom pa'i me tog nyi ma dga' ni ci ltar bshad kyang zungs gnyom pa yin/ a les de brang la mi sbyar bar smon/a les khong gi da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i gsar rtsom gyi zhing du/ nam yang bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas kyi ljon pa chen po 'dir rgyab brten nges/ nga tshos mes pos shul du bzhag pa'i ches gna' bo'i srol gyis lus ngag yid gsum gyis smon lam 'debs/ tshe 'dir brje thabs med pa'i lus kyis legs sbyar gyis rab gnas mdzad pa'i pha skad la skye stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba'i smon lam snying nas 'debs/ rnam shes dang bsam pa kho na 'phos tshe tshe srog gi rdul nges par du sa ru 'bab/(mchog ldan tshe ring gis bsgyur/)179

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsangagator/lam ni 'tshol zhib pa'i rdog sner 'then yod/da wa tshe ring don grub dang khong gi brtsams sgrung /tshe ring don grub ni khong gi brtsams sgrung dang mnyam du deng rabs gzhon skyes rtsom pa po'i sder zhugs pa yin/ nga tshos phal chen po'i rtsom pa po'i sde las〈lam〉 nas 〈shi gson〉 gyi gshib bsdur bar du/ khong gi thun min gyi sger chos dkyus gcig tu mthong ba ni/ rtsa ba kho rang nyid 'tsho sa'i rtswa thang la zug yod de/ rtswa thang gi rang sa rang yul gyi kha dbugs stug po las kun la khyab pa'i spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul khod du phyung nas/ des yongs su sim pa'i mi sna dag skyes sa'i khor yug dang / chos lugs dad mos/ srol rgyun phyag len gyi sum snar 'tsho ba'i 'tsho ba dang / mi tshe/ las dbang bcas mngon par mtshon gyin yod/ da cha bod yig gsar rtsom gyi rlabs zhi 'jags su gnas pa'i skabs 'dir/ tshe ring don grub kyis 'di ltar mdung rtse thad gtod kyis nyams zhib bgyis te/ mi tshe'i rang nyid phyir phyung ba la brten nas sems kyi dra rgya ga ge mo zhig gtor ba'i snying stobs dang bsam gzhigs bsnyeg pa ni klog pa po spyi dang lhag par gzhon rabs 180

lam ni 'tshol zhib pa'i rdog sner 'then yod/klog pa po 'do/gas pa'i /klo gal chen zhig lags/rtsom rig ni mi'i rig pa yin pa'i cha nas mi gshis kyi rnyog 'dzing rang bzhin dang ngo mang rang bzhin sngog 'don bya rgyu ni rtsom pa'i las la 'jug mkhan zhig ma 'grim thu med kyi lam yin la/ lhag par bod kyi deng rabs sgrung gtam gsar rtsom la mtshon nas bshad na/ bod yul gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rang byung khor yug dang / mi lo stong phrag brgyud pa'i chos lugs dad mos bcas kyis/ mis rang ngo zin pa la da dung chos lugs dung bas sne bsham dgos pa'i gnas tshul 'og mi gshis kyi cha so sor byas nas phyi ru bkram rgyu ni de bas kyang rtsom pa po'i ma skul dang len gyi las su gnas/ tshe ring don grub kyi brtsams sgrung gi zhing khams nam yang zhol gyi skyo gar gyi kha dbugs khrod du gnas te/ yid kyi dad mos rnam dag gis stong ba'i gzugs phung zhig phyogs bzhir 'khyams/ mi tshe'i skyo gdung dang gu thug ni kho tsho rang gis rang la bsam bzhin bgyis pa'i zhags pa bzhin nam char yang rang gi sker bskon par gra sgrig byed cing sngar bzhin mun pas khebs/ kho tshos bzod bsran dang brtson 'grus la brten nas kun slong brtan po'i dad pas tshe gang gi smon lam rgyag dus/ ci byed 'di byed mi shes pa'i skyo gdung las shul du lhag mi 'dug kyang / kho tsho ji 'dra'i bde ba la ang yod tshad de 'dra'i dga' snang gis dang du blangs byung / tshe ring don grub kyis mi sna 'di dag re re bzhin khod du phyung nas/ sprid pa dang rtogs sad/ mchog gyur dang tha 181

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/shal/ 'jon nus dang brdzus ma cha bsgrigs te klog pa po'i mthong lam gyis chod pa'i tshun du gna' bo'i rol rtsed rigs 'di bstar/ kho rang 'du 'dzir phyogs pa'i mgron po zhig ma yin par lam sne bsham mkhan zhig gi tshul bzung ste/ klog pa po'i sde gtam rgyud bsgrigs sa'i ches thag nye la rgyus med pa/ spro sems 'khol la brtse ba dman pa/ ngo mtshar la phal ba'i mdo dbus mtho sgang shar rgyud kyi rtswa thang la khrid de/ tshe ring dang ra lo/ dpal rin po che/ rta mgrin rdo rje sogs la blta ru khrid/ 'di ni tag tag tshe ring don grub kyi thabs yin yang srid pas/nga tsho 'di lta bu'i lam la ma zhugs na mi 'gri+ogadang pa/tshe ring don grub kyis lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i stod nas bzung sgrung gtam rtsom 'go brtsams/ ṭ+wāṃbakra shis kyi gnyen sgrig〉ces pas thog ma'i rgyal kha'i dar cha bsgrengs te/ 1982nas1983lo'i ang gnyis pa'i phul byung rtags ma blangs/1984lor/ khong gi rtsom 〈na chung gzhon nu'i rang sgrar 〉 ang dang po'i sbrang char gsar rtsom gyi rtags ma thob/ lo bcu'i rjes kyi de ring / brtsams chos 'di dag la phyir ltos byed dus kho rang ches yid mi tshim pa ni ches thog ma'i bya dga' thob pa'i rtsom de red zer/ lo bcu ni mig rdeb yun tsam gyi dus las ring bo min mod rtsom rig gi gshin sar thog mar sa bon gtor mkhan gyi gzhon skyes rtsom pa po 182

lam ni 'tshol zhib pa'i rdog sner 'then yod/zhig gi ngos nas bshad na/ (bod kyi rtsom pa po phal che ba ni zhor du rtsom 'bri mkhan yin/) de ni ha cang ring zhing dka' tshegs kyis khengs pa zhig red/ tshe ring don grub kyis khyad du 'phags pa'i shes rab dang rtogs sad kyi bsam blo la brten nas rang nyid 'jal bar spobs la 'tsho bar yang dag pa'i mig gis lta bar nus/ rang gis rang dgag pa'i thabs lam la brten nas rang las 'das pa thob/ stobs shugs 'dis khong gi brtsams chos kyi mgo mjug bar gsum du khyab yod/ khong gis rang nyid kyi ched du goms pa'i rang gshis la brten nas rig gnas so so'i dag ther dang du blangs/ phyi rgyal rtsom rig dang deng rabs rtsom rig 'bor chen dang mjal nas rang gi mig rgya bskyed de rang gi brtsams sgrung gi zhing khams su gtam rgyud 'bri ba'i dus rabs las brgal te/ gting zab pa'i mi sna'i sems khams khor yug zhib 'bri byed pa'i phyogs su phyogs/ nga tshos 〈lam 〉zhes pa'i nang gi bkra shis dang dbang mo nas/ ṭ+wāṃn chung gzhon nu'i rang sgra'i 〉 khrod kyi tshe ring las 'di lta bu'i gsar rtsom gyi 'phel kha rtogs thub/〈lam 〉zhes par mi sna bdag gi slob grogs bkra shis dang dbang mo gcen sring gnyis kyis cha mi mthun pa'i rang rang gi mi tshe'i bgrod lam bdams pa'i gtam rgyud brjod yod/ da cha'i mig gis phyir lta byed pa'i tshe na rtsom 'di sngar bzhin gtam rgyud 'bri ba'i dus las brgal mi 'dug mi sna'i snang brnyan gyi bzhengs skrun dang lhag par mi sna'i gshis ka'i zhib 'bri sngar bzhin phyi rnam pa'i 183

semasapa'i rtsomogyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsangagator/steng du lus 'dug rtsom du bkra shis ni brtson 'grus che zhing slob 'dod can gyi bsam blo ring lugs pa zhig nas phyogs phyogs su chang kho na btsal nas nam gung dkyil du nyog bshad mtshams mi chad pa'i 'khyams po zhig tu gyur/ de'i phyi rkyen ni lo bcu'i dus zing gi dus su khu tshur la brten nas go sa thob pa'i rdzong ga ge mo'i rdzong dpon mgon po'i dbang cha dang shes yon skor gyi 'chad khrid cig la nyan pa nas bsam blo mar 'grib pa byung ba yin/ mi sna'i ltag rgyab tu skung ba'i tsha lam lam gyi sems pa'i 'gul skyod de de lta bu'i mi'i gnyug ma'i 'dod pa dang dpyod shes kyi 'gal 'du 'bri ba'i tshad du tshe ring don grub da dung slebs mi 'dug cing / kho rang la mtshon na de ni tha na rgyus med kyi gegag gnas shig kyang yin/ de bas/ brtsams sgrung khrod kyi ngas ‘‘yon tan sbyang 'dod kyis khengs pa'i dbang mo'i mig zung’’ las brgyud cing sbrel mi thub pa'i khyad par gyi tshor rtogs zab mo zhig las ci yang byed mi nus/ 〈lam 〉〉 zhes pa byung ba ni mgo brtsams ma thag pa'i skabs de'i bod kyi rtsom rig la mtshon nas bshad na/ tshe ring don grub kyi dngos yod 'tsho bar yang dag pa'i mig zung gis blta phod pa/ 'tsho ba'i khrod du dngos su gnas kyang gnas lugs dang mi mthun pa'i snang tshul mtshon par phod pa'i spobs pa mngon mgo tshugs/ khu tshur la brten pa'i rdzong dpon de'i mi tshe'i mtshan nyid kyi gsang tshig gi 'gyur yig las/ mi 'di'i rigs ni sgyu dang bab bstun la mkhas pas 'tsho ba'i rgyal kha reg pa yin zhing / de ni sa gnas dang khor 184

lam ni 'tshol zhib pa'i rdog sner 'then yod/yug nges can zhig gis bskyed pa'i dug rlangs las gzhan ci yang min/ nam zhar yang dbang cha dang yon tan ni dpon g.yog gi 'brel bar chags mi rung / 'di ni rtsom pa po 'tsho ba dngos su ji bzhin brgyud pa'i nyams myong red/ spyir rtsom spyi'i bkod pa nar ma son par mi sna'i snang brnyan dkar nag gcig gcod kyi sgyu rtsalo gyi ra bar gnas mod kyang / nga tshos rtsom pa po'i ngal ba 'bras med kyi tshul mthang ba dka'/tshe ring don grub kyi sgrung gtam gyi rang gshis ni khong gi 〈mjal skor gyi lam bu'i 〉 steng gi ngal dub dang sprug gsig brgyud nas rim gyis rtogs pa sad pa'i nang sems kyi rang ngos 'dzin pa zhig yin/ sgrung gtam 〈na chung gzhon nu'i rang sgra'i 〉 nang gi mi sna gtso bo tshe ring ni 'di lta bu'i rgyab ljongs zhig nas byung yod de/ kha ba chen po babs pa'i rjes la rtswa thang gi phyogs bzhi dkar mdog gi kha bas g.yogs/ nyin gung gi nyi zer sprin pa srab mo'i phang brtol nas dkar mdog gi sa gzhir mig gis mi bzod par 'phros/ lhing 'jags kyi khor yug tu grib ma nag po zhig rgyang nas gam du bcar/ 'di ni slob grwa stor ba'i byis pa zhig ste/ rang gis slas pa'i rtsid pa'i mig shel zhig gyon nas bor zin pa'i lug khyu 'tshol du 'ongs pa yin la yid chad pa'i rmi lam 'tshol du 'ongs pa'ang yin/sgrung gtam gyis ches lhing 'jags dang ljid tig gi rgyab ljongs nas mi sna gtso bo tshe ring klog pa po'i spyan lam du drangs/ lo gcig sngon gyi tshe ring ni brtson 'grus 185

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/can gyi slob 'bring gi slob ma zhig yin la/ gung gzhon tshogs pa'i tshogs mi dang slob grwa'i rkang rtsal spo lo ru khag gi gtso gras kyang yin/ kho'i sems kyi re smon nyag cig ni khyim gyi gyang ngos su rang gi ming bkod yod pa'i bya dga'i rtags ma dang kho dad pa'i tshan rig pa'i sku 'dras yongs su khengs par byed rgyu de yin mod/kho rang dbyar gnang gi skabs su phyir pha yul la log dus rang nyid la dbang ba'i khor yug yongs su bcom tshar yod de/ brjid chags dang gsang bas phyug pa'i thang sku gang mang gis sngon gyi gyang ngos kyi 'dra ris dang bya dga'i tshab byas 'dug 'di ni tshe ring gi rang nyid kyi 'dun ma thengs dang por rang khyim gyi stegs bu'i steng sa la 'gyel ba yin/ khos ngo rgol ji ltar byas na'ang mjug 'bras gum pa las gzhan mi 'dug smra bsam brjod 'das kyi sdug bsngal yang dus kyi 'phang 'gros kyi bab kha dang bstun nas bag la zha zhing / mjal bskor gyi lam bar du byung ba'i don dag re res tshe ring gi kheng log gi bsam pa sad du bcug tshe ring dang khong gi pha ma ming sring tshos khyim gyi rgyu nor yod tshad dang tha na tshe srog kyang dgun gyi bu yug gi khrod du grang ngar phyogs bzhi nas lding ba'i rlangs 'khor chen po zhig gi klad la 'tshang / grang ngar khyad du bsad/ srang lam mal du byas byas pa'i mthar deng rabs grong khyer gyi tshul 'dzin pa'i sa na mi rnams kyis ngo mtshar dang / zur za/ tha na mthong chung gi mig mda'i 'og tu tshe ring glo bur tu rtogs pa sad de/ nga tshos 'di ltar byed pa ci zhig gi ched du yin nam/ bskal ba'i skye 186

lam ni 'tshol zhib pa'i rdog sner 'then yod/'jig gi mna' tshig gi ched du yin nam/ 'dul dka' ba'i bas mtha'i las 'brel gyi ched du yin/ skye ba phyi ma phyi ma'i thar ba'i ched du 'di lta bu'i sdug myong ba yin nam/ gnas skabs su lan ma rnyed kyang gang ltar khong gis bsam gzhigs btang ba yin/ tshe ring gi tshor rtogs de rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi nga ro ma yin pa ci la srid/ 'di ni sgrung gtam gyi ches 'bur du thon sa yin la rtsom pa po'i dung pa'i nyams myong gi kha phyogs bsgyur sa'ang yin/ 'di nas bzung ste tshe ring don grub kyis khong gi sgrung gtam khrod kyi mi sna gtso bo skyo gar gyis dril ba'i sgrung mjug dag la khrid/ tshe ring don grub bltas tshod kyis yid mug par snang mod kyang / kho rang grags med du gyur ma song / 'di lta bu'i snyan ngag pa dang rtsom pa po'i spobs pa ma 'ongs par khong gi thun min gyi rtsom gshis skyed byed du 'gyur yang srid/ nga tsho'i rtsom rig la bla na med pa dang gzhon skyes kyi ngar sha dgos la rtsom pa po'i rtsom gshis kyis phyi rol 'jig rten tshur snang byas pa'i rang snang 'jig rten gyi phud kyang dgos pas/ 'di lta na da gzod gdod nas rtsom pa po zhig gi rtsom ga sa rim gyis chags nges/gnyis pa/rtsom pa po rang nyid rtswa thang gi 'brog mi'i rgyud pa yin pas sam kho rang rtswa thang la brtse ba lhag par ba zhig yod pa'i rkyen gyis/ tshe ring don grub kyi sgrung 187

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam ga myong dpyad phra mo'i bsangagator/gtam gyi dbyangs rta gtso bo nam yang mtha' yas pa'i thag ring gi spang thang nas grags 'ongs pa'i bshad zhor ngu zhor gyi pi wang gi sgra bzhin/ dus kyi nges pa gsal bor bkod med la rgyun chad med par kha sang dang de ring 'byung bzhin pa'i gtam rgyud khyod la bshad/ nam rgyun nga tsho grong khyer gyi 'du 'dzi dang thang chad las thar nas lhod la babs nas khong gi sgrung gtam gyi kha 'byed dus me tog sna brgya ldem pa'i g.yu lo'i gdan steng na/ lhing 'jags kyis kha dbugs snyoms par rgyu ba'i sgra thos thub pa'i mthong lam na/ nyams snang gzhan pa zhig khyod la sbyin/gnas de'i yod tshad 'dris che la rgyus med pa zhig yin/ rta'i rmig sgra'i rjes kyi gtam rgyud kyis khyod kyi sems pa drangs nges shing / 'khor bar 'khor ba'i 'phel 'grib dus kyi dga' ba dang skyo ba slar yang khyod kyis myong thub/ 〈shi gson〉gyis 'di ltar klog pa po sgrung gtam gyi khor yug tu drangs/sgrung gtam 〈shi gson 〉zhes par mi sna gtso bo gnyis bzhengs yod de/ rta rkun rta mgrin rdo rje dang sprul sku dpal rin po che gnyis yin/ byung rim spyi tsam ni/rta rkun rta mgrin rdo rje dang sa cha gang gi yin pa mi shes pa'i sprul sku gnyis kyis jag byed par gros 'cham ste/ brku nor ci yod mnyam bgo byed rgyu'i gros thag bcad/ thengs shig dpal rin po che skog tu bsdad nas rta rkun gyis spobs pa chen pos brkus legs par grub rjes su/ 'dod ham can gyi sprul skus rang gi skung phyung bar skrag nas grogs rta mgrin rdo rje bsad/ nyin 'ga'i rjes su rta rkun 188

lam ni 'tshol zhib pa'i rdog sner 'then yod/lha sgrung nang bzhin phyir sos la spyang khyir brten nas slar rang sder log mod/ kho rang bem po phyir slebs pa ji bzhin a in gyi sgra las skad cha bshad mi shes/rin po tshesatshul de shesanas yang bskyar rta mgrin rdo rje ni mi min par shi bo ro langs brgyab pa red ces rta rkun rang gi khyim du log mi btub par byas pas/ kho gtsang bo chen po zhig gi khar 'ongs nas chur lcebs te shi/ 'on kyang khos da dung rang nyid gsod mkhan ni khong gisanam rgyun phyag 'tshal sa'i sprul sku yin pa shesamed/gtam rgyud rta mgrin rdo rje shi ba nas mjug sgril yod kyang klog pa por dngos nas smra bsam brjod 'das kyi sdug bsngal zhig bskyur yod/ dge mi dge mnyam du gnas pa'i mi rang nyid la kha gtad de blo ngor mi shang ba'i mi'i dge mi dge gzhi gcig tu bstar/ 'di ni chos lugs kyi dung bas khyab pa'i skabs skabs su rang btsan dang skabs skabs su de las ldog pa'i mi'i ngos thad nas bshad na 'di lta bu'i 'tsho ba mtshon pa dang 'di lta bu'i mi sna'i snang brtan bzhengs skrun bya rgyu ni de 'dra'i las sla mo zhig ma yin/ rgyu mtshan de ni rang bzhin gyis bod mi rigs kyi 'gro 'dug spyod gsum gyi 'tsho ba'i phyogs so so'i chos lugs dung ba dang kha 'bral thabs med/ chos lugs kyi nyams myong ni bod mi re re skye ma thag nas shi ba'i bar du mnyam du bgrod pa yin/ mi phal ba'i rnam shes ni sa na gog pa'i lus phung gis chos la bzhag pa'i tshe gang gi gtong ba dang dam bca' yin zhing / gtong ba 'dir mi 'tsho gnas kyi rin thang ste tshe srog kyang 'du/ dad 189

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/pa 'di ni mi gson pa la kha dbugs nang bzhin rtsa lam na rgyu ba'i zungs khrag tu gyur yod/ mi lo stong phrag du ma'i ring nga tsho'i pha mes yang mes la dung ba 'dis lwa ba snum gyis sim pa ltar zin nas nyam chung gi rang nyid rtag brtan gyi 'khor ba la slogadangos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi 'dra mnyam min pa yod do cog rang sdug rang gis nyos par bsam/ de'i rkyen gyis kho tshos rang mos kyi rang nyid blos btang nas phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi dka' ngal dang du blangs/ sems khams 'di mang du brtsegs te mi rigs spyi'i thun mong gi sems khams su chags/ rtsom pa po zhig dang lhag par gzhon skyes rtsom pa po zhig gis der ngo rgol byas te chos lugs kyi dung ba'i 'og na lhog lhog gdu ba'i mi'i rang gshis ngo ma khod du phyung bar spobs pa dang snying stobs tshad nges can zhig med na mi 'ongs/ tshe ring don grub kho rang nyid la chos lugs kyi dri mas sbags yod cing / kho rang srol rgyun rig gnas kyi mngal rtags thebs pa'i khor yug tu 'tshar longs byung bas/ khong gi nye 'gram na rta mgrin rdo rje gang mang mang zhig gi gzugs brnyan g.yo bzhin yod la dpal rin po che'i gting mi dpog pa'i 'dzum mdangs mang po skyom bzhin yod/ 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi chos lugs kyis kho la bsam blo'i skya thig mang bo zhig btab yod/ ṭ+wāṃn chung gzhon nu'i rang sgra 〉zhes pa'i khrod kyi tshe ring gis ljid tig tig gi khur bo khur nas mjal bskor la song yang dngos yod kyi 'tsho bas kho la slar spyin pa ni pha bu gtan du gyes pa de red/ ṭ+wāṃbasde ba'i rlung 'tshub 〉ces pa'i 190

lam ni 'tshol zhib pa'i rdog sner 'then yod/nang gi ru gtso bsod rgyal gyis dgon pa bzhengs skrun byed spyad kyi dngul sde mi kun la khral bzhag gis bgos nas bsdus pa'i tha ma kho rang smyo la khad du bcuga'adi lta bu'i chos lugs khrod kyi gnas lugs dang mi mthun pa'i cha las bskyed pa'i sems khams ni tshe ring don grub kyis 〈shi gson〉 gyi bag la sbas pa'i sems khams red/ chos lugs kyis bod du lo ngo stong phrag ring gi dar spel las bod mi rigs kyi thun mong gi sems dang rig gnas kyi dar rgyas dang bsam blo bskyed 'phel gyi phyogs su gzhan gyis tshab byed mi thub pa'i bsam blo ba chen po grangs med bskyangs myong mod/ nga tshos dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod du chos lugs kyi lugs mthun min pa'i cha'ang brdzus nas khas ma blangs na mi chog la/ rmongs ba'i dad pa'i mun dong du ci byed 'di byed ma nges na ga la chog tshe ring don grub kyis log lta'i bsam blo 'chang bar phod de/ ma brtag ma dpyad pa'i rmongs dad la skyon brjod drag po gtong bar spobs/ 'di ni gsar skyes gzhon nu zhig gi spobs pa yin phyin nga tshos ci mi snyam par ngan khag dkri ba'am byed thabs 'di la g.yam chung gnangs pa'i 'os ma mchis so/ /rta mgrin rdo rje 'chi lam du brdzangs nas sprul skus rang nyid kyi gson pa'i lam bu bdams/ tshe srog gi ltos zla'i sne gnyis dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba'i nang du mgo rting gi go sa gto du brje ma nus/ tshe srog gi rgyun bsring thabs la skyon shor ba ma yin par shugs drag po'i 'tsho ba'i 'gugs shugs kyi ra bar 'gul skyod byed bzhin pa'i spyi 'gros bsgyur bkod 191

semasapa'i rtsomagyi 'am bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/byas mi chog pas lan/ rtsom pa po ha cang lhod la babs nas 'di lta bu'i gtam rgyud bshad/ dpal rin po che ni rang byung mtshar 'dzin khrod stes dbang gis thug 'phrad byung ste tsho ba der phebs pa'i mgron po zhin yin/ char bsil mas sne drangs te bar snang la 'ja' tshon gyis khengs/ go thos su da dung me tog gi char yang 'bab kyin 'dug zer/ kha btags ltar rgyang du 'then pa'i lam phran gyi steng du rtogs pa brnyes zhing kha ngo skye gzugs yag pa'i lha phrug 'di 'ongs pa na/ lha mi yi khams dang bstun la/ mi'i khams lha yi rjes su bsnyeg ces pa ltar/ kho rang skad cig la'ang yid bcol sa'i rten med du mi rung ba'i 'bangs mi kun gyi dad sa'i gzhir lhun gyis gyur zhing mtha' yas pa'i rtswa thang gi tsho ba 'di'i yid kyi dad yul du gyur/ 'di ni dgod bro la gegs med lhun gyis grub pa zhig kyang red/ nga tsho'i nye 'gram na dgod bro la yod tshad 'gal med lhun gyis grub pa'i don mang bo yod pa ma yin nam/ tshe srog gi 'dam bag sa la gtor ba na rtswa skye ba las me tog mi bzhad/ 'di ni nga'i nyes pa red/ nyes pa yin na'ang dpal rin po che'i rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba'i mtshan nyid yod cing / rgyun du kha na bzlo ba ni rtogs pa mkha' dang mnyam yang / spyod pa mi dang mthun dgos zhes pa de red/ kho rang rtswa thang du lo mang 'khyams te mi dang lha bar gyi mtshams sbyor mkhan du gyur zhing khong ni langs nas bsdad na kun gyis lhar 'dzin cing / nyal nas bsdad na kun gyis mir brtsi ba'i gnas lugs rnyed/ 'di lta bu'i ngo gnyis kyi las bsgyur ba'i ra 192

lam ni 'tshol zhib pa'i rdog sner 'then yod/bar/ kho dang rta mgrin rdo rje gsang gros la gcig tu mol ba yang kho rang gis mi'i tshul bzung ba'i ngos nas rgyu nor la dga' ba dang rta mgrin rdo rje brku las la gzhol dus lha dang chos la 'gyod bshags byed sa dgos pas yin/ dpal rin po che'i rang gshis la grub pa'i khog rgya chung la brdzus bag can/ rang kho na las mi bsam pa/ gdug rtsub bcas shi gson gyi 'gal 'du'i bar na lhang la bud cing / khos snga mo nas 'dul khrims btang zhing / 'chi bdag gi grib ma nag po de rta mgrin rdo rje'i lus la phog par byas/ ston pa'i na bza'i phyi shun can gyi dpal rin po ches gzhan gyi tshe srog gi dbang cha bdag gir bzhes rjes yid kyi mnar gcod kyang khad kyis slebs/ rta rkun gyi chung ma dang a ma mthong dus khong gi mig na mchi ma lhung zhing kha nas lhung bshags bton/ don grub kyi le 'khon las rang nyid kyi skyug bro ba'i rnam pa yang mthong mod/ dpal rin po che ni dad yul rnam dag cig byas te 'tsho ba'i mi min par rang gi thob go sa dang snyan grags kyi ched du dad pa'i ma rtsa gsog mkhan zhig yin pas/ khos nges par yang bskyar nyen kha brgyud dgos byung / ro langs ni rtswa thang du rang byung khor yug gis sbyin pa'i 'gro 'ong 'dzin byang ltar de la kha g.yar nas rang skye rang 'gag byed du 'jug thub/dpal rin po che'i bdam gses la ji 'dra'i bsam blo gtong sa yod pa la ang /rta mgrin rdo rje ste/ skyo gar 'di'i mi sna gtso bo 'di ltar gegs med du shi song /kho dpal rin po cher bla na med pa'i yid ches kyis yan lag lnga sa la sbyar nas 193

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/phyag gsum btsal rjes sprul sku'i gsung ba nang bzhin gtsang 'gram du phyin song /'di ni ji 'dra'i yid sems 'dar bar byed pa'i gtam rgyud cig red ang / thal mdog gi shog ngos brgyud nas nga tshos tshe ring don grub kyi smyu gu bzung ba'i lag pa 'dar bzhin pa mthong thub pa 'dra/ 'di ni tshe srog cig la rdzogs tshig bkod pa yin pas khos 'di ltar bkod sgrig byed par sems kyis mi bzod/ klog pa po re re 'di lta bu'i tshe srog bcom thabs kyi mdun du tshang mas rmi lam gyis dbugs dbyung byed par smon yang / dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba ni nyam chung ste lhan skyes kyi rmongs pa'i mdun du nam yang don dngos kyis ltar snang gi brdzu bag drungs nas 'byin mi nus/ lha'i nus mthu mchod khri steng krong nger 'greng dus/ sa na gog pa'i mi rnam pa/ khyod kyis bdam ga ji ltar byed dam/ 'di ni tshe ring don grub kyis mi sna'i snang brnyan bzhengs skrun byed pa'i tshe na mi mngon pa'i tshul du byas pa'i kun spyod kyi gdengs 'jog red/〈ra lo 〉zhes pa'i nang gi ra lo ni tshe ring don grub kyi nye char gyi gsar rtsom khrod kyi cung tshab mtshon can gyi mi sna'i snang brnyan zhig yin/ kho ni rang la yi chad dang rang bkur/ sdug bsngal dang sprid pa/ rang 'dod can dang khog rgya can/ skyug bro la sems bzang ba bcas mnyam du 'dus pa'i nam yang rang snang rang gis skyid du 'jug cing gang la gang bstun byed mkhas pa zhig yin/ khong gis dwa phrug cig nas slob mar gyur ba dang de nas gzhan gyi mag par bsdad/ de nas grwa ba 194

lam ni 'tshol zhib pa'i rdog sner 'then yod/byas shing mthar phyir skya sar babs pa'i brgyud rim rtog 'dzing can gyi mi tshe zhig skyel/ ra lo'i sna 'og na nam yang skam pa med pa'i chu bo cha zhig bzhur bzhin pa las nga tshor dgod kha tsha bo zhig gi snang ba bskyed cing / dgod kha'i bag la nyal ba'i 'jig rten gyi drod 'khyags shig kyang tshor 'ongs/ ra lo ni rang gis rang la yid chad pa zhig yin pa'i stabs kyis chung dus nas a pha'i brtse ba stor/ lhan skyes nas sdar ma snying chung ste/ lo bcu kha'i nang du'ang rta'i rgyab tu kha bub log nas 'gro ba las lcag gis bskul mi nus/ zhes pa ltar yin/ gzhan rnams kyis slob chung lo lnga'i nang mthar phyin na'ang ra los lo brgyad la bton pa'i mthar nam gung la skyes ma'i dge rgan gyi nyal khang gi sgo rdung ba'i rkyen gyis phyir pha yul du skyel/ ra lo nga rgyal dang rang mthong che ste/ khos gzhan gyi nor lug 'tshos te rang gi rtsol ba la brten nas rtsam pa dang mar thob/ gzhan gyis bshad bshad nas 'gro sgo ci yang gtong mi dgos pa'i mag par bsdad/ rim gyis 'jon nus bskyed pa'i rjes nas sngar bzhin rang nyid kyi rin thang gi myu gu 'bus/ nga ni khyod tshang gi bdag po las yun ring gi g.yog po min/ zhes pa la brten nas lugs mthun gyi ngo rgol byas/ bud med des ra lor chung mas rang gi ngo la bltas nas gzhan dang gnyen bsgrigs pa'i dgod gtam dang zur za mtha' chod pa byas mod kyang / ra los de la snang chung skyur 'jog gis gzhan du song nas sngar bzhin las gzhan la 'jug 'di lta bu'i dgod bro ba'i gnyen sgrig gis ra lor sdug chen po 195

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/skyel mi thub/ rgyu mtshan ni ra lo nam yang za ri zi ri'i ngang rang gi lto ba'i ba'i ched du 'tsho la/ mi'i lhan skyes kyi dgos mkho las gzhan de las 'phags pa'i bsam blo'i dgos mkhor bsam blo mi 'khor/ de lta bu'i ra lo ni mngar la shugs ring yang 'byin pa/ gting zab cing ro kha ba'i brtse dung gang la'ang kha phyogs khom med/ kho rang la ches ran pa ni grwa sar 'gro rgyu de red/ dgon par thun gsum gyi pho ba'i gnad don la 'dang rgyag mi dgos la gzhan gyi ngo mdog la bltas nas dkar thigs de bas kyang slong mi dgos/ kho la nyin re bzhin phal cher 'bras legs shas dang mar/ rgum 'brum/ sha bcas las grub pa'i bsod snyoms rgyags chad pa re bza' rgyu yod la/ sems pa gtsang mar gnas shing rkang bde lag bde tsam gyis dge bshes rnams kyi blor 'bab/ 'jig rten na 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'byin par khag cing / ra los tshe 'di ji ltar skyel rgyu mi shes la skye ba phyi ma de bas kyang rgyang thag ring zhing ci byed cha ma 'tshal/ khos de lta bu'i dgon pa'i lo bcu'i 'tsho ba dngos nas bsran thabs bral/ ra los ston pa'i na bza' gyon pa ni 'khor bar nges 'byung skyes pa ni ma yin gyi 'tsho ba mu mthud du skyel stangs kyi rnam pa bsgyur ba tsam yin pas/ 'tsho ba'i gnad don thag chod tsa na sngar bzhin rang sems la kha lo bsgyur mi thub par gyur/ rgyab tu gyon pa'i na bza' de ni ma gzhi 'du khrims srung ba'i mtshon rtags las grong dang mi khyim myul byed kyi lam yig min pa kho rang gis rtsa ba nas bsnyel te/ gtsang bo'i phar ngogs su 'jig 196

lam ni 'tshol zhib pa'i rdog sner 'then yod/rten gyi bde ba 'tshol du phyin/ mjug 'bras ni ra lo dgod bro la ngu 'chor ba'i khrims rmongs kyi tshul bzung ba'i brtse dung gi zlos gar thengs gnyis par gzhan gyi khyo ga'i sku tshab tu bsdad pa'i skyo gar bsgyur/ ra lor gong la gtugs bsher rgyag sa'i sgo med pas yang bskyar pho ba'i don du bzhon pa nyag gcig pu mi btsong ga med byung mod/ gnam 'og na gson thabs gtan nas med pa'ang ma yin te/mi tshe 'gyu bag re re'i klong na ra lo'i lhan skyes kyi sems pa bzang bo dang bden pa bskyangs nas gzhan la rogs ram byed pa'i gshis ka da dung 'gyur med/'khyams po'i sems kyis dus nam zhig gi tshe na brtse dung gi gtam rgyud cig gi khrod na gnas mal rnyed/ snying rje la snying yang langs pa/ dgod bro la ngu yang 'chor ba'i ra lo'i gnyen thengs gsum pa bud med khrims rmongs zhig gi khyo ga'i sku tshab tu bsdad pas/ bud med de zla drug gi ring btson du 'dug dgos mod/thang chad cing gzhung rgyud drang ba'i ra lo kho mo'i dam bcar yid ches te/ re bas brtas la brel ba 'tshub pos kho rang gi brtse dung gi ches mtha'i gnas mal la sguga'adi ni tshe ring don grub kyi smyug 'og gi 'gal 'du dang bzang ngan yag btsog gi cha mang du 'dus pa'i ra lo red/ rtsom pa pos phra zhib kyis zhib 'bri byas pa'i thabs la brten nas klog pa po'i bsam blo mtha' med pa'i mkha' dbyings su gang dgar rgyu zhing nyams su myong ba dang / phyir 'dang rgyag pa/ rang gi rtog 'char 'phar ma'i rgyun bsring bar byas/ lus po dang sems pa/ 'tsho gnas 197

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/dang 'dun pa'i bar gyi 'gal ba ni ra lo kho nar yod pa'i nyams myong skya bo tsam min par nga tsho mi re re'i mdun du lhags pa'i dka' ngal yin/ gsar rtsom gyi gshin sa 'di'i steng du tshe ring don grub kyis nam yang rang nyid kyi 'tsho rten du gyur ba'i rtswa thang la thugs snang mdzad kyin yod/ gzhung rgyud drang zhing sems pa bzang ba'i 'brog mi dang lhab lhub bskyod pa'i dar lcog da dung lug rdzi gzhon nu ma'i gdangs mthon po'i glu skad bcas la rna ba gtan du blag yod cing / 'di dag gis dus rtag tu kho la drag tu 'phyur ba'i sems 'gyu spyin gyin yod/ khos ngo mtshar ba'i mdo dbus mtho sgang shar rgyud kyi rtswa thang 'di'i steng gi ngo mtshar bcos mar brten nas har gyis gtam phung mi bskyed la/ gzhan la rgyus med pa'i cha btsal nas sgrid nad can la zug gzer ster ba'i las kyang byed don med/ rgyu mtshan ni/ rtswa thang ni kho la mtshon nas bshad na mgron po'i gnas tshang gtong sa min la/ kho rang rtswa thang la mtshon nas bshad na yang lag pa g.yug g.yug gis gyes brda ston pa'i 'khyams phrug min/ 'di ni gdod nas tshe smon sngon gyi las 'bras zhig kyang yin phyin/ shi gson mnyam du gnas la sems pa dang sems pa bsnol/ 'di ltar gnyen nye lta bu'i 'brel ba dam po 'di'i bar na da dung tshe ring don grub kyi smyug kha stong bar lus par skrag dgos sam/tshe ring don grub kyi sgrung gtam la tag tag kho rang gi thun min gyi rtsom gshis shig chags kyin gda'/ dngos yod dang srol rgyun mnyam gcig tu 'dus 198

lam ni 'tshol zhib pa'i rdog sner 'then yod/pa'i rtswa thang na/ da ni rtswa sa rtsod gleng gi spun zla nang dme'i mda' kha na 'gyel ba'i gzhon nu'i ngo gdong mthong rgyu med par/ me tog ser chen lham mer bkra yod pa'i dus tshigs la smon/ khos rang kha rang gso byed thub pa'i shākya'i dge slong la smon pas/ bsod snyoms kyi lag pa dus tshod skar cha tsam yang ngal gso khom med pa'i 'brog khyim la mi bsring bar 'tshal/ khong gi smyug kha spro sems dmar po dang rmi lam sngon po/ dad pa ser bo'i snag tsha la bsgres na'ang bris pa'i sgrung gtam ni mi sems 'dar bar byed pa'i khrag mdog dmar po yin du ma 'jug kho rang khu sim mar gnas pa'i dus su 'thus tshang yang kha grags pa'i tshe na snying bo med pa'i tshor ba mi skyes pa'i smon lam 'debs so/ /(kame 'bum gyis bsgyur/)199

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myongadapyad phra mo'ispasangagator/'gog thabs bral ba'i nyams 'gyur gyi ri mo/da wardo rje mkhar gyi rtsom nyams la dpyad pa/rang nyid sdug bsngal bar gyur pa'am/ yang na bde ba 'ba' zhig thob pa'i rgyu rkyen 'bras bur kha gsal gyi 'grel ba zhig 'thob par 'dod pa ni tshang ma gcig yin te/ mdor na 'khor ba 'dir lus rten 'cha' ba'i snying po yang de yin par kun nas byed pa 'dra/ rtsom pa po rdo rje mkhar yin na'ang don de las ma 'das bas/ khos nam yang theg dka' ba'i bsam mno'i ljid tshad cig rgyab tu len pa'am/ yang na sdug yus dang 'char yan/ mngon sla ba'i tshor 'du ci rigs shig mtshon par byas mthar/ rang nyid kyi bsam pa'i zhing bkod cig bzhengs par snang la/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas/ khos dngos yod 'tsho ba'i phun tshogs ji snyed cig nyams su myong ba'i gnas skabs su'ang / 'thor la nye ba'i sgrog tse gcig dang / de'i mched zlar song ba'i sgron me zhig ste mtshan thogs thag zhi rgyu med pa gnyis ni/ ci zhig la snyeg pa'i kho'i nam rgyun gyi bsdongs grogs lta bur song snang /gang ltar/ nga tshos mthong sne de spyad de 'jig rten 'di'i mgron po bzhud skyen pa 200

'gog thabs bral ba'i nyams 'gyur gyi ri mo/zhig tu khas 'ches pa'i kho'i snang brnyan mdo tsam zhig ga ler nges thub pa 'dra'o/khos lo rabs brgyad cu ba nas bzung rtsom 'bri 'go brtsams pa red la/ de ni mun pa'i yang mthar thug cig nas sgron bskal du 'da' ba'i dus rabs shig la 'khel 'dug ci ltar na/ bcings 'grol byas rjes kyi bod kyi rtsom rig ni rta thog nas ri mgor bslebs pa lta bu zhig ni min par/ chab srid kyi char rlung drag tu 'tshub pa'i dus rim nang / gar 'gro 'di 'gro'i gtol ma rnyed par 'dam nang du ring zhig tshud pa ltar gyur mthar/ dka' ba brgya phrag gi nyer len gyis zla ba sgra gcan las thar ba bzhin thon pa zhig red/ de ltar/ dus de tsam nas/ bod kyi rtsom rig gsar ba yang dal ba dal bur 'jig rten kun gyi mig gi gsos su gyur pa dang / lhag par du/ de dus bod kyi na gzhon mang po zhig la mtho rim slob gso myangs ba'i skal ba'ang ldan par gyur te/ rtsom pa'i smyug rtse bod yig tu thog mar bkod pa dang chabs cig kho tshos 'byams klas pa'i byang khog mu nas mu ru bsrings pa'i steng / phugs re dang snying stobs kyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang zhig hur gyis bzhengs pa'i gleng slong mdzad pa las thon pa zhig kyang red/bod kyi rtsom rig gi sde gsar pa zhig de ltar ngang gis chags te rim bzhin dar zhing rgyas par gyur la/ reb gong rdo rje mkhar ni de'i gras kyi gcig red/ rtsom rig la dungs ba'i zhen ka de dang / yang na brag ri gsil bar yang 'gran chog pa'i brtson 'grus kyi stobasakyis/ khos thog mar 〈tshigs su bcad pa'i sgrung 〉201

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/zhes pa sbrang char steng 'khod par kun nas gdeng 'jog mi dman pa 'thob cing /de'i 'bras rtags su gya gsum lo'i bar gyi sbrang char rtsom rig bya dga' ang gnyis pa'ang 'thob byung / der mthud de/ khos sgrung thung 〈ze'u 'bru 〉 dang 〈sgrung ring rmi lam gyi 'jig rten 〉 gnyis kyang rim bzhin kun gyi mig lam du bstar byung la/ dus de nas bzung / khos rtsom pa'i rlabs phreng bar med du g.yos te/ yud tsam la'ang rtsom gyi ngal bas dub pa'i rnam 'gyur ni sus kyang mthong bar ma gyur te/ sgrung rtsom dang snyan ngag lhug rtsom sogs spyi bsdoms nyis brgyar longs tsam zhig spyi tshogs steng zam ma chad par bkrams byung la/ de las/ nga tshos kho ni sna du mar phyogs shing 'bri ba'i rtsom pa po zhig tu'ang mthong ngo /spyir rtsom rig pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ rtsom pa pos 'tsho ba'i sna ji snyed cig nyams su myangs ba dang shes rtogs byung ba'i 'bras bu de yi ge'i sdeb sbyor byed pa'i go rim zhig la go na'ang / de ni 'tsho ba zhes pa'i yul gyi gnas tshul so sor mthong ba dang / rtsom pa po rang gi blo yi snang tshul gyi khyad par gyi dbang gis/ gsar rtsom gyi 'bras bu de'ang tha dad du snang ste/ reb gong rdo rje mkhar gyis cung snga bar brtsams pa'i sgrung rtsom ṭ+wāṃrtswa thang gi dpa' mo 〉 dang / 〈bslu brid/〉 〈mig chu 〉sogs su/ spyi tshogs steng gi dngos yod 'tsho ba mtshon par byed pa'i thad la dang dod cher mdzad 'dug la/ don ga ge mo'am rkyen gang rung zhig gi mthong sner snyeg ste/ rang gi mdzes dpyod sogs kyi lta ba de ched du mngon par byas kyang 202

'gog thabs bral ba'i nyams 'gyur gyi ri mo/'dug mod/ 'bri thabs 'di ni bod yig sgrung rtsom thog mar 'khod pa kun la'ang snang 'dug 'on kyang / da lta nga tshos de rnams la phyir bltas tsam mdzad na/ sgrung rtsom du mthong tshad kun rtag par bod kyi 'tsho ba'i nang mthong thos dran reg gi yul du song ba'i snang tshul 'ba' zhig ste/ phyogs thams cad dang sgo kun nas cung zad rgyas par mngon mod/ rtsom pa po rang gi sim gdung 'dres ma'i cha ci rigs sam/ rtsom gyi mi snar bgos pa'i brtse gdung gi cha sogs ni de tsam phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam par mthong zhing / mdor na/ yul yul can du byed pa'i phyi ma'i khyadachos 'bur du dod mi snang ba de'o/ de lta na'ang / nga tshos brtsams chos 'di dag re re bzhin bklag tshe/ dus rabs gsar pa'i nang du/ mi rigs 'dis rang gi 'du shes gsar sgyur dang bla srog 'du bar byed pa/ bsam blo'i rgya skyed pa bcas kyi thad la yid 'jog gang mang mdzad myongs ba de tshegs med du mthong thub la/ rtsom pa pos yul can gyi khyad par dang de'i nang gi de nyid/ yang na mi sna'i rang gshis tshags su chud pa rnams ste/ bsam pa'i grub stangs kyi thad la cha 'jog mdzad pa ma 'dang ba'ang de ma thag tu nges thub/ gzhan du na/ de ni rtsom pa pos rtsom pa'i thabs tshul cig la dmigs pa las gzhan min par/ bab chags shing don rkyang ba mtshon tshul tsam la bsnyegs par yang nges mod/ brgya la de lta'i dmigs rnam du mthong na'ang / spyi bas bye brag gtsor mdzad cing / byung rim dang thabs tshul gnyis bzang rab tu thon pa'i gnas skabs dag tu'ang / 'tsho ba dang sgyu rtsal 203

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/gnyis/ dungs zhen dang dpyod shes gnyis ya ma bral bar spyi snyoms byed pa'i nus pa shor ba sogs ni/ skabs de'i bod kyi sgrung rtsom 'bri mkhan rnams la thun mong du yod pa'i chag che nyam nga zhig tu mthong / de bas/ gang la skyon zhib dang phyir rtog byed pa gal che bar mthong ste/ de min nya be nyob be'i rnam par shes pa zhig gi ngang la 'dug dgos pa'ang gor ma chag ste/ de ltar na mtha' mar sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs kyi rang tshugs de yang yal bar 'dor dgos par dogs/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i rtsom pa po mang po zhig gis don nyams pa'i skyon 'di rigs yid la bcags par ma zad/ dus rabs de ni rig gnas 'du shes shig rang shugs kyis pher ba'i rtogs sad kyi dus rim tsam las gzhan min par yang ngos 'dzin byed pas bag bro'o/gzhan du na/ reb gong rdo rje mkhar ni bod rigs rtsom pa po'i nang rtsom sna mang la brtsams chos kyang de bzhin mang por snang ba'i gras su mngon mod/ kho'i rtsom 'bri ba'i blo zad du med la zag pa'ang med par lag smyu gu dang ma bral tsam du mthong ba der rgyu mtshan med pa zhig ni min te/ rnam pa gcig tu na/ de ni bod kyi rig gnas mkha' dbugs 'dis bskyed pa'i snying stobs shig gi rtags mtshan yang yin 'dug ‘‘54’’ / 'di ltar rang rtogs kyi 'du shes shig gis rgyas btab par brten/ khos sngon byon bod kyi mkhas dbang na rim la dad cing bslabs pa'i mthar/ rang gi sor mo'i 'du byed de de dag gi zla la drangs par 'bad cing 204

'gog thabs bral ba'i nyams 'gyur gyi ri mo/'bungs te/ khong rnams kyi rnam dpyod dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin ma lus pas gzhan kun la'ang phan du bzhed pa'i lhag bsam mi dman pa zhig bcangs nas snang la/ bod kyi srol rgyun rig pa'i 'bab stegs 'di'i steng / khos snyan gzhung me long ma'i gzhung tshig dbye ba tshig rgyan byed stangs sogs la byang bar sbyangs pa phud/ gnas lnga rig pa'i bcud la'ang gang la gang 'tsham du rol ba'i mthus/kho'i mos pa dang spro snang / mdor na rdzu ོma rgya sogs mang zhig de nas 'khrungs te rgyas par song ba yin zhes kyang smra bar bya ste/ yang dag par na/ reb gong rdo rje mkhar kho'i rang rgyud na phal bar dkon pa'i gsar rtsom gyi blo 'gog med cig mchis tsa na/ gong smos kyi bslab pa'i rim pa yi rkyen med dag dang 'phrad de/snyan rtsom dang sgrung rtsom sogs rtsom rig brtsams chos ji snyed pa'i 'bras bu khyad par can de mngon du gyur ba red/ de lta na'ang / de lta bu'i 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur tshul ni 'di ltar mthong ste/ rtsom pa po khong gi sems kyi kun slong dang phyi rol gzugs su snang tshad bar gyi rtsol ba de ga'u kha sbyor bzhin 'phrod pa'i 'du byed las byung ba ni thag gis chod kyang / phugs ded na rtsol ba de rigs khong gi mdzes dpyod kyi lta ba rnam par g.yos pa las byung ba zhig kyang red 'dug spyir gong nas smras pa bzhin/ khos rgyun gtan 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi bya dngos mthong tshad kun re re bzhin rtsom gyi rnam par 'god dus/ gang gi snang tshul dang khyad chos sogs 'gyed tshabs che ba'i dbang gis/ rtsom pa po rang gi sems kyi khyad par 205

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/dang de'i rang bzhin rnams gsal bor 'don pa'i cha de re zhig bag la zha ba'i tshor snang zhig 'u cag la 'phral du ster mod/ 'on kyang kho'i rtsom gyi babs dang tshig gi rgyan/ rtog pa'i 'phro 'du sogs gang la bltas kyang ‘‘mi sdug pa'i nyams’’ shig snang ba phar zhog de las ltog ste rang gi rtsom gshis mtshan nyid pa zhig kun gyi snang ngor legs par sbyar 'dug dper na/ 〈kha tas gling bu 'bud pa 〉zhes pa'i tshigs bcad kyi sgrung der mtshon na/ rtsom gyi rtog ljongs byin chags shing yangs por mngon pa ma zad/ tshig gi sdeb legs pa bcas rmad byung gi chos du ma mngon tshan che zhing / brjod bya'i cha nas/ de sngon bod kyi srol rgyun la gnas pa'i kun spyod kyi legs nyes lta ba zhig sgrung gi tshul du bsdus brjod kyi rnam pas bskyar 'dug ste/ kha tas kha yag mgo skor gyi sbyor ba sngon du btang nas gser gyi gling bu 'thob rjes/ 'jol ma'i tshogs kyis rang gi mtha' nas bskor ba'i rnam par blo bying ste mgo 'thoms par gyur kyang / de'i bya byed las nga tshos dge ba dang sdig pa/ byams pa dang sdang ba'i bar gyi 'gal 'du zhig tshor thub la/ mjug mthar des zog rdzun nam nga rgyal gyi rnam 'gyur re zhig dor te rang gi mgrin sgra ji ltar phyungs nas mgo bskor ba'i rang mtshang mi phud ka med du gyur pa'i bden lugs shig kyang bstan 'dug gzhan du na/ rtsom 'di ni brjod bya gang zhig bsdus te brjod pa'i ngag sgrung gi rnam par mthong mod/ sgyu rtsal gyi mgo mjug kun tu ri yi mu khyud dang dwangs pa'i chu phran/ 'jol mo'i gsung snyan/ de bzhin 206

'gog thabs bral ba'i nyams 'gyur gyi ri mo/mtshan mo'i zla 'od dang nam mkha'i skar tshogs sogs mi'i yul gyi mdzes pa mtha' dag gcal du bkram pa'i rnam pa der kun gyi yid smon 'chor zhing / sngon dus bod rnams sgrung gtam gyi tshul du dngos po'i rang bzhin 'god pa la rtsom pa po rang nyid yang byang bar gyur pasabadams te/ da ni snyan cha che zhing lhod bag ldan pa/ blo la 'bab bde ba'i yon tan gyis phyug pas/ sgo kun nas bod mi'i sems khams dang mthun par gyur cing / gang zhig zhib par spro la tshags dam pa dang /ci bder rtsom du rung ba'i rang nyid kyi rtsom rtsal kyang de ru yongs su mngon 'dugalar bod rang gi rig gnas ngang tshul gyi gting zab sar gnas pa'i mi rigs spyi'i gshis ka de dang / yang na bod rnams dag dang ma dag pa'i blo sna tshogs pa 'khrungs pa'i gnas skabs na/ so so'i sems khams kyi gnas stangs ci ltar yin pa rnams re re bzhin sgrung rtsom gyi rnam pas mtshon par byed na/ nges par du mi rigs 'dir rgyus lon gting zab cig dang mthong rgyus nges can zhigayang na ro bro ba ci lta ci ltar de lta de ltar myang dgos pa ji bzhin mi rigs 'di'i nang gi de nyid kyang de bzhin nyams su myong ba las/ bsam tshod byed pa sogs kyis gar yang mi phyin te/ de ltar na mi rigs 'di'i lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i yun gyi tshe srog gi rgyun ji bzhin 'don dka' 'o/ de bas/ reb gong rdo rje mkhar kho rang yang sgang pa mi rigs 'di'i cha shas gcig gam/ lhag par mi rigs 'di yi bsam mno'i rig gnas kyi rgyun 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur yod tsa na/ kho'i mthong 207

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsangagator/sner 'khor ba ni snod kyi bkod pa khyad par can 'di'i thu 'og na bag bro zhing sos dal ba'i ngang kha ton dge sbyor la spyod pa'i bod kyi 'tsho ba'i rnam pa tsam po de min par/ de las 'gongs te mi rigs 'di re zhig sgrog tu tshud myong ba la phyir bltas mdzad pa de red/ dper na kho'i sgrung rtsom thung gras ṭ+wāṃmig chu 〉zhes pa'i mi sna gtso bo bkra shisakyisamatshon pa'i 'tsho ba de rigasani/ 'dasasong gi lo rgyusade mi rnams kyi semasasu phog pa'i nag nog gi grib ma re zung yin 'dug la/ nam zhig sems kyi mnar gcod mthar thug pa'am 'tsho ba'i sdug bsngal bzod glags bral ba las yongs su thar ba'i gnas skabs na/ de'i ngag nas thal ba'i bstod bsngags ni ches rma med pa'am ches rnam dag cig red de/ rgan po bkra shis kyis rang gis yun ring nyar ba'i kha btags de dbul bo rnams kyi phyir du blos gtong mkhan gang de'i phrag la sgron dus/ sems kyi dga' ba dang yid kyi spro ba de tshig sbyor las mtshon pa'i ngal ba bzhag 'dug kyang / rtsom gyi sbas don las re zhig mtshams sbyar te mngon par snang ngo / de bzhin du/ 〈rtsa thang gi dpa' mo 〉 zhes pa'i nang du'ang / zhing grong gi dge rgan tshe brtan sgrol mas rang gi yun ring bsags pa'i sgor mos slob sbyong gi yo chas ci rigs nyos/ de nas yang bud med rnams la yod pa'i brtse ba'am zhi dul gyi rang bzhin cig khyer te slob bu dag la bcar ba'i rnam 'gyur las/ nga tshos brtse ba zhes pa'i don gyi snying po de ji 'dra'i rtag brtan zhig yin pa'i cha de tshor thub cing / spyir mo rang la byis pa skyob slad tsha bas bsregs te 208

'gog thabs bral ba'i nyams 'gyur gyi ri mo/rmas phog pas dpa' mo zhes pa'i don zhig 'byor zin na'ang / rtsom pa pos bzhengs skrun byas pa'i mi sna'i snang brnyan gyi babs la brtag na/ de 'dra'i don can las 'gongs te gong smos kyi mi sna de dang de lta bu rnams ches phal ba'am dkyus ma zhig tu 'tsho na'ang / kho tsho'i rang rgyud na gnas pa'i yon tan ni gzhan ma yin par dus rgyun rang 'jags su gnas pa'i sems pa de cung zad g.yos pa las byung ba'i chos nyid cig ston bzhin gda' ste/ rtsom gyi nang dge ba'i las de dag byed par bslab byas bskul ba'i tshig lhag med la/ kho tshos don de tsam byed pa la lus sems gnyis rang sor gnas te 'khrigs pa'i long cang med par/gdon ma nas rang chas su thon pa'i bya spyod cig ste/ mi rigs shig gi rin thang gcod tshul de sgrung rtsom du gsal bor bton gnang ba dang chabs cig de rang brtsams chos kyi brjod byar yang gang la gang 'tsham gyis thim par gyur tsa na/ de ni 'tsho ba dang gsar rtsom gnyis yug gcig tu sbrel cing 'degs pa'i stobs shugs bla med cig tu song 'dug pas so/ kun gyis shes gsal ltar/ sgrung rtsom 'bri tshul gyi sgyu rtsal ces pa ni sgyu rtsal rigs de'i spyi'i cha de yongs su 'dzin par go mod/ de min sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa dang de'i nyams 'don thabs kho nar dang dod byed drags na/ rtsom gyi brjod snying sogs btang snyoms su bzhag pa'i skyon du'ang 'gro bar dogs/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ legs rtsom phal che bas rtsom gyi shugs bstan la yod pa'i brjod bya'i 'gros kyis bsam blo rigs shig khyab spel byed bzhin 209

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/'dug la/ brjod bya'i 'gros de rigs ji tsam rang shugs su brdol ba yin na rtsom nang du mngon pa'i tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms rnams de ltar bden pa'i phyogs su gzhol che bar snang zhing / rtsom gyi phyi'i rnam pa'i thog nas nyams 'gyur sna tshogs thon rung 'gros de la ma brten pa gcig kyang med/ 'on kyang / nga tsho'i brtsams chos mang po zhig tag tag rtsom gyi nyams 'don tshul dang phyi'i rnam pa'i thog nas ngos gtsang ma zhig thon par gzhol che 'dug ste/ tshig rgyan sogs kyis bcings ba'i bstan bya de bsam blo nyi tshe ba zhig dang sbyar 'dug bya ba 'di rigs gnyer ba'i sems shugs bzo bskrun pa rnams de las ldog te spyi tshogs don rkyen 'ga' zhig gi 'grel bshad par gyur yod/ brtsams chos mang po zhig gi rgyu cha la dpyod shes kyis bzhu sbyangs dang rang gshis dod med stabs/ klog pa po rnams la tshor shugs zab mo zhig ster ma thub pa red/ de sngon rdo rje mkhar gyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom kyang 'di lta'i 'thom sprid khrod 'phel med sor gnas kyi tshul du gnas myong la/ khor mtshon na de ni dka' spyad stobs 'phel dang rang skyon bcos bsgyur gyi bsam gzhigs la gzhol ba'i go rim zhig las ma 'das/ kho'i rgyud la ma skad kyi lam nas brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom gyi las la zhugs tshe rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas 'du shes mtshon dgos pa'i nges shes zab mo zhig chags/shugs drag po'i mi rigs lo rgyus kyi 'du shes dang spyi tshogs 'gan khur gyi bsam pa ldan zhing phyi rol yul gyi 'tsho gzhes gnas tshul la zhib gzigs dang bsam 210

'gog thabs bral ba'i nyams 'gyur gyi ri mo/zhib gnang gyur na/ da gzod brtsams chos la dus kyis tshod bgam byed thub cing klog pa po dang ma gros gcig mthun gyi bsam blo chags thub pa red/sgrung thung 'bor chen zhig klog pa po'i mig gi dga' ston du phul ba nas bzung sgrung 'bring gsar rtsom gyi sta gon bgyid 'go brtsams pa red/ rmi lam gyi zhing khams ni mi'i gshis kar grub pa'i legs nyes dge sdug gi 'thab rtsod dam 'gran rtsod cig red/ rtsom pa pos bar bcug dang phyir dran sogs kyi mtshon thabs spyad de mi sna'i bya 'gul spel sa'i khor yug yangs por bzos/ gsog gsob kyi rmi lam ni nam yang rmi lam rang yin la/ dngos yod dang rmi lam las 'u tsho'i snang brnyan re re skog la gyur zhing de'i brel 'tshub ltod 'jags kyi 'brel 'dris la rgyun chad med par/ 'di lta'i gnam sa'i bar mtshams nas dpa' 'dzangs rtul phod can gyi rgod po char rjes kyi sha mo bzhin byung ba'i go rim gyi khrod du/ dngos yod 'tsho ba'i go rim dang myur tshad de rmi lam gyi rang dbang gi mnga' khongs nas rang mos sgos sgrig sbyor gyis grub/ mi sna gtso bo dang thog sne mang 'dres 'dzing dpyad par dka' ba'i byung tshul las 'thom sprid du gyur yang / dmar rjen du snang ba ni sngar bzhin mi gshis las tshugs thub pa'i rang gshis de red/de ni rdo rje mkhar gyis sgrung 'bring 'di nyid kyi nang du nus shugs yod dgus mi sna'i phyogs dang rim pa mang por zhib 'bri byas pa brgyud de sems shugs dang dngos yod mthun sdeb dang phyi rol rgyu cha dang rang sems mthun sdeb legs 'grub 211

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/las brdol ba'i tshor ba zhig red/ 'di ni kho'i gsar rtsom gyi bya ba rgyun 'dzin nas lad 'bri'i phyogs la gzhol zhing / de nas rang 'gul gyis gsar rtsom gyi las la zhugs pa'i tshod bgam zhig yin zhing / der da dung mnar ma son pa'i cha gang mang ldan la/ yin 'ang de ni gsar rtsom gyi gom pa dang po spos zin pa'i dan rtags shig yin zhes bshad chog rang re'i bod kyi rtsom pa pos rang nyid kyi gsar rtsom nyams myong brgyud de 'di lta bu'i gnas lugs shig brjod bzhin yod de/rig gnas kyi bzhur rgyun ring zhing dpal yon gyi rmang rdo sra zhing brtan pa'i mi rigs shig la mtshon nas bshad na/ rtsom pa po'i gsar rtsom ni rang mi rigs srol rgyun rgyun skyong dang rig gnas btso sbyang gi gal 'gangs che ba'i go rim zhig yin/ rang re'i bod kyi brtsams sgrung ring mo'i srol 'byed mkhan 〈mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur 〉 gyi rtsom pa po rnal 'byor ba rus pa'i rgyan can dang 〈gzhon nu zla med 〉kyi rtsom pa po mdo mkhar tshe ring dbang rgyal sogs kyis rang gi skyes thob kyi shes rab dang zhi dul gyi gshis rgyud/ 'tsho ba'i brgyud rid+dha/ bcas la brten nas rtsom rig gi bye thang chen mo'i dus skabs re rer/ gzhan gyis do zla bral ba'i brtsams chos kyis dus rabs shig gi rgyun mthud pa red/ gsar rtsom gyi dbang gis khong rnam pa tsho dang rang re'i mi rigs kyi rig gnas 'di bskal brgya'i bar du gnas thub par gyur ba yin/ khong rnam pa tsho'i smyug rtse nas thon pa'i brtsams chos rnams dus kyi tshod bgam brgyud de deng gi rtsom rig gar stegs su'ang 212

'gog thabs bral ba'i nyams 'gyur gyi ri mo/gzhan gyis 'gran zla bral zhing me tog bzhin zhim mngar gyi dri ngad phyogs kun tu ldang bzhin yod/ su zhig gis sgyu rtsal la gzigs zhib dang bsam gzhig nan mo mkho ba red ces gsung ba nang bzhin don dngos su lad zlos ni sgyu rtsal gyi gshed ma yin zhes brjod chog rdo rje mkhar dka' tshegs che zhing dus yun ring ba'i gsar rtsom bgyi ba'i go rim du las dang po'i skabs kyi byis blo lta bu'i mtshar 'dzin brgyud mthar/ khos sngar bzhin 'tsho bar sim pa'i snang tshul than thun bsdu len gyis gsar rtsom gyi spyi khog bzo bar mi brel bar stobs shugs yod dgu gsog ste dus yun ring bor dus nam zhig la rang byung sgos klong brdol la re sgug byas pa yin/ kho'i rang gshis su grub pa'i spyang grung dang zhi lhod kyi dus ni mig snga'i pha skad rtsom rig gsar rtsom la ches mkho ba'i dus skabs shig yin/ zhi lhod kyi dus skabs nas brtse gdung gi mdzod du gyur bar re sgug dang de'i khrod du gsar rtsom gyi rang gshis mngon zhing rang gshis las rang nyid kyi khyad chos mdzes bar grub pa'i goms gshis ldan par gyur na/ rang re'i bod kyi brtsams sgrung la yang rtsom stegs kyi ri gsum rtse nas thun min khyad mtshar gyi 'od snang 'gyed srid la/ rang re'i bod kyi na gzhon rtsom pa po rnams la'ang de lta bu'i zhi lhod re sgug gi dus skabs shig ldan par 'tshal/rdo rje mkhar gyi gsar rtsom gyi spro ba de sna gcig rang bzhin gyi rgya las 'gongs te rang la rgyus mnga' che ba'i khyab khongs so sor khyab yod pa red/ de'i 213

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/stabs kyis/ rdo rje mkhar gyis brtsams sgrung ma zad pa'i snyan ngag dang lhug rtsom sogs kyi brtsams chos kyang 'bor chen spel yod pa red/ khos nga'i brtsams chos kyis mi yul gyi 'grul bzhud ring mor bkod pa'i zhabs rjes kyi bden dpang du mtshon pa yin zhes bshad 'dug kho'i snyan rtsom brtsams sgrung dang bsdur na gsar rtsom gyi cha legs shing tshad las 'das ba/ don snying phun sum tshogs pa'i khyad chos 'bur du thon yod/ don gyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom 〈gser gdub 〉 kyis sor gdub cha gcig gi skud sne brgyud de rgya mtsho dang bde skyid lha mo gnyis kyi brtse dung mtshon yod pa red/ snyan rtsom gyi khyad chos gtso bo ni rtag mthong mtshar med kyi byung rim min la brtse dung rang ngos kyi kyag kyog kyang minapar kun spyod kyi lta ba'i 'phel phyogs de red/ rdo rje mkhar gyis srol rgyun snyan ngag gi dpe rgyan mdzes shing tshig sbyor snyan mo'i mtshon thabs spyad de snyan rtsom yongs la mdzes nyams dod pa red/ lhag par byung rim gyi ngos thad nas rtsom pa pos rgya gar snyan ngag me long ma'i mtshon thabs dang chos gzhud gi gtam rgyud la gzhi bcol te 'od zer stong ldan gyi mig gi dga' ston du gyur ba'i zhing khams shig bzhengs pa yin/ de ni sgyu rtsal gyi bro bas khyab pa'i 'tsho ba'i khrod yi ge'i sgrig sbyor gyis mi rnams kyi yid dbang 'phrog cing sna mang zhing phun sum tshogs pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pas rgyu cha'i sna gcig rang bzhin dang rags bsdus la kha gsab byas pa red/ snyan rtsom 'dis thad tshor rnam pa'i lam nas klog pa po 214

'gog thabs bral ba'i nyams 'gyur gyi ri mo/rnams la shugs rkyen zab mo bzos yod pa red/ de'i mi sna dang byung rim dran 'dzin gyi me long du mag mog tu gyur yang brtsams chos yongs la sim pa'i mdzes nyams de nam yang brjed thabs mi 'dug par snang / 'di lta'i rnam pa la brten nas don snying yongs khyab tu bzos pa ni rdo rje mkhar gyi snyan rtsom gsar rtsom khrod kyi ches legs pa'i grub 'bras su gtogs/snyan ngag snyan ngag tu gyur don ni rnam pa'i dbye ba dang 'gyur khugs kyi tshad ldan las gtso bo snyan rtsom khrod mngon pa'i dga' skyo chags sdang gi bdag nyid du gyur ba'i don snying la rag las/ rdo rje mkhar gyi 〈glag rgod 〉 ni dngos 'bri'i 'bri thabs spyad de gangs ri'i ri tshom du rlung bser bu gdong gis bsus te zla 'od dang zla 'od med pa'i skar 'od 'og dang mu mtha' bral ba'i nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phur rtsal ngom pa'i glag rgod cig bris yod pa red/ de ni dus gsum gyi bar gseng brgyud nas 'phur ba'i ches legs pa'i 'phur rtsal gyi glags 'tshol bzhin pa'i rgod po zhig gis sa chen gyi steng gi skyes 'gro mtha' dag gi skyid sdug la gzigs zhib gnang bzhin pa'i snang brnyan zhig yin la/ nam yang 'phel rgud khrod gshog rtsal je rgyas 'gro bar yid ches brtan zhing sngar bas mtho ba'i 'phur rtsal las tshe srog dang rnam shes kyi rgyang 'bod la rna ba g.yar ba red/ mi'i rang bzhin du bsgyur zhing stobs dang spobs pas khengs ba'i glag rgod 'di nyid kyi sems shugs dang re smon la kha char bu yug gis ji ltar gtses kyang 215

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/nyams pa med pa bstan 'dug 'khor ba las skye ba phyi ma'i mgron brdar re ba ni skyes 'gro mtha' dag gi shi gson gyi re sgug ma yin nam/ glag rgod la rgyab rten ci yang mi dgos don ni zol med kyi gshis ka dang nyams pa med pa'i yid ches kyis khengs yod pas red/ 'di ni snyan ngag pa'i 'ud bstod kyi klong las bzhengs ba'i glag rgod kyi snang brnyan yin la/ don dngos su bshad na de ni phugs bsam gzhan zhig gi re smon red/ 'di lta'i rang bzhin nas dung ba zab mo'i sems shugs kyi 'tshol snyeg de snyan ngag mkhan po'i smyug rtse nas da gzod mtshon thub/snyan ngag pas brjod gzhi brten sa'i dngos po zhig la brten nas shugs su gting zab pa'i bsam blo zhig mtshon pa yin te/ mi zhig gam yang na mi rigs shig gis glag rgod bzhin 'thab rtsod kyi snying stobs bskyed de yar mtho sar snyeg dgos tshul bstan yod/ 'di ni da gzod rdo rje mkhar gyi rang bzhin thun mong ma yin pa'i rmi lam rang red/ 'di las nga tshos bod kyi rtsom pa po glag rgod lags kyi zol mdog gi sgor gzhas zhes pa de dran thub/ de ni de ltar nam yang kher rkyang gis 'phur zhing sa chen po nam yang kho'i zhabs 'og tu mu nas mu ru rgya bskyed cing gnam sngon po dus rgyun kho'i gshog 'og tu mtha' yas su bcug kho tshos de ltar nam yang zol mdog gi zhabs bro 'khrab ste gdug rtsub mkhan re re'i skyo gar gyi gtam rgyud la mdzes sdug gi rdzogs tshig bris/ yod tshad 'di nas 'go brtsams te slar yang de nas mjug rdzogs pa bzhin du tshad med pa'i mgo mjug ni tshe srog 216

'gog thabasabral ba'i nyams 'gyur gyi ri mo/gi skye 'chi'i 'khor ba rang red/ de'i rkyen pas/ 'tshol snyeg dang skyabs 'jug yod tshad la'ang tshad med pa red/ rgyu 'bras kho na las ci yang yod pa ma red/tshad med pa'i sems khral yang de bzhin rlung gi rgyu ba dang bstun nas 'go brtsams shing mjug bsdus pa yin/ 'di nimatsho bod mtho sgang ma gtogs gzhan na med pa'i glag dang glag gi skad cha red/ rdo rje mkhar la da dung 〈dgu chu'i glu dbyangs 〉dang ṭ+wāṃrmi lam/〉 〈kun dga' mtsho mor phul ba 〉 sogs snyan rtsom mang po yod/snyan rtsom 'di tshor pha yul du log 'dod kyi brtse sems kyis phyug cing / 'di lta bu'i pha yul dran pa'i gdung sems ni kho'i ches thog ma'i snyan ngag gi rmang rdo yin pa ma zad/ mu mthud du snyan ngag gi brngod don la tshe srog gi lang tsho stsol ba'i chab rgyun yin zhes kyang brjod chog 'di lta'i tshor 'du zab mo'i skul 'ded 'og tu/kho'i snyan ngag gi dbyangs rta re re dgu chu'i 'gram rgyud nas rtsa thang gi sbra gur dang phyugs rdzi bu mo'i shugs glu snyan mo'i 'gyur khugs re rer khyab yod pa red/phun sum tshogs pa'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig dang sgam brling gzab nan gyi gsung rab bka' rtsom/ rtsed mtshar bzhad gad kyi gtam rgyud sogs ni kho'i rgyu cha 'tshol sdud kyi kha gtad sa yin/ rtsom pa po gang zhig pha yul dang bral nas grong khyer gyi 'du 'dzi'i khrod brel 'tshub ngang sdod khom med dus/ nga tsho la'ang de'i brtsams chos la spro bskyed bro ba nyams bzhin pa'i tshor ba zhig kyang thob srid pa red/ yul gzhan du brtse sems dron mo 'khyil ba'i bdud brtsi bsil ma med la 217

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/pha skad gtsang ma'i 'tshams 'dri snyan mo de bas kyang med pas/ zol med rnam dag gi spro snang de ar 'dam lcags mdong gi bar 'tshang nas zhi bar 'gro la/ phyir dran gyi klong la 'thims pa'i gtam rgyud re re'ang brel 'tshub kyi gom pa'i 'degs 'jog bar nas stong bar 'gyur 'gro ba red/ 'di ni pha yul dang bral zhing bsam blo rmi lam du 'thims pa'i bas mtha'i rtsom pa po rnams kyi thun mong gi nad yams shig red/ 'di lta bu'i brtse sems la blo kha phyogs pa'i mi su zhig la mtshon na/ gdam gses gnyis ma gtogs med nges pa red/ de ni rgyus med pas mtha' nas dmigs 'ben gsar ba zhig btsal te mthor 'dzegs rgyang gzigs kyis rang nyid bskyar bzo byed dgos pa red/ yang gzhan zhig ni bas mtha'i the tshom khrod rang nyid bor te 'tsho gzhes dang rtsom 'bri'i rnam pa de gnyis las dang po 'dems te dgun gyi khu byug bzhin ngag med du 'dug dgos pa red/ gnas tshul ji 'dra ba zhig yin yang / rtsom pa po'am shes ldan pa zhig la mtshon na/ nga tsho'i re ba ni bsam blo'i stobs shugs kyi gzhis khyim 'tshol bzhin pa'i yul gyar ba rnams kyis gzhan yul 'grim pa'i dka' sdug gi mnar gcod las blo sems sngar bzhin gdod ma'i bsti gnas su bcol rgyu de yin/ rgyu mtshan ni snyan ngag pas brjed thabs bral zhing spro sems 'khor sa ni pha yul gyi chu mig dang phyugs rdzi bu mo'i glu skad/ pha skad gtsang ma bcas yin pas red/ rdo rje mkhar gyi gsar rtsom la mi lo nyi shu'i lo rgyus ldan pa red/ khos rang gi skyes thob kyi shes rab la 218

'gog thabasabral ba'i nyams 'gyur gyi ri mo/brten nas/ bod kyi rig gnas kyi bang mdzod las gsar rtsom las la don gnyer byed par gdam gses byas pa la bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis btang yod pa red/ kho'i brtsams sgrung yin na'ang 'dra/ lhug rtsom dang rtsom rig ched rtsom yin na'ang 'dra/ tshor ba gang byung shar mar brdol zhing brtse 'dangs gang yod lhug por brjod pa zhig yin/ khos 'tsho bas gnang ba'i blo 'byed la brtsi mthong byed cing / 'tsho ba'i gsar rnyed dang mi rabs shig gi dus kyi 'phel 'gyur khrod shugs rkyen thebs nas rim bzhin 'gyur ba'i bsam blo dang rin thang gi lta bar lhag tu brtsi mthong byed pa yin/ khos dge sdig bden rdzun dang yag btsog dkar nag gi do mnyam sgyu rtsal grub 'bras bkol te mi rigs kyi kun spyod shan 'byed byed pa dang mdzes rtog lta ba mtshon pa red/ dus da ltar khong gi brtsams sgrung la lar sngon gyi 'od mdangs yal te klog pa pos mthong chen cher mi byed pa ni brtsams chos rang ngos kyi rgyu rkyen la rag las pa dang / lhag par mdzes rtogs lta ba dang rtsom pa po'i sgyu rtsal lta bar rag las par snyam/ rdo rje mkhar gyis gsar du dar ba'i rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyis thengs gnyis pa'i rdung rdeg las brgal dgos ba'i re ba bton yod med mi shes mod/ ṭ+wāṃmig chu 〉dang 〈ca ne 〉zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung gnyis po dus kyi 'gros dang bstun nas de'i nang gi mi sna gtso bo dang mnyam du rtsom pa posagasar rtsom byed skabasakyi dusasu gtan khel byas yod pa red/ klog pa pos sngar bas kyang phyogs tsam dang rang nyid las brgal te 219
