semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsangagator/phyogs yongs kyi 'gul shugs ldan pa'i gsar rtsom la re smon byed pa red/ kho tshos 'tsho ba gsar ba'i don snying zhig gi gsar rnyed mthong ba dang / snang tshul las brgal te gting zab pa'i bsam blo dang rang gshis phan tshun mnyam bsdebs kyi mthong tshor sgyu rtsal du slebs pa'am/ gtam rgyud dang gna' gtam gyis nyin re bzhin phun tshogs su 'gro bzhin pa'i bsam blo'i 'tsho ba'i 'dod pa skong mi thub par mi dang rang byung / mi dang chos lugs sogs phan tshun 'gran rgol dang bsdu len byed pa'i deng rabs mi'i mdzes rtogs lta bar kha phyogs pa red/ mdor dril na/ rnam pa dang thabs rtsal gyis las ka'i a thang chad pa'i deng rabs mi'i re 'dod skong ma thub pa red/ deng rabs mir mtho drag rgyan dang dma' lhung rgyan gyi tshor snang mkho la/ rtsom pa po zhig la mtshon na/ klog pa po'i dga' phyogs kho nar mi dmigs par nges par du lo rgyus snying stobs dang deng rabs lta ba'i mthun sdeb mngon dgos ba'am/ yang na blo khog dang snying stobs chen mos snga 'dzin phyi gtod kyi sgyu rtsal bzo bkod mo zhig bskrun dgos pa red/ dga' 'os ba zhig la/ rdo rje mkhar dang nga tsho'i grogs po mang po zhig la lo rgyus bzhur rgyun ring bo'i rang re'i rig gnas dang rang mi rigs kyi bsam blo'i snying stobs kyis mtshon pa'i lhag bsam dang snying rje la dad mos dang dga' snang yod pa red/nga tshos shes gsal ltar/ rtsom rig ni mchog tu gyur zhing khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin/ des khyod la phugs bsam dang snying stobs gnang nges pa yin la de 220

'gog thabs bral ba'i nyams 'gyur gyi ri mo/dka' spyad sdug rus kyi rngul chus grub pa'ang yin/ su zhig gis rig gnas nyams rgud kyi ches mngon gsal gyi rtags tham ni sun 'byin snying stobs med pa yin zhes gsungs ba nang bzhin/ nga tsho'i rtsom rig bya ba gnyer mkhan rnams la mtshon na/ dus nam yin yang rang nyid zhib bsher gyi go skabs shor du 'jug mi 'os/ nga tshos smyug rtsesakha lo bsgyur dus sam/ yang na phyag zung gnyis ka gser gyi rtags mar reg dus su/ nga tshos ri chu stong phrag gi rngam brjid dang yig drug dbyangs rtas khyab pa'i mkha' 'og tu byung ba'i 'das don mang po brjed mi rung/rtsom pa pos mu mthud nas rang la dbang ba'i tshe srog gi rang gshis gsar rtsom gyi brgyud rim dang bsdebs na/ da gzod sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos rnal ma zhig chags thub la brtsams chos la'ang dus kyis zhib bsher byed thub/(nyi zer gyis bsgyur/)221

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/༄༅/ /jo mo glang ma'i 'dabs rol nas khong gi mig mda' har gyis ri tshom brgal/da wa o rgyan rdo rje'i snyan rtsom gyis mtho sgang gi dus rabs gsar ba'i 'tsho ba mngon par mtshoni yod/sa bab kyi ngos nas bshad na nang log gi mi mang po'i sems su bod ljongs ni rgyang thag ring zhing skog gyur gyis phyug pa/ 'char yan dang thang stong /gangs sogs kyi bdag nyid can du ngos 'dzin byed kyin yod la/ bod ljongs la yid smon pa ni yid dbang 'gugs pa la yid smon pa smos ci dgos/ de ni lha sgrung gis slas pa'i gur 'og na skyom pa'i 'gro ba'i tshogs kyi sdug bsngal ji ltar lhing 'jags kyi zhogs zer 'og tu 'a 'ur 'bar ba'i gtam rgyud snyan lam du grags par smon pa yin la/ dwangs gtsang gi nyi zer 'og gi dwangs zhing sngar bzhin byis pa'i sems khams bzhin gyi mi'i rigs kyi gces nor te gzhung rgyud drang zhing sems bzang ba/ khog rgya che ba'i rang gshis 'chang ba la yid smon pa yin zhing /deng rabs bzo las dpal yon gyis ma gos pa'i dwangs gtsang gi mkha' dbyings dang rang byung khams kyi gdod ma'i rnam par yid smon pa yin/ gang ltar/ gnas 222

jo mo glang ma'i 'dabasarol nasakhong gi mig mda' har gyisari tshom brgal/de ru rnam pa gzhan dang dung ba gzhan zhig gis khyod dang khyod kyi sems par yongs su kha lo bsgyur te/ nges par du gzu bo'i mig gis rang la lta ba dang mnyam du gzu bos mig gis gnas 'dir blta dgos pa'i gnon shugs sbyin 'ongs/ sha rus gdung rgyud gcig pa'i bod mi dag la mtshon nas bshad na/ bod ljongs ni rang sems kyi pha yul du 'dzin pa'i bsam pa lhun gyis chags yong /bod ljongs kyi gzi byin mig zung khrag khrig gis mgo bo yar la dgyes nas rgyang lta byed pa'i dmar po ri'i steng gi pho brang po ta la ji bzhin/ nam zhar yang lus sems gnyis kyis mgo bo yar la dgyes te rgyang lta byed pa'i srol ga bzung yod la/ de ni nyin mtshan dbyer med du yid la sgom pa'i yab mes kyi bzhugs gnas la rgyang lta byed pa yin/ lo zla mtshams med du brgyud pa'i gnas 'di ru lus srog mnyam gcig tu 'dus te/ lha'i mgon skyabs dang snying 'jags kyi sems pa las gnas 'di ru 'dod ham gzhan ci yang rgyud la mi skyes/ 'di ni bod ljongs kyi 'gugs shugs lags/ mi rnams kyi bdam gses kyi langs phyogs dang kun slong mi 'dra na'ang / dung ba ni gnas 'di nas mnyam gcig tu 'dres nges/ yid mi ches na/ nga tshos o rgyan rdo rje'i snyan rtsom gyi yol ras phyes nas dung ba 'di khong gis ji ltar brjod yod par blta'o/ /na mnyam pa'i bod kyi snyan ngag pa gzhan dag dang 'dra bar/ o rgyan rdo rje'i sgyu rtsal gyi zhing khams na zhib 'bri dang 'dra bshus byed bzhin pa ni kho rang 223

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/brten sa'i 'tsho ba dang ngo bo dbyer med kyi gong bu gcig tu chags yod/ kho rang nyid kyi mig gis dngos su mthong ba'i rang mi rigs kyi 'gyur med brtan po dang /spobs pa'i gzengs mtho ba/ khog rgya yangs la blo sems dkar ba'i rang gshis dang rang gi nyams myong gnyis ltos zlar grub med de/ gnas 'di nas skye zhing gnas 'di nas 'tshar longs byung ba'i kho rang la mtshon na mig la dga' ba ster ba'i bod ljongs kyi nyi 'od drag po 'di mtshar du mi 'dzin zhing / gzim med kyi tshe 'bar grangs med dang / skad dma' mor grags pa'i dung chen gyi sgra/ dal la ring ba'i chos kyi sgra/ thams cad kyis tshe gang bor 'gyur mi srid pa'i dad par mthun snang sbyin pa dang bar med du bsam gzhig byed pa'i she mong sbyin pa las/ ngo mtshar ste dga' snang chen po bskyed mi srid cing / dga' snang chen po de la brten nas dung ba sor rtse las skyug mi srid/ dung ba sor rtse las skyug ste khra khra rig rigakha phyogs med cing sems kyi nges gtan ci yang med pa'i yig tshogs de bas kyang 'bri mi srid/ kho rang lo rgyus kyi chu klong ring mo brgyud nas rang nyid dang gangs ljongs kyi yod rgu skyong ba'i lo rgyus la cer nges/mes po rnams brgyud zin pa'i bsam blo'i 'gyur ldog gi lam thag ring mo khod du phyung rgyu ni o rgyan rdo rje'i snyan ngag gi sngon 'gro'am yang dag pa'i lta ba yin/o rgyan rdo rje lags 1991lo nas bzung ste gsar rtsom gyi las la zhugs shing /bod ljongs zhi bas bcings 'grol byas nas lo 'khor bzhi bcu lon par phul 224

jo moglang ma'i 'dabasarol nasakhong gi mig mda' har gyisari tshom brgal/ba'i snyan rtsom ṭ+wāṃrmi lam 〉zhes pa ni skya rengs sngon gyi thang ldeb cig lags/ srol rgyun gyi dus rabs gsar rnying dbye stangs kyis bltas na/ 'dis bod ljongs kyi gsar rnying ma brje gong gi skya rengs mtshon gyin yod/ ljid tig gi lo rgyus kyi gom sgras nyan mkhan re re'i sems su khong khro gting nas slong / 'di ni skyo gdung gis mnar ba'i lo rgyus kyi rmi lam ring mo zhig ste/ rmi lam gyi zhabs rjes kyis dngos yod kyi dus kyi phung bo thad kyis gshags te/ nga tsho'i mig lam du bstar/khyod kyis/'bud mi thub pa'i sprin nag chen po zhig mal chas su gyon/khyod kyis/blta mi nus pa'i lha sgrung ring bo zhig sngas su byas/skyur sil sil gyi sems pa de da waskyur sil sil gyi sems pa de grang cang cang gi khog tu bcugagadod ma'i gdan steng du 'gre log yang yang brgyab/'di na brjod bzhin pa'i rmi lam ni mi'i rigs kyi lus po rang bzhin gyis gnyid pa'i dus su/ klad pa'i phra phung bsam bzhin ma yin par 'gul skyod kyi rgyud rim la go ba ga la yin te/ 'di ni mi rigs shig gi tshe srog gi gtad rabs kyi go rim du lo rgyus phyi shun gyi dar rgyas dang nyams rgud/ stobs chen dang zungs zad bsnol ba'i dus kyi skad cig gi bris thang ste/ snyan ngag pas rang mi rigs kyi 225

semasapa'i rtsom gyi 'am bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/lo rgyus la skad cig gis phyi mig dang 'tshol zhib bgyis pa yin zhing / zur mi 'dra ba mang bo nas bod ljongs kyi 'das zin pa'i lo rgyus la phyir mig gis bltas/ snyan ngag pas lo rgyus kyi 'gyur ldog gong rol gyi dngos yod kyi myong tshor dang dung ba'i nyams snang gtsor bzung ste/ dngos yod kyi zhing khams su dngos po'i longs spyod ltos bcas kyis dbul yang bsam blo'i zhing khams su nyams pa med pa'i she mong dang / gsar gtod dang phun sum tshogs pa'i rig gnas kyis gtams pa'i snang tshul gtsor 'dzin gyin yod/ dus kyi gom kha na lo ngo bzhi bcu ni mig rdeb dbang tsam du zad kyang / bye brag gi tshe srog re re'i ngos thad nas bshad na lo ngo bzhi bcu 'di'i ring du/ nyin mtshan res mos su zhabor ba'i bar na lus po mtshams med du cher skyes shing bsam blo mu mthud du phun sum tshogs par gyur/ 'das zin pa'i lo zla'i 'khor los dka' sdug dang rngul khrag mig chu bcas kyi zhabs rjes bkod pa dang dus mtshungs su smug long 'thibs pa'i sang nyin la bde skyid kyi skyabs 'jug kyang zhu bzhin yod/ o rgyan rdo rje'i sems pas mes po'i rab rib kyi mig zung brtol nas kho tsho'i rmi lam nang gi 'dzum mdangs mthong / 'tsho ba gsar ba'i rgyab ljongs chen po khyer nas gnas 'dir slebs pa'i ched du nga tshos blos gtong dgos pa ni tshe srog kho na ga la yin/ snyan rtsom hril bor kha brda lta bu'i khyad chos kyis khengs yod cing / 'das song la 'dra mnyam gyi mig zung gis thad kar bltas te/ phan tshun gyi rang tshugs kyi 'tsho gnas tshor 226

jo moglang ma'i 'dabasaroldonasakhong gi mig mda' har gyisari tshom brgal/rtogs byung la brdzu bzo dang spros pa'i 'dra 'bag bshus/ rngams chen po'i dngos yod kyi brnyan ras ngos su dngos po'i rgyags phye las bsam pa'i rgyags phye bsnyeg pa shugs che ba'i mi rigs 'di'i skya rengs ma slebs gong du ji ltar 'tsho zhing /'tsho ba gsar ba'i khrod kyi yid 'ong gi mdzum mdangs ji ltar btsal ba'i brnyan gzugs phab/lo zla dang rlung 'tshub brgyud nas bod ljongs kyi lo ngo bzhi bcu 'di ltar gtan du brgyud myong mkhan gyi mi re re'i dran pa'i ngos su phab/ ma 'ongs lo rgyus kyi ched du smyug rjes zab mo zhig dpar zhing snyan ngag mkhan gyi gnon mi thub pa'i sems shugs drag por snyan ngag gi 'char snang yang mang po sbyin song /o rgyan rdo rje ni rang nyid kyi mig zung dang klad par brten nas rang gi bsam blo phyi ru mngon pa'i snyan ngag pa zhig yin/ mtha' med pa'i rtswa thang dang /stong sing gi 'brog thang / khos dran rgyu ches mang ba ni bod ljongs kyi lo zla'i klong nas sems pa'i ches mtha'i gnas mal ji ltar btsal rgyu phal cher min la/bden don gyi go rim khrod du dbang bor tshor snang sbyin pa'i rgyu cha 'tshol ba'ang min/khos rang 'gul gyis bsnyeg pa ni rang nyid dang sa sgang 'di'i bar du dung ba'i bar gseng med pa dang / so sor gyes te phan tshun cha med du mi 'gyur bar/ sa sgang 'di spros pa mi dgos par rang nyid kyi bla rtsar 'o chu bzhin 'dres te/ rang bzhin gyis mnyam gcig tu 'ongs ste sgal ral btsong mi dgos pa de yin/ gnas 'di 227

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/ myongadapyad phra mo'i bsangagator/ni kho rang bskyed pa'i dngos kyi ma yum ste/ lung stong yin na'ang 'dra/ dbul bo yin na'ang chog tha na skyug bro la chad lhag gis khengs kyang kho rang gis bskyur nas gzhan la 'gro mi srid/ mgron po ltad mo ba rnams kyi tsha lam lam gyi brtse ba dang len ma byas kyang chog mod/ thang stong dang dal cag ger lus pa'i gnas 'dir kho rang mi bcar ba mi srid/ khong gi snyan ngag gi dbyangs rta la drangs pa'i glu skad kyis gnas 'di la kun gyis yid smon 'chor tshul dang / yun ring la nyar ba'i dung ba phyi rwa phyung ste sems gtam gyi 'gyu ba brdol/ 〈mtho sgang gi rlung bu〉'di ltar lding byung ste/sems sdug ni sngar nas yod ma myong /gom bgrod re re ni rang dbang gi glu dbyangs re re yin/ngal dub ni nam yang myong tshor med la/dbugasathengasare re ni stobasashugasakyi gzugasabarnyan re re yin/ rgya mtsho'i ngos las smi4000brgal ba'i mu mtha' bral ba'i gnas 'di ni/ 'das lo khri stong gi gong rol du dbus kyi rgya mtsho chen mo nas 'ongs pa'i rlung gis zin kyang / kyag kyog gi skye 'phel las sa'i rim pa mthug po bskyed cing /ri lung dang gdod ma'i 'brog thang chen po/ chu klung / bde thang dang nags tshal sogs chags su bcug mtho sgang gi rlung ni sprin pa leb mo re re brgal nas snyan 228

jo moglang ma'i 'dabasarol nasakhong gi mig mda' har gyisari tshom brgal/ngag pa'i sems pa brgyud de rlung gi gshog par 'brel yod/ phyir dran ni mtsho 'gram gyi rlabs dang bstun nas 'phel zhing gna' bo'i mdo dbus mtho sgang gi rdo skas ded nas mnyam gcig tu dngos yod kyi zhabs rjes la blta ru phyin/ rgyu mtshan ni/ nga rang dben thang thang gi gnyid las sad tshe/ khu sim mer gtan nas sdod mi thub/ ces pa ltar yin/ lo zla mang por nyar ba'i dung ba smyug rtse las skyug dgos byung la bag la nyal ba'i sems 'gyur da ni kha lo bsgyur mi thub/sems gting nas 'ongs pa'i ga sa gang du lding skor byed pa'i shugs drag po'i tshe srog 'du shes kyi rlung 'di/ 'das song gi som nyi dang 'u thug gi rkyen gyis phyir dal cag ge'i khor yug tu gtan nas log mi srid/nga rang ri klung gi phang du slebs tshe/sos dal du gnas rgyur shin tu dka'/mi tshos snang med du gtong sa'i lung stong du/nga dang spen rtswa'i nyams 'gyur las bus pa'i shu sgra de/grogasamed kher rkyang pa'i skyoglu kher rkyang ba'i skyoglu zhig kyang yin la/nga dang ril ma rkang med kyi 'khrab pa'i bro gar de/sagazhi yi 'khor mtshamasam chad pa'i mtshon rtagasashig kyang yin/bzhud kha'i nyi 'od dang khra chung gi 'ur rdos/dkar nag gi phyugs rigs dag rtswa thang nas bsdus te/229

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad lcamo'ibasangagator/lhas ra gru bzhi ru brdzangs kyang /nga ni zhogs pa'i skya rengs la 'bod brda gtong gin yod/mtha' yas chu gter gyi 'jig rten sa 'og tu nub/rlung rten dar gru yi dril bu yang yang bskyod nas/grangs med kyi mtsho dang mtshe'us/nga dang lhan cig tu/mes po rgya mtsho la dran gso byed/ 'di ni phyi rol 'jig rten shes 'dod kyi shugs drag po'i rlung ste 'tsho ba dang tshe srog 'dzin pa'i rlung zhig yin/ rlung chen pos hril gyis skyom pa'i bla med kyi snying stobs kyis khong gi 'dod pa chen po khyer bar ma zad/ nem nem gyi brtse ba'ang khyer te/ mtho zhing brjid pa'i tshe srog gi khyab rgya mngon bzhin yod/mtho sgang gi rlung gis da dung mtho sgang mi rigs 'di'i rgya che la mthong lam yangs pa'i mi'i snying stobs mtshon gyin yod/ rlung gi phyir dran dang / rlung gi dung ba brjod pa/ rlung gi rang gshis dag mdor dril na mtho dbus mtho sgang gi mi'i lo rgyus dang / mtho sgang gi mi'i gshis ka lags/ de ni 'jig rten phal ba'i 'tsho ba dang lo zla ring mos ma bcom pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i mi rigs snying stobs dang rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi rtogs sad yin/ lo zlas bris 'bur dod pa'i snang brnyan tha dag gi gras su/ gangs rin po che gnam du zug cing / yum bu bla sgang sa 230

jo mo glang ma'i 'dabasarol nas khong gi mig mda' har gyisari tshom brgal/sros su krong nger 'gying / phon po phon po byas pa'i ma ṇi rdo 'bum dal cag ger/shes rab dang spobs pa brtan po'i 'od zer phyogs su bkra/ mkha' na dar lcog dang bod mi tsho'i gsol 'debs lhab lhub bskyod/ rang byung khams chen mo'i snying stobs kyi zil 'di nas mthong thub cing reg thub pa'i dngos po dag las brdol byung / nga tshos mig mdun gyi dngos po 'di dag las mi rigs shig gi srol rgyun don snying steng gi rig gnas kyi tshad dpog thub cing tshad 'di nas yar la 'gos na kha rog ger/ bab chags la mi sems kyang sgul ba'i yab mes nas mthar sring pa'i rmu thag la thug ste/ bshad rgyun du yab mes dag gnam du 'gos byed du grags pa'i/ rang byung khams dang 'brel zhing / mi'i rang bzhin dang lha'i rang bzhin la 'then pa'i rmu thag la thug yod/rmu thag gi bshad rgyun gyis nga tsho'i snyan ngag pa tshor rgya chen po'i bsam gzhig gi mkha' dbyings shig bstsal yod srid/ rmu thag gi sne gcig ni mi gshis dang cig shas lha gshis la thug yod/ lha'i rang bzhin gyi zhing khams ni gtan du nga tsho'i sems la 'dang rgyag ster ba'i pho brang yin/ de ni mi'i rigs kyi mdzes pa dang bzang ba'i mthar thug pa'i sham+bha la yin/ tag tag sems ngos su gnam du dpyangs pa'i rmu thag 'dis nga tsho'i snyan ngag pa tshor rang byung khams la brtsi bkur dang / tshe srog la gus bkur/ mi gshis la yang dag pas ngos 'dzin bcas kyi sems shugs drag tu sgyin/ dus kyi 'phel 'gyur dang 'tsho ba'i go rim bar med 231

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lamabu/myong dpyad phra mo'ibasangagator/du 'thus tshang du gyur ba la brten nas bod kyi gzhon skyes snyan ngag pa dag sngon gyi chab srid dod du phyung nas gsar brje glu ru len pa dang / dngos po la brten nas skad cha shod pa dang ljongs la brten nas bsam blo ston pa'i dkar nag gi rnam pa skya shas las thar te/ mi rigs snying stobs kyi gting du snyigs pa'i phul byung gi kun spyod bsnyeg pa dang / mi sger gyi myong tshor dang rtogs pa gtsor bzung ba'i khar/ 'tsho gnas khor yug dang sems pa'i ma lag rgyab ljongs byas te mi la do snang byed par ma zad/ gting zab pa'i sems pa'i sgrig gzhi bskrun pa'i phyogs su phyogasapa tshor thub/ 'jam mnyen gyi rlung bu re re snyan ngag pa brgyud nas/ brtsams chos re re'i dbye zhib las nga tsho o rgyan rdo rje'i snyan ngag la rim gyis bcar/o rgyan rdo rje ni mdo dbus mtho sgang gi snyan ngag pa zhig yin/ gnas 'di ni snyan ngag gi lha dbyangs can ma gtso byas pa'i lha tshogs kyis bskor ba'i zhing yin/ lo ngo stong phrag mang bo'i ring la mjal skor ba dang / rig gnas gser du brje mkhan/ ljongs rgyu ba bcas kyi zhabs rjes grangs med 'di ru bkod myong la/gnas 'di'i lhog lhog gdu ba'i snyan ngag gis kho tsho bzi ru bcug cing / bshad mi tshar ba'i sgrung mkhan gyi ge sar sgrung dang / rnam par bkra ba'i mi rigs sgyu rtsal gyis kho tsho bzi ru bcug myong / o rgyan rdo rje ni gnas 'di nas skyes pa'i gces phrug yin phyin snyan ngag ni chung dus nas khong gi gnyen nye dag gi bab chags pa'i skad ngag las 'phyur zhing / rol dbyangs dang lha sgrung gis phal cher khong gi 232

jo moglang ma'i 'dabasarol nasakhong gi mig mda' har gyisari tshom brgal/byis dus kyi rtsed rogs byas yod pa smos ci dgos/ dka' tshegs che zhing snying 'jags dang dga' spros kyang khyab pa'i lo zla'i khrod du/ o rgyan rdo rje dang kho dang kho lta bu'i na mnyam tshos/ tag tag pha mes yang mes nas brgyud pa'i khyad du 'phags pa'i sems khams shig dang snying stobs kyis phyug pa'i pho brang nas mdzes sdug gi gtam rgyud dang glu skad kyi nu zho btung ba la brten nas dka' sdug che ba'i 'tsho ba rtsub po skyel cing / snyan ngag gi snying stobs kyi ra ba ni khong tsho'i sems pa ngal gso sa'i gnas su gyur/khong gi snyan rtsom ste/ ṭ+wāṃbadag yid 'gyur med kyi rdo rje 〉 zhes pa dang /ṭ+wāṃgrong rdal 〉chesko/pa yin na'ang 'dra/ 〈bod yig rtsom sgrig pa zhig gi dam bca' 〉zhes pa dang ṭ+wāṃrang dbang gi 'dod mos 〉ges pa yin kyang rung / khong gis snyan ngag gi rmang gzhi gding ba dang snyoms gnas kyi dus su rang gi myong tshor shugs drag pos mtshon gyin yod/ 〈mtho sgang gi rlung 〉 zhes par/ bkag sdom gyi sgo mo dang 'gal ba khur ba'i mtho sgang gi rlung 'tshub drag pos rtsom pa po'i rang gshis dang rtogs pa/ da dung rang byung khams nas byung zhing rang byung khams la 'dres pa'i bsam gzhig mtshon gyin yod/ khong gis 〈bod yig rtsom sgrig pa zhig gi dam bca'〉 dpang du bzhag nas rang gi mi tshe'i bdam ga srung ste 'tsho ba'i thabs chag dang 'tsho gnas khor yug gi btsog 'gyur las rang gi phugs bsam dang dad 'dun mi bor ba'i dam bcas/ snyan rtsom du/ khong gis thad ka thad kar du dbang 233

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/thang dang rgyu nor/ go sa dang snyan grags kyis kho rang gi phugs bsam gyi phyogs gzhan zhig har gyis drangs mi srid pa'i tha tshig bsgrags shing / ma dran pa'i bus phrug gi sems pa zhig klog pa po'i mig mdun du bstar nas/ rang gi 'gyur med kyi goms gshis brtan po bsam pa'i 'tshol bsnyeg gi 'grel bar bzung nas drang bo dang rbad chod kyis rang gi bya gzhag la bcangs pa'i dga' snang mtshon pa'i khar/ de ni bsam pa'i mtshan rtags su bzung nas rnam par dag pa'i rang nyid kyi sems pa'i 'dun ma 'tshol ba'i go rim re re bzhin brgyud/ snyan ngag gi zhing khams su o rgyan rdo rjes khong gi mi tshe gang bor skyor ba'i sems pa'i 'du shes brjod cing / sems pa'i 'du shes 'di ni kho rang 'tshar longs byung sa'i mtho sgang nas byung la/ kho rang nyid kyis mtho sgang la bcangs pa'i brtse dung las byung ba yin/o rgyan rdo rje'i snyan ngag gis mtho sgang gi mi'i 'tsho ba dang mi tshe'i myong tshor mngon pa las gzhan da dung bab chags shing phal ba'i mi gshis te/ mi sna grags chen phyogs bsdus kyi glegs bam du ming dgod ma thub mod/ nga tsho'i 'tsho bar rtag tu bde skyid dang drod khol sbyin mkhan gyi 'bangs mi phal ba dag la thugs snang mdzad yod/ bod yul stod smad bar gsum gyi sa cha so sor khyab pa'i blo rig rgod cing rtsed mtshar can gyi gtam rgyud mi sna grags can a khu ston pa yin na'ang 'dra/ mdo dbus mtho sgang du bab chags shing las la brtson pa'i phal ba'i lam bu bskrun mkhan gyi lam bzo ba yin kyang chog thams cad kyis khong gi 234

jo moglang ma'i 'dabasaroldonasakhong gi mig mda' har gyisari tshom brgal/snyan ngag gi thig phreng re re'i bar na brtse ba'i tshon mdangs bkra ba'i thang ga re re bris yod cing / thang ga 'di dag gis kha gsal la gting zab pa'i sgo nas blo rig bkra zhing phyi thag ring ba/ bab chags la 'tsho ba'i mdzes sdug gis khengs pa'i yul mi phal ba tsho'i brtse ba bris yod/a khu ston pa ni bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig tu blo rig rgod cing rtsed mtshar can gyi mi sna zhig yin te/ khong rang skye sa'i khyim tshang dbul la khyad du 'phags pa'i shes rab ni ngal rtsol gyis dub ste shugs ring nar nar 'byin pa'i sdug bsngal gyi khrod na yid kyi smon pa g.yo ba'i dus su/ mtho sgang na lding ba'i bsil rlung bzhin sbra khyim re re brgyud de dgod sgra kun gyi gdong na 'dzum du bcug dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi dka' sdug 'di ltar spro ba'i dgod sgras mnan/a khu ston pa gzhan yul 'grim pa dang / dgon par song ba/ phyug bdag tshang gi mngar skyur gyi 'tsho ba las mtshams mtshams su dgod du 'jug cing / skabs skabs su ngu ru 'jug pa'i gtam rgyud dag dang / mi yul gyi brtse dung brjod pa'i le tshan/ za 'thung sogs kyi gus lugs/ pho mo'i brtse dung gi gtam rgyud/ thams cad dus kyi bar gseng brgal nas nga tsho'i gam du bcar/ snyan ngag pa'i mig lam du/ gtam rgyud kyi rgyal bo 'di ni mtha' mtshams brgal ba'i rta rgod ji bzhin shes rab kyi rgya mtsho las 'khrug ste/ sgrog gis ma bcings par gnam sa dang / rtswa thang / rang byung khams gnyen du bzung / khong gis glu chung len bzhin sbra 235

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/khyim re re 'grim/ 'dzum mdangs phyung nas khang khyim re rer 'dzul/ zhes pa ltar/ring la sun snang skyes pa'i mtshan mor khong ni chang rag zhim po zhig dang 'dra bar mi rnams kyi nyin gyi ngal dub yod rgu sangs par byas/ khong gi blo rig rtsed mtshar gyis mgo nag mi la sngo bsang gi mkha' dbyings shig bskrun/ zhes pa ltar nyam chung gi lus pos rnam dkar gyi sems pa'i dga' spro'i rang dbang bcom par mi nus/ a khu ston pa'i blo rig ni lugs med 'gog pa'i phub ji bzhin phyug bdag gi khrims med lugs med kyi spyod pa re re bkag ste/ sku drag dag la dgod bro ba'i bya byed 'chol du bcug nas ci bya gtol bral du btang / a khu ston pa'i blo gros kyis rdzong dpon gyi ngan mtshang sgor phyung zhing nga rgyal gyi snang ba thal tu gtor/a khu ston pa'i gtam rgyud dang khong gi nyam thag gi mi tshe las dga' spro dang rang dbang gi 'char snang bskrun/ sos dal gyi dus su/ zas zin rjes kyi khom skabs las/ khong gis mi rnams la phal bar snang yang stobs shugs dang dam bcas phyug pa'i rtsed mtshar spyin 'ongs/o rgyan rdo rjes gzhung lam 'dzugs skrun gyi lo zla glu ru gyer te/ kha bas g.yogs pa'i le dbar stong phrag gi lam du mdzes sdug gi 'tsho ba'i ched du gzhung lam bskrun pa'i bya gzhag la'ang bstod bsngags mdzad yod/ khong gi mig lam du/lag tu lcags khem thogs shing lwa ba snum gyis zin pa'i lam bzo ba dag gis da gzod ga 'dra zhig la kha ba bu yug zer ba dang ga 'dra zhig la rlung 'tshub drag po 236

jo moglang ma'i 'dabasarol nasakhong gi mig mda' har gyisari tshom brgal/zer ba de bas tshor rtogs zab par snang / ya chung drod kyis khengs pa'i mi phal ba dag 'di dag gis phal ba'i las kas mi khrag khrig bde 'jags dang lhod yangs kyis bgrod pa'i gzhung lam bskrun/ go thos su sems pa zhib pa'i lam bzo ba 'di dag gis lha sa nas yangs pa can gyi gzhung lam steng du mdog srab pa'i tshon gyis gze dbyibs kyi me tog bris 'dug pas/ rlangs 'khor bskor nas mtshams 'dir slebs tshe kun la 'dzum mdangs lan cig spyin 'ongs skad/ tag tag 'dzum mdangasa'adisaphan tshun gyi sems pa'i bar thag je nyer btang zhing / rengs la stong sing gi skad cig de yal nas phan tshun la cha rgyus yod par gyur/ tag tag bde la 'jags shing brtse ba mi dman pa'i lam bzo ba dag la o rgyan rdo rjes snyan ngag gi kha btags shig gi zhor du bde zhing skyid pa'i smon 'dun yang phul/dmag 'khrug med pa'i lo zla'i khrod du ngo mtshar ba'i gtam rgyud yod mi srid la/ zhi bde'i dus rabs su/ nga tsho dngos nas spyir btang gi 'tsho bar brten nas spyir btang gis 'tsho bzhin yod/ nga tsho'i 'tsho ba'i khrod du dpa' bo dang phal ba ma yin pa'i rlabs chen gyi mi mi chad mod/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i khor yug tu 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi mi phal ba de bas mang / rgyang ring zhing rgya chen po'i 'tsho ba'i rgyab ljongs su kho tshor thugs snang re mdzod dang / o rgyan rdo rje ni kho tsho gras kyi mi gcig yin/ snyan ngag pa'i tshor ba rnon pos kho rang la/ brtse ba dang mi gzhi'i zhib 'bris snyan ngag 'bri bar mtha' med pa'i snang brnyan 'dzoms po las gzhan 237

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/myongadapyad phra mo'i bsangagator/da dung 'tsho ba'i rim pa brtol nas bsam blo'i zhing khams kyi 'gyu ba mthong du 'jug pa basbran/snyan rtsom ṭ+wāṃmi chung gi 'gying glu 〉zhes pa dang 〈thang dkar rgod po 〉zhes pa/〈gsar rtsom legs bshad gzhon bu'i yid kyi 'bod sgra 〉 zhes pa/ kun gyis o rgyan rdo rje'i snyan ngag gis 'dul dka' zhing sgul mi tshugs par/ ngar chen pos mdun du bskyod pa'i snying stobs shig bsgrags kyin yod/ 'tsho ba'i lam bu'i steng kyag kyog dang dka' sdug gis khengs shing / nga tsho rgyun du mi'i ma rig pa'i zur nas mgo thom na'ang / snyan ngag gis nga tshor sngar bzhin rang gi phugs bsam dang 'od snang gi phyogs su bgrod pa'i spobs pa dang she mong gis brtas pa'i dad 'dun brjod yod/ o rgyan rdo rje'i mig lam du/ 'tsho ba'i 'phel 'grib las gting du snyigs pa ni 'tsho bar 'dzin pa'i brtse ba rnam dag dang tsha lam gyi brtse dung kho na tsam ma yin par/ dga' snang dang khod yangs/ zhi 'jam dang snying 'jags kyi sems kyi rgyang lta 'dus yod/ 'dra mnyam kha gtad kyi sems pa yod na ni snyan rtsom gyi phyogs gnyis ka dang sems pa'i sne gnyis ka bod mi rigs kyi bla srog dang sbrel/ mes po dang rang byung khams/ lha'i mthu dang 'dres pa'i lhan skyes kyi snyan ngag gi sa bon yod na ni/ da gzod de ring gi dngos yod 'tsho ba'i sa gzhir skyes stobs kyi dpal 'bar bar ma zad/ snyan ngag gi rtsa ba dang 'brel te bsam gzhig gis khyab pa dang bsam blos phyug pa'i mi rigs rang bzhin gyis 238

jo mo glang ma'i 'dabasporol nasakhong gi mig mda' har gyisari tshom brgal/khyab cing / deng rabs bod kyi bsam blo dang brtse dung / rang gshis dang myong tshor gyi snyan ngag gi sne 'dir 'brel yod/ der da dung o rgyan rdo rje dang khong gi rogs pa tshos rngul khrag dang brtse ba de bas mang po btang nas mu mthud du rtogs sad dang gsar rnyed 'byung dgos la/ 'tsho ba gsar ba'i bod kyi snyan ngag gsar ba ni srol rgyun gyi brjod bya dang srog gis bcings pa'i dung ba lhug par brjod pa kho na tsam gyis ma yin par gzhan da dung bsam blo gsar ba dang snyan ngag gi mtshon thabs gsar ba dgos/ de lta na da gzod nga tsho'i snyan ngag 'das pa'i dus kyi rgyang bsgrags kyi rnam pa dang kha g.yang gi rnam pa'i dung ba mngon stangs las brgal nas/ bye brag gi snang brnyan zhig las shugs drag pa'i dngos yod dang gting zab pa'i lo rgyus su 'phos pa la brten nas/ snyan ngag gi lus dang skad cha/rnam pa sogos rim pa mang bo nas bod kyi snyan ngag gsar ba'i rang gi rtsom gshis can du bgrad thub/rgan rabs kyi snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring lags kyis 'di ltar gsungs yod de/ snyan ngag pa'i ming gzhan la brtse dung gi legs skyes zer zhing / snyan ngag pa'i tshe srog ni brtse dung gi snying khrag yin/ snyan ngag par sems ngogs su 'phyur ba'i rlabs kyis dbul lam/ khyed nyid 'tsho ba'i chu 'khor du song nas gzhib dang / rgyu mtshan ni gnas de ni brtse dung 'du sa yin/ zhes pa ltar snyan ngag gi ga na sa nas o rgyan rdo rje dang bod kyi gsar skyes snyan ngag pa mang pos 239

semasapa'i rtsom gyi 'am bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/rang gi snyan ngag gi rtsa bar thugs gzhig zhib mo gnangs/ kho tshos rang nyid la tshe srog gi ngo bo sbyin pa'i bsam blo'i pha sa dang / rang nyid dang rig gnas kyi kha dbugs gcig tu 'tsho ba'i klog pa po gnyis kar kha gtad de/ ci nus kyis rang gzhan mnyam spyod kyi skad cha'i khor yug tu/ mtho sgang gi brtse ba'i skya thig bzhengs/chos lugs dang dmangs srol/ lo rgyus rig gnas kyi khyad chos kyis phyug pa'i zhing khams nas mdo dbus mtho sgang gi mi rigs 'di'i dngos yod 'tsho ba dang /gting zab pa'i rig gnas sger chos la thugs snang mdzad/ 'di ltar byas na da gzod snyan ngag pa'i gsar rtsom gyi rtsa bar bsil rlung dang nyi 'od ldan la/ char chu dus 'bab kyi cha rkyen 'og tu skye stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba kho tshos gsal bor shes/ ga la te de las ldog ste/ sger chos 'di dang gyes na/ brtsams chos dang rnam pa rkyang 'ded kyi zhib 'bri/ mtshar 'dzin gyi mngon tshul dag 'tsho gnas yul ljongs gzhan zhig gi phyi tshul rtsom rig dang 'dra bar gsar rtsom gyi bye thang du bgrod nges la/ ngo mtshar gyi ched du ngo mtshar bskrun ba 'i log lam las rang nyid kyi gsar rtsom bor nges/gzhon rabs gsar ba'i snyan ngag pa mang shas shig ni rang mi rigs kyi mi yin zhing / kho tsho rang gi 'tsho gnas khor yug dang 'dris cha ha cang che phyin/skad cha'i bar thag dang brtse dung gi bar thag gang yang med/ kho tsho phal che bas srol rgyun rig gnas kyi slob gso legs shos myang yod pas/ rang gi mi rigs 240

jo moglang ma'i 'dabasarol nas khong gi mig mda' har gyisari tshom brgal/la bla na med pa'i gus bkur byed cing / gsar rtsom gyi 'dun pa dang gsar rtsom gyi spro sems tag tag gus bkur 'di las 'phos pa yin pas/ brtse ba 'di rnam dag yin min dang spobs pa brtan min la the tshom za mi dgos mod/ 'di kho na tsam gyis mi chog ste/ des nga tshor gnad don 'di lta bu zhig bton yod de/ nga tsho'i rtsom rig krung go dang nub phyogs rig gnas kyi mnyam 'dus dang / mi rigs so so'i rig gnas kyi mnyam 'dus las/ phyi phyogs sgo 'byed kyi lam du bskyod cing bskyod/ sna gcig dang bkag bcad rang bzhin gyi rig gnas srol rgyun gyi rnam par rgol ba thebs kyin yod/ dngos yod kyis lo rgyus dang dus rabs/ ma 'ongs par bar thag je nyer btang / bsam blo'i nang rdzong mthug po dang bsam gzhig gi nus pa rim bzhin snyan ngag gi dgos nges kyi kha phyogs su gyur/ nga tsho'i snyan ngag kyang phyi rnam pa'i steng gi zhib 'bri mtshon don zab pa'i gsar ba'i lam la zhugs mgo brtsams te de bas nang snying can dang dung ba can gyi dus rabs su bskyod/ don snying 'di nas bzung ste da ni brjod pa dang tha snyad kyis skad cha'i tshab byed pa tsam ma yin par/ snyan ngag de bas sems khams tha na thun ne skyug pa tsam du gyur te/ cha med pa'i skad cha zhig gis bsnyeg byar gyur ba'i dus su slebs tshe/ nga tsho'i bod kyi snyan ngag gis ci zhig byed dgos sam/snyan ngag gi gting zab pa'i mtshon don 'dzin dgos sam/ yang na bye brag gi chos kyi zhib 'bri kho nas yid tshim ste/ 'gyur ldog sna mang gi tshab mtshon gyi zhing du skad 241

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/cha'i mdzes nyams dang mdzes pa'i dpe zhib 'bri byed pa'i smyug rtsal las bzi nas 'dug dgos/ snang tshul 'dir bod skad kyi snyan ngag pa'i sdes thugs snang mdzad mgo tshugs zin mod kyang / nges pa don gyis 'di la bsam gzhig bgyis te de ni snyan ngag 'bri ba'i nyams myong du byed mkhan mang po mi 'dug 'di ni nga tsho'i snyan ngag pa rnams kyi ‘‘mdzes dpyod lta tshul gyi rgyu'i sgrig gzhi’’ dang 'brel ba yod par snang zhing / rgyu'i sgrig gzhi 'di nyid ni snyan ngag gi shugs bstan gyi dung ba'i zab tshad dang che chung gi rgyu rkyen gal chen zhig red/ (rtsom rig dpyad brjod pa krug grin pa'o yi gsung /) nga tshos yi dam tshe ring dang don grub dbang 'bum sogs rgan rabs kyi snyan ngag pas rgya yig gis bris pa'i snyan rtsom dang /pha skad kyis brtsams pa'i bod kyi rig gnas kyi rdzong mthug pa'i don grub rgyal gyi snyan ngag klog dus/ skad cha dang yi ge so sor snang yang snyan ngag tu bzhur ba'i mi rigs kyi dung ba dang / bod mi rigs kyi gting zab pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas rgyud 'dzin dang gtan tshigs kyi nus pa nas brjid cing 'jam la 'char yan gyis phyug pa'i 'gyur khugs bcas rtsa ba gcig las phyung ba lta bur mthong thub/ kho tsho'i snyan rtsom du/ gangs seng dang 'ja' tshon/ rbab chu bcas rang rang gi mtha' mtshams las brgal nas mi rigs shig gi bsam blo'i gzi byin dang lo rgyus kyi brda 'phrin skyom zhing / mi rabs nas mi rabs brgyud de sang nyin la dkyel yangs kyis bgrod pa'i yid ches dang spobs pa gyer bzhin yod/ ches 'dris che 242

jo mo glang ma'i 'dabasarol nasakhong gi mig mda' har gyisari tshom brgal/ba'i pha skad dang brtse ba las 'phos pa'i mi sger gyi sems pa'i brjod bya ni tsan+dan bzhin dri bsung gis sems kyi bang rim brtol byung / de ni skad cha'i yol ba las ring du brgal nas blo sgo 'byed pa dang shes rab kyi lam bu'i steng / mi rnams la rang gi thun min gyi snyan ngag gi nyams myong brgyud bsgrags byas/ tag tag 'di lta bu'i mi rigs rig gnas kyi rgyab ljongs las 'tshar longs byung ba'i snyan ngag pa dang rang byung khams/ snyan ngag pa dang mi rigs/ snyan ngag pa dang sems pa'i gting rum gyi mnyam 'dus ni o rgyan rdo rje dang khong gi spun zla tsho'i smon pa dang dmigs yul red snyam/mi rnams kyis nam rgyun lha ri dang lha mtsho/ lha bcas kyi mdo dbus mtho sgang zer/ don dngos su gal te khyod la de mthong ba dang myong ba'i sems yod na/lha ni ga sa gang na'ang yod/ o rgyan rdo rje dang o rgyan rdo rje lta bu'i snyan ngag pa rnams la mtshon na/ 'di thams cad a ma'i khog na yod dus nas yod pa'i mngal rtags ji bzhin sems kyi ngos su dpar yod cing / kho tshos gnam bskos kyi las 'di mu mthud du rgyun skyong bzhin par ma zad/ kho tsho'i smyu gus bod ljongs kyi kha sang gi lo rgyus dang de ring gnyis tsha la byas te mig zung rgyang ring gi ma 'ongs par gtad yod/ kho tsho'i snyan ngag gi steng du kho tsho'i lo tshod bzhin nar ma son pa'i gzhon rtags cung tsam yod srid mod kyang / gzhon skyes kyi gzi dpal mtho sgang gi rlung bu bzhin shugs kyis bskyod 'ongs/ (kame 'bum gyis bsgyur/)243

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/zhu 'phrin mdza' ba'i gleng mol/'jigs med thog mchogarang rigs kun gzhi lha lam yangs ba'i mkhar/ /chags zhen 'od rlabs 'gyu ba'i 'dzin zhabs kyis/ /dam du bcings pa ma lhod rang rtags su/ /ma mthong rgyang na dga' ba'i grogs dag kye/ /mthon po gnam la 'khor ba'i nyi ma dang / /dma' ba sa na skyes pa'i pad+ma ltar/ /yul gyis ring yang nye ba'i mdza' gcugs bzhin/ /thams cad sems kyi nye ring kho nar 'dug kho bo pha mas lus kyi cha bgos te/ /khong bar ched du bskyangs pa don che yang / /dpral ba'i ang yig bzhi bcur 'phel ba des/ /glo snying mgrin pa'i lam du yang yang 'phen/ /de phyir bdag la rtsom pa'i yon tan zhig /phar zhog klad rgya'i shun pa cung srab na/ /dgun gyi dus na grag pa'i khu byug ltar/ /ltas ngan zer yang skug pa ci la byed/ /'on kyang tshe rabs sngon ma'i bag chags kyis/ /dbang bsgyur rig pa'i gnas la zhen che bas/ /dri za'i tshal la khā yi skad ji bzhin/ /dogs pa'i sgo lcags kha la rgyag ma phod/ /e ma gza' skar rlung la bskyod phyogs kyis/ /sa yi drod grang 244

zhu 'phrin mdza' ba'i gleng mol/'byung ba'i 'phrod 'du sogs/ /'dzam gling snod kyi bkod pa sna tshogs shig /skad cig rer yang skyes 'jig mang bar mthong / /khyad par lhumyo/ stug gangs ri'i zhing khams zhes/ /sa mtho chu gtsang rin chen sman gyi ljongs/ /zas la bcud che lus la nad nyung zhing / /gnas kyis nyon mongs skye ba'i tshabs kyang chung / /lugs kyis bltas na nor 'dzin mdzes pa'i gtsug /chos kyis bltas na bsam gtan 'phel ba'i gnas/ /so nam dbang byas sos dal longs spyod bzang / /mkhas bas bsams na snod kyi dge kun tshang / /de ltar yin na snyan tshig me tog phreng / /mtsho byung dbang mo 'gugs pa'i nyams dang bcas/ /sdeb sbyor tshig gi rnam 'gyur la zhugs te/ /bsil ldan mdzes ma'i phrag tu dpyangs na 'dod/ /yang gcig 'dod pa'i phyogs dang sbyar byas nas/ /dus dang mthun pa'i gtam la sbyor byed na/ /ri bo gangs kyis bzung bas 'khyags grang che/ /kha char bu yug 'tshub pa drag cing rtsub/ /mi med lung stong 'dre srin gnod byed mang / /chu klung gnam 'bab g.yang gzar brag la 'thab/ /sdod pa'i grong nyung ri dwags gnas pa'i yul/ /dga' ba'i grogs nyung phyugs la brten pa'i khyim/ /'di ltar bsams na skyo zhing gdungs pa'i rgyus/ /ro 'dzin kha mchu'i mal du lhung las ci/ /lag pa'i sor mo gdong la bkram dang lhan/ /mthong byed lam kun 'od lnga'i rdul du langs/ /snying gtam snyam na da dung gsan mdzod dang / /g.yo ba bcud kyang nang gi 'byung ba lngas/ /dar dang rgud pa skyes pa'i skad cig nas/ /'chi ba'i snga rol rgyun mi chad 245

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/du 'byung / /ji ltar te se nyi mas bzhus pa'i rgyun/ /gcig la snod kyi dbang gis ro nus sogs/ /'dra min phan gnod mang ba de ltar du/ /sa steng mi yi rigs rus rjes su dpog /mgo yi skra dang lus kyi sha mdog rnams/ /rang la gang lobs mjes pa'i phul du 'dug /skad dang spyod lam pha mas gang bslabs pa/ /gang la gang goms mchog dang rab tu grub/ /spyir na mi rnams 'dod pa'i phyogs su lhung / /nang sgos 'jig rten 'dod pa'i bran du khol/ /khyad par 'dod pa'i dus kyi rjes 'brangs pas/ /bzang ngan 'dod pa'i skabs dang bstun par go /de ltar chags sdang rus su 'don tshul gyis/ /mtho dman btsan phyug mkhas blun nye ring rnams/ /sa steng mi yis sgrub tshul gang yin pa/ /'jig rten byed po'i blo dang khyad mi 'dug /don gyi dbang 'dis mdzub mo nang bkug tshe/ /gang zhig bstod dang smad pa'i gnas byas te/ /sgro bkur gtam snyan thos pa'i lha dga' byed/ /rang mgo rang gis bskor ba'i chos kho na/ /yin yang bye brag ri bo gangs can pa/ /gdong dmar bod ces bya ba rang gi rigs/ /rta mchog rgyab na ki sgra brag la 'cha'/ /am gtsugs khrag gi thigs pas brang la bsher/ /lus la shed shugs sha tshags bongs kyang che/ /dka' thub bsran tshugs dpa' rgod gtum zhing drag /lab rjes btsan la phyi thag ngang yang ring / /chog shes khengs bskyungs gzhan phan sems kyang dkar/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang rgyal bo'i khrims la brtsi/ /byams ldan pha ma drin can lan du gzab/ /zas la rtsam pa chos la ma ṇi dkar/ /246

zhu 'phrin mdza' ba'i gleng mol/lus la tsha ru las la bsod nams dkar/ /tshul 'dis dar cig rab btags tshon gyi chus/ /snyan dbang shel gyi sa 'dzin brgyan 'dod kyang / /yid kyi mtsho las dran pa'i rlabs 'byur te/ /skad cig khyur mid byed snyam 'phyang mo nyug lus kyi lang tsho dbyar gsum char gyis 'khyer/ /sems kyi dran rig dgun gsum 'khyag pas bsdams/ /snying gi zungs khrag sa yi brlan la sbyor/ /sgo gsum bya ba thams cad rlung la bskur/ /gral mgo zhe sdang gros phug mna' yis 'dzin/ /las 'bras kha bshad dad pa mig la bskyed/ /mkhas pa'i mgo gnon bzang bo mtha' la bskyur/ /grogs ngo thal dang dgra ngo 'dzum gyis bsu/ /rang mir mi dga' gzhan mir dga' mi shes/ /dam pa mi bkur g.yo can shes kyang brtsi/ /phyi snyoms che la nad 'dzing rgyun mi chad/ /'dre srin dri za'i rigs la skyur dad che/ /yon tan mi sbyong phyugs dang 'grogs la dga' / /sa chu rtsod pas rang mi rang gis gsod/ /ngo mtshar yul la med pa'i chos shig mkho/ /mthar thug rang la 'di zhes bya ba med/ /phal cher skad cha 'di dag gzur bo'i gtam/ /mang kha gcig gis 'gog pa'ang 'jig rten srol/ /spar mo mkha' la bgrad mkhan med kyang snyam/ /cal sgra gcig gis thams cad 'bros kyang srid/ /bla ma zer ba yon tan can zhig dgos/ /rgyu nor 'khor g.yog skyong mkhas de 'dra min/ /slob ma dad shes don gnyer can zhig dgos/ /ma rabs brkam chags can gyi 'khor de min/ /chos ni rang gzhan gnyis la phan pa'i sems/ /nyam chung gzhan mgo bskor ba'i thabs 247

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/de min/ /grogs po yin na phyi thag can zhig dgos/ /gnas skabs gang mkho'i rjes su rgyugs de min/ /dpon po zhes bya spyi don sgrub la mkhas/ /'bangs la khrims kyis mnar mkhas de ci zhig /las ka can ni rang 'khos nus ba can/ /lto ba gzan la sgug pa de ci zhig rig gsar sngon med 'phrul gyis bzo ba'i rtsal/ /sngar yod thal bar rlog pa de ci zhig /bcud la phan pa'i longs spyod de phun tshogs/ /mi la gnod pa'i ngo mtshar de ci zhig /rtsol med rang gir 'byung de yid bzhin nor/ /mtha' dag ched du bzo dgos des ci bya/ /yod pa srung ba 'bad med lhun grub ste/ /med pa bzo phyir yod pa brlags de ci/ /bsam pa ma bzang dngos bos bzang thabs gang / /sems pa ma skyid 'dod pas skyid thabs gang / /rang sems ma shes gzhan sems ga la shes/ /lugs dang mi mthun chos dang ji ltar mthun/ /chos la gnas skabs las kyang mthar thug gtso/ /'jig rten dag la 'byung 'gyur shin tu gnyan/ /de phyir chos pa bang mdzod mang ba dang / /'jig rten can gyis chos 'tshol dogs pa'i gnas/ /rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs ba ma byas kyang / /nor dang ldan na mkhas pa'i tshad du 'dzin/ /nor yod thams cad rgyal bor gyur ba na/ /nor gyis rgyal khams 'joms la the tshom med/ /de phyir rtsom zhes btags pa chags sdang gis/ /gzhan skyon smra ba'i rang sgra rgod pa 'di/ /kho bo'i snying la nyal ba'i gdon chen zhig /kha lag bar nas shor ba'i rnam thar yin/ /min na bden gtam ngag gi nyin mo byed/ /lung rigs dpe 248

zhu 'phrin mdza' ba'i gleng mol/gsum bsgril ba'i 'od 'phro ba/ /stong ba'i mkha' la kho bo 'phen byed na/ /re ba'i gnyen du 'dzin 'dod 'ga' yod dam/ /dus 'dir re dogs che bas bshad mkhan dka'/ /thams cad nor gyis dbang byas nyan mkhan dkon/ /khams pa'i lag dang a mdo'i kha de la/ /bcos kyang dgos med rang gi gshis min nam/ /gsung snyan yi ge'i srad bu la brgyus te/ /dga' ba'i skyes bzang ched du gnang ba la/ /sdug gtam 'khor lor phab pa'i lan 'di tsam/ /gus pas phul ba drang nges phye ste bzhes/ /bdag gi ha cang bsdus pa'i lo rgyus ni gsham gsal/bcu bzhi'i dus nas slob grwa'i dge rgan byas/ /nyer bzhi'i bar du rig gnas gsar brjes bskyangs/ /nyer bdun phyin tshe rgyab kyi gon pa bsgyur/ /da lta bzhi bcu ming snyan don stong yin/ /gzhan la bshad na kha lce je bde dang / /rang la bskor na sems rgyud je gyong 'dis/ /mkhas pa zer na rang yang khrel ba'i rgyu/ /blun po zhes na 'dug sa mtho bas mnar/ /249

semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsangagator/tshe stod kyi rang rnam mdor bsdus/mkhas grub/bsod nams che ba gcig la/ /dal 'byor mi lus thob kyang / /skya ser sum mdo'i lam la /nga ni mgo bo 'thoms byung / /zhes pa'i gzhas tshig sho lo ka gcig gis sngon bsus te tshe stod kyi rang rnam mdor bsdus bri bar bya ste/ de yang 1957lor bod ljongs lho kha grwa nang dga' tshal sbug dgon du kho bor dal ba'i rten bzang thob/ yab chen dam pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na 7dkon mchog chos dpal rgya mtsho dpa' bo rin po che zhes bya ba dgon 'di'i bstan pa'i bdag po yin gshis gang de'i bka' lung gtsug tu blangs nas lo gnyis nas skra phud phul zhing phyis bstan pa 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel me tog gtor/ 'on kyang de lor yab chen dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim zhing / ring min dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul tshugs pas kho 250

tshe stod kyi rang rnam mdor bsdus/bo ni a ma lags dang gcen po mnyam du rang kha rang gso'i 'tsho bar rol/nar cung son rjes thog mar khyim du yi ge 'bri klog dang zhor du rang dgon gyi 'don bya chung gras ngag tu zin/ de nas rim bzhin dgon pa'i mkhas dbang bcu phrag kha shas bsten nas bod kyi rig gnas spyi dang khyad par du nang rig pa'i gzhung la thos bsam byas/ skabs der nga dang gzhen po lo na phra zhing khyim gyi phyi nang las ka dka' ngal che bas a ma lags kyis don de la dgongs pa'am gang ltar ci ste/ de snga rang dgon gyi btsun pa mkhas dbang karma phun tshogs lags kyi sku zla gnang / 'on kyang ring min a ma lags kyang sku tshe ma zin pas nga gnyis dwa phrug tu gyur/ de nas bzung mkhas dbang karma phun tshogs lags nas nga gnyis la pha ma dngos dang 'dra ba'i 'tsho skyong dang / shes yon gyi bdud rtsi bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang bas kho ni nga gnyis la ches drin che ba'i pha g.yar gser 'dra ba zhig yin/ /'on kyang 'jig rten gyi bde ba ni ngo ma 'ja' tshon dang 'dra ste/ dus re zhig song ba na g.yo la goms pa'i 'phyan mo lang shor ba zhig gis g.yo ku'agral gyi kyo ba rnon pos nga'i pha g.yar bzang bo'i thugs sems kyi nywa mo dbang med du 'dzin/ ring min bu mo zhig kyang btsas pas de nas bzung nga dang gcen po'i bde skyid nyi ma gzhan dbang sprin pas bsgribs/ nga gnyis dang pha g.yar bar gyi la rgya'am brtse gdung phon po'i phon thag kyang chad/ de la smras pa/ 'jig rten 'tsho ba zer ba/ /las su sla po mi 'dug /skyid po yod kyin yod kyin/ /sdug po mi yis 251

semar+sāpa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/gtong gis/ /phagayar thugasasemasathang shing / /'gyur yong bsam pa med kyang / /da lo shing 'bu phra mo/ /khog pa rul du bcug byung / /chu mo'i chu mgo 'gyur song / /zhing chu than pas 'tshig song / /pha g.yar thugs sems 'gyur song / /gcen gcung g.yog por gyur song/ /byams po pha mas gnang dus/ /byams po yin bsam ma byung / /byams po mi la re dus/ /chu la 'o ma bro byung / /zhes so/ /de nas bzung 'tsho gos kyi 'gan lci de gcen gcung gnyis kyi phrag thog tu babs nas rang rang so so'i 'tsho ba so sos bskyal/1981lor lho kha sa khul nas nga dang gcen po las khungs su gdan drangs/gcen pos dge rgan gnang ba dang / kho bos ched las 'khrab gzhung rtsom pa po'i 'gan khur/ snga phyir gtam brjod chung ba dang / gzhas ma gtam/ lha mo chung ba/lkugs brda'i zlos gar sogs lnga bcu lhag bris shing / rang ljongs kyi ched las rig rtsal 'gran tshogs nang zhugasapar bya dga' rim pa dang bo 5dang / gnyisapa 4/gsum pa 3bcas thob pa ma zad 〈yar klung glu gsar〉zhes pa'i dgod gtam la rgyal yongs grangs nyung mi rigs ched las gzhas ma gtam 'gran tshogs nang ang dang bo thob/ zhor du snyan tshig dang / brtsams sgrung / dpyad gtam sogs brtsams bya brgya lhag tsam ljongs phyi nang gi dus deb dang tshags par thog spel bar mkhas dbang tsho'i bsngags brjod sbrang gzhog tsam re thob/ 1991lor bod kyi deng rabs rtsom pa po'i dpe tshogs nang 〈dus bzhi'i so nam byed lugs〉zhes 252

tshe stod kyi rang rnam mdor bsdus/pa'i snyan tshig ched bsgrigs deb gcig dang / 1993lor lho kha'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal thog gzhas ma gtam dang zlos gar 'khrab gzhung ched bsgrigs deb gcig bton par ljongs phyi nang du bag chags zab tsam byung / da dung blo khog chen pos mkhas dbang don grub rgyal sku 'das nas rtsom 'phror lus ba'i sgrung rtsom 〈gzhon nu'i yid kyi mdzes rgyan 〉zhes bya ba'i mjug bsdu khul byas te sgrung rtsom te ‘‘khrung khrung dkar la mjug ma nag’’ ces pa lta bur gyur yod kyang mjug sgro med pa las legs pas dge mtshan cung zad byung yod snyam/rang gis bris pa'i brtsams bya'i nang snyan tshig yid mgu shos ni 〈dus bzhi'i so nam byed lugs〉 dang 〈ka phreng rig pa'i rol rtsed〉 ces bya ba gnyis yin la/ sgrung rtsom yid mgu shos ni 〈mkha' 'gro krad 'thag〉 ces pa yin zhing /da dung gzhas tshig yid mgu shos ni glu dbyangs 〈skad cig gi 'ja' tshon〉 zhes pa'i nang gi dum bu gcig ste/ mdzes pa'i skar ma smin drug /'dzin 'dod blo la yod kyang / /gnam la skas 'dzeg 'dzugs pa'i/ /thabs shes nga la mi 'dug /ces pa de yin/rang nyid yid mi mgu ba'i brtsams bya ni gzhas ma gtam 〈cog chag hral lags〉 zhes pa'i nang gi dum bu kha shas te/ zhing pa rgya skad mi shes/ /tshong khang nang la ma thad/ /tan shel rgya ma gang la/ /gshe gshe chu tshod phyed ka /zhes pa dang /sha khang 'khyags las grang ba/ /ltag sgo mkhar las btsan pa/ /rgyus yod tshi lu 253

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/bag bag /rgyus med rtsibs ma ro ro/ /zhes pa/ yang / sgor mo lnga brgya lnga bcus/rlangs 'khor lag 'byer nyos yod/ /rgyugs pa'i bar gyi yig tshad/ /ga ler bzhugs gdan 'jags shig /ces pa sogs yin/mdor na lo mang rtsom rig gi bya bar zhugs par 'bras bu'ang phran bu thob ste da lta kho bo rang ljongs rtsom pa po'i mthun tshogs kyi li hri dang / dmangs khrod sgyu rtsal mkhas can mthun tsogs kyi li hri/ rang ljongs chab gros kyi u yon/ sa khul rig rtsal lhan tshogs kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa/ bod rigs gzhon nu rtsom pa po thabs chag gi ming tsam bzung nas/ snga phyir su'u kru'u ru skong tshogs byas pa'i rgyal yongs lho phyogs sa khul gzhas ma gtam ched las 'gran tshogs dang / yun nan du skong tshogs byas pa'i ljongs dang zhing chen lnga'i bod rigs gar rtsom dpyad mol tshogs 'du/ de bzhin rang ljongs su chab gros dang / gsar rtsom dpyad mol/ dmangs khrol zhib 'jug sogs kyi tshogs 'du ji snyed la zhugs nas rang lugs dpyad rtsom gtam bshad byas shing / de dang chabs cig gsar du bzhengs ba'i dga' tshal sbug dgon pa'i chos srid la'ang the jus phran bu re byas te 'tsho ba'i lam bu'i thog skya ser gnyis dpung thang shig shig gis bskyed bzhin pa ni kho bo'i rang rnam dum bu 〈skya ser bar gyi mkhas grub〉 ces pa'i brnyan 'phrin 'khrab tshan la gzigs na zhib tu mkhyen nges yin no/ /254

'das song gi rang rgyus ban bun du brjod pa rmi lam snang ba'i zin tho/'das song gi rang rgyus ban bun du brjod pa rmi lam snang ba'i zin tho/'ju skal bzang /lcog ra'i glu dbyangs/nga yang a mar skyes/ yin te spyi lo 1960lor bod byanga'abrog sa cha'i a ma byams ldan zhig la skyes/ nga'i a ma lo na gzhon dus 'byor ba zhan la/ skye 'bras kyang shin tu mtshar bo zhig min/ khyad chos su smra 'os pa ni sems rgyud bzang zhing / byams sems che la/ a ma'i 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes shin tu dam/kho mo'i pha rus khams gtsang dang / ma rus sang sing yin/ de bzhin phran gyi yang sems khams bde thang yin cing / blo phugs klong yangs ba'i 'brog khul skyes pa zhig yin pa la/ blo rtse cung rgod cing spyang grung 'dzoms/ dpe 'dren go skon gyi skad cha'i sgyu rtsal la mkhas shing / yid 'gugs 'go bsdu yi rtsa 'dzugs nus pa ldan/mi chos kyi blo rtse grung nger yod pa nga las ldab 'gyur gyis lhag pas/ a pha ni da lta ba'i bar nga'i sems ljongs kyi skyes pa pho yi mtshon dpe yin/ khong gi pha rus 'ju (nga'i rus kyang de yin pa bshad ma dgos)dang / ma rus wa shul bkra za yin/255

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/nged cag gi khyim rgyud kyi rus ni sgo spa'am sgo pa zhes pa yin te/ rus sgo rang gi che bstod skabs bod gna' bo'i rus la/ ‘‘bse rmu stong ldong rus chen bzhi/ zhang po sgo dang lnga ru gyes’’ zhes pa'i sgo yi rus rgyud yin pas sgo pa yin zhes kyang smra/gong smras bzhin a pha ni nga'i mig dpe yin te/ ngas byis sgrung mang bo zhig a pha las thos shing / klog slob ba'i dge rgan dang po'ang a pha yin/ nga'i byad bzhin dang skyes gzugs a pha dang shin tu 'dra bar ma zad/ a pha'i gshis khams dang spyod lam gyis nga la bag chags dang shugs rkyen gting zab mo zhig thebs yod pas/ nga'i gtam spyod dang rnam 'gyur kun gyi khrod a pha las brgyud ba'i grub cha nyin bzhin je mang dang je gsal du 'gro bzhin yod/gal te/ a phas skabs de'i 'brog mi dkyus ma zhig gi mig rgyang las brgal ba'i blo rgya la brten nas nga rang slob grwar bskyal ba min na/ ji ltar byas kyang de ring gi rtsom yig 'di 'dra gtan nas 'bri mi srid/nga rang 'jig rten 'dir 'ong nas thengs dang bor mthong ba ni a ma'i zhal ras lags shing / thengs dang por btung ba a ma'i nu zho lags/ ngas kyang 'dzum dkar dang po a mar bstan la/ 'khang ra dang po'ang a mar byas/ 'jigs nyen byung tshe dang po 'bod sa a ma yin la/ lto ba ltogs tshe dang po 'tshol bya a ma yin/ a ma la 'jigs snang med pas legs nyes ci byung zhu phod cing / a ma la zilaganon med pasa.a ma'i bka' lasa'agongs bar phod/ nga la ma ṇi yig drug gi 256

'das song gi rang rgyus ban bun du brjod pa rmi lam snang ba'i zin tho/lung a ma las thob cing / skyabs 'gro dang sgrol ma a ma las bslabs/ a mas nga rang khrid nas skam la nye ba'i chu 'khor zhig las nya lcong mang po rdzing bu gzhan du gnas spo byas pas/ ngas tshe srog gi rin thang la go ba dang po de las lon cing /ma bcos pa'i snying rje dang byams sems dang por de las rtogs la/ bod mi rnal ma zhig byed pa'i gshis rgyud kyi rtogs pa dang po de las brnyes/ a mas dbul po nyam thag dang rgan rgon bdag med la zas gos tshun chad phangs med du byin cing / de dag la dman sdang dang gtsang dme med par gces skyong dang rogs ram byed pa las/ nga la mi lus kyi thob thang 'dra mnyam yin cing / bde sdug gi 'gyur ba rnam pa tsam du zad pa'i slob gso thog mar thob / gzhan yang ngas zol med dang / drang bden/ lhag bsam rnam dag dang gzhan don bla med ces pa sogs da lta mang pos rtsis med du dor yang rang la gces thang che ba'i tha snyad mang po zhig a ma las bslabs pas a ma'i bka' drin gzhal du med/da lta nga'i a ma dgung grangs mtho tsam du son yod kyang da dung nged cag bu bu mo dag la rtag par sems khral byed bzhin yod la/ nged cag kyang a ma la sems pa sngar las 'phreng bzhin yod de/ de sngon kho bos snyan rtsom zhig tu 'di ltar bris myong /'gro khar a ma la thod pa lan gcig baspos/sa pasasnyi drags pa'i sems pa de257

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/dpral gnyer gyi dra rgyar yun ring thogasanyin bzhin dkar ba'i skra lo der bltas kyinangu snying zhig gting nas 'ong yang nga la a mas dang por bslabs pa ni'adzum dkar lags pasabyis pa'i gtan tshigabyis pa rer rang rang gi 'jig rten re yod cing /byis pa rer rang rang gi gtan tshig re yod/nga rang byis pa'i dus kyi gtan tshig ni shin tu sla ste/rgyang ring gi ri rgyud nam mkha' dang mnyam par snang ba de gnam sa'i 'brel mtshams yin/pha yin phyir a pha zhes 'bod dgos pa las/'ga' zhig a pa zhes 'bod par rgyu mtshan brjod du med pas nor/lwa ba brjes nas shig 'chi ru 'jug pa des shig ltogs grir 'chi dgos pas 'u cag gi zas skal bcad pa dang gcig yin phyir lus la shig ji ltar mang yang rang dgar 'jog pa las 'os med byis pa'i dus su/nga rang res 'ga' spyang po yin cing /rig pa bzang /rang lo drug par rang gi pha las yi ge'i klog yun tsam la bslabs pas/dbyangs gsal so bzhi bo lugs 'byung dang lugs ldog gang ltar byas kyang shar mar klog thub cing /ṭ+wāṃ 5ṭ+wāṃ bzhin gyi dbyibs tsam blo ngor 'bri shes par gyur bas kun gyis ya mtshan

'das song gi rang rgyus ban bun du brjod pa rmi lam snang ba'i zin tho/mtshan byed/ yang nyin zhig nga rang a zhang gi gzhug ded nas rdzi bor phyin/ dgong mo phyir slebs tshe zog kha shas da dung ri 'gor lhag 'dug pa la nged kyi a mas a zhang la mang du spros song pa nga'i blo ngor shin tu ma 'thad par kha pho dang bcas gcig pur gsang stabs kyis zog de dag 'ded du phyin/ lam bar du sa rub pas/khyim mi dag nga rang 'tshol du 'ong nas nga'i ming nas 'bod bzhin pa thos/ lan 'deb rtsis la byis sgrung 'ga' zhig tu mtshan mo 'dre dag mi srog len du 'ong tshe mi de'i ming nas 'bod/ de la lan byin tshe srog 'chor la ma byin na kho rang thabs zad nas phyir log 'gro zer ba phral mar dran pas lan ster ma phod/ 'on kyang gal te mi yin na ni lan ma byin tshe nga rang gang du yod mi shes pas mi rnyed snyam ci bya gtol med par gyur ba na/ glo bur du thabs rnyed de/ a ma'i ming nas phar rgyang 'bod byas pas/ de dag gis nga rang bde blag tu rnyed la/ nga'i srog kyang 'dre la ma shor/ 'on kyang res 'ga' ni shin tu glen pa'ang yin te/ nga rang rang lo brgyad la lon pa'i lo der thon skyed ru khag gi yong 'bab bgo bsha' rgyag skabs kyi gnas tshul gleng skabs shig la/ nga'i a phas 'u tshang gi skar grangs na ning las nyung bar 'dug ces smras pa thos pas/ ngas de 'phral ‘‘mi srid de/ da lo nga rang gcig pa'i thob skar la'ang mi nyung ba zhig yod’’ smras pas/ khong tshos nga'i gdong la mtshar ltas byed / ngas ‘‘yin te/ ngas rgyugs sprad thengs rer skar ma dgu bcu tham pa man du lhung ma myong ’’ zhes 'grel bshad byas pas/ tshang ma hab cha 259

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/thag ger song / yang skabs shig a pha la tha mag nyung ngu las med pa la/ rgyun par gzhan la tha mag slong bas kha 'phud mkhan zhig yod pa de nged tshang la 'ong ba mthong 'phral/ a phas tha mag bag cha zhig nga la sprad nas de mi mthong sa zhig tu sbos shig ces bgo ba bzhin bgyis/ 'grul ba des ja btung zin nas phyir log rtsis byed skabs/ ngas 'grul ba de latsha‘khyod kyi ngas tha mag gang du sbas yod pa ye nas ma khed pas/ da khyod rang pham song / ma ṇi tshar gcig thon dang ngas khyed la ston chog’’ ces smras pas rang gzhan tshang ma shin tu bag mi pheb par byas song /ci yin mi shes pa'i rgyu mtshan zhig gis nga rang chung ngu nas slob grwa la 'gro dga' bo yod/ da lo slob ma bsdu rgyu'i las 'gan yod ces pa zhig a pha'i zhal nas thos pa'i nyin nas bzung / ngas u tshugs mtha' skyel gyis nga rang slob grwar 'gro rgyu yin ces smras pa la brten/ rang lo bdun par dpon skor slob chung du zhugs/ lo bcu'i steng nas rgyu mtshan 'ga' zhig gi dbang gis phyir khyim du log nas bsdad yod pa la/ rang lo bcu drug tu lon pa'i dbyar dus kyi nyin zhig la bod skad rgyang sgrog las mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo nas slob ma bsdu grub byed bzhin yod zer ba tsam thos pa nas bzung yang bskyar u tshugs byas mthar/a phas rang rtogs dang a ma dang a phyi gnyis gzhan dbang du gyur nas nga rang slob grwar 'gro bar 'thad pa byung / de bzhin rgyu rkyen rten 'brel mang po lhan du 'dzoms pa'i dbang gis nga'i ha cang tshad las brgal ba'i nyam sems de 'dra yang 260

'das song gi rang rgyus ban bun du brjod pa rmi lam snang ba'i zin tho/mngon du gyur bas/ spyi lo 1975lor nga rang glo bur du mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i slob mar gyur/ngas slob 'bring gi slob tshan ma bklags shing / slob chung gi slob tshan hril bo de lo gsum tsam gyis bton zin khul byas/ bklags thag chod ni 〈ma'o tse tung gi gsung rtsom gces btus〉 yin la/ bklags thag chod ni 〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉 kyi sgrung dpe yin/ nga rang lo bdun steng slob chung du zhugs skabs slob gnyer dga' tsam yinate/ dge rgan lags nas ‘‘ka (la) ga bzhag kag ’’sogs bslabs pas kha (la) ga bzhag sogs slob mi dgos par rang sdo/gas kyis sgra gdangs kyi chos nyid dang bstun nas klog thub par yod/ de dus slob chung gi slob tshan la bod kyi skad yig dang bod skad kyi grangs rtsis tsam las cher med pas/ de lo gcig dang phyed tsam gyis yongs su shes khul gyi nga rgyal zhig byas pas/ dge rgan lags nas nga la dmigs bsal byas te slob khrid du zhugs mi dgos par gcig pur ṭ+wāṃma'o rtsom〉klog tu bcug de nas lo gcig lhag ring ngas 〈ma'o rtsom〉 deb dang bo nas bzhi ba bar yun gyis bklags pas/ ‘‘gral rim’’ dang ‘‘gsar brje ’’ sogs kyi dgongs pa ma lon yang bod yig la goms 'dris ches cher song / phyis yul du phyin tshe sgrung yig dang gsar 'gyur sogs g.yas g.yon dang mgo mjug phyogs gang rung gi ngos nas bklags kyang shin tu dag cing mgyogs pa gzhan las lhag par klog nus pa tsam du 'dug /261

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/byis pa'i dus kyi 'tsho ba dran yul na rtag par gsal ba ni dpon skor slob chung na yod skabs kyi skor yin pas/ spyi lo 1985lor kho bo ched du gnas der zhib par blta ru phyin/ gnas de ni bod mdo khams sgang drug las rma rdza sgang la gtogs pa'i byang stod snying lung gtsang bo dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram rgyud yin/ de yang srib ngos kyi ri rgyud dag shing phran glang ma dang / nya phrug su mā snyag ma sogs kyis rdzong mthug por dkrigs pas mdog gnag la mdangs snum/ nyin ngos kyi ri tshogs dag 'jam men rtswa ljang gi lo mas khebs pa la/ dbyar dus ri 'dabs kyi gdong phran dang leb ngos dag tu sa mtho'i ri skyes kyi me tog mon dkar dang / dngul tig mkhan pa gser mgo zangs tig me tog ser chung (me tog kha tsha)/ sa zhag dkar po/ 'jib rtsi dkar po dang smug po/ dpal ldan jo bo rje gang gi zhal nas rgya gar na med pa bod yul gyi bsod nams su bsngags pa'i me togo shang shango dri+ol bu smug po dang dkar ser / u pa la ser bor grags pa rkyang shag chun pa sags dus dang bstun nas sa khugs dang sa khugs gang bar skyes pa dkar ser dmar gsum gyi tshon ris ched du byugs pa lta bu la nyi 'od phog tshe 'od mdangs lam lam 'tsher bas ma goms pa'i mig la gzan pa ster bar byed/ bar gyi ne'u gsing gi thang du rtswa sngon gyi smyu gu phra la thung ngu skyes pas khebs po la/ spong sha shin tu sra zhing mtshams motshams su spang drego nago po dang dkar pa thar thar du chags pas cung zad khra bar yang snang / dgang zhags su 262

'das song gi rang rgyus ban bun du brjod pa rmi lam snang ba'i zin tho/bsil rlung yang bar ldang bas me tog dang rtsi sman sna tshogs kyi dri ngad phyogs dang phyogs su skyel bar byed pas khams dang snang ba dwangs bar skyed pa bod byang 'brog gi bag chags brtas pa zhig la snang ba dga' zhing tshor ba skyid pa'i nyams shig bsnyon med du stob par byed/gnas de na a ma rog ma dang a ma dred mos gro ma rta mgo tsam brkos shul mthong du yod cing / kho bo'i byis dus kyi dgod sgra dang bag yangs kyang a lce 'brug mo'i mgul rgyan dang lhan cig 'thor yod/ yin te/ pha gi'i spo tho las byas pa'i khang bu gzhogs gcig zhig ral du gyur cing / cig shos da dung yar bzhengs pa'i ngos su rtswa sdum gyis kun nas dkris pa de ni nga rang dang por slob gnyer byas pa'i gnas te/ de dus kyi dpon skor slob chung gi khang shul lags/de dus sdod gnas spo tho yin la/ mal khri'ang spo tho yin/ mu 'brel mal khri ring mo de 'dra'i steng nged cag mi bcu skor lhag re mda' mo phreng la bsgrigs pa ltar star chags su nyal bar byed pas/ shig dang sro mong la za kha shin tu dar te/ phreng mgo nas phreng rnga bar rigs rgyud myur ba myur bar spel nus shing / lto rgyab kyi longs spyod 'bel bor yod/ nged cag slob bu dag ni de las ldog ste/ thun mong du za khang bya ba med par slob ma rang gis bzung 'ong ba'i gro chas tsam la brten nas 'tsho ba skyel dgos pas gro chad pa'i gnas tshul su la'ang rtag tu 'ong / slob ma che gras dag ‘‘gro leb ’’ bam ‘‘gro sdong ’’ bya ba'i brda chad cig lag bstar 263

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/byed dga' bo yod pas/ rtag par mi du ma'i gro chas gcig tu bsres nas mnyam pas bza' bar byed/ de lta bu'i thun mong ring lugs chen po las ‘‘thun mong min pa'i ’’ mjug 'bras shig nged cag chung gras dag gi mgo la 'ong bzhin yod pa phyis su dpogs/ phan tshun 'bar 'thab kyi gnas tshul ni ‘‘rgyun mthong nad rigs ’’ shig yin pas/ bdag gis kyang lcags gri btsa' bo thang nas rnyed pa zhig bzung nas mi gsod pa'i dam bcas pa dran/ 'on kyang rtag par ni chur ba rdog po che ba zhig 'phangs pa dbral bar babs pa'am/ rtsam ldur tsha mo zhig steng du pho ba tsam gyis ngud mo 'don pa'i sdar ma mdo shor zhig yin/ stabs legs pa la phran pa byis pa'i dus su rgan gzhon su yi'ang snying du sdug tsam yin la/ lhag par du slob grogs bzang po rig 'dzin phrin las dang karma chos 'phel sogs kyis rtag par bdag skyong byed cing / a lce mo bzang bo zhig gis kyang rgyun par gces skyong byed pas/ yi pham pa'i don dag cher ma byung ba 'dra/de dus su nga yis glu dang la gzhas mang du shes shing / sgrung dang gna' gtam 'chad la dga'/ res 'ga' gcig pur gnas tshe spang thang du gan rkyal du log nas nam mkha'i sprin gyi 'du 'god kyi dbyibs dang rnam pa la bsam nas/ 'di ni ne tso gtam pa dang / de ni a khu spyang ki yin par rab tu rtog bzhin yun ring 'gor 'gro ba'ang yod/ de bas kyang rtsed 'jo rigs sna tshogs la shin tu dga' bas/ pha gi'i chu 'gram dang / ma gi'i gad rgyud/ ya gi'i thang khugs 264

'das song gi rang rgyus ban bun du brjod pa rmi lam snang ba'i zin tho/sogs gang du'ang nged cag rtse ma myong ba'i gnas med pa kho thag yin/ nga tshor bod snga rabs dus kyi byis pa tshos gsar gtod byas pa'i mtho sgang 'brog khul gyi khor yug dang 'tsham pa/ shes rab kyi sgo mo 'byed cing / brtson 'grus mal las slong la/ lus sems bde thang ngang 'tshar du long ba'i grogs su 'gro ba'i rtsed 'jo'i rnams grangs bgrang las 'das pa zhig yod pa las/ nged cag rgyun par rtse la dga' ba ni a yas(a phyi)res rnga dang / 'bri belā wa sha khyi/ 'brug skor ba/phreng ba rgyab 'jog rgya lug bsha'/ khra byilā 'ben le'u bdun ma/ zla nyi ma/bzha' res 'tshol res/tha gu thag lding sogs yin la/ gzhan yang nged cag gi kha skad la chab 'phen pa zes pa 'ba' rde'u rtse ba ste/ rnam grangs la'ang btsan chab dang / sgur chab/ spungs chab/ mi grags chab/ rgya chab rkang lo/ shwa chab sho'u chab/ri bong spra chab sogs dang / dgu 'grig dang / gcug 'grig hor gling g.yul 'gyed/ rgyal po mgo gcig nas mgo brgyad bar sogs mig mang gi rigs sna tshogs bcas rtsen pas/ slob khrid kyi bar gseng sogs ngal gso'i dus tshod yun gyis 'phul bar byed/de ltar yol song / 〈ma'o rtsom〉dang gling sgrung tsam gyi khar 〈kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung 〉 dang / 〈rtsa mdo chu mdo〉 la'ang bag chags cung tsam zhig 'jog khul byas pa las gzhan/ rig pa dwangs zhing rang bzhin ma bcos pa byis pa'i dus ni phal cher de ltar rnam g.yeng dang rtsed 'jo'i ngang nas yol song /265

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/de lta na'ang / gal te nga la byis pa'i 'tsho ba de yang skyar 'go nas 'dzin pa'i go skabs shig thob na ni/ bdag gis slar yang gnas de ka ru tshul de ltar gtong ba las gdam nga gzhan du mi byed thag chod yin/lang tsho'i 'gyur khugs/ngas skad cha chen po de tsam lab ma myong / 'on kyang nga la phugs bsam bya ba zhig yod myong la/ de'i don du kha pho'ang bcangs myong / ngas na tshod chung ngu'i dus nas 'di phyogs la bsam blo 'di 'dra zhig skor myong / 'jig rten na mi skyes pa grangs med/ gnam sa sgul skyom byed pa'i bya bzhag chen po rtsom thub mkhan re gnyis las med la/ de 'grub mkhan de bas dkon/ de lta na 'ang dkyus ma dag la'ang rang dang 'tsham pa'i mi tshe'i dmigs bya re yod na cis mi chog /de la rab yin na phyi rabs la lag rjes re 'jog dgos/ de min kyang rang nyid gcig pu'i lto rgyab tsam kho na las ci yang 'dang rgyag med pa ni shin tu tha shal snyam pa'i blo zhig yod/ phyis de lta bu'i blo de rim gyis 'phags nas mi rigs kyi don bya ba zhig kyang yid la bcangs myong / de yang shes brtson gnyis ldan gyi gna' bo'i mi rigs 'di'i la rgya zin pa shin tu dka'/ 'on kyang rang nyid bod kyi a mar skyes phyin mi rigs de'i rkang mi 'dru ba'am mtshang du ma gyur ba zhig cis kyang dgos zhes snyam myong mod/ da lta 'di ltar lab na kun gyi 'phya bzhad 'ong / 'on kyang 266

'das song gi rang rgyus ban bun du brjod pa rmi lam snang ba'i zin tho/slob gnyer sogs kyi skabs kun tu ni de'am 'di'i ched du yin snyam pa'i blo zhig skyes pa mi dran la/ tha na skabs mang po zhig du bslab par bya ba gang shes na phan pa ci zhig bdog tsam la'ang 'dang rgyag ma myong bar/ 'di cis kyang shes dgos tsam kho na snyam nas yod/gong smras bzhin nga rang lo na chung zhing rig pa gsal ba'i dus su slob gnyer gyi skal ba cher ma ldan mod/ glo bur du ‘‘rig sad de’’ slob grwa chen mo'i slob mar gyur ba'i tshe'ang ‘‘'brog dben’’du yun ring bsdad pas mthong thos nyung phyir klad pa stong hang nger yod pa'i rkyen yin pa 'dra ste/ rig pa 'jug bde la dran bzang ba tsam yin/ gang ltar dge rgan dag thabs mkhas thugs rje che bas slob gnyer la ngal ba cher ma myangs la/ dus mtshungs su phar khong rnams la'ang dka' ba dang sun snang chen po ma bskyed snyam/ phyis bka' drin mnyam pa med pa'i slob dpon chen mo 7dmu dge rin po che nas snyan ngag khrid skabs khong gi zhal rgyun khag gcig yig thog tu spel ba sogs zhabs zhu cung tsam yang yong / skabs de dag tu mkhas pa'i dbang po dung dkar blo bzang phrin las dang / gzan dkar sprul ba'i sku mthong thub bstan nyi ma/ tshe tan zhabs drung rin po che/ shar gdong rin po che/ rdo rgyal sku lo tshang sogs gangs can sa yi bsod nams kyis theg par dka' ba'i dran dbang gser gyi lhun gyi phreng la bsgrigs pa lta bu du ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i skal ba bzang po stes dbang gis thob/ de bzhin che ba du 267

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/ma'i khyad chos dang bcas deng rabs bod kyi na gzhon mkhas pa'i gral 'go 'dzin pa sku zhabs don grub rgyal lags nas kyang lta rgya'i sgo mo yangs bar 'byed cing dpyod pa'i blo la rno ngar 'byin pa'i zab khrid du ma bstsal cing / las bya'i mjug tu/‘‘skyes sbyangs rig pa'i 'gros ldan cang shes khyod/ /rnam g.yeng le lo'i sgrog tu ma tshud par/ /shes rab brtson pa'i lcag gis skul mdzod dang / /shes bya'i thang chen chod la gdon mi za/ /’’ zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pas dbugs dbyung yang gnang / 'on kyang kho bo da lta le lo'i sgrog tu tshud/ shes brtson gyi lcag kyang bor/shes bya'i thang mtha' tsam yang ma zin par lus pa khong gis ga la dpogs/yin te/ kho bo'i mi tshe phyed ka de phal cher snyom las kyi ngang nas shor song /kho bo rang lo bcu gsum pa pha yul du sdod pa'i skabs/ bod kyi gso rig 'dzin pa grags can mgo log stag bla nor bu'i dngos slob ngang ba dpal mgon dang rgya'i sman pa ming grags can gnyis kyi rjes su zhugs te gso ba rig pa la sbyang khul tsam byas kyang lha rje byed ba'i las ma 'ong / rang lo nyi shu'i steng rdzong dril sgrog pu yi pu krang gi 'gan khur zhing / 'gro khrid rnam pa tshos kyang srid 'dzin phyogs 'tshar du longs pa'i re bzhag mi chung bar bzung yang / ‘‘dpon sa’’ zin pa'i mi min pa 'dra/ phyis ngan pa yas sar bzhag ste/ mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo sogs kyi dge rgan dang /krung go'i bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi zhib 'jug pa/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi rtsom sgrig las ka sogs las rigs 268

'das song gi rang rgyus ban bun du brjod pa rmi lam snang ba'i zin tho/sgrib pa'i go skabs thob thob tu 'ong yang / mjug mthar de yi skal ba'ang ma ldan/chung ngu'i dus su 'gyur yig yun ring bklags pa'i bag chags kyi ‘‘'phen pa’’yin nam lo tsā ba yi las la zhugs pas da lta skad sgyur zhus chen gzhon pa'i ming tsam 'dzin khul byed/de lta na'ang 'bras bu cung zad thob pa ni bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi phyogs yin pa 'dra/ byis pa'i dus su gna' sgrung yag po re la nyan rjes 'phral mar de la lad rtsom byas pa'i gna' dpe 'dra chag res byis pa gzhan dag la tshegs med du ‘‘mgo g.yog’’ gtong thub cing / gnam la gza' skar bkra ba dang / sa la gtsang chen rgyu ba/ bar snang du sprin pa ldang ba sogs la yun ring had bltas kyi ngor rtog bsam gzhigs kyi rgyun ma ring du rkyong thub pa sogs lhan skyes kyi bag chags su 'chad rung tsam yod pa'i khar/ phyis su rig pa'i 'gro phyogs sgyur stangs dang blo kha khrid phyogs sogs kyi dbang gis rtsom rig dang khyad par snyan ngag phyogs la mos pa lhag tsam thon/ brtson pa cung zad kyang byas/ khyad par du rang bzhin mi rigs kyi gna' deng la mig ltos byed yul 'dod blo tshim tshim du yod pas/ lad zlos kyi rkang 'gros khyar ma khyor du sgyur thub pa byung / de bas kho bos nga rgyal byas te/ ‘‘rgyab na pha nor rig pa'i gangs ri de brtan cing / /mdun na mig ltos gsar ba'i skyed tshal 'di yangs pa/ /na chung snang ba skyid pa'i glu dbyangs shig longs dang / pha rje bu yis zin la the tshom rang mi 'dug /’’ ces 269

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/'ud kyang lab shar/da lta phyir 'dang brgyabs tshe/ chung ngu'i dus nas rtsom yig 'bri ba la dga' tsam yin tshod 'dug ste/ phran pa rang lo bcu drug par mi rigs slob grwar rgyugs sprod rtsis skabs/ dge rgan gu ru rgyal lags nas tshod bgam phyir rtsom yig cig phris zhes bka' bgos ba bzhin de 'phral ‘‘rtsom yig ’’ring thag chod cig bris/ nang don ci zhig bris pa da lta mi dran la/ yi ge'ang shin tu mi dag mod/snang ba la las sla ba zhig shar ba'i mod thogs rdugs med par bris/ yun ring song bas dge rgan lags kyang sgug ma tshugs pa 'dra ste ‘‘bris e tshar ’’ zhes lan 'gar dris par ngas ma tshar zhes lan smras pas/ khong nas ‘‘da de tsam gyis chog ’’ ces nan gyis tshod 'dzin dgos pa byung / da lta bsam na shin tu dgod bro ba nyog la ring ba zhig bris yod pa thag gis chod mod/ rang la ni yin snyam gyi snang ba zhig shar/ phyis slob gnyer gyi skabs dag tu snyan ngag sogs slob tshe/nang don 'gro phyogs shig go ba tsam nas de la lad zlos sam de dang phyogs mtshungs pa'i rig pa'i 'gro phyogs shig 'tshol la dga' ba'i snyad cig yod/ de'i dbang gis skabs de dag tu rtsom rig gsar rtsom phyogs su brtson mkhan phal cher med la/ phal mo cher mtshon na/ snyan ngag bya ba phyi rabs pa dag la go ba skon phyir sngon gyi mkhas pas mdzad pa yin phyir de'i dgongs don rtogs par bya ba zhig yin pa las/ de dang de 'dra gsar rtsom byed pa ni ci nas kyang 'os su mi 270

'das song gi rang rgyus ban bun du brjod pa rmi lam snang ba'i zin tho/che ba'i las shig yin cing / tha na 'phya bzhad kyi yul zhig tu rnam par rtog pa'i gnas tshul 'og spobs pa bskyed nas las bya sogs kyang mi dgos bzhin du gna' rtsom la lad zlos byas te bris/ stabs legs pa la dge rgan gu ru rgyal lags nas khyad gsod ma byas par khong gi thugs la bde ba'i las bya snyan ngag tu 'bri khul byas pa zhig slob grwa'i rigs gzhung dus deb tu mtshams sbyor byas song ba dus deb nyid du (1977lor)bton pa phran gyis dang por spel ba'i snyan rtsom du gyur/ de dus nga rang rang lo bco brgyad yin pas/ drod chung dang byis blo gcig tu bsdongs pas yid dga' ba la zungs khrag khol ba tsam byung / de nas bzung snyan ngag gsar rtsom phyogs la bag chags cung zad brtas te/ ra min lug min sna tshogs shig bris shing spel nas rang dang gzhan gyi dga' skyo chags sdang yang yang bslangs/da lta'i bar dus deb sogs su spel ba'i snyan rtsom rkyang ba'i grangs brgya skor las brgal cing / skor zhig bod kyi snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs du ma dang zhing gcig ljongs lnga'i slob grwa chung 'bring gi gcig gyur slob deb tu bsdus/ snyan ngag rig gzhung skor gyi zhib 'jug ched deb cigadang / snyan rtsom phyogs bsgrigs deb chung zhig par du bskrun/ rang lo nyer bdun par bod kyi rtsom rig hra'o hri bya ba'i ming gog cig blangs/ rtsom rig gsar rtsom dang phul byung brtsams chos sogs kyi phyogs zhing chen phyi nang gi bya dga' thengs du mar blangs shing / stes dbang 271

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/gis 1991lor kung go rtsom pa po'i mthun tshogs dang krung hwa rtsom rig thebs rtsa'i tshogs pa nas gnang ba'i krung go'i krong krung win rtsom rig bya dga' zhes pa'ang de sngon thob mkhan bod mi nyag gcig gi ngos nas kho bor thob/'on kyang de dag ni de ka tsam du zad de/ rang gis brtag ngor ni phran gyis de sngon 'bri khul byas pa dag shin tu ma nges pa zhig ste/ res 'ga' ni rang la'ang yid 'gul thebs su 'jug nus shing / res 'ga' rer ni ci yang ma yin la gang du'ang ma slebs pa'i lab rdol za zi tsam du zad/ cung yin snyam du brtsi ba dag la'ang yid brtan 'pher med de/ spyir spyi tshogs kyi 'gyur ba dang sgos rang sems bslu brid can 'di'i rjes su 'brang ste bsam pa'i 'khyer so yang yang 'gyur bar byed pas/ da lta bklags tshe rang nyid la'ang skyengs pa ster bar byed pa'i sngar gyi rtsom dag kyang deng thog spel ba'i dus der ni blo ngor 'bab po zhig gam tha na shin tu mtshar snang yang skyes myong / de la bsam na phyis sam da lta'i lta tshul 'di la'ang gdeng khel chog pa'i gnas lugs til tsam ma mchis/ de'i phyir nga'i 'di yin snyam pa'i u tshugs 'dzin ma myong la/ gzhan gyi de ma yin snyam pa'i snyon 'dzugs ni de bas kyang byed ma myong /de ltar na'ang / kho bo col chung bas klog pa po'i ngo 'dzum gyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa'i zhad cig yod la/ khyad par rgyu mtshan gzhan yod mi srid la yod kyang med pa'i ‘‘ngo bstod ’’ la gtsigs su 'dzin te/ de la rang gis nyag nyog tu 272

'das song gi rang rgyus ban bun du brjod pa rmi lam snang ba'i zin tho/bris pa de dag klog mkhan dag la dgos mkho e yod rtogs thub/ de sngon chab mdo'i phyogs kyi klog pa po zhig gis rtsom dpyad lta tshul snying bsdus shig tu lo shas ring 〈sbrang char〉 du bkod pa'i snyan rtsom khrod 'ju skal bzang gi 〈ka rtsom gnod sbyin pho brang dkrugs pa'i 'phrul 'khor〉 dang / tig ta yis brtsams pa'i 〈gru ga gzhan zhig nas mthong ba'i 'jig rten〉 gnyis ka legs par mthong ces smras 'dug pa/ don du gnyis ka kho bo'i rtsom du gyur ba'i stes dbang des bdag la skul ma thebs shing / gdeng drod bsnan pa gzhan las lhag pa byung / da dung blo gros bya ba kho bo'i pir ming du ma shes pas dus deb rtsom sgrig pa rgan pa zhig gi zhal nas kyang gong 'dra'i gtam 'phros byung / de dang de lta bu kho bor sems shed snon pa'i legs skyesasu 'gro ba'am/ yang na bdag gisadapa' rtags bzhag pa'i tshul mi nyung ba zhig yod kyang da lta'i snyom las kyi tshul 'dir bltas kyin yi chad de smra ba la ngo tsha bas bzhag go /de bzhin bdag gi rtsom la skyon brjod gnang mkhan yang yod de/ dang po tsa na ‘‘kha dam drags’’ zhes pa dang / phyis su bsam blo'i cha nas phyogs su lhung ba'am gzhan skyon brjod pa thal ches zhes ngag thog dang yig thog gang rung nas brjod yod/ 'on kyang de la ni ‘‘lan gyis dben pa pham pa'i mthar thug’’tu 'dod pa'i lta ba bzung nas rang la dag sel gyi lan phral mar e 'byor ma bltas/ rgyu mtshan yang spyir rtsom yig gcig gis kyang klog pa po mi 'dra bar 273

semar+sāpa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/bzang ngan bar ma'i tshor ba skyed nges pa bsnyon med yin pas/ bdag gi rtsom bklags tshe khyod la tshor ba legs po kho na 'khrungs dgos pa'i re ba 'dzin pa btsan shed ches la/ rtsom rang ngos kyi ro khyad mi 'dra ba'ang khyad du bsad par snang / de bzhin rtsom pa po zhig la mtshon na gzhan gyis snyan pa brjod tshe mig spus zim zim dang kha spus zhum zhus byas te yod tshad kha rog ngang dang du len cing /mi snyan pa cung zad brjod tshe 'phral mar smin ma bsdus / mig 'bur gces nas ‘‘'di ltar ma yin na khyod la'ang ’’zhes mtshang la rgol bzhin tsham tshom med par rtsod pa'i g.yul ngor bsre ba ni sngon mu stegs pa dang bstan pa'i la rgya rtsod mkhan dag yin na ma gtogs/ rang re'i nang khul la 'os su mi che bar snyam nas btang snyoms su bzhag pa yin/gang ltar da lta rtsom pa po'am snyan ngag pa zhes pa'i ming stong ba zhig thogs zin/ 'di la dge rgan dang grogs po dag gi rogs ram dang skul ma thim yod la/ da lta gtan gyi grogs su gyur ba mos kyang skul ma dang ram 'degs tsam du ma zad/ snyan ngag gi tshor ba yang yang skul myong bas bka' drin mi chung / 'on kyang gang las kyang mang ba ni rang nyid kyi rngul chu dang bsam gzhigs yin par gdon mi za/ de lta na'ang phran pa le lo che ba'i khar/ de sngon log par rtog pa 'di 'dra zhig gi dbang du gyur te/ 'bad pa dang ngal ba ring du bsten ma dgos par 'bras bu gzengs su thon pa ni rig pa'i rang rtsal khyad du thon pa'i rang rtags yin/ de 274

'das song gi rang rgyus ban bun du brjod pa rmi lam snang ba'i zin tho/min sdug rus sha thang chad chad kyi rnga mar 'bras bu cung tsam rnyed pa ni sus kyang nus phyir khyad chos su mi 'dug snyam/ stabs legs pa la lo chung dus sogs su snga ma ltar gyi tshugs ka cung tsam 'ong snyam yang shar/ de 'dra'i mjug 'bras su 'bad pa dang brtson pa bag la zha bas/ ma gzhir 'thob chog gi go skabs dang grub 'bras dag phangs sems dang bcas shor song bas/ da lta bsam na lta tshul 'di 'dra'i nor 'khrul che ba ma byung snyam pa'i blo zhig da gzod skyes/ 'on kyang 'phyis zin pa 'dra/da ni gom pa dang po spos zin/ dpung gral nas ma lhung bar du gsar rtsom gyi snyu gu 'dzin dgos byung yang / gtong la nye/ 'on kyang de sngon bris la deng phyin yang 'bri nges pa'i rtsom nyog dag ni mtshon bya'i bsam blo dang mtshon byed sgyu rtsal gang rung gi cha nas bod mi rigs dang de'i rig gnas gsar bar dngos dang brgyud nas rgya mtshor chu thigs bsnan pa lta bu'i phan pa cung zad cig e yod snyam pa'i kun slong bzang pos bslangs te bris shing 'bri nges sha stag yin/ yin te/'ju skal bzang da dung ‘‘legs na dge mtshan bod la 'bul/ nyes na khag ngan bdag la dkris’’ces pa'i sngar smras kyi tshig la gnas par yid ches gnang rogs dang bcas khyed nyid zhal dro ba'i smon pas re zhig rtsom yig 'di'ang mjug bsdu bar byas sa/ /bdag gis de sngon bris pa'i khrod rang gi blo ngor bde tsam yod pa ni 〈lam 275

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/phran du lus pa'i gtam〉 (don brjod snyan ngag ring mo)yin la/ blor shin tu mi 'bab pa ni/ 〈me mda'i las dbang 〉 yin/bdag gi snang ngor shin tu don la gnas shing rjod byed kyang ches nyams dang ldan pa'i legs bshad ni mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis blun po rang gi rjes su mi 'brang ba/ /rang nyid blun po'i rjes su mi 'brang ba/ /'di ni mkhas pa'i dam tshig dang po ste/ /srog la babs kyang 'bad pas bsrung bar gyis/ /ces pa yin la/ ches khams su mi 'phrod pa'i gshis spyod ni bod mi rigs la khyad gsod gtong ba'i gtam spyod yin/276

gangs ri'i chu phran/ gangs ri'i chu phran/reb gong rdo rje mkhar/kho bo ni lhun stug blta bas mi ngoms pa'i gangs ri lhun po las byung ba'i chu phran zhig ste/ 'dzam bu gling 'di'i yang rtser chags pa'i bsil ldan ljongs su shang shang gi sgra snyan ci dgar sgrog bzhin bzhur zhing / lung khug nas rnyed pa'i rngon pa'i rmi lam rgyab tu khur ba dang / rong 'brog gnyisakyi re sgug gi mig 'od ska rags su bcings te dbang phyogs su lhung lhung dal gyis 'bab par brtson bzhin yod/gangs ri'i ljongs kyi rtswa thang du rnam par bkra ba'i mtshar sdug gi me tog re rer kho bo'i rnam shes kyi mjal dar 'then pa yin nam ci/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi lo'i lo mgo zla ba'i dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gsum pa'i nyin mor kho bo cha rgyus med pa'i nam mkha'i mtha' zhig nas lho bzhud kyi chu 'dzin phung bo zhig dang 'dra bar reb gong rig pa 'byung ba'i grong khyer gyi ya gyal 'jam pha brgya bu stong gi grong du 'ongs shing / the tshom dang 'jigs skrag gi bar nas rgyus med pa'i 'tsho ba'i lam sne zhig rnyed tsa na/ nga'i ming la rdo rje mkhar zhes btags te dka' 277
