semasapa'i rtsomagyi lam bu/myong dbyad phra mo'i bsangagator/rgan gyi bya ba 'di rmad pa la ang snyam/gan+da/ma/bgrang bya bcu phrag gcig gi ring la/ bdag gisami rigs kyi skyo ba'i zlos gar la 〈phangs pa'i mchi ma dbang med du bton〉pa dang / mi rigs kyi 〈dka' sdug gi lo zla〉 skyo ba'i ngag tu zlos pa dang / mi rigs kyi da lta'i 〈'pho 'gyur/〉la bstod pa'i snyan ngag bris/ bdag gis gnyid la yur ba'i mi rigs 'dir 〈skya rengs lha mo'i 'bod brda〉 thog mar bsgrags pa dang / 〈zhogs ka'i cong sgra'i〉khrod da so ma sad pa'i mi rigs 'di'i 〈mdun skyod kyi goms sgra〉 la 'thab rnga brdungs pa dang / bdag gis mi rigs 'di'i 〈slar yang sad pa'i rnam shes 〉kyi rmad byung 〈phugs bsam〉 la gnam 'phang gcod pa'i gshog 'gyur skyed/bdag gis dus rtag tu bdag gi lhag bsam dkar ba'i 〈re 'bod〉 la a lan yod par rlom pa dang / bdag gi 〈ches thog ma'i tshor snang 〉gi 'grel bshad la go ba yod par re/bdag gi sgrung gtam dang snyan ngag de tsho la gnangs pa'i bya dga' ni/bdag gi gsar rtsom gyi grub 'bras yi gdeng 'jog dang / bdag gi gsar rtsom gyi mdun lam gyi rting skul du sems pas/ da so ma lam sna zin pa'i nga rang /rgyang thag ring la dka' sdug che ba'i gsar rtsom gyi lam chen 'dir/ sngar bzhin 340

rang gi byung ba hril gyis brjod pa rgyud mangs rol dbyangs/bsam gzhig dang 'char yan/ lhag bsam dang dungs zhen/ hur brtson dang 'acesal snyeg gis skyod dgos snyam/bdag gi sgrung gtam 〈khyod kyi yi ge〉 la krung go'i rtsom pa po'i mthun tshogs mtsho sngon yan lan tshogs pa dang 〈sbrang char〉 rtsom sgrig pu'u lhan 'brel gyis (1981 da wa 1983) 〈sbrang char〉 las phul du byung ba'i rtsom rig dpyad bsdur byas khrod bya dga' ang gsum pa thob pa dang / sgrung gtam 〈dngul gyi sor gdub〉 la kan su'u zhing chen gyi thengs gnyis pa'i grangs nyung mi rigs kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi bya dga' ang gnyis pa (1982 da wa 1985)thob pa dang /snyan ngag 〈rlabs sngon mo〉la rgyal yongs kyi thengs dang po'i 〈gser 'od 'phro ba'i gangs ljongs〉 zhes pa'i rtsom rig dpyad bsdur khrod/ phul byung bya dga' thob pa dang / 1991lor 〈sbrang char〉gyi (1981 da wa 1991)phul du byung ba'i rtsom pa po'i bya dga' thob pa dang / snyan ngag 〈me tog gi 'phreng sems/〉 la kan su'u zhing chen gyi thengos gsum pa'i grang nyung mi rigs kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi phul byung bya dga' thab/ gzhan yang sgrung gtam dang snyan ngag lhug rtsam sags gsar rtsom mi nyung ba zhig mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe bskrun khang gis par skrun mdzad pa'i 〈bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs〉 dang / krung dbyang mi rigs dpe bskrun khang gis par skrun mdzad pa'i rtsom rig dpe tshogs sogs su bdams bsgrigs byas yod/ da lta phyir dran byas tshe/ bdag gi gseng mtho ba'i glu sgra brag 341

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/ca nas brag car brgyud zin pas/ bdag gi zhen che ba'i glu tshig sems khams dang sems khams su nyar yod par sems/ /bzhi/brgyud zin pa'i bgrang bya bcu phrag gcig gi gsar rtsom gyi bshul lam du/bsam gzhig dang brtse rlabs/ spobs pa dang dungs zhen gyis bris pa'i gsar rtsom de rnams mdzub mo nang la bkug nas brtsis tshe/ grangs ka de 'dra nyung ba la ang snyam/ sgyu rtsal gyi srang la gzhal tshe/ la la'i rin thang de 'dra chung ba la ang snyam/ yin na'ang / dus rabs 'dir 'tsho zhing bzhes pa'i bod mi rigs kyi gnas bab dang las dbang de gsar rtsom gyi srog shing du dam por bzung ste/ deng rabs kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs kyis mi rigs rang gi khyad du 'phags pa'i mdzes dpyod lta tshul yang dag par spyad de gsar rtsom bgyis pa de ni kun nas yang dag pa'i gtan gyi bgrod lam zhig tu nges la/ rang nyid kyi nges pa don gyi chu tshad chung chung zhig tu 'dod do/ /lar gsar rtsom ni bod rang gi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi legs char gces 'dzin byas te mi rigs rang gi mdzes dpyod lta tshul rnam par spyod pa dang / rgyal khab phyi nang gi gna' deng rtsom rig gi rtsom snyangs dang nying bcud sdud len byas te dus rabs kyi ngo mtshar khyad chos kun nas ldan pa zhig yin dgos pas na/ de 342

rang gi byung ba hril gyis brjod pa rgyud mangs rol dbyangs/la'ang mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba'i dbu ma'i lta ba zhes smra chog go /srol rgyun kho na mkhregs 'dzin dang bskyar zlos byas pas chog par snyam pa dang / gsar dar kho na slob sbyong dang don gnyer byas pas 'thus par rlom pa gang yin yang / g.yas mtha' la lhung ba min na g.yon mtha' la lhung ba sha stag yin phyir/ gshog ya chad pa'i 'dab chags kyis gnam 'phang gcod par 'dod pa'i zla ru 'gyur ro/ /gal srid nga tsho bsam gzhig dang 'char yan/ lhag bsam dang dungs zhen/khur brtson dang 'tshol snyeg gis gsar rtsom la gzhol na/ kha ba ri ba'i ma 'ongs ba'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal la mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i grub 'bras gsar ba zhig 'byung ba gdon mi za la/ 'dzam gling rtsom rig bang mdzod khrod du'ang rin chen nor bu ru mi 'gyur ba ci la srid snyam/da lta bsam blo btang tshe/ kha ba ri ba'i gsar rtsom la rnying ba bskyar zlos las/ gsar ba dar spel gal mi che'am snyam/ kha ba can gyi gsar rtsom la ri ltar spungs pa'i grangs ka las/ gser ltar brin pa'i spusaka 'gangs mi che'am bsam/lnga/bdag gi ha cang zhan pa'i rtsom ni 〈kan lho la bstod pa pad dkar phreng mdzes〉 zhes pa u+ob ma'i dus skabs su brisatang / bdag gi cung phul du byung ba'i snyan ngag ni 〈skya rengs lha mo'i 'bod brda〉 zhes pa/ ( 〈sbrang char〉 19934)343

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/yin par 'dod/bdag gisachesabazod bsran dka' ba'i spyod tshul ni/ lhun brjid ri bo brko ba dang / rab stug nags tshal bcad nas rang byung gi 'jig rten la gtor brlag dang / rang byung gi mdzesasdug rmeg med du 'joms pa de yin/ bdag gi rang blo rig pa'i gnas dang legs pa'i lam du skul ched/ rang la legs bshad 'di bris/phugs 'dun bral ba'i mi tshe ni/rgyud skud chad pa'i yi wang 'dra/kye/ khyod kyi phugs 'dun gyi rgyud mangs dkrol bar gyis/blo gros nyams pa'i rkang gnyis mi/ral gri stor ba'i gri shubs 'dra/kye/ khyod kyi blo gros kyi ral gri phyar bar mdzod/'byung 'gyur la bsam blo btang tshe/ bdag gi tshe srog ni rtsom rig gsar rtsom dang dus gtan tu 'bral thabs med la/ rtsom rig sgyu rtsal kyang bdag gi bsam blo dang 'bral ba min snyam/ bdag gi snyan ngag ni mtsho byung lha mo dang 'bral thabasamed la/ mtsho byung lha mo'ang bdag gi rnam shesadang 'bral ba min snyam/ de ltar gyur tshe/ bdag gi bde sgyid che la sdug bsngal lci na'ang / de ni rang gis rang la bcangs pa'i yid chesakho nar nges/ /344

nga dang sgyu rtsal gyi lam sne/nga dang sgyu rtsal gyi lam sne/rdo rje rin chen/skye skar/gus po ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i me lug gi lor gcan tsha nyin srib gnyis su phyes pa'i snga ma'i yul gyi char gtogs pa snang ra'i grong brgyad kyi ya gyal gle chen zhes pa'i grong sder skyes/ skyes nyin dpyid nyi ldog tu khel bas ma drin mo che thugs mnyes nas rigs kyi myu gu'i tshe mtha' shin tu 'khyongs shing ring ba'i 'grel bshad 'jig rten du bskyur te gshegs/ phyis su/ gus pos don 'di'i gsang ba dang go don mtha' dag shes nas smra ba 'ga' la dris/ re 'gas mgo bo nang du ldem/ la las gus pos da dung 'grel bshad 'di yid kyi yol gor nyar/rang gshis/gzhan gyis nga yi rang gshis drang ba'i sdom tshig 'jog don du nga'i rang gshis ni ‘‘athi’’ ltar rnyog 'dzing che/ de bas/ nga'i rang gshis ni tshul 'chos kyi dbang gis gzhan gyis dpog par dka'/ gzhan dang bstun ched rang gshis 345

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/kyi rnga sgro re ‘‘mchan 'og’’ nas bud myong / yin na yang / de la sus kyang do snang byed rin med par 'dug brtse dung /rgyang mig cig gis mi yul la skor lta byas tshe tha snyad gsar ba zhig gi go don la nges shes rnyed/ de ni ‘‘brtse dung’’ red/ brtse dung gis snod kyi 'jig rten dang bcud kyi sems can kho na las nga la mos pa bstabs/ yod tshad la ngas gtsigs 'dzin dang 'khreng sems chags pa ni nga rang brtse dung gi dra rgyar lhung bas yin/ don dngos kyis zhu na nga rang rtsom rig la dung ba yang de'i rjes mthun rang yin/myang brgyud/phu bos bka' drin gyis nga rang chung dus nas rtsom rig gi lam 'phrang brgyud/ 〈'od 'tsher ba'i skar ma dmar po/〉 da wa mi sna phan tung tsi/ 〈mi ro rtse sgrung 〉 da wa mi sna dran gsal/ da dung a ce gser mo mtsho dang dngul mo mtsho la sogs pas byisapa'i dus kyi nga rang rmi lam du mjal dka' ba'i zhing khams gzhan la khrid/ rtsom rig gi mos kha de nas bzung sbrang tshang ltar phyes/ phyis su/ ngas sor rtser lcags smyug 'chang ste sgrung gtam dang / lhug rtsom/ snyan ngag sogs mang du bris/ 'on kyang / rtsom sgrig pas re re bzhin phyir bsrings/346

ngadangasgyurtsalagyi+olamasne/'dad mas/sku zhabs lu'u zhun gyi rnam thar gtsang mar bklags myong ba zhig yin na/rtsom rig gi nus stobs dang dge mtshan cig car rtogs srid/ ngas rtsom rig gi nus stobs dang dge mtshan la snying gting nas khas 'ches te de nyid bed spyod gtong bar 'dod/ de bas nga'i 'dod blo ni rtsom rig gi nus stobs dang dge mtshan nas brtsams te kha lo bsgyur mgo tshugs/ de yang / ngas ni mi'i rigs kyi bsam pa'i 'jig rten la sngon thon dang bla na med pa'i bsam blo gsar ba zhig brgyud sgrog byed par 'dod/gnas bab/1994lo'i zla 8par krung go'i spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gi zhib 'jug pa gzhon pa sku zhabs dbyang lags kyis phran la 'phrin yig cig bsrings par/‘‘khyod rang gzi brjid ldan pa'i mi'i rigs kyi bla srog gi bzo skrun pa zhig byas te/ byams brtse nus ldan mi sna bskyed bsring byed par ma zad/ da dung rang gi lcags smyug bkol te rtsom yig legs po spel nas mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba ni bkur du 'os ba zhig red ’’ ces 'khod/ bden don dang 'brel ba'i gtam des nga yi gnas bab thag gis bcad/ nga rang dngos gnas de 'dra'i gnas bab cig tu 'phag 'tshag rgyag347

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/myong tshor/'tsho bas nga la rtag tu phog thug tshad med gtong / de bas/ nga'i 'tsho ba ni dga' sdang chags zhen dang / mya ngan dang 'o dod/ re 'bod dang ngang sgrug gis khyab/gal te/ de lta min na nga la rtsom yig spel ba'i blo stobs dben/ der brten/ nga rang 'tsho ba'i zab sar 'dzul te sgyu rtsal gyi yangs sa nas 'bud par brtsams/bgrang bya nyer lnga rim gyis 'das pa'i khrod/ rtsom rig gis nga la mnar gcod tshad med btang / 'on kyang / sbar kha phyes tshe nga la 'thob bya nyag gcig kyang med par thams cad sgyu rtsal gyis sa bon du 'thims/ stong lhang nge /lta sdo/04/srol rgyun rtsom rig gis da lta'i bod kyi rtsom rig la rmang gzhi phran tsam las bzhag mi 'dug /'di ni nga'i 'dod tshul phran bu zhig lags/ 'di rmang nas 'khrul ba yin kyang srid/ 'on kyang dog 'jug snyan ngag gi bla srog ma nyams par gda'/ de bod kyi rtsom rig gi sku tshab tu bgrang chog skad yig du ma dus gcig tu mkhyen pa'i mkhas dbang dang rtsom mkhan rnams kyi sku drin gtsos pa'i 'og da lta'i bod kyi rtsom rig ni 'phel kha do mi mnyam yang ston zla'i dpal la bsnyegs 'dug pas rang gzhan mnyam bsres kyi ‘‘sha ra bha’’ ltar lags/348

nga dang sgyu rtsal gyi lam sne/rgyang lta/ce khi rgyal khab kyi rtsom rig smra ba'i dbang bo khun ti lwa zer ba des 〈brtsams sgrung gi sgyu rtsal〉 zhes pa'i dpe deb tu ‘‘rtsom rig’’ la 'grel gsar ba zhig gnang 'dug pa ste/ ‘‘da lta'i brtsams chos ni 'gyur gyin 'gyur gyin je nyung red/nga'i bsams par rtsom rig gi 'chi ba thon la nye/ cung tsam nas rjes shul med par mjug mthar rtsa ba nas yal 'gro’’ zhes zer/ phran gyi bsam par de ni snga na med pa'i mkhas pa'i legs bshad du mngon te/ skye zhing 'jig pa ni 'jig rten gyi bzlog med chos nyid lags na/ bod kyi rtsom rig gi 'chi ba yang 'jab bus mi slebs pa ga la srid/ de bas/ 'byunga'agyur nged cag bod kyi rtsom rig dang gtan du gyes pa'i dus su ‘‘rtsom rig’’ gzhan gyi yal gar 'thams te ‘‘nga tsho mnyam du sham bha la ru 'gro’’ choga'abel gtam/'tsho ba ni rtsom rig bskyed pa'i ma ma yin zhingatsho/ rtsom rig ni sngon thon mi sna'i 'gyur khugs bsdebs pa'i glu dbyangs yin/ bod rigs kyi 'tsho stangs la dma' 'bebs gtong ba'i gang zag des nga'i snying la mtshon rma btab/ de ni bzod sgom theg dka' ba'i gnas shig red/ khos mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho ba'i gru ga dang zur mtha' ma mthong bar 'dug ji 'dra'i a re chad/349

semasapa'irtsomagyilamabu/ myongodapyadaphramo'i bsang gtor/rang skyan/da lta'i bar la/ rtsom rig gi dra rgyar lhung ste 'phag 'tshag ji tsam brgyab pa ni sus mkhyen/ 'on kyang / sger gyi 'bri deb tu bris bris dang thun mong gi dus deb tu spel spel mtha' dag las gzhan la ngom so byed chog pa'i brtsams chos shig bstan du med/ tha na rang blo tshim pa'i rtsom yig cig kyang dben pa yin na phyis su de 'dra zhig 'ong thub pa'i re ba snying la 'chang zhing 'dug /phugs re/'tsho ba ni gting zab cing rnyog 'dzing ldan pas rtsom rig gis de nyid khyur mid byed thabs bral/ 'on kyang / ngas rtsom rig gi mche ba rag tu brdar te bod kyi 'tsho ba khyur mid btang rjes slar bskyug par 'dod/ de yang / rtsom rig gi brtsams chos rin thang can zhig bskyed cing 'khrungs pa'i thad la ngas mi tshe'i yod tshad brlag par ya nga ba ci/ mjug mthar/ gzhan gyis dang ba ston pa'am sdang sdig gi mtshon cha ji ltar phab kyang nga rang snang brnyan zhig gi khrod du tshe yi 'phen pa rdzogs nges lags/350

dka' spyad pa zhig gi gom 'gros/dka' spyad pa zhig gi gom 'gros/phun tshogs bkra shis/lo shas gong du bod kyi rtsom rig gar stegs thog tu 'phyur ba'i rba rlabs de gcig las gcig mtho ba dang / deng dus yang de ni zhi 'jam gyi gnas shig tu gyur/ lhag par bod rig gi rtsom rig ni dben por gnas pa'i mtshe'u zhig dang 'dra bar chags nas skye bo rnams kyi snang 'jog skong ba'i nus pa je nyams su phyin/ 'di'i dus la ngas blo khog chen pos rtsom rig gi bya ba dang du blangs nas dben gnas kyi mtshe'u der rdo kha shasadabyug ste skad sgra dang bcas pa'i sgor gzugs chu ris grangs shas bton pa byas/brtsam sgrung 'bring gras〈sgo ras spang ra'i skyo glu lhang lhang〉dang 〈rgyun ldan gyi nyin mtshan〉 〈'das don gyi 'char snang 〉 sogs kyis skye bo rnams kyi snang 'jog skong ba dang mi tshos bod kyi rtsom rig gi gar stegs su dpyid ka gnyis pa slebs pa'i sngon rtags khu byug slebs 'dug ces bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor ba dang / mi rnams kyis rtsom rig gi gar stegs la sngar las lhag pa'i do snang 351

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/dang / sems rtsa 'phel pos do khur byed kyi yod / yang gtam brjod zlos gar thung gras 〈nga tsho'i mag pa slob grwa chen mo ba red〉 ces pa bod zhi bas bcings bkrol btang nas lo bzhi bcu 'khor bar rten 'brel zhu ba'i ljongs yongs kyi skabs dang bo'i gtam brjod zlos gar thung gras kyi 'gran sdur nas bya dga' ang dang po thob pa dang / yang gtam brjod zlos gar thung gras 〈dgod bro ba tsam ma yin〉zhes pa1992lo'i ljongs yongs kyi dpyid gsar dus chen dang bod kyi lo gsar gyi brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal le tshan 'grems gtong nang phul byung gi le tshan nang du tshud pa/ yang gtam brjod zlos gar thung gras 〈'di bstan bzhig slong ba ma red〉 ces pa 1993lo'i zho ston gyi ljongs yongs kyi ched las gtam brjod zlos gar thung gras kyi 'gran sdur nang gsar rtsom gyi bya dga' thob pa dang / yang brtsam bya de 1994lo'i bod kyi lo gsar gyi brtan 'phrin sgyu rtsal mtshan tshogs chen mo'i nang bdams bzhugs byas pa dang / mtshan mo de rang du bod kyi rgya che'i mi dmangs tsho'i spro ba 'phel ba dang / lan mang gzigs par 'dod pa'i 'khrab tshan zhig la gyur zhing / de'i nang gi 'khrab tshig kyang rgyun ldan 'tsho ba'i nang du skye bo rnams kyis ku re'i tshul du gleng bzhin yod/ngas so sos 'bad pa'i las la grub 'bras phran tsam thob pa'i dga' tshor yong dus rang nyid kyi skyod myong ba'i lo rgyus sems dbus su rtag tu 'char gyi 'dugang rang 1960lo'i lo mgor gtsang gnas gzhis ka rtser skyes/ yul de ni bod kyi 352

dka' spyad pa zhig gi gom 'gros/rig gnas kyi lte ba'i gnas bye brag cig yin zhing / lo rgyus thog bod kyi rig gnas la nub mi rung ba'i byas pa rlabs chen 'jog mkhan skye bo phul byung 'bor chen thon pa'i lung ba zhig red/ dus yun ring ba'i lo rgyus nang goms gshis chags pa'i rkyen gyis nga'i pha yul gyi skye bo rnams la dka' spyad bab chags dang /yon tan la snying rus rdo la i khung 'bigs par byed pa'i dbu btsugs ldan yod gshis phyi yul pa rnams kyis ‘‘bdag tsho gtsang pa'i mi la i'i dang i'i pag byung na las la skyug ma bro ’’ zhes 'o cag gtsang ba'i snying rus dang / brtson shugs/bab chags la smad pa'i tshul gyis bstod bsngags gtong gi yod/ yul gshis kyi spyod bzang de 'dra zhig gis shugs rkyen thebs pa'i dbang gis nga rang chung byis pa'i dus nas slob sbyong la 'bad pa dang / lhag par du rig rtsal gyi bya gzhag la ngang ba dpal mtshor 'jug pa ltar gyi spro ba'i ngang bzhugs kyi yod/ ngas slob chung dus nas slob grwa'i nang du rig rtsal gyi bya ba byed mkhan byed pa dang / de ltar rgyun ring du rig rtsal gyi bya gzhag la zhugs pas chung dus nas rang ra'i rig rtsal gyi byang goms brtan po chags pa dang / rim gyis gong mthor 'gro ba byung / de dus nga tsho'i rig rtsal gyi dge rgan ni grong gseb la khyim gzhis btsugs mkhan nas 'then pa'i gzhon nu shes yon can yin zhing / kho tsho ni mkhyen stobs che ba dang /lhag par rig rtsal gyi bya ba kun la mi shes pa sne gcig med pa ltar du shes yon sne 'dzoms zhing / ngas khong tsho'i shes yon la yid smon pa dang / rang nyid kyang kho 353

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/tsho bzhin du rig rtsal gyi shes yon yod na ci ma rung snyam gyin yod/ ngasakhong tshor lad zlos byas nas rig gnas khag la sbyangs pa byas pa dang / skabs rer dge rgan rnams kyang sun snang skyes pa'i bar du nga rang gis 'go ma tshod pa dang / yang mtshan du mthong ba'i don mang po skad cha dris kyi yod/ ngas dus da lta'ang de dus kyi bshes gnyen drin chen de tsho'i bka' drin sems dbus su bcangs bzhin rtag tu bsam par nga la de dus blo sgo 'byed pa'i bshes gnyen 'di 'dra ma 'phrad na da lta'i rig gnas kyi byang tshad ga la yod/ de bas grub 'gras 'di 'dra ga la thob srid/ ma mtha' yang nga rang la grub 'bras thob pa'i dus tshod lo shas kyis 'phyi ba yong rgyu red bsam gyin 'dug /nga rang chung dus skad yig gi slob tshan la shin tu dga' ba dang / rtag tu slob deb nang gi sgrung gi slob tshan la sems g.yengs nas sdod kyi yod/ ngas rtsom bris pa'i sbyong gzhi legs sgrub byed dus slob phrug gzhan las khyad chos che ba zhig bris thub kyi yod gshis rtag tu dge rgan gyis bsngags brjod thob kyi yod/dge 'os slob grwar slob sbyong byed dus nga'i rgya yig gi rtsom yig zhig la bod skyor du phebs pa'i rgya rig dge rgan zhig gis 'di ni rgya nag gi slob phrug gis bris pa'i rtsom las chu tshad mtho ba 'dug ces bsngag brjod gnang ba dang / 'dzin grwa yongs su klog 'don gnang yod/ de ni nga rang la chu tshad 'di tsam rtsa ba nas slebs med rung rgan lags kyis skul ma'i dmigs yul du bsngags pa yin pa 354

dka' spyad pa zhig gi gom 'gros/nges gtan red/ yang bod yig gi sbyang tshan bkod sgrig zhig tu rgan lags kyis nga tshor dmangs khrod kyi sgrung zhig bsdu rub byed dgos gsungs/ ngas bsdu rub byas ba'i sgrung de nang don zab la snyan zhing / sgrig gzhi gsal la go rim ltar chags pa byung nas 'dzin grwa'i nang du dpe mtshon du klog pa dang / bstod bsngags gnang ngo / /bsngags brjod de tshos nga rang rjes su gsar rtsom gyi lam bur zhugs par skul 'ded chen po thebs pa smos ci dgos/ de dus ngas rgya yig gi brtsams sgrung ring gras 〈chu ngogs gtam rgyud〉 dang / 〈brag dmar〉 〈ka'o yud pa'o〉〈khyim tshang〉 〈lang tsho'i glu gzhas〉 sogs go ba len thub la ma thub kyis lta klog byas pa dang / yang ngas glog brnyan mang dag zhig la blta bzhin de tsho'i nang don dang / sgyu rtsal la yid dbang 'phrog nas sdod dus ngas kyang 'di ltar gyi deb dang rtsom bya bri thub na ci ma rung snyam gyi yod/ 'di ltar gyi 'dun pa de na gzhon gyi nga'i sems nang du dbyar rgyas kyi chu bo ltar du 'phel nas ngas thengs shas so sos brtsams sgrung 'bri ba'i bya ba brtsams myong / 'on kyang ngas bris ba'i skabs la rang nyid kyi shes bya dang da dung yang dma' zhing / mi gzhan gyi mig rna'i g.yeng ba skong thub pa'i rig rtsal gyi brtsam bya skrun par nges par du mi'i rnam shes bzo mkhan gyi sgyu rtsal pa la khyad stobs kyi rig rtsal shes bya ldan dgos pa myong tshor zab mo byung / de nas ngas rang nyid mi rabs gsar ba'i blo rig 'byed pa'i dge rgan byed pa'i zhor la sbyong tshan khag rang sbyong gis slob grwa chen mor shes bya'i nor 355

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/bu len par 'gro rgyu'i lta gon la 'jug ‘‘brtson pas blo ldan skye bor gyong gud mi ster’’ ba'i dpe mtshungs su 1984lor nga rang bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i rgya skad yig rtsom rig gi tshan par tshud thub pa byung / ngas shes bya'i 'byung gnas 'di'i nang du bkres ltogs pas rtsam skya la 'thab pa bzhin du rtsom rig gi rig pa'i gzhung lugs rnams go rim ldan pa'i ngang slob sbyong byas pa dang / krung phyi'i grags can gyi rtsom rig khag lta klog bgyis pa yin/ de ltar slob sbyong rgyun ring tsam byas pa brgyud nga rang gi slad kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi bya ba dang du len par rmang gzhi brtan tsam gting thub pa byung / ngas 1987lor thengs dang por brtsam sgrung thung gras 〈bsod rdor dang kho mo tsho〉 bris nas 〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 la bskur ba dang / de nas brtsams bya de dngos su zhwa nye'i par mar gyur nas nga ra'i mig snang du mthong dus dga' ba rab tu 'phel ba'i myong ba ni ngag las brjod ma shes pa zhig rang red/ de nas nga rang pe cin krung go'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug lte gnas su las kar skyod/ de gar ngas bod kyi rig gnas dang /chos lugs/ lo rgyus sogs kyi shes bya mang po nyan shes thub nas nga ra'i slad kyi gsar rtsom brtsam byar gting tshad dang gnas tshad yong rgyur phan thogs chen po byung / de rjes ngas lo shas ring la 'bad brtson byas nas brtsam sgrung 'bring thung bsdoms grangs bco lnga tsam spel ba dang / gtam brjod zlos gar thung gras dang /dgod bre'i gtam gleng / gzhas tshig sogs mang dag bris nas 'khrab ston byas 356

dka' spyad pa zhig gi gom 'gros/pa dang / rig rtsal skor gyi dpyad gtam gnyis spel ba de'i nang nas 〈lha mo'i 'khrab gzhung gi mi sna'i gzugs brtan skor gleng ba〉 zhes par krung go'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi rig dpyad tshogs 'du'i thog tu bya dga' ang gnyis pa thob byung /rig rtsal gsar rtsom gyi bya ba ni mi rnams kyis yid smon byed cing / yang bya ba der grub 'bras thob mkhan ni ha cang nyung nyung red/ de ni gang lags zer na/gsar rtsom byed mkhan la spyir btang gi skye bo las lhag pa'i rig gnas kun gyi byang tshad ldan dgos pa phud da dung mi gzhan las sdug rus theg pa dang / rtag tu sim dben po'i gnas dang 'grogs pa'i goms gshis dgos/ lhag par du deng skabs mig gis mthong ba'i sar rgyan po 'jog pa dang / 'dus pa lta ba sogs kyi skye bo phal ba'i spyod pas yul khams khengs pa'i skabs la de bas rang gis gcun nas so so'i sems pa'i 'char bkod mngon 'gyur yong bar 'bad rtson byed thub pa dang / gyong gud khyer thub pa/ sdug rus byed thub pa bcas dgos/ deng skabs mi rnams kyis kun dga' bde legs la sngar byung myong med pa'i chags zhen dang 'tshol len byed cing / rig gnas la rdza thang chag nas ha lam spyi tshogs thog tu mi gnas dgos med du gyur ba ltar du snang / 'on kyang mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi don dngos nas rwa sprod byung bar dngos po'i dar rgyas dang / bsam pa'i dar rgyas gnyisaka ni med du mi rung ba zhig yin pa dang / dngos po'i sprang po 357

semasapa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/ myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor/dang / bsam pa'i sprang po ni nyin bzhin 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i spyi tshogs kyis ring du skyur ba'i sprang po rigs gnyis gnas po de red/ nga rang mi rigs kyi rig gnasagong 'phel 'gro phyir rig rtsal gsar rtsom gyi lam bu 'dir skyod rgyu bdams zin pa yin/nga ches dga' ba'i legs bshad ni/ byas pa'i las la grub pa'i 'bras bu dgos/ khong khro skyes pa'i spyod pa/ mi tshe nyi ma gang 'khyol byed pa sogs yin/rang gi rtsom rig nang nas 'dod blo khengs shos ni/ 'das don gyi 'char snang zhes pa de yin/ 'dod blo mi khengs pa ni/ 'gyod sems zhes pa de'o/ /358

dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/k+tapal ṭ+wā+oṃṭ+wāṃ grub rdilagyi gsur+sha 'bum6ban go dang bkra rgyal gyis bsgrigs nga / giṭ+wāṃs da skrun // skyis99laraparasdinabyas/ gyili pe2 snyanarno ga ga chu ba da sgral mas brtsams shang zhang kang nga da skrun khag sa //ṭ+wāṃ2larapar skrun byas/ kyi shisi miri3 brtse dung ga chu gcod pa don grub sabartsams nga khron gas dpe giskrun khaṭ+wāṃ des993larazlorasdu~Xs/4 bo+odakyidengarabasartso+omarigadapetshogasad warto ṭ+wāṃg sgrogo 'gras/5 bad kyi dengarabs rtsam rigadapetshogasad walhasenadrozhanapa6 bodakyideng rabasartsom rig dpe tshogasad wagar gya gdu batsho7 bo+od kyi deng rabs rtso+om rig dpetshogasad ṭ+wā+oṃm s+t+ripyad gto gas8 bad nga ra~Xs ṭ+wāṃmaṭ+wāṃdashigadīdomirinagyaṭ+wāṃdabyangasagido wa 'gyur da sabags nga ma sngan gas da skrun khang sa990rdo/ paro spro/na //ba// kyi 3| muli pe9gis pa nga dan grub sa brtsams nga zhang kang gya nga da skrun khang sa 200lar par skrun byas/0 snulkepo ༈ ṣ+ṭhaṣ+kalkosto oṃṣ+ṭhaṣ+perkiṭhasprajitshelo༈/983ñtsaltaṭha 39

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/ dbyangs can lha mo/mdun shog 'char 'god pa/ karma tshe ring /sems pa'i rtsom gyi lam bu/myong dpyad phra mo'i bsang gtor zhes bya ba/ bde skyid 'tshos rtsom sgrig byas/si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa dang /si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun/si khron ca phram par 'debs 'gan 'khri tshad yod kung sis dpar/2006lo'i zla10par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2006lo'i zla10par par thengs dang po dpar/par grangs/ 0001da 1000dpe rtags/152kho 7—5409—3330—5(1 481dpe rin sgor/ 28 00

cha zlak+ṣedz+ralho 7 ྾k+kok+ṣecha.oṃ4lhoṅgeyolhocha4kā4chiwaṃrmi7snyer+had+dha baṃbyerker+yaṣ+pebheṭhatelko zo nashukotsādzālko74rdzispyo ldirdi dhes4lha zil+lī ( 1/ byu3 khu k+ṣegyi spro r+sha sko ṅkad+ku d+ku sne tre chi 7 sa1cisnyeglu7—5809—3330—5 tsā 1sdu2smo7—5409—3330—5sni1 4819 787580 933302 〉 tshoyi/ 28 00rke
